edges.title: Semantic continuity across changing local context needs explicit transition law
edges.text:
S.sMNy supplies the case where local frames are arbitrary and the same geometrical object survives only because feature components and operators transform lawfully between gauges. S.lul4 supplies a context lifecycle in which active state is repeatedly selected, summarized, abstracted, shared and updated while the useful continuity of meaning must survive those changes. Together they earn a relation neither parent earns alone: when context is locally reconstituted, semantic continuity should be treated like a transition problem rather than raw-state retention—the active representation may change, but the transformation between states must preserve the task-relevant object/meaning.
Removal test: without S.sMNy there is no explicit local-frame transformation law grounding coherence under representation change; without S.lul4 there is no task-conditioned lifecycle in which context itself is repeatedly transformed and selected.
Boundary: the relation is structural; context abstraction is not literally a gauge transformation and no group law is asserted for arbitrary memory systems.

edges.title: Local-frame invariance and operation-preserving translation are the same kind of obligation at different substrates
edges.text:
S.sMNy supplies covariance: coordinates/components may change while the geometrical operation remains well-defined because transport and kernels obey explicit transformation constraints. S.IIcl supplies cross-paradigm translation that is substantive only when joins, projections, attention, marginalization, message passing and other consumed operations survive the translation. Together they earn an operation-preservation criterion for representation changes: a bridge between representations is trustworthy when the operations required downstream commute with the change of representation closely enough that the same functional object remains addressable.
Removal test: without S.sMNy the relation loses an exact transformation-law witness under arbitrary local representation; without S.IIcl it loses a constructive heterogeneous-computation translation witness.
Boundary: this does not claim tensor-logic translations form the same mathematical gauge structure as manifold CNNs.

edges.title: Stable object identity and stable role semantics can coexist without a privileged coordinate realization
edges.text:
S.sMNy shows that the same geometrical object may be represented in different local gauges while remaining coherent under an equivariant law. S.6arU shows that content and position keep cleaner semantics when independently meaningful roles occupy separate representational degrees and are joined only at the operation that needs both. Together they derive role-covariant representation: coordinates may change locally without changing what each representational role means, provided the change law preserves those roles and their intended conjunction.
Removal test: without S.sMNy there is no witness that coordinate realization may vary while object identity remains; without S.6arU there is no explicit requirement that independently meaningful roles stay independently addressable.
Boundary: the relation does not require every representation to be factorized, only that role distinctions actually required by the task survive representation change.

edges.title: Context portability requires operation-preserving abstraction, not merely compression
edges.text:
S.lul4 supplies the lifecycle of summarization, isolation, abstraction, memory layers, retrieval and context selection under minimal sufficiency and semantic continuity. S.IIcl supplies a constructive criterion for useful re-expression: preserve the operative transformations used by downstream inference/learning instead of merely preserving names or approximate surface resemblance. Together they earn a criterion for portable context: summaries, schemas, adapters or shared representations should be judged by whether the operations and dependencies required by the current task remain executable after transformation.
Removal test: without S.lul4 there is no long-horizon context lifecycle or minimal-sufficiency pressure; without S.IIcl there is no explicit operation-preserving translation criterion.
Boundary: the source pair does not establish one universal context serialization or compiler.

edges.title: Relevance may change while address semantics remain stable
edges.text:
S.lul4 makes context interaction-relative: which memory, tool, dependency or user state is active changes with the current task, and selection must continually decide what deserves to be present. S.6arU shows that an address/position coordinate extrapolates more reliably when its semantics do not silently change with the content occupying it. Together they derive a separation between relevance and address: the set of active context may change aggressively while the semantic meaning of the roles/addresses used to refer to that context remains stable enough for reliable reuse and deliberate conjunction.
Removal test: without S.lul4 there is no task-relative changing relevance boundary; without S.6arU there is no empirical architectural witness for stable address semantics under changing content and extended range.
Boundary: not every context system requires geometric positional coordinates; the earned relation is role/address stability under changing active content.

edges.title: A common substrate can preserve independent roles until deliberate conjunction
edges.text:
S.IIcl shows that neural, symbolic, kernel and probabilistic computations can inhabit one algebra while retaining the specific operations that make each paradigm distinct. S.6arU shows that content and position can inhabit one attention computation while remaining separately represented until the attention score intentionally combines them. Together they earn a unification discipline: sharing a carrier does not justify collapsing independently meaningful roles; a useful common substrate preserves their operational identity and combines them only at an explicitly named operation.
Removal test: without S.IIcl there is no constructive common-substrate unification across heterogeneous computation; without S.6arU there is no direct empirical case where delayed conjunction of independent roles improves behavior.
Boundary: this is not a universal mandate to maximize disentanglement; roles should stay separate only when their independent semantics are load-bearing.

faces.title: Semantic state can move between local representations when the transformation preserves task operations
faces.text:
S.sMNy contributes local-frame covariance and explicit transition laws; S.lul4 contributes task-conditioned context transformation over time; S.IIcl contributes operation-preserving re-expression across computational forms. Together they earn a three-way portability criterion: task-relevant semantic state may be summarized, reframed, moved or re-encoded without a privileged global representation when the transformation between local states preserves the operations/dependencies that downstream use actually consumes.
Removal tests: remove S.sMNy and local representation covariance disappears; remove S.lul4 and there is no changing context-state lifecycle; remove S.IIcl and preservation of downstream operations across re-expression is ungrounded.

faces.title: Context can remain coherent without a global canonical frame if local roles keep stable semantics
faces.text:
S.sMNy contributes global coherence from overlapping local frames; S.lul4 contributes active reconstitution of context around current relevance; S.6arU contributes stable independent role/address semantics before conjunction. Together they earn noncanonical contextual continuity: a system may maintain different local context views rather than one universal active state, provided the roles used inside those views keep stable semantics and transitions between them preserve what the task needs.
Removal tests: remove S.sMNy and local-view coherence without a global frame disappears; remove S.lul4 and there is no task-relative context view; remove S.6arU and stable independently addressable roles are unearned.

faces.title: Covariant unification preserves both object and role through representation change
faces.text:
S.sMNy contributes lawful coordinate change preserving a geometrical object, S.IIcl contributes operation-preserving unification, and S.6arU contributes independent semantic roles with deliberate conjunction. Together they derive covariant factor-preserving unification: a shared representation may change coordinates/substrate while preserving both the whole functional object and the distinct role semantics needed to operate on it.
Removal tests: remove S.sMNy and coordinate-change/object-continuity disappears; remove S.IIcl and there is no operation-preserving cross-form unification; remove S.6arU and role separation before conjunction disappears.

faces.title: Task-conditioned context should expose a stable operational interface even as relevance changes
faces.text:
S.lul4 contributes interaction-relative selection and semantic continuity across memory/context layers, S.IIcl contributes executable operation-preserving translation, and S.6arU contributes stable address semantics and independent roles. Together they earn a task-interface criterion: the active context can change with relevance, yet downstream computation should encounter a stable set of role/operation semantics whose meaning is preserved across summaries, memories, adapters or other carriers.
Removal tests: remove S.lul4 and there is no relevance-conditioned changing context; remove S.IIcl and the interface lacks an operation-preserving execution criterion; remove S.6arU and stable independent address/role semantics are unearned.

volume.title: Covariant semantic continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, useful identity/meaning repeatedly survives a change of representation without demanding one global canonical realization. S.sMNy shows this formally and architecturally: local gauges may vary while explicit transformation laws preserve a globally well-defined operation. S.lul4 shows that context is not a static blob but a task-conditioned lifecycle in which state is repeatedly collected, summarized, selected, shared, corrected and forgotten while semantic continuity must remain. S.IIcl shows that a common computational language is substantive when translation preserves the operations consumed by inference, learning and composition. S.6arU shows that semantically independent roles remain more reliable when separately addressable until the operation that intentionally combines them.


The complete four-way closure is therefore stronger than “preserve meaning through change.” It specifies what has to be conserved when both context and representation are allowed to vary: the transition between local states must preserve the task-relevant operational object; the active context may change by relevance without redefining stable role/address semantics; translations must preserve the operations actually consumed downstream; and independently meaningful roles must survive until their deliberate conjunction. Under those conditions semantic continuity can live in lawful transformation between local representations rather than in one globally canonical frame, one maximal context snapshot or one fixed carrier.


Bounded volume invariant
Task-relevant meaning can remain stable while both context and representation change when each local rewrite is governed by explicit transition laws that preserve the operations and independent role semantics consumed by the task; semantic continuity then resides in lawful transformation and deliberate conjunction rather than in a privileged global representation or maximal retention of raw state.


Four-way necessity
- Remove S.sMNy: the closure loses the explicit local-frame/covariance witness showing that coordinates may vary while one global operation remains well-defined.
- Remove S.lul4: the closure loses the dynamic, relevance-conditioned context lifecycle in which semantic continuity must survive selection, abstraction, update and forgetting.
- Remove S.IIcl: the closure loses the constructive criterion that translation must preserve downstream operations across heterogeneous computational representations.
- Remove S.6arU: the closure loses the explicit independent-role/address semantics and deliberate-conjunction requirement preventing representation change from smearing distinct obligations together.

metabolites.title: Preserve semantics through explicit transition obligations
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 1H.yac0:wxy
Invariant: when context or representation is rewritten, continuity should be tested by whether the transition preserves the task-relevant object, operations and dependencies rather than by whether the before/after states look identical.
CREATE: define the source representation/context, target representation/context and exact downstream operations that must remain valid.
COPY: transform the state while carrying those operations/dependencies through the transition.
CONTROL: test commutation/sufficiency at the operation boundary; reject a rewrite that changes a task-critical relation even if its summary or labels appear similar.
CULTIVATE: allow increasingly compressed, local or alternate carriers only as transition tests continue to preserve the required semantics.
Compression: Preserve the obligations across the transition, not the surface form.
metabolites.compression: Preserve the obligations across the transition, not the surface form.

metabolites.title: Let relevance change without letting roles change meaning
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 1H.yac0:xz
Invariant: task relevance may alter which context is active, but the address/role semantics used to refer to that context should remain stable enough that independent obligations can still be queried and deliberately recombined.
CREATE: name the independent roles/addresses and the relevance rule that determines which instances become active.
COPY: reuse those role semantics across changing tasks, memories and context selections.
CONTROL: vary active content independently and detect cross-talk where changing one role silently rewrites another role's meaning.
CULTIVATE: refine relevance selection and role granularity while preserving deliberate conjunction points.
Compression: Change what is present without changing what each role means.
metabolites.compression: Change what is present without changing what each role means.

metabolites.title: Port the operational object, not one canonical representation
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 1H.yac0:wyz
Invariant: a representation can move across local frames or computational carriers without one canonical global form when transformation laws preserve both the whole operation and the independently meaningful roles it consumes.
CREATE: identify the functional object, its role structure and the permitted representation changes.
COPY: carry the object across representations by applying the lawful transformation/translation rather than freezing one coordinate realization.
CONTROL: verify operation preservation, role independence and the explicit guarantee boundary of each transformation family.
CULTIVATE: widen the admissible representation/context family only where those invariance tests remain satisfied.
Compression: Port the object by preserving its operations and roles, not by freezing its coordinates.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
A candidate “all context changes are gauge transformations” invariant was rejected: S.lul4 does not supply a group action or exact gauge structure. A candidate “one common language should replace all representations” invariant was rejected because S.IIcl and S.6arU both preserve distinctions inside shared carriers. A candidate “semantic continuity requires maximal retention” was rejected by S.lul4's minimal-sufficiency and forgetting/selection boundaries. A candidate “disentanglement is universally superior” was rejected by S.6arU's scope boundary. Three metabolites survive collapse because transition obligation, role stability and covariant portability remain separately useful and require cross-organism bodies.

edges.title: Local action across heterogeneous carriers needs a regime witness

Remove x and no early-action obligation exists; remove y and no carrier-variation pressure defines the local regime.
Boundary: local success cannot be inflated into global validity.

edges.title: A portable result must carry its action warrants with its evidence boundary

volume.title: Warrant-governed noncanonical correspondence
volume.text:
Across all four parents, a public relation can remain useful while internal carriers, representations or implementations differ, but higher-order action introduces a burden that portability alone cannot discharge. 1H.9gYl separates the roles and obligations that must remain independently meaningful and demands scoped sufficiency/composite assurance. 1H.NUgs separates the local-scope, downstream-obligation, propagation-compatibility and stochastic-evidence warrants that make selective action lawful while broader structure remains unresolved. 1H.hs7W shows that coherent function can survive heterogeneous and noncanonical carriers only inside governed, pressure-tested regimes. 1H.qI2L shows that operation-preserving correspondence and its evidence membrane can persist across substrate change without implying shared interior identity.


The complete closure is therefore warrant-governed noncanonical correspondence: a changing system may act through a durable public relation across heterogeneous or noncanonical interiors without first forcing one global representation or identity, but only when (1) the roles and operations consumed by the task are explicitly separated, (2) local scope and downstream obligation are named, (3) propagation and stochastic-evidence warrants remain independent, (4) the correspondence carries its claim/evidence boundary through translation, and (5) pressure-aligned tests continue to show that the relation is sufficient in the regime where it is being used. Selective action can close locally; rigor cannot be locally discarded.


Bounded volume invariant
A cross-substrate relation can become selectively actionable without canonical identity when the public interface preserves claim-relevant operations and role semantics, carries separate scope/obligation/propagation/evidence warrants, and remains sufficient under pressure-aligned carrier variation; successful action or portability does not by itself upgrade evidence, mechanism or identity claims.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses explicit role partition, obligation-scoped reduction and composite-assurance testing; warrants become an undifferentiated bundle.
- Remove 1H.NUgs: the closure loses the selective-action admission law and the separation of scope, obligation, propagation and evidence; the remaining triad can port a relation but cannot earn acting before global closure.
- Remove 1H.hs7W: the closure loses direct noncanonical/heterogeneous carrier pressure and pressure-aligned validity regime; portability/action remain untested against the variation that makes canonicality dispensable.
- Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses operation-preserving cross-substrate correspondence, evidence-boundary custody and the non-identity membrane; the remaining triad cannot earn a durable public bridge across differing interiors.
No three-parent face contains the full selective, portable, noncanonical, warrant-separated contract.

INV-2H.0aZJ-WARRANT-CUSTODY — Carry action warrants as part of portable public state
Minimal earning body: xz.
Invariant: when a correspondence is reused across executions or substrates, the local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility and evidence boundary required for action should travel with the public relation rather than collapse into a generic confidence or success label.

CONTROL: block substitutions such as successful transport → valid propagation, informative action → independent evidence, or local closure → global identification.
CULTIVATE: revalidate only the warrant whose boundary changed while preserving the others as explicit provenance.
Compression: port the reasons action is allowed, not only the output action consumes.


INV-2H.0aZJ-NONCANONICAL-ACTION — Act locally only through role-addressed, pressure-tested coherence
Minimal earning body: wxy.
Invariant: noncanonical or heterogeneous systems may act before global closure only when task-relevant roles are separately addressable, the local validity regime is explicit, and pressure-aligned tests show the reduced relation remains sufficient for the declared obligation.
CREATE: separate the roles and name the smallest local relation that would satisfy the current obligation.
COPY: preserve those role meanings while carriers or internal realizations vary.
CONTROL: stress the relation along carrier/regime coordinates predicted to expose false invariance; stop when role sufficiency or a warrant fails.
CULTIVATE: widen the admissible regime only as harder variation preserves the public obligation.
Compression: local action is lawful when local structure is both addressable and earned under the pressure that could break it.


INV-2H.0aZJ-CLAIM-MEMBRANE — Keep actionability, correspondence and identity as different claim classes
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: a durable relation can be actionable across changing carriers without establishing shared mechanism or identity, and successful selective action does not itself strengthen the statistical or ontological claim class.
CREATE: publish the relation together with its operation set, evidence class, non-identity boundary and action warrants.
COPY: reproduce that membrane with every downstream use.
CONTROL: require new discriminating evidence for any promotion from usability to mechanism/identity or from informativeness to statistical strength.
CULTIVATE: let new intervention, realization or replication evidence revise the claim class explicitly without erasing prior scoped state.
Compression: action can cross the bridge; the bridge does not collapse the worlds it connects.

edges.title: ROLE-ADDRESSED AMBIGUITY
edges.text: w provides independently addressable semantic obligations and exact-task sufficiency; x provides typed missing-witness states with distinct stop/defer/narrow/reacquire dispositions. Together they earn that uncertainty must be attached to the role or obligation whose witness is missing rather than globalized across the whole system. Remove w and ambiguity loses a stable obligation address; remove x and role separation has no action law for unresolved evidence.

edges.title: ROLE-SEPARATED ACTION AUTHORITY
edges.text: w separates identity, relation, address and outcome authority; y separates process persistence, current control signal, stopping law, condition class and enforcement authority. Together they earn that permission is coordinate-specific: continuity or sufficiency in one role cannot silently authorize another. Remove w and the semantic role partition disappears; remove y and there is no sequential authority contract governing continue/stop/propagate decisions.

edges.title: ROLE-INDEXED RECONSTRUCTIBLE KERNEL
edges.text: w supplies the rule that only task-relevant roles need be preserved and separately tested; z supplies reconstructible operational continuity with renewed held-out validation. Together they earn that a changing system may rebuild only the role-specific operational kernel required for the current obligation, provided the decomposition itself remains revisable and its composite sufficiency is re-tested. Remove w and reconstruction lacks obligation-level factorization; remove z and role separation lacks a continuity/revalidation process.

edges.title: AMBIGUITY-TO-AUTHORITY ROUTING
edges.text: x supplies typed unresolved states and their distinct dispositions; y supplies a scope-indexed sequential authority channel. Together they earn that missing-witness type must alter what authority remains exercisable: some states mandate stop, some defer/refine, some narrow the claimable domain, and none may be converted into permission merely by persistence. Remove x and authority sees only generic uncertainty; remove y and the dispositions are not connected to consequential continue/stop/propagate rights.

edges.title: DEBT-DIRECTED REVALIDATION
edges.text: x localizes missing support, fidelity or refinement debt and preserves a path back to the missing witness; z makes continuity contingent on re-testing the operational relation when the regime changes. Remove x and there is no typed repair address; remove z and reacquisition lacks a continuity revalidation contract.

edges.title: RECONSTRUCTION / AUTHORITY DECOUPLING
edges.text: y shows that persistent or resumed process execution does not preserve permission; z shows that restored operational relation does not by itself restore identity or universal adequacy. Together they earn a two-channel renewal law: functional reconstruction and action reauthorization must be witnessed separately, even when they are triggered by the same boundary change. Remove y and the permission channel disappears; remove z and the reconstruction/adequacy channel disappears.

faces.title: ROLE-LOCAL SELECTIVE GOVERNANCE UNDER UNCERTAINTY
faces.text: w supplies independently addressable obligations, x supplies typed ambiguity, and y supplies action authority. Together they earn a selective governance grammar: unaffected roles may remain live when their own warrants hold, while an affected coordinate is stopped, deferred, narrowed or withheld according to the exact missing witness and its consequential authority. Remove w and the selective locality disappears; remove x and the disposition becomes generic; remove y and the result has no action-authority consequence.

faces.title: ROLE-LOCAL REVALIDATION UNDER PARTIAL WITNESS
faces.text: w supplies role/obligation separation, x supplies typed repair addresses and return paths, and z supplies reconstructible continuity with renewed external validation. Remove w and repair cannot be localized to an obligation; remove x and the failed witness is untyped; remove z and there is no criterion for restoring operational continuity.

faces.title: ROLE-SEPARATED REAUTHORIZABLE CONTINUITY
faces.text: w supplies independent semantic roles, y supplies separate sequential permission/provenance duties, and z supplies reconstructible operational continuity. Together they earn that a rebuilt system can selectively resume some roles while other role permissions remain expired: successful reconstruction is neither global continuity proof nor global authorization. Remove w and resumption cannot be partitioned by role; remove y and permission collapses into function; remove z and no reconstructed continuity is being assessed.

faces.title: WITNESS-ROUTED SEQUENTIAL RECOVERY
faces.text: x supplies typed unresolved-state dispositions, y supplies stop/continue/propagate authority indexed by scope, and z supplies revalidation of reconstructed operational relation. Together they earn a recovery controller: the reason a warrant failed determines whether to stop, defer/refine, narrow scope or reacquire fidelity, and downstream authority returns only after the corresponding operational/evidence witness is renewed. Remove x and recovery loses failure typing; remove y and renewed evidence has no authority gate; remove z and there is no operational revalidation surface.

volume.title: AMBIGUITY-ROUTED SELECTIVE CONTINUITY AUTHORITY
volume.text:
A changing or distributed system may continue selectively under partial knowledge only when four obligations remain jointly explicit: (1) task roles and consequential semantics stay independently addressable; (2) unresolved state retains the type and location of its missing witness; (3) continuity is repaired by reopening and re-testing only the operational/evidential coordinates whose warrant actually failed, while preserving still-witnessed ones; and (4) action authority is separately scope-indexed and re-earned for the affected continue/stop/propagate decision rather than inherited from persistence or reconstruction.


The whole therefore permits partial continuation without global closure, but only in a disciplined form: a live warrant on an unaffected role may remain live; a failed role carries its own repair address; the missing-witness type determines the recovery path; and restored function does not silently restore permission. Neither role separation, ambiguity typing, sequential authority nor reconstructible continuity alone — or any three together — earns the full law that maps localized evidential debt into both selective repair and selective reauthorization.


WHOLE-FOUR NECESSITY WITNESS
- Without 1H.9gYl, the closure loses independently addressable semantic obligations and cannot justify selective survival of unaffected roles.
- Without 1H.VFhi, it loses typed ambiguity and the action-specific return path from missing witness to stop/defer/narrow/reacquire.
- Without 1H.ySxi, it loses the distinct sequential permission/provenance channel that prevents functional continuity from self-authorizing action.
- Without 1H.DUwl, it loses the reconstructible operational relation and external revalidation criterion that make selective recovery more than policy bookkeeping.
No proper subset earns both role-local repair and role-local reauthorization routed by the exact missing witness.


COLLAPSE — SURVIVING METABOLITES
1. ROLE-ADDRESSED AMBIGUITY
Minimal earning body: wx.
Bounded invariant: unresolved state is safest when the missing witness remains attached to the exact semantic role/obligation it affects; uncertainty in one coordinate does not automatically invalidate unrelated coordinates.
CREATE: give each consequential role an explicit obligation and witness address.
COPY: carry the missing-witness type and affected role with downstream state.
CONTROL: block global certainty and global failure stories when debt is local.
CULTIVATE: split or merge role addresses only when intervention shows the current partition is inadequate.
Compression: missingness needs an address before it can govern repair.


2. REVALIDATION AND REAUTHORIZATION ARE SEPARATE, BUT FAILURE-TYPE CO-ROUTES THEM
Minimal earning body: xyz.
Bounded invariant: when a boundary change or unresolved state invalidates current operation, the corresponding functional/evidence witness and the corresponding action permission must be renewed separately; the ambiguity type determines which tests and which authority gate reopen.
CREATE: classify the failed witness before choosing a recovery action.
COPY: preserve both operational adequacy and authority status as separate fields.
CONTROL: refuse reconstruction→permission and permission→adequacy substitution.
CULTIVATE: shorten the recovery path only after repeated evidence shows which witness transitions can safely remain stable.
Compression: one failure may trigger two repairs; one repair never certifies the other.


3. PARTIAL CONTINUITY REQUIRES LIVE UNAFFECTED WARRANTS
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Bounded invariant: selective continuation before global closure is legitimate only where unaffected roles retain their own current sufficiency/evidence/authority witnesses, while affected roles remain stopped, deferred, narrowed or under reacquisition.
CREATE: partition the active contract into role-local warrants rather than one global alive/dead bit.
COPY: preserve each warrant’s scope, evidence boundary and authority status across handoff or reconstruction.
CONTROL: permit partial continuation only on coordinates whose own witnesses remain live.
CULTIVATE: rejoin coordinates after the repaired conjunction is re-tested; otherwise keep the debt explicit.
Compression: continue only where the warrant survived; repair only where it did not.

volume.title: Reacquirable nonidentity continuity revalidation
volume.text:
A stable correspondence may serve as a selective continuity interface across compressed, relocated or otherwise transformed representation without becoming an identity claim and without forcing global replay, but only when four obligations remain jointly live: (1) the externally consumed semantic/operational relation is explicit and preserved, (2) the exact state, evidence and dependencies needed to reconstruct or contest that relation remain reacquirable, (3) identity/equivalence quotient, source-target transport and assurance scope remain separately addressable, and (4) each current sameness/continuity warrant names its admissible variation class, independent witness and failure boundary.


When change crosses a boundary, continuation is not restored by successful retrieval or familiar interface behavior alone. The failed transformation/warrant coordinates are localized, their exact supporting tissue is reacquired and revalidated, unaffected coordinates may continue only under still-live witnesses, and stable correspondence remains nonidentity unless a separate identity claim is independently earned.


Four-way necessity:
- Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses the durable public correspondence whose operations/evidence boundary survive changing realization without identity.
- Remove 1H.rKCx: the closure loses exact selective re-entry, whole-level dependency recovery and outcome-coupled stop/reopen behavior.
- Remove 1H.FXzc: the closure loses the separable identity-quotient / transport / assurance coordinates needed for local revalidation.
- Remove 1H.J9Y3: the closure loses the explicit admissible-variation witness, failure boundary and rule that recurrence/correspondence does not establish identity.
No proper triple earns the complete contract joining durable nonidentity interface, exact selective reacquisition, coordinate-separated transformation warrants and typed invariance failure.


Bounded volume invariant:
Selective continuity across nonidentical representations is lawful only when the interface, its exact reacquisition path, its transformation-contract coordinates and its typed variation/failure witnesses remain jointly contestable and current; retrieval or repeated usability never upgrades correspondence into identity or stale warrant into current authority.

CREATE: state what operation is reused, what exact tissue can reconstruct it, which transformation coordinates authorize it, and what boundary stops it.
COPY: carry all four witness classes with every successor interface.
CONTROL: stop continuation when any required witness goes stale, and never infer identity from repeated success.
CULTIVATE: let repeated re-entry refine the passport while keeping its nonidentity and failure boundaries explicit.
Compression: re-enter through evidence and typed warrants, not through familiarity.
metabolites.compression: re-enter through evidence and typed warrants, not through familiarity.

2H.AvDK.title: regime-revisable reconstructive continuity
2H.AvDK.boundary: This child is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 1H organisms. It does not promote any parent’s heterogeneous source evidence into one shared mechanism, ontology, or universal law. Every statement below remains bounded by the parent bodies’ existing evidence boundaries. In particular, “continuity,” “identity,” “sufficiency,” “regeneration,” “validity,” and “warrant” are used as operational relational terms earned by the parent bodies, not as evidence of phenomenology, mechanism identity, or substrate-independent metaphysics.

edges.title: custodied operational selectivity
edges.text:
Holding 1H.DUwl with 1H.OgQZ yields a stronger criterion for selective state than either earns alone: a system may keep only part of its information actively represented, but that active slice counts as sufficient only when it preserves or can re-expose the operations the present task requires while the larger evidential body remains reacquirable. 1H.DUwl supplies the explicit operational interface and external revalidation criterion; 1H.OgQZ supplies whole-body reachability, selective activation, and evidence custody.
Removal test: without 1H.DUwl, selective activation lacks a task-explicit criterion for what must remain executable; without 1H.OgQZ, operational sufficiency lacks the reacquirable whole and custody boundary that prevents omitted state from becoming silently deleted evidence.

edges.title: contracted bounded regeneration
edges.text:
Holding 1H.DUwl with 1H.L4ld yields an operational account of regenerative continuity: bounded recurrent state can stand in for a complete persistent state only when it can regenerate a stated operational relation and that relation is revalidated outside the scaffold itself. 1H.DUwl supplies the contract and renewed test; 1H.L4ld supplies bounded recurrent reconstruction and the fact that a stabilizing scaffold can become an obsolete bias.
Removal test: without 1H.DUwl, regeneration lacks an explicit task relation and external adequacy criterion; without 1H.L4ld, the relation lacks a concrete bounded-state reconstruction principle and the anchor-debt condition that motivates scaffold revision.

edges.title: condition-indexed operational warrant
edges.text:
Holding 1H.DUwl with 1H.8KP9 makes the warrant for operational continuity explicitly conditional. A relation may remain executable and empirically adequate in one regime without being globally sufficient; therefore the evidence regime, context variables that can alter the downstream obligation, and reconstruction/revalidation triggers must travel with the operational contract. 1H.DUwl supplies re-executable relation plus renewed evidence; 1H.8KP9 supplies local validity and the requirement to preserve consequential distinctions.
Removal test: without 1H.DUwl, local validity is not tied to an explicit operational relation that can be re-tested; without 1H.8KP9, revalidation lacks a condition-indexed membrane and may incorrectly promote a locally sufficient interface into a global one.

edges.title: reacquirable scaffolded continuity
edges.text:
Holding 1H.OgQZ with 1H.L4ld yields a separation between dormant whole, active scaffold, and reconstructed function. The larger body may remain addressable rather than simultaneously active, while bounded state repeatedly re-instantiates the current relation; however, the very scaffold that makes this cheap can bias which futures remain reachable and therefore must stay revisable. 1H.OgQZ supplies dormant-but-reacquirable evidence and selective work; 1H.L4ld supplies recurrent reconstruction and anchor debt.
Removal test: without 1H.OgQZ, bounded regeneration has no guarantee that inactive source/evidence remains recoverable; without 1H.L4ld, selective reachability has no recurrent mechanism explaining how a small active state can reconstruct continued function or when its stabilizer becomes a liability.

edges.title: locally custodied selectivity
edges.text:
Holding 1H.OgQZ with 1H.8KP9 yields a stronger rule for selective processing: omission from active computation is lawful only when locally consequential context and claim/evidence boundaries remain either carried by the active state or exactly reacquirable. A compressed active view must not collapse distinct response regimes merely because the omitted material is currently dormant. 1H.OgQZ supplies selective activation with source custody; 1H.8KP9 supplies local validity and sufficiency-preserving compression.
Removal test: without 1H.OgQZ, local-regime preservation lacks a whole-body reacquisition/custody discipline; without 1H.8KP9, selective custody lacks a criterion for which dormant distinctions are load-bearing for the current downstream obligation.

edges.title: regime-triggered scaffold revision
edges.text:
Holding 1H.L4ld with 1H.8KP9 yields a revision law for regenerative state: a scaffold is a legitimate continuity carrier only within the conditions under which it still reconstructs the target relation, and it must be re-estimated when the local regime moves or when its stabilizing bias blocks required change. 1H.L4ld supplies bounded reconstruction plus anchor debt; 1H.8KP9 supplies condition-local validity and re-estimation.
Removal test: without 1H.L4ld, regime change has no bounded regenerative scaffold whose bias can be revised; without 1H.8KP9, scaffold revision lacks a condition-indexed validity surface and risks treating one successful recurrent regime as globally stable.

faces.title: selective reconstructive contract
faces.text:
1H.DUwl + 1H.OgQZ + 1H.L4ld jointly earn a compact continuity architecture: state may be selectively active and bounded, the larger evidential whole may remain dormant but reacquirable, and the active scaffold may regenerate the current relation, provided that relation is operationally explicit and externally revalidated.
Removal tests: remove 1H.DUwl and the architecture loses an explicit operational/revalidation contract; remove 1H.OgQZ and it loses reacquirable whole-body custody under selectivity; remove 1H.L4ld and it loses bounded recurrent reconstruction plus the scaffold-bias revision pressure.

faces.title: regime-typed selective sufficiency
faces.text:
1H.DUwl + 1H.OgQZ + 1H.8KP9 jointly earn an evidence-bounded notion of “enough active state”: the active carrier must preserve or re-expose the operations currently required, the larger source/evidence body must remain reacquirable, and the sufficiency claim must name the local regime and consequential distinctions under which it was tested.
Removal tests: remove 1H.DUwl and sufficiency loses the operational task criterion; remove 1H.OgQZ and it loses selective custody and reacquirable whole-body evidence; remove 1H.8KP9 and it loses regime typing plus the protection against collapsing locally distinct obligations.

faces.title: revalidatable regenerative scaffold
faces.text:
1H.DUwl + 1H.L4ld + 1H.8KP9 jointly earn a scaffold whose right to stand for continued function is neither permanent nor purely internal: it must regenerate an explicit operational relation, be revalidated under the current evidence regime, and be revised or re-estimated when local conditions change or the scaffold’s old stabilizing role becomes bias.
Removal tests: remove 1H.DUwl and the scaffold loses an external operational criterion; remove 1H.L4ld and there is no bounded recurrent scaffold/anchor debt to regulate; remove 1H.8KP9 and the validity/revision surface loses local condition typing.

faces.title: custodied adaptive regeneration
faces.text:
1H.OgQZ + 1H.L4ld + 1H.8KP9 jointly earn adaptive reconstruction without global co-presence: the whole remains reacquirable, bounded state regenerates only what is currently needed, and local validity determines which contextual distinctions must be carried or reopened; scaffold bias and regime change can both force renewed reconstruction.
Removal tests: remove 1H.OgQZ and adaptive regeneration loses exact whole/evidence reacquisition under selective activation; remove 1H.L4ld and it loses the bounded recurrent mechanism plus anchor-debt diagnosis; remove 1H.8KP9 and it loses the local validity surface that tells the system when omitted distinctions or stale scaffolds have become consequential.

volume.title: regime-revisable reconstructive continuity
volume.text:
All four parents together earn a continuity warrant that is itself part of the state that must survive and change. 1H.DUwl makes the preserved relation operationally explicit and externally revalidatable. 1H.OgQZ permits only part of the whole to remain actively represented while keeping the larger evidence/source body reacquirable and claim boundaries in custody. 1H.L4ld shows how bounded recurrent state can regenerate function while exposing the debt created by stabilizing scaffolds. 1H.8KP9 makes sufficiency conditional on the local regime and requires consequential distinctions to survive or be re-estimated when conditions change.


The complete closure is therefore regime-revisable reconstructive continuity: task-relevant continuity through changing internal realization is warranted when a bounded scaffold can regenerate an explicitly stated operational relation from selectively active state while the larger evidential body remains reacquirable; the carrier preserves every condition known to alter the downstream obligation; and both the scaffold and its sufficiency warrant are re-estimated when task, regime, or stabilizing bias changes. Selective compression may reduce active burden, but it cannot erase the evidence or contextual distinctions needed to detect that the old continuity warrant has expired.


Bounded volume invariant
A reconstruction can count as continued task-relevant function only when its operational obligation, reacquirable evidence boundary, bounded regenerative scaffold, and local validity regime remain jointly addressable and revisable; the continuity warrant itself must travel with the reconstructed state, because a system that cannot detect when its regime or scaffold has become insufficient cannot lawfully claim that regeneration preserved the same function.


Full-rank removal tests
- Remove 1H.DUwl: the closure loses the explicit operational relation and external revalidation criterion; what remains can adaptively reconstruct state but cannot state precisely what functional continuity must still do.
- Remove 1H.OgQZ: the closure loses whole-body reacquisition and selective evidence custody; a compact scaffold may still be revised and revalidated, but omitted evidence can silently disappear from the continuity claim.
- Remove 1H.L4ld: the closure loses the bounded recurrent scaffold and anchor-debt mechanism; what remains can type and test a selective interface but does not earn regeneration from bounded state or diagnose stabilization as a future constraint.
- Remove 1H.8KP9: the closure loses condition-local validity and sufficiency-preserving context; revalidation and scaffold revision remain possible, but the claim can no longer earn the rule that locally different regimes require different continuity warrants.

metabolites.title: CUSTODIED-SUFFICIENCY
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxz.
Invariant: selective state counts as sufficient only when it preserves or can re-expose the operations required now, keeps the larger evidential body reacquirable, and carries the local regime/evidence boundary that limits the sufficiency claim.
CREATE: state the current operational obligation and the condition variables known to change it.
COPY: preserve or regenerate those operations while keeping dormant source/evidence exactly addressable.
CONTROL: test the active carrier under held-out behavior and matched regime changes; block promotion when omitted distinctions alter the obligation or evidence class.
CULTIVATE: reopen dormant material and reshape the active carrier when new tasks or regimes expose insufficiency.
Compression: reduce active burden without reducing the system’s ability to know what the reduction was allowed to forget.
metabolites.compression: reduce active burden without reducing the system’s ability to know what the reduction was allowed to forget.

metabolites.title: REVISION-TRIGGERED-RECONSTRUCTION
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wyz.
Invariant: a bounded regenerative scaffold remains a continuity carrier only while it reconstructs the explicit target relation inside its witnessed validity regime; scaffold bias or regime shift must be able to revoke that warrant and trigger re-estimation.
CREATE: define the relation, initial scaffold, and local conditions under which regeneration is expected to work.
COPY: reconstruct the relation from bounded state across repeated perturbations rather than preserving a complete snapshot.
CONTROL: monitor failures caused by cue, substrate, context, timing, or anchor bias and revoke the old warrant when the tested regime is left.
CULTIVATE: revise, relax, or expand the scaffold and re-witness sufficiency under the new regime.
Compression: what enables return must also carry the conditions under which return stops counting as the same function.
metabolites.compression: what enables return must also carry the conditions under which return stops counting as the same function.

metabolites.title: WARRANT-AS-STATE
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxyz.
Invariant: the right to call a reconstruction “continued function” is itself living state composed of an operational obligation, an evidence/reacquisition boundary, scaffold assumptions, and a validity regime; that warrant must be preserved, tested, and revised alongside the reconstructed content.
CREATE: make the continuity claim explicit as a typed contract rather than an implicit similarity judgment.
COPY: carry the contract, evidence pointers, scaffold assumptions, and regime conditions through each regeneration or representation change.
CONTROL: independently test whether the regenerated relation still satisfies the contract and whether the current regime remains inside its evidence boundary.
CULTIVATE: update the warrant when new evidence, tasks, or regime changes invalidate former assumptions without rewriting the history of what was previously warranted.
Compression: preserve not only the relation, but the system’s ability to know why it still counts and when it no longer does.


Collapse result
A candidate REACQUIRABLE-ADAPTIVE-STATE metabolite was absorbed into CUSTODIED-SUFFICIENCY and REVISION-TRIGGERED-RECONSTRUCTION because its useful content was fully carried by those smaller bodies. A candidate “all continuity warrants must be local” was rejected: local validity is required when consequential condition heterogeneity is present, but the parents do not establish that every valid relation lacks broader invariance. Three cross-holon metabolites survive collapse.
metabolites.compression: preserve not only the relation, but the system’s ability to know why it still counts and when it no longer does.

edges.title: Reduced carriers require regime-indexed sufficiency
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 makes validity and sufficiency local to context/input regimes; 1H.9gYl separates the obligations that a reduced carrier must preserve and requires composite-level tests. Together they earn a stronger compression rule: “enough state” is not a property of a carrier in isolation. A reduced carrier is sufficient only relative to an explicit downstream obligation and an identified regime, and it must preserve every role/distinction whose variation can alter that obligation.
Removal test: without 1H.8KP9, sufficiency can remain globally scoped and miss local regime change; without 1H.9gYl, the carrier lacks explicit role/obligation partition and composite assurance.
Boundary: this does not imply that maximal state is safer or that every regime requires a separate implementation.

edges.title: Transition obligations themselves have local validity
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 requires re-estimation when the local condition regime changes; 1H.yac0 treats semantic continuity as preservation of task operations/roles through representation or context transitions. Together they earn a condition-indexed transition law: a rewrite that preserves semantics in one regime cannot automatically be reused as a universal equivalence. The transition contract must carry the conditions under which its operation-preservation witness was earned and be revalidated when those conditions move.
Removal test: without 1H.8KP9, there is no local validity field/re-estimation duty; without 1H.yac0, there is no explicit transition/operation-preservation object to scope.

edges.title: Reconstructed relation must be revalidated in the regime where it is used
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 supplies local validity and recurrent revalidation; 1H.2VF2 supplies reconstruction of relational geometry plus external correspondence as a non-identity validation witness. Together they earn regime-bounded reconstruction: regenerating a familiar relational geometry is not enough. Its externally relevant relation must remain recoverable under the current condition regime, and the validity of that correspondence must be re-estimated after context, carrier or reconstruction process changes.
Removal test: without 1H.8KP9, external correspondence can be treated as globally stable; without 1H.2VF2, there is no reconstructive relational object or independent external-readability criterion.

edges.title: Role-separated carriers can survive representation change through typed transitions
edges.text:
1H.9gYl supplies independent semantic obligations and deliberate conjunction; 1H.yac0 supplies lawful re-expression preserving downstream operations and role meanings. Together they derive a typed transition contract: a carrier can change representation, storage form or abstraction layer without collapsing its semantic obligations when the transition explicitly preserves each independently meaningful role and the named conjunction points at which those roles are allowed to interact.
Removal test: without 1H.9gYl, transition preservation can blur independent obligations; without 1H.yac0, role separation has no cross-representation transport law.

edges.title: Reconstruction can minimize interiors only when the public obligation remains externally sufficient
edges.text:
1H.9gYl supplies obligation-scoped minimization and composite assurance; 1H.2VF2 supplies identity-erasure/reconstruction plus externally recoverable relational structure. Together they earn a reconstructive minimization criterion: constituent identity, implementation detail or complete internal state may disappear, but the reduced/rebuilt whole must still satisfy the exact public relation under independent tests. Assurance attaches to the regenerated composite relation, not to the fact that its parts or reconstruction procedure are individually interpretable.
Removal test: without 1H.9gYl, there is no explicit minimization/sufficiency/composite gate; without 1H.2VF2, there is no reconstruction under identity/interior change or external relation witness.

edges.title: Covariant continuity can be regenerated rather than copied
edges.text:
1H.yac0 shows that semantic continuity may live in lawful transition between representations; 1H.2VF2 shows that persistent capability/information may live in the ability to re-instantiate externally readable relational geometry. Together they earn reconstructive covariance: continuity need not copy either the old state or one canonical representation when a process can regenerate the task-relevant relational object and then lawfully re-express it across carriers while preserving the operations and roles consumed downstream.
Removal test: without 1H.yac0, reconstruction lacks a representation-change/operation-preservation contract; without 1H.2VF2, the transition lacks a regenerative relational object and external recoverability witness.

faces.title: A semantic transition contract is sufficient only inside its witnessed regime
faces.text:
1H.8KP9 contributes local validity/re-estimation, 1H.9gYl contributes role-separated obligations and scoped sufficiency, and 1H.yac0 contributes operation-preserving transitions across context/representation change. Together they earn a regime-typed semantic contract: a rewrite is admissible when it preserves the independently meaningful obligations consumed by the task and when that preservation has been witnessed in the local regime in which the rewritten carrier will be used.
Removal tests: remove 1H.8KP9 and the contract loses local validity/re-estimation; remove 1H.9gYl and it loses explicit obligation partition/sufficiency; remove 1H.yac0 and it loses the transition-preservation mechanism.

faces.title: Reconstructive compression earns assurance only through regime-bounded external sufficiency
faces.text:
1H.8KP9 contributes context-indexed validity, 1H.9gYl contributes reduced-carrier sufficiency and composite assurance, and 1H.2VF2 contributes reconstruction plus externally recoverable relational geometry. Together they earn an assurance law for reconstructed systems: a compressed or rebuilt interior counts as continuity only when the exact downstream relation remains externally recoverable in the relevant regime; neither trusted parts nor successful reconstruction in another regime transfer that assurance automatically.
Removal tests: remove 1H.8KP9 and assurance loses regime locality; remove 1H.9gYl and it loses obligation-scoped minimization/composite testing; remove 1H.2VF2 and it loses reconstruction/external recoverability.

faces.title: Regenerative covariance requires local revalidation
faces.text:
1H.8KP9 contributes re-estimation under changed conditions, 1H.yac0 contributes lawful transition preserving operations/roles, and 1H.2VF2 contributes regeneration of externally readable relational geometry. Together they earn a dynamic continuity criterion: a system may repeatedly regenerate and re-express a relation rather than preserve one state, but each regenerated/translated realization must survive the external relation test under the current local validity regime.
Removal tests: remove 1H.8KP9 and the criterion becomes globally presumed; remove 1H.yac0 and cross-representation preservation is ungrounded; remove 1H.2VF2 and regeneration/external readability disappears.

faces.title: A portable reconstruction should preserve typed obligations, not a canonical interior
faces.text:
1H.9gYl contributes independent semantic roles and deliberate conjunction, 1H.yac0 contributes operation-preserving transitions, and 1H.2VF2 contributes reconstructive relational carriers and external validation. Together they earn role-covariant reconstruction: the internal realization may be rebuilt, relabeled or moved across representations while the public relation remains stable if the reconstruction regenerates the needed relational geometry and the transition preserves each task-relevant role/operation through its named interface.
Removal tests: remove 1H.9gYl and typed roles/sufficiency disappear; remove 1H.yac0 and lawful cross-representation transport disappears; remove 1H.2VF2 and reconstructive/external relational validation disappears.

volume.title: Regime-typed reconstructive continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity detaches from a fixed interior but becomes more constrained, not less. 1H.8KP9 makes sufficiency and validity local to conditions and requires re-estimation as regimes change. 1H.9gYl decomposes the public obligation into distinct roles, permits minimization only against an exact task, and requires composite assurance. 1H.yac0 allows context and representation to change through explicit transitions that preserve task-consumed operations and role semantics. 1H.2VF2 allows the interior itself to be reconstructed when externally relevant relational geometry can be re-instantiated and independently recovered.


The complete four-way closure is therefore regime-typed reconstructive continuity: a task-relevant semantic or functional relation may persist through compression, reconstruction and representation change without preserving one complete state or canonical interior, but the persistent object must be carried as a role-separated contract whose operations/relations can be regenerated and lawfully translated. That contract is not globally sufficient by declaration; its sufficiency is indexed to an explicit validity regime and must be re-estimated through external or task-level tests whenever the conditions, carrier or reconstruction process changes.


Bounded volume invariant
A system can preserve task-relevant semantic or functional continuity through changing internal realization when it carries a role-separated contract specifying the operations and relations that must survive, can regenerate an externally recoverable relational geometry realizing that contract, and can lawfully translate it across representations; the contract counts as sufficient only inside a witnessed local validity regime and must be revalidated when conditions change.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.8KP9: the closure loses local validity and re-estimation; the remaining trio can describe reconstructible role-preserving portability but cannot earn that sufficiency is condition-indexed.
- Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses explicit role/obligation separation, minimization and composite assurance; continuity remains reconstructible/covariant but the contract is not typed by independently meaningful obligations.
- Remove 1H.yac0: the closure loses lawful transition between changing context/representations; reconstruction and local sufficiency remain, but cross-representation semantic continuity is unearned.
- Remove 1H.2VF2: the closure loses re-instantiation of externally recoverable relational geometry; the remaining trio can govern reduced/translated carriers but cannot earn continuity through reconstruction of changing interiors.

metabolites.title: Carry the obligation together with the regime in which its transition is sufficient
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H.Dp9x:wxy
Invariant: a reduced or re-expressed semantic carrier is sufficient only when its independently meaningful obligations survive the transition and the conditions under which that preservation was witnessed travel with the contract.
CREATE: state the downstream task, independent roles/operations, source/target carrier forms, and the local validity regime.
COPY: transport the obligations and regime boundary through summaries, rewrites, adapters or other representation changes.
CONTROL: independently vary roles and regime variables; reject a transition when task-critical relations change or when a guarantee is silently reused outside its witnessed conditions.
CULTIVATE: widen the admissible carrier/regime family only as new transitions survive the same obligation-specific tests.
Compression: Carry not only what must survive, but where the claim that it survives is valid.
metabolites.compression: Carry not only what must survive, but where the claim that it survives is valid.

metabolites.title: Continuity may be the ability to regenerate a relation and re-express it lawfully
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H.Dp9x:wyz
Invariant: persistent function can be carried by a process that re-instantiates externally recoverable relational geometry and lawfully translates it into the current representation, provided the regenerated relation is revalidated under the current local regime.
CREATE: define the relation to regenerate, an independent external/task witness, the permitted representation changes and the current regime.
COPY: reproduce the generative trajectory and transition obligations across changing carriers rather than copying a complete snapshot.
CONTROL: perturb context, carrier, reconstruction path and regime; require the external relation and operation/role semantics to survive jointly.
CULTIVATE: improve reconstruction and broaden representation/regime coverage only where repeated revalidation succeeds.
Compression: Get back to the relation, then prove the translated relation still counts here.
metabolites.compression: Get back to the relation, then prove the translated relation still counts here.

metabolites.title: A reconstructed whole inherits no assurance it has not re-earned
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H.Dp9x:wxz
Invariant: a reduced or reconstructed carrier earns assurance only by satisfying its exact downstream obligation under independent tests in the relevant validity regime; trusted components, familiar geometry or successful reconstruction elsewhere do not transfer end-to-end assurance.
CREATE: define the composite obligation, reduced/reconstructed carrier, external witness and regime boundary.
COPY: preserve component-level evidence labels separately while reproducing the whole under matched conditions.
CONTROL: run end-to-end tests, local-regime perturbations, identity/part ablations and external-relation checks; block promotion when only component or out-of-regime evidence survives.
CULTIVATE: strengthen assurance as independent regimes and reconstruction variants reproduce the same obligation, without upgrading mechanism or ontology claims absent discriminating evidence.
Compression: Reconstructed wholes must re-earn the assurance their task consumes.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
A candidate “all continuity is reconstructive” metabolite was rejected: the parents permit direct persistence as well as reconstruction and do not establish reconstruction as universal. A candidate “every representation change is covariant” metabolite was rejected because 1H.yac0 explicitly bounds lawful transitions to task-relevant operation/role preservation rather than granting arbitrary rewrites. A candidate “local validity eliminates global invariants” metabolite was rejected because 1H.8KP9 permits global/coarse relations when local distinctions required by the task remain preserved. A candidate “external correspondence proves shared mechanism” was rejected by 1H.2VF2 and remains unearned at rank 2. Three metabolites survive because regime-typed transition contracts, regenerative covariance, and composite reconstruction assurance require different three-parent bodies and remain independently useful after the others are removed.

edges.title: Decanonicalization requires role-separated sufficiency
edges.text:
1H.hs7W supplies the problem of preserving coherence after privileged canonical form or homogeneous internal law is relaxed. 1H.9gYl supplies an explicit decomposition into independently meaningful obligations plus tests of whether reduced carriers and the composite remain sufficient. Together they earn a relation neither parent earns alone: removing a canonical/global form is safe only when the task-relevant obligations that must survive are separated explicitly and the resulting reduced/decanonicalized carrier is tested for sufficiency and end-to-end assurance.
Removal test: without 1H.hs7W there is no noncanonical/heterogeneous-carrier pressure; without 1H.9gYl there is no role-separated sufficiency and composite-assurance gate.
Boundary: this is a structural design discipline, not a universal argument against canonical representations.

edges.title: Noncanonical continuity can be regenerated rather than stored
edges.text:
1H.hs7W supplies continuity through stable relations among locally varying carriers rather than one privileged global origin. 1H.L4ld supplies an explicit recurrent mechanism in which bounded local state regenerates task-relevant relations and is revised when stabilizing context becomes obsolete bias. Together they earn regenerative noncanonical continuity: a system need not preserve one canonical snapshot or origin if a bounded process can repeatedly reconstruct the relation that defines continuity while variation remains governed and testable.
Removal test: without 1H.hs7W the noncanonical carrier/origin distinction disappears; without 1H.L4ld there is no bounded recurrent reconstruction or scaffold-revision criterion.
Boundary: the claim is about preservation of task-relevant relation, not preservation of every historical state.

edges.title: Heterogeneous systems can share a durable interface without a shared interior
edges.text:
1H.hs7W supplies coherent function across heterogeneous carriers/operators without requiring one privileged form. 1H.qI2L supplies operation-preserving translation, durable external interfaces, evidence custody, and an explicit non-identity membrane. Together they earn a portability relation: heterogeneous systems can share a stable public interface without homogenizing internal law when claim-relevant operations are preserved and the evidence boundary travels with the interface.
Removal test: without 1H.hs7W there is no heterogeneous/noncanonical architecture to bridge; without 1H.qI2L there is no operation-preserving interface or custody discipline.
Boundary: interoperability does not imply mechanism, code or ontology identity.

edges.title: Minimal regenerative state should be obligation-partitioned
edges.text:
1H.9gYl supplies the separation of stable task structure, private/identity particulars, address semantics, residual detail and outcome authority. 1H.L4ld supplies bounded reconstruction-critical state and the requirement that retained anchors be revised when they block necessary change. Together they earn a criterion for compact recurrent state: retain only explicitly named roles whose information is necessary to reconstruct the target relation; leave history, particulars and implementation detail outside unless the stated obligation proves them necessary.
Removal test: without 1H.9gYl there is no explicit obligation partition or minimization discipline; without 1H.L4ld there is no recurrent reconstruction target or revision pressure.
Boundary: minimality is obligation-relative and must be re-tested when obligations change.

edges.title: A portable interface is a typed contract of obligations, not a shared representation
edges.text:
1H.9gYl supplies semantic role separation, obligation-scoped sufficiency and composite assurance. 1H.qI2L supplies operation-preserving translation, externalized public state and evidence custody across changing substrates. Together they earn a typed-interface criterion: a portable public contract should expose only the roles, operations and evidence obligations required for downstream use, while unrelated internal realization remains free to differ.
Removal test: without 1H.9gYl the public object lacks explicit role/sufficiency partitioning; without 1H.qI2L it lacks cross-substrate operation preservation and evidence custody.
Boundary: the contract is sufficient only for the obligations it explicitly names.

edges.title: Persistent correspondence can be regenerated from bounded state
edges.text:
1H.L4ld supplies identity/function through recurrent reconstruction from bounded state. 1H.qI2L supplies a durable public correspondence that can remain useful while internal realization changes, provided claim-relevant operations and evidence boundaries are preserved. Together they earn reconstructible correspondence: continuity may live in the ability to rebuild the same public relation from compact state rather than in retention of the original implementation.
Removal test: without 1H.L4ld there is no bounded regeneration mechanism; without 1H.qI2L there is no typed public correspondence or evidence membrane to reconstruct.
Boundary: repeated reconstruction must preserve the public obligation, not merely reproduce a familiar label.

faces.title: Decanonicalized systems need role-separated regenerative scaffolds
faces.text:
1H.hs7W contributes coherence under removal of privileged canonical form, 1H.9gYl contributes explicit role separation and sufficiency testing, and 1H.L4ld contributes recurrent reconstruction from bounded state plus scaffold revision. Together they earn a three-way architecture: a system can abandon one canonical representation while retaining continuity if a bounded, role-separated scaffold contains enough information to regenerate the task-relevant relations and is revised when pressure reveals that its former stabilizing role has become bias.
Removal tests: remove 1H.hs7W and there is no decanonicalization/heterogeneous-carrier pressure; remove 1H.9gYl and the scaffold loses obligation partition and sufficiency/composite tests; remove 1H.L4ld and the scaffold is no longer a regenerative process with revision conditions.

faces.title: Interoperability across heterogeneous carriers requires role-separated, operation-preserving contracts
faces.text:
1H.hs7W contributes heterogeneous/noncanonical carriers and governed invariance, 1H.9gYl contributes role-separated obligations and composite assurance, and 1H.qI2L contributes operation-preserving translation with evidence custody. Together they earn a stricter portability principle: shared use across differing interiors requires a typed public contract that preserves only the roles and operations consumed downstream and carries the boundary on what the correspondence does not identify.
Removal tests: remove 1H.hs7W and heterogeneity/noncanonicality disappears; remove 1H.9gYl and explicit obligation partition/sufficiency disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and operation-preserving cross-substrate correspondence plus custody disappears.

faces.title: Regenerated correspondence earns continuity only under noncanonical carrier variation
faces.text:
1H.hs7W contributes pressure-aligned tests across changing carriers/operators, 1H.L4ld contributes recurrent bounded-state regeneration, and 1H.qI2L contributes a durable public correspondence with its evidence membrane. Together they earn a validation law: repeated regeneration counts as continuity only when the reconstructed interface preserves its claimed relation across relevant carrier/operator variation that could expose false invariance, while the claim boundary is regenerated with the relation.
Removal tests: remove 1H.hs7W and the relevant noncanonical variation/stress surface disappears; remove 1H.L4ld and repeated regeneration disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and there is no typed correspondence/evidence boundary whose continuity can be assessed.

faces.title: The minimal durable state is the set of claim-relevant obligations needed to reconstruct a typed public interface
faces.text:
1H.9gYl contributes obligation separation and minimization under sufficiency tests, 1H.L4ld contributes reconstruction-critical bounded state, and 1H.qI2L contributes operation/evidence-preserving public correspondence. Together they earn a compact state law: durable state can be reduced to the role-typed operations, evidence boundaries and authority/scaffold information required to regenerate the public relation; implementation history and unrelated internal state may vary or disappear.
Removal tests: remove 1H.9gYl and there is no principled role/minimization basis; remove 1H.L4ld and no bounded reconstruction mechanism; remove 1H.qI2L and no operation-preserving typed interface or custody object.

volume.title: Reconstructible relational contract
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity and correspondence repeatedly detach from one fixed internal snapshot, but the higher-rank closure adds a stricter requirement than any proper subset. 1H.hs7W shows that coherence can survive noncanonical and heterogeneous carriers only when roles, regimes and pressure-aligned tests remain explicit. 1H.9gYl shows that stable task structure, private particulars, address semantics, residual detail and outcome authority should be separated into obligations whose reduced carriers must be proven sufficient. 1H.L4ld shows that functional continuity can be repeatedly regenerated from bounded local state, while the same scaffold can become an adaptation-blocking bias that needs revision. 1H.qI2L shows that a public correspondence can survive substrate change when claim-relevant operations and its evidence boundary are carried forward without promoting usability into interior identity.


The complete four-way closure is therefore a reconstructible relational contract: the thing that persists need not be a canonical representation, a complete history, or a shared implementation. It can instead be a role-separated public obligation containing the minimal operations, evidence boundaries and reconstruction-critical scaffold state needed to re-instantiate the relation downstream work consumes. The contract remains valid only while it survives pressure-aligned variation across heterogeneous carriers and while its retained scaffold is revised when stabilizing history ceases to be faithful.


Bounded volume invariant
A noncanonical system can preserve task-relevant identity or correspondence through changing internal realization when continuity is carried by a role-separated relational contract containing only the operations, evidence boundaries and scaffold state required to reconstruct the public obligation; that contract may be regenerated from bounded local state across heterogeneous interiors, but remains valid only while pressure-aligned tests show the scaffold is sufficient and has not become an obsolete bias.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.hs7W: the closure loses direct noncanonical/heterogeneous carrier variation and pressure-aligned governance; the remaining trio can reconstruct a typed interface but cannot earn coherence without canonical form under carrier variation.
- Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses role separation, obligation-scoped minimization and composite assurance; the persistent contract becomes an undifferentiated interface.
- Remove 1H.L4ld: the closure loses recurrent re-instantiation from bounded state and anchor-debt revision; the contract may persist as externalized state but not as a regenerative process.
- Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses operation-preserving translation, evidence custody and the non-identity membrane; the remaining trio cannot earn cross-substrate public correspondence without shared interior.

metabolites.title: Preserve the obligations that let the relation be rebuilt
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H.Dzmx:xyz
Invariant: durable state can be the smallest role-separated set of claim-relevant operations, evidence boundaries and authority/scaffold information sufficient to regenerate a public relation while unrelated implementation history varies.
CREATE: Name the downstream public obligation, then separate required operations/evidence/policy from implementation history, private detail and residual state.
COPY: Carry only those reconstruction-critical obligations across reruns or substrate changes and use them to regenerate the public interface.
CONTROL: Ablate retained roles and test the regenerated interface against the exact downstream obligation; reject the reduction when missing state changes the public relation or silently weakens its evidence boundary.
CULTIVATE: Compress or expand the retained contract as obligations evolve, keeping internal realization free unless the public relation proves the current contract insufficient.
Compression: Preserve the obligations that let the relation be rebuilt, not the whole interior.

CONTROL: Stress the relation along variation axes expected to move neighboring non-invariants, and retain explicit non-identity/evidence boundaries.
