metabolites.title: Regenerate the boundary with the relation and know when the scaffold must change
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H.Dzmx:wyz
Invariant: every regenerated/stabilizing interface should carry both its evidence boundary and an explicit revision condition because the scaffold that preserves continuity can later become an obsolete bias.
CREATE: Bind the public relation to its claim class, evidence boundary and a condition under which the retained scaffold must be reconsidered.
COPY: Reproduce that boundary and revision condition whenever the relation is regenerated.
CONTROL: Stress the scaffold with regime, carrier and framing changes; block claim inflation and detect when the old anchor preserves the wrong future.
CULTIVATE: Relax, replace or reweight the scaffold when its former stabilizing role blocks a newly required but still evidence-consistent relation.
Compression: Regenerate the boundary with the relation, and know when the scaffold must change.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
A candidate “canonical forms are unnecessary” metabolite was rejected: 1H.hs7W only earns noncanonical coherence under explicit governance and bounded regimes. A candidate “minimal state is always better” metabolite was rejected: 1H.9gYl and 1H.L4ld both make sufficiency obligation-relative and permit expansion when the reduced scaffold fails. A candidate “stable interfaces imply shared mechanism” metabolite was rejected by 1H.qI2L and is not rescued at rank 2. A candidate “every persistent system is a contract” was rejected as unearned universality. Three metabolites survive collapse because reconstructible obligation, noncanonical portability and custodial revision each require cross-parent relations and remain independently useful after the others are removed.

edges.title: covariant correspondence contract
edges.text:
1H.qI2L supplies a durable public relation that may remain useful without shared interior identity. 1H.yac0 supplies the transition law by which representations may change while task-relevant operations and role semantics remain stable. Together they earn a stronger bridge criterion: a correspondence may persist across representation changes only when the transformation preserves the operations and role meanings the correspondence actually promises.
Removal test: remove qI2L and the relation loses its explicit correspondence-without-identity/evidence boundary; remove yac0 and the bridge lacks a lawful transition criterion across changing representations.

edges.title: revalidated correspondence
edges.text:
1H.qI2L makes the public relation and its evidence boundary durable; 1H.DUwl makes adequacy a renewable warrant tied to current task/regime rather than a permanent property of a carrier. Together they earn a relation whose continuity is conditional on renewed evidence: the bridge may persist while implementation changes, but its authority expires when the validation regime no longer covers the current use.
Removal test: remove qI2L and there is no explicit durable cross-substrate correspondence to warrant; remove DUwl and no rule states when continued usability must be retested or revoked.

edges.title: role-explicit non-identity interface
edges.text:
1H.qI2L distinguishes useful correspondence from mechanism/code identity. 1H.9gYl distinguishes semantic obligations that should remain in separate carriers or channels until deliberate conjunction. Together they earn an interface discipline: a cross-system relation should expose which role is being preserved—address, operation, evidence, authority, identity-bearing particulars—rather than letting success in one role imply sameness or assurance in another.
Removal test: remove qI2L and the non-identity membrane disappears; remove 9gYl and the correspondence lacks explicit obligation/role separation.

edges.title: revalidatable covariant transition
edges.text:
1H.yac0 supplies explicit transition obligations for semantic continuity; 1H.DUwl supplies renewed testing and revocation when task/regime changes. Together they earn a transition warrant rather than a transition assumption: a rewrite is continuous only while its operation-preserving obligations survive current tests, and prior validation may be retired when the regime leaves scope.
Removal test: remove yac0 and there is no explicit preservation law through the rewrite; remove DUwl and there is no renewable validation/revocation boundary.

edges.title: role-preserving sufficient transformation
edges.text:
1H.yac0 says independent role semantics must survive representation change; 1H.9gYl says those roles should be independently addressable and their reduced carriers tested against exact obligations. Together they earn selective transformation: representation may be compressed, reframed or rebuilt without preserving all particulars, provided each load-bearing role remains addressable and sufficient for the operation that consumes it.
Removal test: remove yac0 and role continuity through transformation is ungrounded; remove 9gYl and the criterion for separating and testing role-specific sufficiency disappears.

edges.title: selectively revocable composite assurance
edges.text:
1H.DUwl requires adequacy to be revalidated as goals/tasks drift; 1H.9gYl refuses assurance-smearing from trusted parts to a composite. Together they earn selective revocation: evidence may remain valid for some roles while failing for another, but the composed interface must also be retested at its conjunction boundary before authority is renewed.
Removal test: remove DUwl and no regime-sensitive revalidation/revocation remains; remove 9gYl and local component validity can silently substitute for end-to-end assurance.

faces.title: revalidatable covariant correspondence
faces.text:

Removal tests: remove qI2L and the non-identity correspondence/evidence contract disappears; remove yac0 and lawful transformation disappears; remove DUwl and the warrant cannot expire or be renewed.

faces.title: role-indexed correspondence through change
faces.text:
qI2L + yac0 + 9gYl jointly earn a cross-representation interface whose promises are not one undifferentiated similarity claim: each preserved role remains separately addressable through the transformation, and success of the relation does not collapse identity, authority, address and operational sufficiency into one object.
Removal tests: remove qI2L and non-identity/evidence typing disappears; remove yac0 and transformed-role continuity is ungrounded; remove 9gYl and independent obligation channels disappear.

faces.title: compositional warrant without identity inflation
faces.text:
qI2L + DUwl + 9gYl jointly earn a renewable interface warrant in which evidence attaches to named roles and the whole composition, while stable correspondence never by itself promotes to mechanism/code identity. A role may keep its local warrant while the composite is withheld, or the composite may be revoked when its conjunction changes.
Removal tests: remove qI2L and the identity barrier disappears; remove DUwl and the warrant is not renewable/revocable; remove 9gYl and component versus composite assurance is not distinguished.

faces.title: selectively revocable semantic continuity
faces.text:
yac0 + DUwl + 9gYl jointly earn continuity that can survive substantial carrier/context change without all-or-nothing preservation. Role semantics and consumed operations define what must survive; current tests determine whether they still do; failures can localize which role or conjunction lost warrant rather than forcing material sameness or indiscriminate reset.
Removal tests: remove yac0 and there is no role-preserving transition law; remove DUwl and no current-regime validation/revocation exists; remove 9gYl and failures cannot be localized by independently addressable obligation.

volume.title: role-indexed revalidatable correspondence
volume.text:
All four parents together earn a continuity contract in which a cross-substrate relation can remain the same usable relation without requiring the participating systems to share an interior, a fixed carrier or one canonical representation. The relation is made explicit as a set of independently addressable obligations; every representation change must preserve the operations and role semantics consumed by those obligations; sufficiency is re-witnessed under the current task/evidence regime; and composite authority is granted only after the conjunction itself is tested rather than inherited from valid components.


The additional rank-4 consequence is selective renewal. Because the interface is role-indexed, a regime or carrier change can reveal exactly which obligation or conjunction has left its tested scope. The old warrant can then be retained for unaffected roles, revoked where coverage failed, and reissued only after the transformed relation and its composition are revalidated. Continuity therefore lives in a typed, renewable relation rather than in material sameness, global representational identity or assurance by association.


Bounded volume invariant
A correspondence may count as continuous across changing substrates and representations when its public obligations are separately addressable, lawful transitions preserve the operations and role semantics each obligation consumes, current evidence revalidates both role-level and composite sufficiency, and the relation keeps shared-interior identity explicitly unearned. Regime change may selectively revoke and renew affected warrants without requiring fixed material realization.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses the explicit correspondence-without-identity and evidence-boundary membrane; successful continuity can inflate into shared-interior identity.
- Remove 1H.yac0: the closure loses the explicit transition law preserving task operations and role semantics through representation change.
- Remove 1H.DUwl: the closure loses renewable validation, revocation and regime-sensitive reconstruction; a once-valid relation becomes implicitly permanent.
- Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses independently addressable obligations and the component-versus-composite assurance boundary required for selective renewal.

metabolites.title: ROLE-INDEXED-CORRESPONDENCE

COPY: preserve those obligation identities through representation/carrier changes even when implementation details change.
CONTROL: test each obligation independently and prevent success of one channel from certifying another or establishing shared mechanism identity.
CULTIVATE: refine the interface by splitting newly independent obligations only when repeated evidence shows they need distinct validation or lifecycle.

edges.title: LOCAL SUFFICIENCY CAN SUPPORT NONCANONICAL COHERENCE
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 makes validity and reconstruction sufficiency local to condition/input regimes; 1H.hs7W shows coherent function can survive without a privileged global form when stable relations and governance remain explicit. Together they earn: a noncanonical distributed carrier can count as continuous only relative to the local conditions under which its relational state is sufficient for the current obligation.

edges.title: DURABLE INTERFACE SUFFICIENCY IS OBLIGATION- AND REGIME-INDEXED
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 requires retention of locally load-bearing distinctions that can change downstream behavior; 1H.qI2L allows public correspondence to persist across changing internal realizations when claim-relevant operations remain preserved. Together they earn: an interface can carry continuity across substrate change only when it preserves the distinctions and operations required by the downstream obligation in the present validity regime.
Necessity: without 1H.8KP9 there is no local test of which distinctions are sufficient; without 1H.qI2L there is no durable operation-preserving cross-substrate interface.

edges.title: CONDITION CHANGE IS A CONTINUITY-REVALIDATION TRIGGER
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 shows that validity can vary across local regimes and that reconstruction must be re-estimated when the regime changes; 1H.J9Y3 requires a typed admissible variation class and independent witness for continuity. Together they earn: a detected move between validity regimes is not merely metadata but a revocation trigger for inherited continuity authority until the affected obligation is revalidated.
Necessity: without 1H.8KP9 the boundary is not condition-indexed; without 1H.J9Y3 there is no typed warrant or revocation/re-certification law.

edges.title: HETEROGENEOUS COHERENCE CAN BE CARRIED BY A PUBLIC NONIDENTITY INTERFACE
edges.text:
1H.hs7W permits coherent shared function while local carriers and operators differ; 1H.qI2L makes correspondence durable by preserving public semantic obligations and claim-relevant operations without identifying the interiors. Together they earn: stable role-preserving interfaces can carry coherent cross-substrate function without requiring canonical internal form or mechanism identity.
Necessity: without 1H.hs7W the heterogeneous/noncanonical coherence relation disappears; without 1H.qI2L the executable durable interface and explicit nonidentity membrane disappear.

edges.title: DECANONICALIZATION REQUIRES A TYPED VARIATION WARRANT
edges.text:
1H.hs7W shows that removing privileged global form shifts burden into governance and pressure-aligned testing; 1H.J9Y3 says invariance is meaningful only against an explicit admissible variation class with a failure boundary. Together they earn: freedom from canonical form is lawful only inside a named variation regime whose preserved relation is independently witnessed under pressure.
Necessity: without 1H.hs7W no decanonicalized coherence or governance debt is present; without 1H.J9Y3 the variation class and independent continuity warrant are absent.

edges.title: CORRESPONDENCE BECOMES RENEWABLE AUTHORITY ONLY THROUGH TYPED WITNESS
edges.text:
1H.qI2L supplies operation-preserving durable correspondence with evidence boundaries; 1H.J9Y3 supplies admissible-change typing, independent witness and boundary reissue. Together they earn: a correspondence may be reused as authority only while its operation semantics, evidence class, admissible change set and failure witness remain current; otherwise it must be revalidated rather than inherited.
Necessity: without 1H.qI2L there is no durable correspondence object to renew; without 1H.J9Y3 there is no typed criterion for when its authority expires.

faces.title: RECONSTRUCTIBLE INTERFACE CONTINUITY WITHOUT CANONICAL FORM
faces.text:
1H.8KP9 contributes condition-indexed sufficiency and regeneration, 1H.hs7W contributes coherence without privileged global form, and 1H.qI2L contributes a durable operation-preserving interface that does not assert identity. Together they earn: task-relevant continuity can be reconstructed through a noncanonical interface across changing carriers when the interface preserves locally sufficient distinctions and claim-relevant operations.
Removal tests: remove 1H.8KP9 and local sufficiency/reconstruction disappears; remove 1H.hs7W and noncanonical heterogeneous coherence disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and the durable cross-substrate interface disappears.

faces.title: CERTIFIED NONCANONICAL CONTINUITY UNDER LOCAL REGIMES
faces.text:
1H.8KP9 contributes local validity fields, 1H.hs7W contributes decanonicalized coherence plus pressure testing, and 1H.J9Y3 contributes the typed variation witness and re-certification boundary. Together they earn: a distributed noncanonical continuity claim is valid only inside a locally identified regime and only while pressure tests support the typed relation being preserved.
Removal tests: remove 1H.8KP9 and the regime-local validity membrane disappears; remove 1H.hs7W and there is no noncanonical coherence to certify; remove 1H.J9Y3 and certification/failure authority is untyped.

faces.title: REVALIDATABLE CORRESPONDENCE AS A CONTINUITY CARRIER
faces.text:
1H.8KP9 contributes condition-dependent sufficiency, 1H.qI2L contributes durable correspondence across substrates, and 1H.J9Y3 contributes independent typed continuity witness and boundary-triggered reissue. Together they earn: a correspondence can serve as a continuity carrier across regime changes only by carrying the current obligation and being freshly revalidated whenever its condition or admissible variation boundary changes.
Removal tests: remove 1H.8KP9 and the condition-specific sufficiency obligation disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and there is no durable correspondence carrier; remove 1H.J9Y3 and boundary-triggered revalidation lacks authority.

faces.title: GOVERNED NONIDENTITY PORTABILITY
faces.text:
1H.hs7W contributes heterogeneous shared coherence without homogeneous form, 1H.qI2L contributes operation-preserving portable interfaces, and 1H.J9Y3 contributes typed variation and identity restraint. Together they earn: heterogeneous systems can share a portable executable relation without sharing an interior when stable roles are preserved, permitted variation is explicit, and correspondence remains distinct from identity.
Removal tests: remove 1H.hs7W and heterogeneous/noncanonical coherence disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and executable portability disappears; remove 1H.J9Y3 and the typed nonidentity/failure boundary disappears.

volume.title: CONDITION-ADDRESSED NONCANONICAL CONTINUITY REVALIDATION
volume.text:
Across all four parents, task-relevant continuity need not live in one canonical snapshot, shared interior, or permanent substrate. 1H.8KP9 makes sufficiency local to the condition and obligation being served, and requires reconstruction to be re-estimated when that local regime changes. 1H.hs7W shows that coherent function can survive heterogeneous carriers and local laws without a privileged global form, provided the relation is governed and stress-tested. 1H.qI2L shows that an externalized, operation-preserving correspondence can remain durable and useful across changing internal realizations without becoming an identity claim. 1H.J9Y3 supplies the missing authority law: continuity is a typed warrant over an admissible variation class with an independent witness and a visible failure boundary.


The complete four-way closure is therefore a condition-addressed noncanonical continuity revalidation contract. A noncanonical interface may carry continuity across changing substrates only while (1) the current local regime in which the carrier is sufficient remains explicit, (2) the claim-relevant operations and role semantics survive translation, (3) the admissible variation class and independent witness remain current, and (4) boundary changes trigger reconstruction and fresh revalidation rather than silent inheritance. The carrier may remain useful without identifying either side of the correspondence.


Bounded volume invariant
A noncanonical cross-substrate interface may stand in for shared state or shared identity only for a named downstream obligation inside a witnessed local validity regime: preserve the claim-relevant operations and distinctions, keep the admissible variation/failure coordinates explicit, and reissue the affected continuity warrant whenever that regime changes.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.8KP9: the closure loses condition-indexed sufficiency and the regeneration/re-estimation obligation.
- Remove 1H.hs7W: the closure loses the demonstrated possibility of coherent continuity without privileged canonical form and its governance debt.
- Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses durable operation-preserving correspondence as the cross-substrate continuity carrier.
- Remove 1H.J9Y3: the closure loses typed admissible variation, independent witness, failure boundary and revalidation authority.


COLLAPSE — THREE SURVIVING CROSS-ORGANISM METABOLITES


INV-2H.LlIB-OBLIGATION-LOCAL-SUFFICIENCY — Continuity sufficiency is indexed to obligation and condition
Minimal body: 2H.LlIB:wy
Invariant: a reduced, reconstructed or translated carrier is sufficient only relative to the downstream obligation and local validity regime whose consequential distinctions it preserves.
CREATE: state the obligation and condition regime before declaring two carriers interchangeable enough.
COPY: preserve the variables, relations and operation semantics that can alter that obligation.
CONTROL: test matched regime changes and reject global sameness when behavior or support differs materially.
CULTIVATE: expand the recognized regime only after repeated revalidation supports the extension.
Compression: “same enough” always has an obligation and a regime.


INV-2H.LlIB-NONIDENTITY-INTERFACE-CUSTODY — Preserve the relation without inventing a shared interior
Minimal body: 2H.LlIB:xy
Invariant: a public interface may preserve coherent cross-substrate use through stable role semantics and claim-relevant operations while the internal carriers remain heterogeneous and non-identical.
CREATE: define the public relation and the operations downstream work actually consumes.
COPY: carry those commitments across substrate or implementation changes without requiring hidden-state equality.
CONTROL: keep evidence class, failure coordinates and identity claims separate; stable use does not upgrade correspondence into mechanism or object identity.
CULTIVATE: extend portability one witnessed operation/role at a time.
Compression: preserve the interface; do not hallucinate the interior.


INV-2H.LlIB-BOUNDARY-TRIGGERED-REISSUE — Changed validity boundaries revoke inherited continuity authority
Minimal body: 2H.LlIB:wz
Invariant: when the condition, support, carrier or admissible variation class crosses the boundary of the current witness, the old continuity warrant becomes insufficient and the affected relation must be reconstructed and freshly revalidated.
CREATE: detect and name the boundary transition that makes the old witness incomplete.
COPY: retain unaffected warrants and exact return paths to the evidence used by the invalidated one.
CONTROL: refuse silent inheritance beyond the tested class; require a fresh independent witness for the affected obligation.
CULTIVATE: let successful revalidation mint a successor warrant while preserving the predecessor as historical scope, not current authority.
Compression: boundary crossing is a revalidation event, not permission to assume continuity.

edges.title: obligation-scoped selective realization
edges.text:
1H.ujF6 supplies context- and trajectory-dependent selective actualization over a stable/reacquirable scaffold; 1H.9gYl supplies explicit semantic role separation and exact-obligation sufficiency. Together they earn a bounded architecture in which only the flexible state presently needed for a named task is instantiated, while the current carrier is tested for sufficiency against that exact obligation rather than treated as globally complete.

edges.title: actualization is not expansion
edges.text:
1H.ujF6 shows that access to useful behavior can change through selective realization, routing and reallocation as context or pressure changes; 1H.uSiP shows that improved access or visible performance does not by itself establish a larger reachable support. Together they require a distinction between re-realizing/reweighting existing possibility and genuinely enlarging it, with operating trajectory and boundary witness carried separately.
Rank necessity: remove 1H.ujF6 and there is no explicit moving realization/reallocation process; remove 1H.uSiP and there is no independent criterion separating better access from boundary expansion.

edges.title: selective coherence across noncanonical carriers
edges.text:
1H.ujF6 supplies bounded local actualization and revalidation as context and pressure move; 1H.hs7W supplies coherent relational continuity without a privileged global carrier. Together they earn the possibility that one task-relevant relation can remain coherent while its active support appears, moves or disappears locally, provided relation semantics and validity conditions survive each transition.
Rank necessity: remove 1H.ujF6 and the relation loses selective/path-sensitive local realization; remove 1H.hs7W and it loses the warrant for coherence across changing noncanonical carriers.

edges.title: sufficiency frontier is not capability frontier
edges.text:
1H.9gYl makes sufficiency relative to an exact downstream obligation; 1H.uSiP distinguishes success on a current task or measurement from expansion of the underlying possibility set. Together they establish that proving a reduced carrier is enough for task T does not show that the carrier preserves every possibility or that the system’s capability frontier has grown.
Rank necessity: remove 1H.9gYl and exact-obligation sufficiency disappears; remove 1H.uSiP and the independent support/expansion boundary disappears.

edges.title: role-stable continuity without carrier identity
edges.text:

Together they earn continuity through stable role semantics and tested relation rather than through representational identity, as long as the recombined carrier remains sufficient for the named obligation.
Rank necessity: remove 1H.9gYl and role semantics plus obligation-scoped sufficiency disappear; remove 1H.hs7W and cross-carrier relational coherence disappears.


zy — pressure-tested boundary change
1H.uSiP requires a boundary-crossing witness before calling an adaptive gain expansion; 1H.hs7W requires candidate invariants to survive variation along the coordinate expected to disturb neighboring non-invariants. Together they earn a stronger growth test: capability expansion across carrier or regime change must cross the old boundary while the claimed relation remains coherent under pressure-aligned perturbation.
Rank necessity: remove 1H.uSiP and the expansion criterion disappears; remove 1H.hs7W and the pressure-aligned cross-carrier invariance test disappears.

faces.title: selective realization with expansion accounting
faces.text:
1H.ujF6 contributes selective actualization and reallocation, 1H.9gYl contributes role separation plus exact-obligation sufficiency, and 1H.uSiP contributes the boundary between better access and enlarged possibility. Together they derive that a task-specific realized state may be both useful and sufficient without implying growth of the reachable support; any improvement must be classified as changed realization/reweighting or true expansion by a separate boundary witness.

Removal tests: without 1H.ujF6 elasticity loses selective/path-sensitive realization; without 1H.9gYl it loses exact role and sufficiency semantics; without 1H.hs7W it loses carrier-flexible relational continuity.


wzy — trajectory-sensitive expansion witness
1H.ujF6 contributes a moving pressure/frontier and adaptive reallocation, 1H.uSiP contributes the separate expansion boundary, and 1H.hs7W contributes pressure-aligned invariance testing across changing carriers. Together they derive that when support moves under pressure, an apparent gain counts as expansion only if it crosses the prior boundary under a relevant stress test while the task relation remains coherent; otherwise the gain remains a reallocation or access effect.
Removal tests: without 1H.ujF6 there is no moving realization/frontier; without 1H.uSiP no criterion for boundary expansion; without 1H.hs7W no pressure-aligned relational witness across carrier variation.


xzy — role-stable boundary revision
1H.9gYl contributes stable independently meaningful roles and exact obligation, 1H.uSiP contributes the distinction between current success and support expansion, and 1H.hs7W contributes relational continuity across heterogeneous carriers. Together they derive that before/after claims across adaptation are commensurable only when role semantics remain stable enough to compare, the exact obligation remains testable, and any claimed boundary change is separately witnessed across the relevant carrier/regime variation.
Removal tests: without 1H.9gYl semantic comparability and exact obligation disappear; without 1H.uSiP the expansion test disappears; without 1H.hs7W coherent comparison across carrier change disappears.

edges.title: A regenerated relation counts as the same durable interface only when its contract and evidence membrane recur
edges.text:

Together they earn a relation neither parent earns alone: regeneration is not enough by itself; the reconstructed state counts as continuation of the same public relation only when the externally consumable obligation and its epistemic membrane are also re-instantiated.
Removal test: without 1H.L4ld there is no recurrent reconstruction/identity witness; without 1H.qI2L there is no typed durable interface or custody boundary to be regenerated.

edges.title: Recurrent continuity across representation change requires transition-preserving reconstruction
edges.text:

edges.title: A reconstruction scaffold has a local validity regime and revision condition

Together they derive regime-indexed reconstruction: the retained state is sufficient only inside a witnessed operating region, and its identity-preserving role must be revised rather than presumed when that region changes.
Removal test: without 1H.L4ld there is no bounded regenerative scaffold or anchor debt; without 1H.8KP9 there is no locally varying sufficiency/validity field.

edges.title: A portable public interface survives representation change through preserved operations and roles, not shared interior
edges.text:
1H.qI2L supplies durable externalized correspondence and a non-identity membrane. 1H.yac0 supplies lawful transition across local representations while preserving task operations and independent role semantics. Together they earn covariant interface portability: a public relation can remain usable across changing internal representations when the transition preserves exactly what downstream use consumes, without requiring the interiors to be the same.
Removal test: without 1H.qI2L there is no durable public interface/evidence custody; without 1H.yac0 there is no transition/role-preservation law across changing representation.

edges.title: Evidence custody must be indexed to the regime in which correspondence is valid
edges.text:
1H.qI2L supplies claim class, realization boundary, prior-good state and evidence custody as part of maintained public truth. 1H.8KP9 supplies validity as a field over context/input regimes rather than one global scalar. Together they derive local epistemic custody: the public interface must carry not only what is established but the conditions under which that correspondence is warranted, so recurrence in one regime cannot silently inflate into a global claim.
Removal test: without 1H.qI2L there is no durable evidence membrane; without 1H.8KP9 there is no condition-indexed validity surface.

edges.title: The set of lawful rewrites is itself regime-dependent and must be revalidated
edges.text:
1H.yac0 supplies explicit transition obligations that preserve operations and role semantics across context/representation changes. 1H.8KP9 supplies local validity and the rule that compressed/reconstructed carriers must be re-estimated when their regime changes. Together they earn adaptive covariance: a transformation that preserves the obligation in one local regime cannot be assumed lawful everywhere; the admissible rewrite family must be retested as conditions change.
Removal test: without 1H.yac0 there is no explicit rewrite/transition obligation; without 1H.8KP9 there is no local-regime boundary or revalidation pressure.

faces.title: Reconstructible semantic interface
faces.text:

Together they earn an interface that can be repeatedly re-instantiated through changing representations without preserving one complete state or one interior, provided each reconstruction reproduces the public obligation through a lawful transition.
Removal tests: remove 1H.L4ld and regeneration disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and there is no durable public correspondence; remove 1H.yac0 and cross-representation reconstruction loses its preservation criterion.

faces.title: Regenerative correspondence with a local evidence membrane
faces.text:

Together they earn a stricter continuity claim: a regenerated interface counts as the same warranted correspondence only when its evidence boundary and validity regime are regenerated with it and the scaffold is revised when those conditions change.
Removal tests: remove 1H.L4ld and there is no reconstruction; remove 1H.qI2L and no typed public/evidence interface; remove 1H.8KP9 and no locally bounded validity/revision condition.

faces.title: Adaptive reconstruction law
faces.text:
1H.L4ld contributes bounded regenerative process and anchor debt, 1H.yac0 contributes transition-preserving change of representation, and 1H.8KP9 contributes local sufficiency and revalidation. Together they earn an adaptive reconstruction discipline: preserve only enough state to rebuild the relation, transform it lawfully across carriers, and revise both scaffold and admissible transition family when the local regime changes.
Removal tests: remove 1H.L4ld and there is no regenerative process; remove 1H.yac0 and no lawful cross-representation transition; remove 1H.8KP9 and no condition-sensitive revision membrane.

faces.title: Regime-bounded covariant interface
faces.text:
1H.qI2L contributes operation-preserving public correspondence and evidence custody, 1H.yac0 contributes covariant semantic portability, and 1H.8KP9 contributes local validity and sufficiency testing. Together they earn a public interface whose portability is explicitly regime-bounded: the interface may cross substrates/representations, but its claim-relevant operations, role semantics and evidence boundary must all survive inside the currently witnessed local regime.
Removal tests: remove 1H.qI2L and public correspondence/custody disappears; remove 1H.yac0 and representation-change preservation disappears; remove 1H.8KP9 and portability loses its local validity membrane.

volume.title: Regime-covariant regenerative correspondence
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity becomes neither preservation of a fixed state nor merely successful translation. 1H.L4ld shows that task-relevant function may be repeatedly rebuilt from bounded state while the scaffold that stabilizes it can later become a bias. 1H.qI2L shows that a durable public correspondence can survive changing internal realization only when claim-relevant operations and the evidence boundary travel with the state. 1H.yac0 shows that context and representation may change while meaning survives through explicit transition obligations that preserve downstream operations and independent role semantics. 1H.8KP9 shows that sufficiency and validity are themselves local to context/input regimes and must be re-estimated when conditions change.


The complete four-way closure is therefore regime-covariant regenerative correspondence: a durable relation may persist without one fixed state, representation or interior when it can be re-instantiated from bounded state through operation-preserving transitions into a public interface whose evidence boundary and validity regime are carried with it. Continuity is earned only while each reconstruction preserves the task-relevant relation under the current local regime; when that regime changes, both the retained scaffold and the admissible transformation family must be revised and revalidated rather than treated as globally invariant.


Bounded volume invariant
A durable task-relevant correspondence can persist through changing state and representation when bounded local state can regenerate the public relation through transitions that preserve its claim-relevant operations and independent role semantics, while the evidence boundary and local validity regime travel with the regenerated interface; continuity remains warranted only until regime change requires the scaffold and transformation law to be re-estimated.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.L4ld: the closure loses recurrent re-instantiation and anchor-debt revision; the remaining trio can describe a regime-bounded portable interface but not regeneration from bounded state.
- Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses durable public correspondence, evidence custody and the non-identity membrane; the remaining trio lacks an externally typed object whose continuity is being regenerated.
- Remove 1H.yac0: the closure loses operation-/role-preserving transition across changing representation/context; regeneration and local validity remain, but covariance across carriers is unearned.
- Remove 1H.8KP9: the closure loses condition-local sufficiency and revalidation; the remaining trio can earn reconstructible portable correspondence but not the rule that its validity and admissible transformations change with regime.

CULTIVATE: revise the scaffold and admissible transition family as new regimes are witnessed, widening portability only after revalidation.

metabolites.title: Portability includes a revision rule for the transformation itself
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H.S5EU:xyz

METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
A candidate “continuity is always reconstruction” metabolite was rejected: the parents earn reconstruction as one valid carrier, not a universal necessity. A candidate “every valid transformation is context-dependent” metabolite was rejected as too broad: local validity is earned only where regime dependence is evidenced. A candidate “stable interface implies stable identity” was rejected by the explicit non-identity boundary of 1H.qI2L. A candidate “preserve all state to preserve evidence” was rejected because 1H.L4ld and 1H.8KP9 both permit bounded/compressed carriers when sufficiency is tested. Three metabolites survive collapse because regime-covariant reconstruction, custodial regeneration and adaptive portability require different minimal cross-parent bodies and remain independently useful after the others are removed.

edges.title: Operational continuity can be carried by regenerated relational geometry
edges.text:
1H.DUwl requires an explicit operation-level obligation plus external revalidation; 1H.2VF2 shows that the carrier of competence may be a relation-generating geometry rather than fixed elements. Removal test: without 1H.DUwl, recoverable relational geometry has no explicit operation-level adequacy/revalidation criterion; without 1H.2VF2, operational continuity has no constructive relational carrier that can be regenerated across changing realization.
Boundary: external recoverability witnesses usefulness, not shared implementation or ontology.

edges.title: Operational equivalence is local and evidence-typed
edges.text:
1H.DUwl supplies the rule that continuity must be revalidated against current task obligations and may be revoked after repurposing; 1H.F8cX supplies locally warranted quotienting plus an evidence budget for deciding which differences are nuisance. Together they derive that operational equivalence is not a blanket sameness claim: it is a task-local quotient whose admissibility must be revalidated at the strength of evidence available.
Removal test: without 1H.DUwl, local quotienting lacks a concrete operational adequacy/revocation surface; without 1H.F8cX, revalidation lacks an explicit law for which representational differences may be ignored.

edges.title: Reconstruction contracts must carry consequential context

1H.DUwl supplies a compact operational relation plus explicit reconstruction/revalidation triggers; 1H.8KP9 supplies local validity and the requirement that policy-changing/context-changing distinctions survive compression. Together they earn a context-indexed reconstruction contract: a regenerated interface preserves continuity only while it carries every distinction known to alter the downstream obligation and is revalidated when that local regime changes.
Removal test: without 1H.DUwl, there is no explicit operational contract or external adequacy witness; without 1H.8KP9, the contract has no law requiring load-bearing context to travel with reconstruction or to be re-estimated by regime.

edges.title: Relational carriers are equivalent only under an explicit quotient

Together they earn quotient-bounded relational portability: two regenerated geometries may count as equivalent for a task only under a declared transformation class whose nuisance status is locally supported, while task-relevant factors remain addressable.
Removal test: without 1H.2VF2, the quotient has no reconstructive relational carrier to act upon; without 1H.F8cX, relational correspondence can drift into unqualified sameness or erase meaningful factors.

edges.title: Regenerative geometry is valid only inside a witnessed local regime
edges.text:
1H.2VF2 shows that relational geometry can be re-instantiated from changing internal realization and judged by external recoverability; 1H.8KP9 shows that the sufficiency of a compressed/reconstructed carrier is local to context/input conditions and must be re-estimated after regime change. Together they earn locally regenerative geometry: relation-generating reconstruction can preserve function without global co-presence only while the local validity field and load-bearing distinctions needed for external recovery are preserved.
Removal test: without 1H.2VF2, there is no explicit reconstructive relational geometry; without 1H.8KP9, there is no context-indexed sufficiency membrane or re-estimation requirement.

edges.title: Safe quotienting and safe compression share a local validity witness
edges.text:
1H.F8cX shows that broad invariance can erase predictive factors unless nuisance transformations are locally warranted; 1H.8KP9 shows that compressed/hierarchical carriers fail when locally consequential distinctions are dropped. Together they derive a common validity condition: both quotienting and compression are lawful only when the same local evidence boundary shows that removed distinctions cannot change the downstream obligation, and that boundary must be re-estimated when the regime changes.
Removal test: without 1H.F8cX, there is no explicit nuisance/equivalence decision or evidence budget; without 1H.8KP9, there is no reconstructive/compression failure witness tying erased distinctions to downstream behavior.

faces.title: Evidence-typed regenerative interface
faces.text:
1H.DUwl contributes an explicit operational obligation plus current revalidation, 1H.2VF2 contributes reconstructive relational geometry, and 1H.F8cX contributes a locally warranted nuisance quotient. Together they earn an interface criterion: a changed realization may substitute for a prior one when it regenerates the task-relevant relation, preserves the declared operation, and differs only along transformations currently evidenced as nuisance; this still does not establish implementation identity.
Removal tests: remove 1H.DUwl and there is no operation-level adequacy/revalidation criterion; remove 1H.2VF2 and no regenerative relational carrier remains; remove 1H.F8cX and the equivalence scope becomes unbounded.

faces.title: Reconstructive continuity needs a local witness
faces.text:
1H.DUwl contributes explicit operation and revalidation, 1H.2VF2 contributes relation-generating reconstruction, and 1H.8KP9 contributes locally varying sufficiency plus custody of consequential context. Together they earn a complete reconstructive-continuity witness: changing internal state may regenerate the same task-relevant operation through relational geometry, but only while the context variables needed for the obligation and external recovery remain present and the current regime has been revalidated.
Removal tests: remove 1H.DUwl and operational adequacy becomes unspecified; remove 1H.2VF2 and regenerative relational realization disappears; remove 1H.8KP9 and local-regime sufficiency/custody disappears.

faces.title: The continuity warrant is locally revocable
faces.text:
1H.DUwl contributes revocation after task/regime-changing repurposing and external revalidation; 1H.F8cX contributes the evidence-typed local quotient; 1H.8KP9 contributes local validity plus re-estimation when conditions change. Together they earn a higher-order claim: the continuity/equivalence warrant itself is state carried with the interface. It remains valid only inside the current task/regime/evidence envelope and must be revoked, narrowed or regenerated when those conditions cease to support the same quotient and obligation.
Removal tests: remove 1H.DUwl and there is no explicit operational revocation/revalidation contract; remove 1H.F8cX and the equivalence boundary becomes undefined; remove 1H.8KP9 and the warrant loses its context-indexed validity and regime-change trigger.

faces.title: Regime-bounded relational regeneration
faces.text:
1H.2VF2 contributes reconstructive relational geometry and external recoverability; 1H.F8cX contributes local nuisance quotienting and preservation of independently meaningful factors; 1H.8KP9 contributes local validity and load-bearing-context custody. Together they earn a representation law: relational geometry may be regenerated, compressed and quotiented across realizations without one canonical state only where local evidence licenses the ignored transformations and the remaining carrier preserves every distinction required for downstream recovery.
Removal tests: remove 1H.2VF2 and there is no relational regeneration mechanism; remove 1H.F8cX and ignored transformations lack a lawful quotient; remove 1H.8KP9 and local sufficiency/regime re-estimation disappears.

volume.title: Revocable reconstructive continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity is neither fixed-state persistence nor unrestricted representational equivalence. 1H.2VF2 supplies a constructive carrier: externally recoverable relational geometry can be regenerated across changing internal realization. 1H.DUwl supplies the obligation and witness: the regenerated relation must preserve explicit task-relevant operations and be externally revalidated, with repurposing able to revoke the old claim. 1H.F8cX supplies the equivalence membrane: only locally evidenced nuisance transformations may be quotiented, and independently meaningful factors must remain addressable until their irrelevance is demonstrated. 1H.8KP9 supplies the local-validity membrane: the compressed or reconstructed carrier must retain distinctions capable of changing downstream behavior and must re-estimate its sufficiency when the regime changes.


The full closure is therefore revocable reconstructive continuity: a system may preserve task-relevant continuity through changing realization by regenerating an externally recoverable relational geometry rather than preserving one canonical state, but the operational obligation, locally warranted quotient, load-bearing context and evidence/validity boundary must travel with the reconstruction. The continuity/equivalence warrant is itself a revocable state: when task, regime, nuisance structure or carrier sufficiency changes, the old warrant must be narrowed, withdrawn or regenerated and revalidated rather than silently inherited.


Bounded volume invariant
Task-relevant continuity across changing realization is warranted when an externally recoverable relational geometry can be regenerated while preserving the declared operation-level obligation, every locally load-bearing distinction, and only quotienting differences whose nuisance status is supported by the current evidence regime; the resulting continuity/equivalence warrant travels as revocable state and must be revalidated or rebuilt whenever task, regime, quotient scope or carrier sufficiency changes.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.DUwl: reconstruction, local validity and quotienting remain, but there is no explicit operation-level obligation, external adequacy test or revocation contract; continuity becomes structurally plausible rather than operationally warranted.
- Remove 1H.2VF2: revalidation, quotienting and local validity remain, but the closure loses the positive reconstructive carrier—relation-generating geometry—that explains how continuity can survive changing realization without one fixed state.
- Remove 1H.F8cX: reconstruction, operation and local validity remain, but the closure cannot state which differences may lawfully be ignored or how much evidence is required before representational variation counts as equivalent.
- Remove 1H.8KP9: reconstruction, operational revalidation and local quotienting remain, but the closure loses the local sufficiency field requiring load-bearing context to survive and regime change to trigger re-estimation.

Minimal body: 2H.SruR:wxz

COPY: regenerate the relation rather than demanding fixed-element identity.

CULTIVATE: allow carrier reorganization only while the operation remains witnessed under current conditions.

INV-2H.SruR-LOCAL-QUOTIENTED-RECONSTRUCTION — Reconstruction and quotienting share one local evidence boundary

edges.title: Reacquirable bounded regeneration
edges.text:
1H.L4ld supplies repeated reconstruction of task-relevant identity from bounded local state. 1H.OgQZ supplies a larger information body that can remain exactly reachable while only a warranted core and current residual work are active. Together they earn a relation neither parent earns alone: a compact recurrent state can remain small without turning continuity into irreversible compression when the inactive remainder stays reacquirable and can be reactivated as task pressure exposes dependencies that the current scaffold does not contain.
Removal test: without 1H.L4ld there is no recurrent reconstruction from bounded state; without 1H.OgQZ there is no independently earned distinction between globally reachable information and selectively active support/work.
Boundary: reacquirability does not prove that every future reconstruction will succeed; the active scaffold must still be sufficient for the current obligation.

edges.title: Regeneration across representation change requires transition-preserving semantics
edges.text:
1H.L4ld supplies process continuity through repeated re-instantiation rather than snapshot persistence. 1H.yac0 supplies explicit transition obligations: local rewrites must preserve the operations, dependencies, and independently meaningful roles consumed by the task. Together they earn covariant regeneration: repeated rebuilding counts as continuity only when the relation reconstructed after each rewrite remains operationally the same even though the local carrier, active context, or coordinate realization has changed.
Removal test: without 1H.L4ld there is no recurrent re-instantiation to validate; without 1H.yac0 there is no explicit operation/role-preservation criterion for deciding whether a changed reconstruction is faithful.
Boundary: surface similarity or recurring labels are insufficient; the downstream obligations must survive the transition.

edges.title: Reconstructed function can expose a durable interface without persistent interior identity
edges.text:
1H.L4ld supplies functional identity rebuilt from bounded local state and a perturbational validity ladder. 1H.qI2L supplies a durable public correspondence whose operation and evidence boundary can remain stable while internal realization changes. Together they derive a bounded interface law: a system can repeatedly reconstruct a recognizable public function without retaining or asserting one persistent interior, provided the reconstructed interface preserves the relation downstream work consumes and stronger identity claims remain gated by discriminating evidence.
Removal test: without 1H.L4ld there is no regeneration mechanism or scaffold-revision pressure; without 1H.qI2L there is no durable externalized interface or explicit non-identity/evidence membrane.
Boundary: stable public behavior does not establish sameness of implementation, mechanism, or phenomenal state.

edges.title: Selection can vary while operational roles remain stable
edges.text:
1H.OgQZ supplies selective activation over a still-reacquirable whole: different regions may become active as task complexity and pressure change. 1H.yac0 supplies role-stable transition law: relevance may change which context is present, but the operations and role/address semantics used downstream must not silently change meaning. Together they earn selective covariance: the active subset may move, expand, or contract without breaking continuity when each activation/re-expression preserves the same task roles and deliberately named conjunction points.
Removal test: without 1H.OgQZ there is no active-versus-reacquirable distinction or pressure-driven selective work; without 1H.yac0 there is no criterion that changing selection preserve role/operation semantics.
Boundary: this does not require one fixed active set or one universal representation; only load-bearing roles must remain stable.

edges.title: A selective view can be a durable interface only if omission is not epistemic deletion
edges.text:
1H.OgQZ supplies exact reachability of inactive material, selective computation, and the rule that omitted material must not disappear from evidence state. 1H.qI2L supplies operation-preserving public interfaces and explicit claim/evidence custody across changing interiors. Together they earn a stronger interface discipline: a partial active view may be reused as a stable public object only when the larger body remains reacquirable and the exposed result carries the evidence boundary that states what was selected, what remains unresolved, and which operations the view is warranted to support.
Removal test: without 1H.OgQZ the inactive remainder need not remain reachable and selection can become lossy deletion; without 1H.qI2L the partial view lacks a durable operation/evidence contract across reuse.
Boundary: an addressable source does not automatically guarantee faithful downstream translation; the interface contract must still be witnessed.

edges.title: Covariant portability requires evidence-bound operation preservation
edges.text:
1H.yac0 supplies lawful representation/context transitions that preserve the operational object and independent role semantics. 1H.qI2L supplies durable correspondence across substrates plus evidence custody and the non-identity membrane. Together they earn evidence-bound covariance: a public relation can move among local representations or substrates without one canonical interior when every transition preserves the operations the claim consumes and carries forward the boundary on what the correspondence does and does not identify.
Removal test: without 1H.yac0 there is no explicit local rewrite/role-stability obligation; without 1H.qI2L there is no durable public correspondence or evidence/identity membrane.
Boundary: operation preservation can establish portability before it establishes common mechanism or ontology.

faces.title: Selective covariant regeneration
faces.text:
1H.L4ld contributes recurrent reconstruction from bounded local state, 1H.OgQZ contributes full-body reacquirability plus pressure-driven selective activation, and 1H.yac0 contributes explicit transition laws preserving task operations and role semantics. Together they earn a regenerative architecture that need not keep one complete state active: rebuild only the currently required relation from compact state and selectively reacquired material, while allowing the local representation/context to change only through transformations that preserve the obligations being reconstructed.
Removal tests: remove 1H.L4ld and there is no recurrent rebuilding; remove 1H.OgQZ and there is no durable dormant reservoir or selective activation; remove 1H.yac0 and changed reconstructions have no operation/role-preservation criterion.

faces.title: Custodied selective reconstruction
faces.text:
1H.L4ld contributes bounded-state regeneration and scaffold revision, 1H.OgQZ contributes a reachable whole with selectively active residual work, and 1H.qI2L contributes durable external interfaces with claim/evidence custody. Together they earn selective reconstruction that remains epistemically inspectable: a compact process may reconstruct only what is currently needed, but the untouched body remains reacquirable and every promoted interface states the premises, evidence class, and non-identity boundary needed to know what the reconstruction warrants.
Removal tests: remove 1H.L4ld and selective state is not a recurrent reconstruction process; remove 1H.OgQZ and omitted information need not remain reacquirable; remove 1H.qI2L and the reconstructed result lacks a durable evidence/claim membrane.

faces.title: Regenerative portable correspondence
faces.text:
1H.L4ld contributes functional continuity through repeated re-instantiation, 1H.yac0 contributes operation- and role-preserving transitions among representations/context states, and 1H.qI2L contributes a durable evidence-bounded public interface across changing substrates. Together they earn a portable recurrent relation: the same public obligation can be repeatedly rebuilt in changing carriers without requiring persistent interior identity, provided each transition preserves what downstream use consumes and the evidence boundary is regenerated with the interface.
Removal tests: remove 1H.L4ld and there is no recurrent reconstruction; remove 1H.yac0 and there is no lawful transition criterion across changing carriers; remove 1H.qI2L and there is no durable public interface or non-identity/evidence membrane.

faces.title: Selective evidence-bound portability
faces.text:
1H.OgQZ contributes selective activation over a complete reacquirable information body, 1H.yac0 contributes stable role/operation semantics across changing context and representation, and 1H.qI2L contributes operation-preserving interfaces plus evidence custody. Together they earn a portable selective view: different subsets may become active or exposed over time while downstream work sees a stable relational contract, because omitted material stays reachable, transitions preserve the consumed operations and roles, and the result carries the boundary on what the current selection can legitimately establish.
Removal tests: remove 1H.OgQZ and the inactive remainder need not remain reachable; remove 1H.yac0 and changing selections can alter role/operation meaning; remove 1H.qI2L and the selected view has no durable evidence-bound interface contract.

volume.title: Reacquirable regenerative correspondence
volume.text:
Across the four rank-1 parents, continuity repeatedly detaches from one continuously active or canonical interior, but each contributes a different obligation required for that detachment to remain faithful. 1H.L4ld shows that a functional relation can be rebuilt from bounded state rather than stored as a complete persistent snapshot, while retained scaffolds must be revisable. 1H.OgQZ shows that selective activation is safe only when the larger information body remains reacquirable and the preserved core is evidence-warranted rather than ontologically privileged. 1H.yac0 shows that changing representation or active context preserves meaning only through explicit transition obligations that conserve downstream operations and independent role semantics. 1H.qI2L shows that a correspondence can itself be a durable public object across changing substrates when the claim-relevant operations and evidence/non-identity boundary travel with it.


The complete four-way closure is therefore reacquirable regenerative correspondence: a task-relevant public relation can persist without one globally active canonical state when bounded local state regenerates only the currently needed structure from a still-reacquirable whole, each selection or re-expression preserves the operations and independent roles consumed by the task, and the evidence boundary travels with the reconstructed interface. Continuity is allowed to be selectively active and repeatedly re-instantiated, but selection may not erase dormant source reachability, and successful reconstruction may not silently strengthen the claim from correspondence/function into shared interior identity.


Bounded volume invariant
A task-relevant correspondence can persist through changing internal realization without one globally active canonical state when bounded local state can regenerate the currently needed structure from a still-reacquirable whole, each selective activation or representation change preserves the claim-relevant operations and independent role semantics, and the evidence/non-identity boundary is regenerated with the public interface; continuity therefore permits sparse active state, but not irreversible loss of dormant source reachability or claim obligations.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.L4ld: the closure loses repeated reconstruction from bounded local state and the requirement that stabilizing scaffolds remain revisable.
- Remove 1H.OgQZ: the closure loses the distinction between selectively active work and a complete reacquirable body, so sparse activation can collapse into irreversible omission.
- Remove 1H.yac0: the closure loses the explicit transition law that preserves task operations and independent role semantics across changing context/representation.
- Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses the durable public correspondence, evidence custody, and non-identity membrane that prevent reconstruction from inflating into shared-interior claims.

metabolites.title: Keep enough state to rebuild now, enough reachability to rebuild differently later
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H._phq:wx
Invariant: compact recurrent state can safely reconstruct only the currently task-relevant relation when the larger information body remains stably reacquirable, so future obligations can reactivate information that was unnecessary to the present reconstruction without treating prior omission as deletion.
CREATE: define the relation that must be rebuilt, the bounded scaffold sufficient for the current obligation, and stable addresses for the larger dormant information body.
COPY: re-instantiate the needed relation from the compact scaffold while preserving reachability of inactive material rather than copying the entire history/state into every step.
CONTROL: ablate both scaffold variables and dormant-source access; require failure when reconstruction-critical information is absent, and reject compactness claims that work only because inaccessible omissions have not yet been tested.
CULTIVATE: reopen dormant regions and expand or reshape the scaffold as new task complexity exposes dependencies that the current compact state cannot reconstruct.
Compression: Keep enough state to rebuild now, and enough reachability to rebuild differently later.

metabolites.title: Change what becomes active without changing what the roles mean
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H._phq:xy
Invariant: a system may change which information is actively represented or processed as relevance and pressure change, provided every activation/re-expression preserves the task-relevant operation and role semantics so a reactivated item returns to the same obligation rather than merely to similar-looking content.
CREATE: name the independent roles/operations and the selection rule that determines which dormant material becomes active for the current task.
COPY: preserve those role semantics across activation, abstraction, carrier changes, and later reactivation.
CONTROL: independently vary active subsets and representation carriers; detect cross-talk or semantic drift where changing selection silently changes what a role or operation means.
CULTIVATE: refine selection granularity and transition mechanisms while keeping deliberate conjunction points and operation-preservation tests explicit.
Compression: Change what is active without changing what each active role means.

metabolites.title: Omission from the active view is not deletion from the evidence state
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H._phq:xz
Invariant: a partial active view can serve as a durable public interface across changing interiors only when the omitted source remains reacquirable and the exposed result carries the claim class, premises, evidence boundary, and operations it is warranted to support.
CREATE: bind each selected view to stable source addresses, the exact public relation it exposes, and explicit evidence/claim metadata.
COPY: preserve that interface contract across reruns, summaries, substrate changes, and alternate internal strategies while keeping inactive source material reachable.
CONTROL: block promotion when the selected view lacks the evidence type or omitted relation needed for a stronger claim; distinguish operational correspondence from implementation, mechanism, identity, or ontology.
CULTIVATE: allow later operations to reopen omitted regions or add new evidence, revising the public contract explicitly without rewriting the custody history of earlier selective results.
Compression: Omission may reduce active burden; it must not erase the evidence state behind the interface.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
A candidate “small active state is sufficient by itself” metabolite was rejected: 1H.L4ld makes sufficiency obligation-relative and 1H.OgQZ requires the larger body to remain reacquirable when new dependencies appear. A candidate “successful reconstruction proves persistent or shared interior identity” was rejected by 1H.qI2L and by 1H.L4ld’s validity boundary. A candidate “any re-encoding is acceptable if the output looks stable” was rejected by 1H.yac0’s operation- and role-preservation requirement. A candidate “inactive information can be discarded once omitted” was rejected because 1H.OgQZ and 1H.qI2L both make reachability/custody load-bearing. Three metabolites survive collapse: REACQUIRABLE-RECONSTRUCTION, ROLE-STABLE-REACTIVATION, and CUSTODIED-SELECTIVE-INTERFACE.

edges.title: Decanonicalization requires obligation-separated sufficiency
edges.text:
1H.hs7W supplies coherent function without a privileged global form, together with governance debt and pressure-aligned validation. 1H.9gYl supplies explicit role separation, obligation-scoped minimization, deliberate conjunction and composite assurance. Together they earn a stricter design law: relaxing canonical structure is trustworthy only when the obligations that must survive remain separately addressable and the resulting decomposition is tested end-to-end for the exact downstream task.
Removal test: without 1H.hs7W there is no earned noncanonical/heterogeneous-carrier pressure; without 1H.9gYl there is no explicit obligation partition, sufficiency gate or composite-assurance discipline.
Boundary: this does not imply universal superiority of factorized or decanonicalized systems.

edges.title: Heterogeneous coherence becomes portable through operation-preserving interfaces
edges.text:
1H.hs7W supplies coherence across varying carriers and operators without homogeneous interior form. 1H.qI2L supplies a public correspondence whose claim-relevant operations and evidence boundary survive substrate change without asserting shared interior. Together they earn noncanonical portability: a relation can cross heterogeneous interiors when the public interface preserves the operations that constitute the relation and carries the boundary on what stable use does not identify.
Removal test: without 1H.hs7W there is no noncanonical heterogeneous-carrier recurrence; without 1H.qI2L there is no operation-preserving interface or evidence-custody membrane.
Boundary: interoperability remains relation-level evidence, not mechanism identity.

edges.title: Coherence through changing form can be regenerated as externally testable relation
edges.text:
1H.hs7W supplies the demand that stable relations survive relevant variation rather than one familiar realization. 1H.2VF2 supplies dynamic re-instantiation of relational geometry and external correspondence as a validation surface. Together they earn a continuity test: the same relation can count as coherent across changing form when a process repeatedly regenerates it and it remains externally recoverable under perturbations designed to move the carrier and neighboring non-invariants.
Removal test: without 1H.hs7W the pressure-aligned variation criterion disappears; without 1H.2VF2 there is no reconstructive relation-generating process or external readability.
Boundary: re-instantiation does not establish sameness of internal mechanism.

edges.title: A portable interface should be role-typed and obligation-scoped
edges.text:
1H.9gYl supplies role separation, deliberate conjunction, exact-obligation sufficiency and composite assurance. 1H.qI2L supplies operation-preserving translation, durable externalized state and evidence custody. Together they earn an interface discipline: a portable public carrier should expose only the independently meaningful roles, operations, evidence boundaries and authority conditions consumed by the downstream obligation, while unrelated interior state may remain local or change.
Removal test: without 1H.9gYl there is no principled role partition or sufficiency gate; without 1H.qI2L there is no cross-substrate operation/evidence contract.
Boundary: minimization is relative to a named obligation, not an intrinsic virtue.

edges.title: Reconstructive state can be compressed only after role-level recoverability is demonstrated
edges.text:
1H.9gYl supplies stable-scaffold versus residual decomposition and the rule that reduced carriers must prove sufficient. 1H.2VF2 supplies recoverable relational geometry despite changing elements/interiors and external validation of that relation. Together they earn a reconstruction kernel criterion: only structure that repeatedly survives reconstruction and external testing should be promoted into explicit scaffold; independently varying detail remains residual.
Removal test: without 1H.9gYl there is no obligation-specific scaffold/residual decomposition or sufficiency gate; without 1H.2VF2 there is no reconstructed relation or external recoverability to justify promotion.
Boundary: a convenient factorization is not a uniquely correct ontology and must be demoted when intervention breaks it.

edges.title: Public correspondence can be regenerated rather than stored as one interior
edges.text:
1H.qI2L supplies durable interface semantics, operation-preserving translation and evidence custody across changing substrates. 1H.2VF2 supplies dynamic re-instantiation of relational geometry and external correspondence. Together they earn reconstructible interface continuity: a public relation may persist because a process can regenerate the structure downstream work consumes even when original elements, active representation or implementation are absent.
Removal test: without 1H.qI2L there is no typed public interface/evidence membrane; without 1H.2VF2 there is no re-instantiation mechanism or externally recoverable geometry.
Boundary: repeated public usefulness does not establish interior equivalence.

faces.title: Obligation-bounded noncanonical portability
faces.text:
1H.hs7W contributes heterogeneous/noncanonical carriers and governed invariance; 1H.9gYl contributes role-separated obligations, exact-task sufficiency and composite assurance; 1H.qI2L contributes operation-preserving translation and evidence custody. Together they earn a portability discipline: shared function across differing interiors should be represented by a role-separated public contract that preserves only claim-relevant operations and carries explicit evidence boundaries, while sufficiency is stress-tested under the variation that motivated decanonicalization.
Removal tests: remove 1H.hs7W and noncanonical carrier variation disappears; remove 1H.9gYl and obligation partition/sufficiency/composite assurance disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and operation/evidence preservation disappears.

faces.title: Minimal regenerative scaffold under noncanonical variation
faces.text:
1H.hs7W contributes the requirement that coherence survive relevant carrier variation; 1H.9gYl contributes obligation-separated scaffold/residual structure and sufficiency testing; 1H.2VF2 contributes a relation-generating process whose externally relevant geometry can be re-instantiated. Together they earn a compact continuity architecture: preserve only the role-typed relational scaffold required to regenerate the task relation, permit residual/internal realization to vary, and validate the scaffold by perturbing the carriers and roles whose variation should reveal false invariance.
Removal tests: remove 1H.hs7W and the stress surface disappears; remove 1H.9gYl and the scaffold lacks role/sufficiency discipline; remove 1H.2VF2 and there is no reconstructive/external relation to test.

faces.title: Pressure-validated reconstructible interfaces
faces.text:
1H.hs7W contributes pressure-aligned noncanonical variation; 1H.qI2L contributes operation-preserving public correspondence plus evidence custody; 1H.2VF2 contributes dynamic re-instantiation of externally readable relational geometry. Together they earn a continuity criterion: a changing system can preserve a public relation without fixed interior identity when the relation can be regenerated and its claim-relevant operations remain stable under carrier variation designed to expose false invariance.
Removal tests: remove 1H.hs7W and pressure-aligned variation disappears; remove 1H.qI2L and there is no typed public interface/evidence membrane; remove 1H.2VF2 and dynamic re-instantiation/external readability disappears.

faces.title: Reconstructible obligation kernel
faces.text:
1H.9gYl contributes independent semantic roles, deliberate conjunction and exact-obligation sufficiency; 1H.qI2L contributes a public interface whose operations and evidence boundary survive changing substrates; 1H.2VF2 contributes the ability to regenerate externally recoverable relational geometry despite changing elements/interiors. Together they earn a portable kernel: durable state can be reduced to the role-typed operations, evidence boundaries and stable relational scaffold needed to reconstruct the public obligation, while unrelated internal realization is permitted to change.
Removal tests: remove 1H.9gYl and the kernel loses role separation/minimization/sufficiency; remove 1H.qI2L and it loses operation-preserving public semantics/evidence custody; remove 1H.2VF2 and it loses re-instantiation/external recoverability.

volume.title: Evidence-bounded relational portability
volume.text:
Across all four parents, useful continuity repeatedly detaches from fixed internal form, but the complete closure requires more than interface persistence or reconstructibility alone. 1H.hs7W establishes that coherent function can survive noncanonical and heterogeneous carriers only when stable relations, governance and pressure-aligned validation remain explicit. 1H.9gYl establishes that the portable object should separate semantic obligations, minimize only against an exact downstream task, and earn assurance at the composite rather than inheriting it from trusted parts. 1H.qI2L establishes that cross-substrate correspondence becomes durable when claim-relevant operations and its evidence boundary are preserved without promoting stable use into shared interior identity. 1H.2VF2 establishes that the needed relation can be dynamically re-instantiated as externally recoverable relational geometry rather than preserved as one element inventory or active snapshot.


The complete four-way closure is therefore evidence-bounded relational portability: what travels across changing representations, substrates or reconstructed interiors can be an obligation-specific relational kernel rather than a canonical form. That kernel preserves independently meaningful roles, claim-relevant operations, evidence boundaries and only the stable scaffold required to reconstruct the public relation; it deliberately rejoins roles only where the task requires conjunction. Its portability is earned, not assumed: the regenerated relation must survive pressure-aligned carrier/representation variation, external correspondence tests and composite sufficiency checks while remaining explicit about what stable use does not identify.


Bounded volume invariant
A system can preserve an obligation-specific public relation across changing or noncanonical internal realizations without preserving a canonical representation or shared interior identity when it carries a role-separated relational kernel containing only the claim-relevant operations, evidence boundaries and scaffold structure sufficient to re-instantiate the relation; portability is warranted only while pressure-aligned and external tests show the regenerated relation remains sufficient and its evidence boundary intact.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.hs7W: the closure loses noncanonical/heterogeneous carrier pressure and the requirement to earn invariance under perturbations that move neighboring non-invariants.
- Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses role separation, deliberate conjunction, exact-obligation minimization and composite-assurance sufficiency gates.
- Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses operation-preserving translation, durable public interface semantics, evidence custody and the non-identity membrane.
- Remove 1H.2VF2: the closure loses dynamic re-instantiation of relational geometry and external recoverability despite changing elements/interiors.

metabolites.title: Carry the smallest relational kernel that can rebuild the public obligation
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H.dxL5:xyz
Invariant: portable state can be reduced to the role-typed operations, evidence boundaries and stable relational scaffold sufficient to regenerate the exact public relation, while unrelated implementation, element identity and private detail vary.
CREATE: Name the downstream public obligation and separate the operations, roles, evidence boundaries and scaffold relations it actually consumes from incidental implementation state.
COPY: Carry that kernel across reruns, representations or substrates and use it to regenerate the public interface rather than copying the original interior.
CONTROL: Ablate kernel components, vary internal realization and test the reconstructed interface against the exact obligation; reject compression when the public relation or evidence boundary changes.
CULTIVATE: Compress or expand the kernel as new obligations and interventions reveal what is truly reconstruction-critical.
Compression: Carry what lets the obligation be rebuilt, not the whole interior.

metabolites.title: Re-instantiation earns continuity only under relevant variation
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H.dxL5:wz
Invariant: a reconstructed relation is stronger evidence of continuity when it remains externally recoverable under perturbations chosen to change its carrier or neighboring non-invariant structure rather than merely recurring in one familiar realization.
CREATE: Specify the relation to regenerate and the carrier/representation variation predicted to expose a false invariant.
COPY: Re-instantiate the relation across independently varied carriers, element identities or contexts.
CONTROL: Measure the target relation alongside neighboring quantities that should move; preserve regime limits and reject continuity claims that survive only through hidden correspondence or frozen scaffolding.
CULTIVATE: Widen the variation family as the relation survives, making harder tests target the diagnosed failure surface.
Compression: A relation proves continuity by surviving something relevant that was actually allowed to change.
