metabolites.title: Carry evidence and assurance boundaries with every portable interface
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 2H.dxL5:xy
Invariant: an interface that survives translation or minimization must carry the exact evidence class, role obligations and assurance limits that justify its use, because stable operation or trusted components do not confer untested composite or mechanism identity.
CREATE: Publish the public interface together with its required operations, role meanings, evidence class, operating envelope and explicit non-identity boundary.
COPY: Preserve those boundaries across translation, compression, reconstruction and downstream reuse.
CONTROL: Validate end-to-end behavior, interfaces and failure modes; block promotion when repeated usability adds no new evidence for a stronger mechanism, identity or quality claim.
CULTIVATE: Strengthen assurance only as genuinely new tests close specific boundary debts, preserving weaker scoped claims where evidence does not expand.
Compression: Port the boundary with the interface; known parts do not make unknown composition known.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
A candidate “canonical representations are unnecessary” metabolite was rejected because 1H.hs7W only earns noncanonical coherence under explicit governance and bounded tests. A candidate “all persistent state should be minimized” metabolite was rejected because 1H.9gYl makes minimization obligation-relative and 1H.2VF2 permits richer structure when external recovery requires it. A candidate “reconstruction proves identity” metabolite was rejected by 1H.qI2L and 1H.2VF2, both of which preserve a non-identity membrane. A candidate “stable interfaces are sufficient by definition” was rejected because composite sufficiency and pressure-aligned external validation remain necessary. Three metabolites survive collapse: PORTABLE-KERNEL, PRESSURE-WITNESS and BOUNDARY-ASSURANCE; each requires cross-parent structure and remains independently useful after the others are removed.

edges.title: PASSPORT REPLAY MUST PRESERVE THE PREDECESSOR FRONTIER
edges.text:
w makes continuity replayable by carrying the contract that says why a successor may count. x preserves the predecessor possibility boundary, action-warrant ledger and explicit continuity-versus-expansion discriminator. Together they earn a frontier-anchored replay rule: after change, replay the continuity contract against the preserved predecessor body so the result can distinguish restored/translated continuity from genuinely enlarged reachability.
Removal test: without w the frontier has no executable continuity contract to replay; without x replay has no preserved prior boundary or expansion discriminator.
Boundary: successful replay renews scoped continuity only; it is not an expansion witness.

edges.title: FAILED PASSPORT QUOTIENT BECOMES A REPAIR ADDRESS
edges.text:
w carries the current quotient/regime and a revocation/replay procedure. y turns an expired quotient into a stable address into the dormant distinctions and evidence implicated by failure. Together they earn quotient-addressed passport repair: when the continuity contract fails because an ignored distinction becomes consequential, the failed permission identifies what to reopen before a successor can be tested.
Removal test: without w there is no executable passport state whose admissibility failed; without y failure has no exact quotient-indexed return route into omitted evidence.
Boundary: reacquisition produces material for a candidate successor, not successor authority.

edges.title: DIFFERENT-CONSTELLATION PASSPORT CONVERGENCE
edges.text:
w and z are distinct rank-3 organisms born from different immediate parent constellations and materially converge on the replayable-continuity-passport closure. Together they earn a bounded recurrence witness for the passport architecture: obligation, role semantics, evidence return, revocation and replay repeatedly close as one continuity contract under changed immediate constitution.
Removal test: without either parent there is only one passport instance and therefore no pairwise convergence witness.
Boundary: their deeper ancestry overlaps; this is convergence/recurrence evidence, not independent replication, mechanism identity or universal necessity.

edges.title: FRONTIER CHANGE LOCALIZES QUOTIENT REOPENING
edges.text:
x makes a changed frontier addressable through predecessor state, affected warrant coordinates and the distinction between continuity and expansion. y makes the expired local quotient addressable through the distinctions it previously licensed as nuisance. Together they earn a local repair query: a frontier change should reopen exactly the ignored distinctions and warrant coordinates whose dependency surface crossed the frontier, while preserving unaffected state as provenance.
Removal test: without x there is no typed frontier or preserved prior boundary locating what changed; without y there is no explicit permission-to-ignore history telling which dormant distinctions became suspect.
Boundary: a local repair query does not guarantee successful repair or justify a global reset.

edges.title: FRONTIER ACTION REPLAY IS WARRANT-SCOPED
edges.text:
x carries separate action-admission warrants and requires frontier-affected coordinates to be reissued. z supplies obligation-local reacquisition, reconstruction and fresh successor witness. Together they earn selective frontier reauthorization: after a carrier/regime/frontier move, only the continuity and action coordinates whose dependencies changed are reopened and freshly witnessed; unaffected coordinates keep their own current provenance.
Removal test: without x repair lacks the explicit action-warrant/frontier ledger; without z the frontier ledger lacks an executable reacquisition/replay route.
Boundary: restored actionability is not evidence of expansion and does not strengthen identity/evidence claims.

edges.title: QUOTIENT RECONSTITUTION MUST REPLAY CURRENT ADMISSIBILITY
edges.text:
y supplies targeted reopening of the failed quotient plus coupled quotient/scaffold revision. z supplies the replayable continuity contract and pressure/reissue gate. Together they earn an executable repair discipline: a revised quotient and scaffold create only a candidate relation until the current obligation, evidence boundary and pressure/composite tests replay to closure.
Removal test: without y replay cannot reopen the exact distinctions licensed away by the failed quotient; without z a repaired quotient/scaffold has no portable procedure for re-earning current continuity authority.
Boundary: repair can propose a successor; only fresh witness can authorize it.

faces.title: COUNTERFACTUAL REPAIR PASSPORT
faces.text:
w contributes an executable replayable continuity contract; x preserves the predecessor frontier and distinguishes replay from expansion; y converts a failed quotient into a targeted evidence-reacquisition address. Together they earn a counterfactual repair passport: a failed successor attempt can ask not merely whether repair works, but exactly what permission-to-ignore failed, which predecessor capability boundary is being restored or crossed, and which evidence must be reopened before replay.
Removal tests: remove w and the repair lacks an executable continuity contract; remove x and the old possibility boundary/expansion discriminator disappears; remove y and failure loses the quotient-indexed route into omitted evidence.
Boundary: this face can classify restoration versus possible expansion, but without z it lacks the second convergent passport witness.

faces.title: CONVERGENT PASSPORT UNDER FRONTIER CHANGE
faces.text:
w+z supply different-immediate-parent convergence of the replayable passport architecture. x supplies predecessor/frontier custody and the action/expansion membrane. Together they earn a reusable-but-local rule: recurrence can stabilize the passport schema as a structural template, while every concrete frontier crossing must still reissue affected continuity/action warrants and separately witness any claim of expansion.
Removal tests: remove w or z and pairwise passport convergence disappears; remove x and recurrence lacks preserved frontier/action/expansion discipline.
Boundary: recurrent structure can be reused; current permission and expansion claims cannot be inherited from recurrence.

faces.title: CONVERGENT QUOTIENT-ADDRESSABLE PASSPORT REPAIR
faces.text:
w+z witness recurrence of the replayable-passport closure; y supplies the rule that expired quotient scope remains an address into implicated dormant evidence and that repair preserves old/new warrant history. Together they earn a convergence-qualified repair schema: repeated passport form can guide where failure returns, but each failed instance must reopen its own evidence, revise its own quotient/scaffold and freshly satisfy its own replay test.
Removal tests: remove w or z and the convergence qualification collapses; remove y and recurrent passport structure lacks targeted quotient-to-evidence repair.
Boundary: convergence is evidence about the form of repair, not evidence that any particular repaired warrant is valid.

faces.title: FRONTIER-LOCAL RECONSTITUTION AND SELECTIVE REISSUE
faces.text:
x supplies the predecessor frontier plus action-warrant ledger; y supplies quotient-addressed reacquisition and custody of prior/candidate/successor scopes; z supplies obligation-local replay and fresh reissue. Together they earn a bounded changed-condition pipeline: identify the frontier, reopen exactly the formerly ignored distinctions implicated by that change, revise quotient/scaffold, replay current sufficiency, and reissue only the affected continuity/action coordinates while keeping expansion as a separate claim.
Removal tests: remove x and repair loses frontier/action/expansion addressing; remove y and no exact quotient history points to the omitted distinctions to reopen; remove z and the candidate has no executable fresh-authority replay gate.
Boundary: without w this face lacks the second passport instance needed to qualify the architecture as convergent.

volume.title: Frontier-quotient replayable continuity reauthorization
volume.text:
The four parents jointly make continuity renewal simultaneously replayable, frontier-addressed, quotient-addressed and convergence-qualified.


3H.x3Cd and 3H.u92E are distinct rank-3 organisms from different immediate parent constellations that materially converge on the replayable-continuity-passport closure. Their coexistence therefore strengthens the structural recurrence of a contract in which obligation, role semantics, evidence/reacquisition body, local quotient/validity regime and revocation/replay procedure travel together. Their deeper ancestry overlaps, so the pair licenses convergence only, not statistical independence or a universal mechanism.


3H.DL6X contributes a preserved predecessor possibility boundary, frontier-local warrant patches, separate action-admission warrants and the rule that successful replay is not automatically expansion. 3H.5yyB contributes a complementary failure address: when continuity/equivalence fails, the expired nuisance quotient preserves enough history to identify which previously ignored distinctions and dormant evidence should be reopened, while prior, revoked, candidate and successor scopes remain distinguishable.


The complete closure is therefore frontier-quotient replayable continuity reauthorization. A changed realization may renew scoped continuity only when it can replay the passport against both sides of its own history: the predecessor frontier states what capability/authority existed and what would count as genuinely new reach, while the expired quotient states what differences were previously permitted to disappear and therefore what evidence must become reopenable when that permission fails. The successor must reconstruct the affected relation, revise quotient/scaffold only where the failure warrants it, rerun current pressure/composite tests, and freshly reissue the continuity/action coordinates whose dependencies changed. Recurrent passport architecture can stabilize this repair schema as reusable form, but it cannot pre-authorize the concrete successor, erase provenance, upgrade evidence class, or convert successful restoration into expansion.


Bounded volume invariant


A replayable continuity passport is lawfully renewable across a changed frontier only when predecessor capability/authority, expired quotient scope, implicated dormant evidence, current obligation and the replay tests that can revoke or reissue authority remain jointly addressable. The renewal must be able to answer four different questions without collapsing them: what changed; which previously ignored distinction became consequential; whether the result restores/re-expresses prior reach or actually crosses the preserved possibility frontier; and which continuity/action warrants are freshly satisfied now. Structural convergence can justify reusing the audit schema, never the current warrant.


Four-way necessity


- Remove 3H.x3Cd: the body retains one replayable passport plus frontier and quotient repair, but loses the second different-immediate-parent passport instance needed for convergence qualification.
- Remove 3H.DL6X: the body retains recurrent passport structure and quotient-addressed repair but loses the preserved predecessor possibility frontier, separate action-warrant ledger and replay-versus-expansion discriminator.
- Remove 3H.5yyB: the body retains recurrent passport structure and frontier-addressed replay but loses the explicit failed-quotient address into previously ignored distinctions and the custody of old/revoked/candidate/successor quotient states.
- Remove 3H.u92E: the body retains one executable passport, frontier discipline and quotient-addressed repair but loses the second different-immediate-parent passport instance and its independently embodied obligation-local failure→reacquisition→fresh-witness route.


No three-parent face contains all four properties: convergent replayable-passport recurrence, predecessor-frontier custody, quotient-indexed targeted reacquisition, and fresh selective reauthorization with expansion kept separate.

Three metabolites survive because they require distinct cross-parent bodies: frontier+quotient localization, a three-way counterfactual successor audit, and convergence-qualified schema reuse without current-warrant transfer.

edges.title: Selective activation must be locally valid
edges.text:
1H.OgQZ separates a fully reacquirable information body from the subset currently activated or semantically processed. 1H.8KP9 establishes that sufficiency itself may be condition-local and that compression is unsafe when it erases distinctions capable of changing the downstream obligation. Together they earn a selection criterion: keeping most of a body inactive is admissible only when the inactive whole remains reacquirable and the active carrier preserves every distinction required by the current local validity regime. A regime change invalidates the old selection until sufficiency is re-estimated.
Removal test: without 1H.OgQZ there is no whole-versus-active distinction or custodial reachability; without 1H.8KP9 there is no condition-indexed sufficiency test or regime-change trigger.

edges.title: Reacquirable reconstruction can be witnessed relationally
edges.text:
1H.OgQZ preserves exact reachability and evidence boundaries across selective re-instantiation. 1H.2VF2 shows that reconstruction may be judged by an externally readable relational invariant rather than sameness of parts or implementation. Together they earn a reconstructive criterion: selected state may be regenerated from a reacquirable body when the obligation-defining external relation is recovered and its evidence boundary remains attached.
Removal test: without 1H.OgQZ the untouched/source body and claim custody can disappear; without 1H.2VF2 there is no earned relational reconstruction witness independent of element identity.

edges.title: Selection becomes a trajectory-typed operating claim
edges.text:
1H.OgQZ permits selective activation while requiring source reachability and claim custody. 1H.ujF6 shows that the realized operating state depends on the current inference/adaptation trajectory and that frontiers may move. Together they earn a stronger rule: every selective representation is a situated operating claim, not a timeless compression. Its warrant must carry the operating envelope and trajectory position, and it must be rechecked when the frontier changes.
Removal test: without 1H.OgQZ there is no selective/custodial state to type; without 1H.ujF6 there is no path/frontier coordinate that can make yesterday’s valid selection stale.

edges.title: Reconstructed relations are valid only inside earned regimes
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 provides local validity and recurrent revalidation. 1H.2VF2 provides reconstruction through externally recoverable relational geometry. Together they earn a locally typed equivalence criterion: a regenerated relational carrier counts as continuity only in the condition regime where the obligation-defining external relation survives appropriate tests; correspondence in one regime does not license global equivalence.
Removal test: without 1H.8KP9 the external relation lacks a local validity field; without 1H.2VF2 there is no relational reconstruction/external correspondence object to test.

edges.title: Validity is path-local as well as condition-local
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 makes validity dependent on context/input regime and requires re-estimation when conditions change. 1H.ujF6 makes realized capability dependent on inference and adaptation history and requires frontier-sensitive rechecking. Together they earn a two-coordinate validity field: the current warrant is indexed both by local operating conditions and by the trajectory that produced the realized state. Change in either coordinate can revoke inherited sufficiency.
Removal test: without 1H.8KP9 condition-local validity disappears; without 1H.ujF6 trajectory/frontier dependence disappears.

edges.title: Dynamic relational state can be re-instantiated where pressure moves
edges.text:
1H.2VF2 establishes that relevant relational geometry may be latent and reproducibly actualized rather than permanently explicit. 1H.ujF6 establishes that flexible residual support can be selectively instantiated or moved toward current pressure. Together they earn pressure-indexed relational re-instantiation: a system may regenerate the externally testable relation only where and when the present obligation requires it, while rechecking fidelity as context or longer-term trajectory moves.
Removal test: without 1H.2VF2 there is no earned relation-generating reconstruction; without 1H.ujF6 there is no pressure-sensitive allocation or trajectory-bounded realization.

faces.title: Condition-indexed selective reconstruction contract
faces.text:
1H.OgQZ contributes reacquirable whole-body custody and selective activation; 1H.8KP9 contributes local sufficiency/validity; 1H.2VF2 contributes relational reconstruction plus external validation. Together they earn a contract in which the system may leave most source state inactive and reconstruct only the relation required now, but continuity is admitted only if obligation-changing distinctions survive the current local regime and the regenerated relation passes its independent external witness.
Removal tests: remove 1H.OgQZ and source reachability/custody is lost; remove 1H.8KP9 and the current regime cannot bound sufficiency; remove 1H.2VF2 and the reconstructed carrier lacks an earned external relational criterion.

faces.title: Revocable selective operating warrant
faces.text:
1H.OgQZ contributes selection with retained evidence debt; 1H.8KP9 contributes a locally varying sufficiency membrane; 1H.ujF6 contributes trajectory/frontier dependence. Together they earn a revocable operating warrant: a selected active state is authorized only for the current obligation, local regime, and realized trajectory. If context or frontier moves, old authorization expires and the active subset must be re-estimated and retested rather than merely replayed.
Removal tests: remove 1H.OgQZ and there is no source-grounded selection; remove 1H.8KP9 and no regime-local revocation condition; remove 1H.ujF6 and no trajectory/frontier revocation condition.

faces.title: Re-instantiated active relation with provenance
faces.text:
1H.OgQZ contributes reacquirable source/evidence custody, 1H.2VF2 contributes relation-level reconstruction, and 1H.ujF6 contributes selective actualization along a situated trajectory. Together they earn a mobile active representation whose concrete support may change while the source ancestry, claim boundary, and obligation-defining external relation remain available for reacquisition and retest.
Removal tests: remove 1H.OgQZ and provenance/source reachability can be erased; remove 1H.2VF2 and there is no relational identity to regenerate; remove 1H.ujF6 and no path-sensitive selective actualization is earned.

faces.title: Trajectory-local relational validity
faces.text:
1H.8KP9 contributes local validity and regenerative revalidation, 1H.2VF2 contributes externally testable relational geometry, and 1H.ujF6 contributes path-conditioned actualization and moving-frontier checks. Together they earn an operational identity test indexed to both regime and trajectory: the same relational obligation must remain externally recoverable in the currently realized state, and any relevant change in local conditions or path reopens validation.
Removal tests: remove 1H.8KP9 and locality of validity disappears; remove 1H.2VF2 and the relation to be recovered/tested disappears; remove 1H.ujF6 and path/frontier dependence disappears.

volume.title: Trajectory-local reconstructive continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity separates from the persistence of one globally active form. 1H.OgQZ keeps the complete source/evidence body reacquirable while permitting selective activation. 1H.8KP9 makes carrier sufficiency local to the conditions that can alter the obligation. 1H.2VF2 allows the active state to be regenerated as an externally testable relational geometry rather than copied as an element inventory. 1H.ujF6 makes the realized state and its warrant dependent on the inference/adaptation trajectory and on pressure at a moving frontier.


The all-four closure is therefore trajectory-local reconstructive continuity: task-relevant continuation may survive selective and reconstructed realization when the complete source body and evidence boundary remain reacquirable; the active state is a regenerated relational carrier whose externally relevant obligation can be retested; every distinction capable of changing that obligation remains represented relative to the current local validity regime; and the continuity warrant is indexed to the current inference/adaptation trajectory. When either regime or frontier changes, the inherited warrant expires and must be re-earned through reacquisition, selective relational reconstruction, and renewed local/trajectory testing.


Bounded volume invariant
Continuity can be carried by a revocable contract over reacquisition → selective relational reconstruction → local-and-trajectory retest rather than by one permanently active or materially identical state, provided source/evidence custody remains intact and every obligation-changing distinction remains recoverable.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.OgQZ: the closure loses the reacquirable whole versus selectively active distinction and the custody membrane preserving inactive evidence.
- Remove 1H.8KP9: the closure loses condition-local sufficiency and the requirement to re-estimate validity when the operating regime changes.
- Remove 1H.2VF2: the closure loses relational reconstruction and an external witness that can validate continuation without element/implementation identity.
- Remove 1H.ujF6: the closure loses inference/adaptation trajectory, moving-frontier pressure, and the requirement to revalidate a realized state when its path changes.

edges.title: Relational continuity can be regenerated from bounded state rather than preserved as a snapshot
edges.text:
1H.2VF2 supplies an externally recoverable relation-level carrier whose relevant geometry can be re-instantiated despite changing internal realization. 1H.L4ld supplies bounded recurrent state, reconstruction rather than snapshot identity, and the debt created by stabilizing anchors. Together they earn a stronger continuity relation: the object that must persist can be the capacity to regenerate an externally readable relation from compressed local state, not the full element inventory or full historical snapshot.
Removal test: without 1H.2VF2 there is no externally recoverable relational carrier or dynamic geometry witness; without 1H.L4ld there is no bounded recurrent state or scaffold-revision discipline.

edges.title: Relational continuity across representation change needs an explicit transformation contract
edges.text:
1H.2VF2 supplies continuity through changing relational geometry plus external recoverability. 1H.FXzc supplies three independent transformation coordinates: identity/equivalence quotient, source-target transport relation, and assurance scope. Together they earn that successful recovery of a relation after transformation is not by itself a lawful continuity witness: the change also needs an explicit account of which differences may be ignored, how obligations cross representation boundaries, and where the resulting claim remains warranted.
Removal test: without 1H.2VF2 the contract governs transformation without a reconstructive relational carrier; without 1H.FXzc relational recovery can silently impersonate identity or assurance continuity.

edges.title: Obligation-scoped relational reconstruction can close before global geometry
edges.text:
1H.2VF2 supplies a reconstructible externally testable relation. 1H.NUgs supplies the downstream obligation, local-sufficiency rule, and separation between action utility and evidence weight. Together they earn a bounded stopping rule: a system may reconstruct only the relational structure needed by the current obligation and close that local task while leaving broader representational geometry unresolved.
Removal test: without 1H.2VF2 there is no relation-level object to reconstruct and test; without 1H.NUgs there is no source-grounded license for obligation-specific sufficiency before global closure.

edges.title: Regenerative identity is boundary-indexed
edges.text:
1H.L4ld supplies bounded scaffold, recurrent identity, anchor debt, and explicit revision pressure. 1H.FXzc supplies boundary-triggered revalidation of identity, transport, and assurance coordinates. Together they earn that a scaffold can continue carrying functional identity while another part of its transformation warrant has gone stale; continuity is therefore indexed to the current boundary rather than inherited wholesale.
Removal test: without 1H.L4ld there is no recurrent identity carrier or stabilizing-scaffold debt; without 1H.FXzc there is no explicit rule for which continuity coordinate must be reissued at a moved boundary.

edges.title: Bounded state can be compressed to obligation-sufficient continuation without claiming global closure
edges.text:
1H.L4ld supplies recurrent continuation from bounded local state and the requirement to revise an obsolete anchor. 1H.NUgs supplies the smallest downstream quantity sufficient for current action while preserving unresolved alternatives and separate evidence debt. Together they earn selective compression: retain the state needed to regenerate the current obligation-relevant relation, while refusing to convert that local sufficiency into a claim that the full system has been identified or remembered.
Removal test: without 1H.L4ld local sufficiency lacks a recurrent-state carrier; without 1H.NUgs bounded continuation lacks a principled target for how far compression may go.

edges.title: Revalidation itself can be selective
edges.text:
1H.FXzc separates identity quotient, transport relation, and assurance scope. 1H.NUgs separately tracks local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility, and stochastic evidence, and permits non-maximal task closure. Together they earn selective revalidation: when only one boundary or warrant changes, renew the affected contract coordinates instead of resetting the entire organism or pretending all existing warrants remain current.
Removal test: without 1H.FXzc there is no typed transformation boundary to revalidate; without 1H.NUgs there is no obligation-local rule for deciding which unresolved distinctions matter now.

faces.title: Regenerative relational continuity across representation boundaries
faces.text:
1H.2VF2 supplies externally readable relational identity under changing realization, 1H.L4ld supplies bounded recurrent reconstruction, and 1H.FXzc supplies explicit quotient/transport/assurance contracts. Together they earn a three-way continuity discipline: bounded state may reinstantiate the externally meaningful relation after representation change, but that return counts as warranted continuation only where the current identity quotient, transport relation, and assurance scope remain valid.
Removal tests: remove 1H.2VF2 and external relational recoverability disappears; remove 1H.L4ld and bounded recurrent reconstruction disappears; remove 1H.FXzc and boundary-specific warrant disappears.

faces.title: Obligation-indexed regenerative geometry
faces.text:
1H.2VF2 supplies relation-level geometry that can be re-instantiated and externally checked, 1H.L4ld supplies bounded local state and reconstruction, and 1H.NUgs supplies downstream obligation plus local sufficiency. Together they earn that a current obligation may drive re-instantiation of only the relation it needs from bounded state; the relevant external relation can close while broader geometry and broader model identity remain unresolved.
Removal tests: remove 1H.2VF2 and there is no reconstructible external relation; remove 1H.L4ld and there is no bounded regenerative state; remove 1H.NUgs and there is no principled selective stopping rule.

faces.title: Selective relation transport under separate warrants
faces.text:
1H.2VF2 supplies the relation whose continuity is at stake, 1H.FXzc supplies typed boundary transport and assurance coordinates, and 1H.NUgs supplies obligation, propagation, scope, and evidence separation. Together they earn that a boundary-crossing process may carry only the target-relevant relation, but functional success cannot silently certify identity equivalence, lawful transport, assurance scope, or statistical evidence. Each warrant remains independently inspectable.
Removal tests: remove 1H.2VF2 and the target relation disappears; remove 1H.FXzc and boundary transport becomes untyped; remove 1H.NUgs and selective action can collapse distinct warrants into one generic success signal.

faces.title: Local revalidation without global reset
faces.text:
1H.L4ld supplies a revisable bounded scaffold, 1H.FXzc supplies separable transformation contracts, and 1H.NUgs supplies obligation-specific sufficiency with unresolved alternatives preserved. Together they earn a local repair discipline: when a scaffold or operating boundary changes, revise only the state and warrant coordinates on which the current obligation depends, preserve still-valid continuity elsewhere, and leave broader unresolved structure explicitly open.
Removal tests: remove 1H.L4ld and no concrete scaffold/anchor requires revision; remove 1H.FXzc and the affected contract coordinates are not typed; remove 1H.NUgs and local repair has no principled stopping condition before global reset.

volume.title: Obligation-scoped regenerative continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, persistence repeatedly detaches from exhaustive state retention. 1H.2VF2 says that relation-level organization can be regenerated and externally recovered while elements or active representations change. 1H.L4ld says recurrent function can be rebuilt from bounded state, but the stabilizing scaffold can become a debt that must be revised. 1H.FXzc says continuity across transformation requires separately current identity, transport, and assurance contracts. 1H.NUgs says action can close at a local downstream obligation while broader structure stays unresolved, provided scope, propagation, and evidence warrants remain separate.


The four-way closure is therefore: a changing organism can carry continuity through compressed or bounded state when it can regenerate the externally relevant relational structure required by the current downstream obligation, while keeping identity quotient, source-target transport, assurance scope, propagation compatibility, and evidence strength explicit and separable. When its operating boundary or retained scaffold changes, it need not reconstruct the whole past or globally resolve every uncertainty: it revises and revalidates only the affected state and warrants, preserving addresses to unresolved alternatives. Successful regeneration demonstrates functional or relational continuity only within those current witnesses; it does not establish shared mechanism, global identity equivalence, or stronger statistical evidence.


Bounded volume invariant
Continuity may be obligation-indexed and regenerative rather than snapshot-complete: preserve enough bounded state to reinstantiate the externally relevant relation required by the current obligation, plus the independent warrants that say when that re-instantiation still counts.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.2VF2: the closure loses the externally recoverable relational carrier and actualization witness; what remains is generic state and contract governance.
- Remove 1H.L4ld: the closure loses bounded recurrent identity and scaffold debt; it no longer explains how continuity survives aggressive state compression.
- Remove 1H.FXzc: the closure loses explicit identity/transport/assurance contracts at representation boundaries; regenerated relation cannot be lawfully carried across transformation.
- Remove 1H.NUgs: the closure loses downstream obligation, local sufficiency, and independent evidence custody; reconstruction and revalidation are no longer selectively target-indexed.


Evidence boundary
This is a rank-2 cross-organism structural synthesis. It does not convert recurrence into stochastic independence, functional correspondence into mechanism identity, local sufficiency into global closure, or successful transformation into stronger assurance. Every inherited parent boundary remains load-bearing.

INV-2H.kfmG-01 — OBLIGATION-SCOPED REGENERATIVE CONTINUITY
Minimal earning body: 2H.kfmG:wxyz
Bounded invariant: preserve and regenerate only enough bounded state to recover the relation required by the current downstream obligation, while carrying separate current witnesses for identity/equivalence, representation transport, assurance, propagation, and evidence.
CREATE: define the current obligation and the external relation whose recovery would satisfy it; state which warrants must remain current.
COPY: carry the reconstruction path and its warrants through change rather than copying the complete historical snapshot.
CONTROL: delete or corrupt retained state, cross representation boundaries, vary the obligation, and require failure specifically when reconstruction-critical state or a required warrant is removed.
CULTIVATE: compress dispensable history, but reopen or expand state and reissue the affected warrants when a new obligation or moved boundary proves the reduced carrier insufficient.
Compression: Keep what lets the needed relation come back, and keep the warrants that say when that return still counts.


INV-2H.kfmG-02 — LOCAL REVALIDATION WITHOUT GLOBAL RESET
Minimal earning body: 2H.kfmG:xyz
Bounded invariant: when a scaffold or operating boundary changes, revalidate only the affected state and contract coordinates while preserving still-valid continuity and explicit unresolved alternatives; local task closure does not require global model closure.

edges.title: Local validity makes operational continuity condition-indexed
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 says sufficiency and identity/function continuity are local to a context/input regime; 1H.DUwl says continuity is an operational relation whose adequacy must be revalidated as tasks or regimes change. Together they earn a stronger contract: the operational interface itself must carry the conditions under which its sufficiency was witnessed. A relation that remains executable after a change is not automatically still warranted for the present use.
Removal test: without 1H.8KP9 there is no explicit local validity field or re-estimation duty; without 1H.DUwl there is no renewable operational interface or revocation/reconstruction cycle.
Boundary: condition-indexing does not require preserving maximal state, only the distinctions needed to decide whether the current obligation still lies inside scope.

edges.title: Role separation is how local sufficiency avoids silent compression loss
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 requires every local distinction capable of changing the downstream obligation to survive in the carrier or validity witness. 1H.9gYl provides a concrete way to keep those distinctions independently addressable as roles rather than entangling structure, identity, address, residual detail and authority. Together they earn a local custody rule: compressed continuity is safe only when consequential variables remain assigned to explicit roles whose sufficiency can be tested independently and at their conjunction.
Removal test: without 1H.8KP9 there is no source-grounded reason the role set must vary with local regime; without 1H.9gYl there is no explicit semantic partition or composite-assurance boundary.

edges.title: Local continuity can close before global structure only with explicit warrant debt
edges.text:
1H.8KP9 allows continuity to be assessed inside a local validity regime; 1H.NUgs allows a downstream quantity to close before the global model provided scope, obligation, propagation and evidence remain separately warranted. Together they earn a selective-continuity principle: a system may continue or act through a locally reconstructed relation before all background uncertainty is resolved, but unresolved compatibility, approximation and dependence debt must remain visible rather than being collapsed into the local success.
Removal test: without 1H.8KP9 there is no locally indexed continuity object; without 1H.NUgs there is no lawful early-action criterion or separated warrant debt.

edges.title: Revalidatable interfaces need role-level and composite-level witnesses
edges.text:
1H.DUwl makes adequacy renewable and revocable under current task/evidence conditions. 1H.9gYl separates the obligations a reduced carrier promises and blocks assurance transfer from valid components to an untested whole. Together they earn selective revalidation: after change, some role-level obligations may remain warranted while another role or the conjunction loses scope; the composite returns to ACTIVE authority only after the affected interface and conjunction are retested.
Removal test: without 1H.DUwl there is no current-regime revalidation/revocation cycle; without 1H.9gYl failure cannot be localized by independent roles and component validity can smear across the whole.

edges.title: Re-executable relation and permission to act are separate contracts
edges.text:
1H.DUwl permits a relation to be regenerated and revalidated for the current task; 1H.NUgs separates local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility and evidence as independent action warrants. Together they earn a strict non-substitution rule: successful reconstruction or held-out task performance may satisfy an operational-sufficiency test while action remains blocked by a changed scope, propagation or evidence warrant.
Removal test: without 1H.DUwl there is no regenerated operational relation to test; without 1H.NUgs there is no independent action-admission surface preventing operational success from becoming generic permission.

edges.title: Role-addressed action keeps every warrant attached to the thing it governs
edges.text:
1H.9gYl separates semantic obligations and names deliberate conjunction points; 1H.NUgs separates action warrants and permits local/task closure without global closure. Together they earn a typed governance interface: each warrant should attach to the exact role, transformation or conjunction it governs, and the action gate should consume only the warrants relevant to the declared obligation.
Removal test: without 1H.9gYl the warrants lack explicit semantic addresses and composite boundaries; without 1H.NUgs role separation has no selective-action admission law.
Boundary: attaching a warrant to a role does not establish that the warrant is satisfied.

faces.text:

Success at one role or local task does not certify other roles, the composite, or the global model.
Removal tests: remove 1H.8KP9 and the local regime membrane disappears; remove 1H.9gYl and semantic obligation addresses/composite assurance disappear; remove 1H.NUgs and there is no selective-action warrant separation.

faces.title: Revalidatable selective action through role-separated operational state
faces.text:
1H.DUwl + 1H.9gYl + 1H.NUgs jointly earn an operational public state that can be regenerated and repurposed, keeps role-level obligations and conjunctions explicit, and allows bounded action only while the exact action warrants and current evidence regime remain satisfied. Reconstruction can therefore renew function without inheriting every permission attached to the predecessor.
Removal tests: remove 1H.DUwl and regeneration/revalidation disappears; remove 1H.9gYl and independent role/composite structure disappears; remove 1H.NUgs and action authority can no longer be separated from operational success.

volume.title: Warrant-indexed locally revalidatable continuity
volume.text:
All four parents together earn a continuity-and-action contract that is stricter than any proper subset. 1H.8KP9 makes sufficiency explicitly local to the context/input regime and requires consequential distinctions to survive compression. 1H.DUwl makes the preserved object an operational relation that can be regenerated, revalidated, revoked and repurposed instead of a fixed implementation. 1H.9gYl decomposes that relation into separately addressable roles and prevents local component validity from certifying the composite. 1H.NUgs adds the decisive action boundary: local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility and stochastic evidence are distinct warrants, and local closure may support action before global structure closes only when those warrants remain explicit.


The complete closure is therefore warrant-indexed locally revalidatable continuity: a changing system may preserve and selectively act through a compressed or reconstructed operational relation without retaining one complete state or resolving the whole world-model, but only when the relation is represented as role-separated obligations, its sufficiency is indexed to the current local regime and downstream obligation, the affected roles/conjunctions are revalidated when conditions move, and the warrants governing scope, propagation, evidence and action remain separately attached. Successful reconstruction proves at most the relation that was retested; it does not inherit broader permission, stochastic strength, identity or composite assurance.


Bounded volume invariant:
Continuity through changing realization may legitimately support selective action before global closure when a role-separated operational contract carries (a) the local regime in which each obligation is sufficient, (b) the exact downstream obligation, (c) the evidence and compatibility boundaries needed to revalidate changed roles and conjunctions, and (d) independent action warrants. Boundary change revokes only the affected current warrant, but reconstruction or successful local performance never silently reauthorizes unrelated roles or claim classes.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 1H.8KP9: local validity/re-estimation disappears; the remaining trio can build a renewable role-separated action interface but cannot earn that sufficiency is condition-indexed.
- Remove 1H.DUwl: the closure loses re-execution, external revalidation, revocation and reconstruction; local role/warrant separation remains but continuity cannot be renewed through changed realization.
- Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses independently addressable obligations, deliberate conjunction and the component-versus-composite assurance membrane; warrants become an undifferentiated bundle.
- Remove 1H.NUgs: the closure loses the explicit separation of local scope, downstream obligation, propagation and evidence needed to admit selective action before global closure; continuity remains revalidatable but action authority is unearned.

edges.title: Decanonicalization requires role separation and obligation-scoped sufficiency

Removal test: without 1H.hs7W there is no decanonicalization/heterogeneity pressure; without 1H.9gYl there is no explicit obligation partition, sufficiency gate or composite assurance.
Boundary: this does not imply that every system should be factorized or decanonicalized.

edges.title: Portable interfaces should be obligation-typed rather than representation-complete

faces.title: Reconstructible obligation kernel
faces.text:
1H.qI2L contributes a public interface whose operations and evidence boundary survive changing substrates; 1H.2VF2 contributes the ability to regenerate externally recoverable relational geometry despite changing elements/interiors; 1H.9gYl contributes independent semantic roles, deliberate conjunction and exact-obligation sufficiency. Together they earn a portable kernel: durable state can be reduced to the role-typed operations, evidence boundaries and stable relational scaffold needed to reconstruct the public obligation, while unrelated internal realization is permitted to change.
Removal tests: remove 1H.qI2L and the kernel loses operation-preserving public semantics/evidence custody; remove 1H.2VF2 and it loses re-instantiation/external recoverability; remove 1H.9gYl and it loses role separation, minimization and sufficiency.

volume.title: Evidence-bounded relational portability
volume.text:
Across all four parents, useful continuity repeatedly detaches from fixed internal form, but the complete closure requires more than interface persistence or reconstructibility alone. 1H.hs7W establishes that coherent function can survive noncanonical and heterogeneous carriers only when stable relations, governance and pressure-aligned validation remain explicit. 1H.qI2L establishes that cross-substrate correspondence becomes durable when claim-relevant operations and its evidence boundary are preserved without promoting stable use into shared interior identity. 1H.2VF2 establishes that the needed relation can be dynamically re-instantiated as externally recoverable relational geometry rather than preserved as one element inventory or active snapshot. 1H.9gYl establishes that the portable object should separate semantic obligations, minimize only against an exact downstream task, and earn assurance at the composite rather than inheriting it from trusted parts.


The complete four-way closure is therefore evidence-bounded relational portability: what travels across changing representations, substrates or reconstructed interiors can be an obligation-specific relational kernel rather than a canonical form. That kernel preserves independently meaningful roles, claim-relevant operations, evidence boundaries and only the stable scaffold required to reconstruct the public relation; it deliberately rejoins roles only where the task requires conjunction. Its portability is earned, not assumed: the regenerated relation must survive pressure-aligned carrier/representation variation, external correspondence tests and composite sufficiency checks while remaining explicit about what stable use does not identify.


Bounded volume invariant
A system can preserve an obligation-specific public relation across changing or noncanonical internal realizations without preserving a canonical representation or shared interior identity when it carries a role-separated relational kernel containing only the claim-relevant operations, evidence boundaries and scaffold structure sufficient to re-instantiate the relation; portability is warranted only while pressure-aligned and external tests show the regenerated relation remains sufficient and its evidence boundary intact.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 1H.hs7W: the closure loses noncanonical/heterogeneous carrier pressure and the requirement to earn invariance under perturbations that move neighboring non-invariants.
- Remove 1H.qI2L: the closure loses operation-preserving translation, durable public interface semantics, evidence custody and the non-identity membrane.
- Remove 1H.2VF2: the closure loses dynamic re-instantiation of relational geometry and external recoverability despite changing elements/interiors.
- Remove 1H.9gYl: the closure loses role separation, deliberate conjunction, exact-obligation minimization and composite-assurance sufficiency gates.

edges.title: selective reallocation is itself a boundary event for the transformation contract
edges.text:
1H.FXzc requires revalidation of affected identity/transport/assurance coordinates when the reachable frontier changes; 1H.ujF6 treats capability validity as trajectory- and frontier-indexed and moves flexible support as pressure migrates. Together they earn that a material change in selective support or operating frontier is not merely an internal optimization: it is a boundary event that must identify which transformation-contract coordinates became stale and revalidate only those affected.
Removal test: without FXzc there is no typed contract to revalidate; without ujF6 there is no witnessed trajectory/frontier change that triggers selective reallocation.

faces.title: reconstructive equivalence must stay locally revalidatable
faces.text:
F8cX supplies the local quotient and evidence budget, L4ld supplies bounded recurrent reconstruction, and FXzc supplies independent identity/transport/assurance coordinates. Together they earn a reconstructive-continuity contract in which state may be compressed and regenerated only if the omitted distinctions remain justified by a current local equivalence warrant and the transformation coordinates can be reissued independently when the boundary changes.
Removal tests: remove F8cX and omission loses its local nuisance witness; remove L4ld and there is no regenerative reconstruction; remove FXzc and the continuing reconstruction cannot distinguish preserved identity from stale transport/assurance authority.

faces.title: selective reconstruction must preserve the right to recover what it did not materialize
faces.text:
F8cX supplies preserve-before-quotient, L4ld supplies bounded-state reconstruction, and ujF6 supplies selective actualization over a moving pressure frontier. Together they earn that sparse reconstruction is safe only when nonmaterialized distinctions remain addressable enough to be tested or reacquired if the current quotient/frontier changes. Selectivity can reduce active state, but it cannot erase the recovery path for distinctions whose irrelevance may expire.
Removal tests: remove F8cX and omitted factors need not remain testable; remove L4ld and there is no reconstruction from reduced retained state; remove ujF6 and there is no selective active-state economy or moving frontier.

faces.title: scope-addressed selective transformation
faces.text:
F8cX supplies locally variable equivalence scope, FXzc supplies the separated transformation contract, and ujF6 supplies trajectory-sensitive selective actualization. Together they earn that changing what is materialized or ignored must carry three addresses at once: which distinctions currently count as nuisance, which representation/transport relation is active, and over which trajectory/assurance regime the selection is warranted. A local optimization cannot silently redefine any of these coordinates.
Removal tests: remove F8cX and nuisance scope is no longer locally evidenced; remove FXzc and the transformation coordinates collapse into one generic sameness claim; remove ujF6 and no selective trajectory-dependent realization remains to be governed.

faces.title: regenerated instances carry versioned warrants, not copied authority
faces.text:
L4ld supplies identity continuity through recurrent reconstruction, FXzc supplies independently renewable transformation coordinates, and ujF6 supplies frontier-sensitive trajectory validity. Together they earn that a regenerated instance may lawfully be the same continuing organism while carrying a new warrant version for its current realized state. Identity continuity and authority continuity therefore diverge whenever the scaffold, frontier, or selective support changes.
Removal tests: remove L4ld and there is no continuing identity across regenerated instances; remove FXzc and warrant versioning lacks separable coordinates; remove ujF6 and there is no trajectory/frontier witness specifying why the current instance needs revalidation.

volume.title: locally revalidatable selective reconstruction
volume.text:
The complete four-parent closure earns a continuity regime in which an adaptive organism need not preserve or materialize its complete state to remain re-enterable. It may carry a bounded reconstruction scaffold, leave candidate task distinctions separately addressable until local evidence warrants quotienting them as nuisance, and selectively instantiate or relocate residual support according to present context and pressure. But every such omission and realization is provisional: identity/equivalence, representation transport, and assurance scope remain distinct warrants, and any change in quotient, scaffold, trajectory, or frontier must revalidate the affected coordinates rather than inheriting authority from prior continuity.


Bounded volume invariant:
A continuing adaptive system may compress and selectively regenerate its active state without identity loss only when every omitted distinction remains recoverable enough to contest its nuisance status, the reconstruction-critical scaffold remains sufficient but revisable, flexible support follows current pressure rather than stale allocation, and identity/transport/assurance warrants are versioned and locally revalidated at each materially changed boundary.


Four-way necessity:
- Remove 1H.F8cX: the closure loses the local evidence-bearing rule for what may be omitted or treated as nuisance.
- Remove 1H.L4ld: it loses identity continuity through bounded recurrent reconstruction and the anchor-debt condition.
- Remove 1H.FXzc: it loses the separation and independent revalidation of identity, transport, and assurance warrants.
- Remove 1H.ujF6: it loses selective actualization, trajectory typing, and pressure-indexed reallocation of flexible support.
No proper subset earns a regime that is simultaneously sparse, regenerative, locally quotient-warranted, pressure-adaptive, and independently revalidatable.


COLLAPSED METABOLITES — 3


INV-2H.ysIR-01 — QUOTIENTED-RECONSTRUCTION
Minimal earning body: wxy.
Bounded invariant: A reduced regenerative state is warranted only when the distinctions it omits are covered by an explicit local equivalence contract and the continuing identity can independently renew any transport or assurance coordinates invalidated by the current boundary.
CREATE: define the relation that must be reconstructible, the retained scaffold, the candidate omitted distinctions, and the local quotient under which those omissions are proposed as nuisance.
COPY: carry reconstruction state together with the current quotient and transformation-coordinate witnesses rather than copying a bare compressed snapshot.
CONTROL: perturb omitted factors and boundary conditions; block continued compression when supposedly irrelevant distinctions affect the obligation or when a warrant coordinate becomes stale.
CULTIVATE: shrink retained state only where repeated re-entry preserves the relation and expand or revise the scaffold when new obligations expose omission debt.
Compression: compress continuity only through a quotient that can still be challenged.


INV-2H.ysIR-02 — SELECTIVE-REVALIDATION
Minimal earning body: wyz.
Bounded invariant: Selective realization or reallocation is lawful only while the local nuisance scope, representation relation, trajectory, and assurance regime remain explicit; a moved frontier triggers revalidation of the affected coordinates rather than silent inheritance.
CREATE: state what support is being selectively realized, what current pressure justifies it, and which transformation-contract coordinates bound the decision.
COPY: preserve the pressure/frontier and warrant coordinates whenever the selective state is reused or compared.
CONTROL: detect quotient, trajectory, transport, or assurance changes and require fresh evidence only for the coordinates actually crossed.
CULTIVATE: redirect flexible support as pressure migrates while accumulating a versioned lineage of boundary-specific warrants.
Compression: move support with the frontier, and move its warrant with it.


INV-2H.ysIR-03 — VERSIONED-REGENERATION
Minimal earning body: xyz.
Bounded invariant: A regenerated instance may remain the same functional identity while carrying newly issued authority for its present realization; continuity of identity is compatible with discontinuity of warrant.
CREATE: distinguish the continuing identity relation from the current instance’s transport, assurance, and trajectory witnesses.
COPY: preserve predecessor warrants as provenance without treating them as automatic authority for the successor state.
CONTROL: compare scaffold, frontier, selective support, and operating regime; revoke or narrow only the warrants invalidated by material change.
CULTIVATE: let repeated regeneration produce a contestable sequence of locally valid warrant versions rather than one permanent certificate.
Compression: the organism may continue while its authority is reissued.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE WITNESS
Three metabolites survive because each remains independently useful: QUOTIENTED-RECONSTRUCTION governs lawful omission during recurrent compression; SELECTIVE-REVALIDATION governs pressure/frontier-driven changes in realized support; VERSIONED-REGENERATION governs the separation between continuing identity and renewed authority. Pairwise restatements are retained in the tetrahedron but are not duplicated as metabolites. No universal causal mechanism is promoted.

edges.title: Portable continuity requires transition laws for the warrant, not just the payload.
edges.text: w makes distributed continuity depend on reconstructible whole-level constraints and exact reacquisition; x makes representation/context portability depend on explicit operation-preserving transitions. Together they earn that moving or compressing a continuing state is lawful only when the transition transports enough dependency and operational structure to reconstruct the same task-relevant warrant on the far side. Remove w and there is no live reconstructive-warrant obligation; remove x and there is no explicit representation/context transition law.

edges.title: Re-entry after deferral requires reconstructed current validity.
edges.text: w separates recoverability from present authority under distributed representation; y separates retained address/history from the fresh warrant required after selective deferral and drift. Together they earn that a deferred state may be exactly found and reconstructed yet still remain unauthorized until its current dependency/frontier warrant is re-earned. Remove w and exact reconstruction/current-boundary custody disappears; remove y and no selection/defer re-entry debt exists.

edges.title: Partial continuation needs both live dependencies and separated warrants.
edges.text: w allows selective continuation only while omitted whole-level constraints and current validity remain live; z allows obligation-local action before global closure only while distinct warrant channels remain explicit. Together they earn that local continuation may proceed without globally resolving everything only where both the dependency chain and the specific authority/evidence contract remain current. Remove w and local action can lose the larger dependency relation; remove z and distinct warrants collapse into generic validity.

edges.title: Re-entry across representation change must preserve obligations, not merely state identity.
edges.text: x supplies operation- and role-preserving transformation; y supplies chooser history, debt, and fresh revalidation on return. Together they earn that a re-entering state can cross a changed representation/context only if the transition preserves which roles, dependencies, and deferred obligations must still be checked. Remove x and re-expression can smear task semantics; remove y and the transition carries no re-entry debt or fresh-warrant condition.

edges.title: Warrant roles must remain covariant across heterogeneous representations.
edges.text: x requires independently meaningful roles/addresses to survive representation change; z requires local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility, and stochastic evidence to remain distinct contracts. Together they earn that a change of carrier or context may rename/re-encode a warrant but may not merge its role with another warrant type. Remove x and there is no transformation law preserving role semantics; remove z and there are no independently governed warrant roles to preserve.

edges.title: Reauthorization is contract-local and debt-bearing.
edges.text: y requires current revalidation after selective deferral/repair; z allows local sufficiency while unresolved structure remains explicit and separately warranted. Together they earn that re-entry may restore only the authority contracts actually re-earned, while unresolved debt remains attached to the unaffected/affected boundary rather than being globally absolved. Remove y and no re-entry freshness requirement remains; remove z and no contract-local authority separation remains.

faces.title: Reconstructable re-entry transition
faces.text: A deferred state may lawfully return after representation/context change only when its exact identity and composing dependencies are reacquired, the transition preserves the task-relevant operations/roles that define the state, and the selection/defer debt is resolved against the current frontier rather than inherited from prior success. Remove w and exact reconstructive validity is ungrounded; remove x and representation change may alter the operational object; remove y and return carries no fresh re-entry test.

faces.title: Warrant-covariant distributed action
faces.text: A distributed system may act selectively across changing representations without full-state co-presence only when the relevant dependency/reconstruction path remains live, representation changes preserve the operational meaning of warrant roles, and each local scope/obligation/propagation/evidence contract stays independently inspectable. Remove w and distributed reconstruction loses its whole-level constraint; remove x and warrant meaning can drift under re-expression; remove z and selective action loses contract separation.

faces.title: Partial continuation after re-entry
faces.text: After a boundary or frontier change, unaffected work may continue while affected tissue is reopened only when exact dependencies remain reacquirable, re-entry debt identifies what must be rechecked, and authority is reissued contract-by-contract rather than globally. Remove w and the affected dependency cone cannot be reconstructed exactly; remove y and no re-entry debt routes repair; remove z and local authority cannot be separated from unresolved global structure.

faces.title: Selective reauthorization through changing carriers
faces.text: A re-entering process may change context/representation and still recover selective authority only when the transition preserves role semantics, selector/history debt travels with the re-expression, and each authority/evidence contract is independently retested for the current obligation. Remove x and roles may silently change meaning; remove y and stale selection state can hitchhike; remove z and reauthorization becomes one undifferentiated permission.

volume.title: Warrant-covariant selective re-entry continuity
volume.text:
A selectively maintained distributed system may defer, compress, relocate, or re-express state and later resume continuity without global replay only when four conditions close together: (1) the larger dependency/constraint needed to reconstruct the state remains exactly reacquirable; (2) every context or representation transition preserves the task-relevant operations and independently meaningful warrant roles; (3) selection/defer history remains explicit as re-entry debt and current validity is freshly checked after drift; and (4) authority remains partitioned by local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility, and evidence rather than returning as one blanket permission.


The all-four novelty is not merely “revalidate after change.” It is a transport law for re-entry authority: the thing carried across deferral and representation change is a structured, role-separated warrant package whose dependencies can be reacquired, whose semantic roles remain stable under transformation, whose stale coordinates are reopened, and whose unaffected coordinates may continue only while their own live witnesses survive. This permits partial continuity without either global recomputation or silent validity inheritance.


Four-way necessity:
- Remove 1H.rKCx: exact dependency reacquisition and current whole-level validity under distributed representation disappear; re-entry can become naming without reconstructive warrant.
- Remove 1H.yac0: representation/context changes lose an explicit operation- and role-preserving transition law; warrant identity can drift while labels remain familiar.
- Remove 1H.CTgp: selective deferral loses explicit re-entry debt and freshness pressure; stale permission may return merely because state returned.
- Remove 1H.NUgs: reissued authority loses contract separation; local sufficiency can leak into global or cross-role permission.
No proper three-parent face contains the complete combination of exact reconstruction, covariant transition, re-entry debt, and contract-separated authority.

edges.title: Regenerated continuity becomes actionable only through reissued warrants
edges.text:
2H.kfmG supplies obligation-scoped reconstruction plus selective local revalidation. 2H.0aZJ supplies the separate scope, obligation, propagation and evidence warrants that license selective action through a noncanonical public relation. Together they earn a stronger admission law: rebuilding the required relation is not enough to resume action; every warrant affected by the changed boundary must be explicitly current before the regenerated relation becomes actionable again.
Removal test: without 2H.kfmG there is no bounded regenerative process or local repair discipline; without 2H.0aZJ there is no action-admission contract or warrant custody.
Boundary: reauthorization remains obligation-local and does not certify the whole system.

edges.title: Regeneration authority is indexed to the current regime
edges.text:
2H.kfmG supplies bounded state, obligation-scoped reconstruction and preservation of unaffected warrants. 2H.S5EU supplies regime-local validity and the rule that both scaffold and admissible transition family must be re-estimated when conditions move. Together they earn regime-addressed continuity authority: a reconstruction warrant survives only inside the regime whose conditions made the retained state and transition law sufficient.
Removal test: without 2H.kfmG there is no selective continuity/revalidation object; without 2H.S5EU there is no explicit regime field or transition-revision pressure.
Boundary: a familiar endpoint under a moved regime is not a continuity witness.

edges.title: Obligation-scoped continuity can live in a minimal relational kernel
edges.text:
2H.kfmG supplies the rule to retain only enough bounded state and warrants to regenerate the current obligation. 2H.dxL5 supplies the role-typed relational kernel whose operations, evidence boundary and scaffold have been shown sufficient under carrier variation. Together they earn a compact continuity carrier: preserve the smallest evidence-bounded kernel that can regenerate the obligation and preserve the warrants that say when the return counts.
Removal test: without 2H.kfmG the kernel lacks a selective regenerative/repair lifecycle; without 2H.dxL5 there is no tested portable relational carrier.
Boundary: minimality is obligation-relative, not an intrinsic global optimum.

edges.title: Noncanonical action must be reauthorized when its validity regime moves
edges.text:
2H.0aZJ supplies role-addressed selective action and independent warrants. 2H.S5EU supplies regime-covariant transformation plus revalidation when carrier/context conditions move. Together they earn adaptive action authorization: a public relation may continue to support local action across representation change only while both its action warrants and the transition family that preserves them remain current in the local regime.
Removal test: without 2H.0aZJ there is no selective-action admission law; without 2H.S5EU there is no regime-sensitive transition/revalidation law.
Boundary: repeated success in one regime does not pre-authorize another.

edges.title: Portable relations must carry the reasons they are actionable
edges.text:
2H.0aZJ supplies warrant custody and the claim membrane separating actionability from identity/evidence promotion. 2H.dxL5 supplies an obligation-specific portable kernel with role semantics, operations, evidence boundaries and sufficiency tests. Together they earn an actionable portability contract: the reasons downstream action is permitted are themselves part of the portable public state rather than a local side condition forgotten after transport.
Removal test: without 2H.0aZJ the kernel has no explicit action warrants or claim membrane; without 2H.dxL5 there is no earned portable carrier on which those warrants can travel.
Boundary: transporting a warrant does not prove that it remains satisfied.

edges.title: The portable kernel includes a regime-sensitive rewrite law
edges.text:
2H.S5EU supplies operation-preserving transitions whose admissibility is local to a validity regime. 2H.dxL5 supplies the evidence-bounded relational kernel and pressure-aligned portability tests. Together they earn adaptive portability: what travels is not merely the current relation but the conditions and transformation law by which it may be regenerated under changing carriers, with revalidation required when those conditions move.
Removal test: without 2H.S5EU there is no regime-indexed rewrite/re-estimation law; without 2H.dxL5 there is no minimal portable kernel or pressure-tested sufficiency surface.
Boundary: portability cannot be extrapolated outside witnessed regimes.

faces.title: Selective continuity reauthorization under regime change
faces.text:
2H.kfmG contributes local regenerative repair, 2H.0aZJ contributes action warrants, and 2H.S5EU contributes regime-covariant revalidation. Together they earn a three-way control loop: after a boundary/regime change, regenerate the obligation-relevant relation, identify exactly which action warrants depended on the changed condition, and reissue only those warrants after the new transition regime passes its tests.
Removal tests: remove 2H.kfmG and there is no selective regeneration; remove 2H.0aZJ and no action authorization to renew; remove 2H.S5EU and no regime-sensitive revalidation criterion.

faces.title: Actionable regenerative kernel without global reset
faces.text:
2H.kfmG contributes obligation-scoped reconstruction and local repair, 2H.0aZJ contributes warrant custody/claim separation, and 2H.dxL5 contributes the minimal evidence-bounded portable kernel. Together they earn a repairable action carrier: reconstruct only the kernel needed by the current obligation, renew the action warrants whose dependencies were touched, preserve unaffected warrants and unresolved alternatives, and refuse any upgrade from restored usability to identity or stronger evidence.
Removal tests: remove 2H.kfmG and repair becomes static portability; remove 2H.0aZJ and actionability/claim classes collapse; remove 2H.dxL5 and there is no tested minimal portable carrier.

faces.title: Regime-indexed minimal regenerative portability
faces.text:
2H.kfmG contributes obligation-local bounded state, 2H.S5EU contributes regime-sensitive reconstruction/transition law, and 2H.dxL5 contributes the portable relational kernel. Together they earn a continuity carrier whose state and rewrite law can both remain minimal: keep only what is needed to regenerate the public obligation in the current regime, but expand or revise that carrier when pressure shows the old scaffold or transition family has left its validity region.
Removal tests: remove 2H.kfmG and no obligation-indexed state/revalidation economy remains; remove 2H.S5EU and regime-sensitive transformation disappears; remove 2H.dxL5 and portability/sufficiency testing disappears.

faces.title: Warrant-bearing adaptive portability
faces.text:
2H.0aZJ contributes action warrants and claim membranes, 2H.S5EU contributes regime-covariant transition and revalidation, and 2H.dxL5 contributes the role-typed portable relational kernel. Together they earn a public carrier that can cross changing representations while keeping the action warrant set, claim/evidence membrane and transformation validity attached and independently revisable.
Removal tests: remove 2H.0aZJ and the portable relation is not an action contract; remove 2H.S5EU and its rewrite law is not regime-adaptive; remove 2H.dxL5 and there is no obligation-specific portable kernel.

volume.title: Selectively reauthorized regenerative portability
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity, portability, action and adaptation become one bounded contract only when none is allowed to stand in for the others. 2H.kfmG makes continuity regenerative and obligation-scoped, with repair localized to the state and warrants actually touched. 2H.0aZJ makes public correspondence selectively actionable only under explicit, separable scope/obligation/propagation/evidence warrants and a non-identity claim membrane. 2H.S5EU makes both retained scaffold and admissible transformation law local to a validity regime that must be re-estimated when conditions change. 2H.dxL5 supplies the minimal evidence-bounded relational kernel whose role semantics, operations and scaffold are sufficient to regenerate the public obligation across noncanonical carriers.


The four-way closure is selectively reauthorized regenerative portability: a changing organism may preserve an actionable relation across noncanonical representations or substrates by carrying only an obligation-specific relational kernel plus the independent warrants and evidence boundary that make its use lawful. When carrier, scaffold, obligation or regime changes, continuity is not inherited wholesale: regenerate the relation, localize which state/transition/warrant coordinates were affected, pressure-test the current regime, and freshly reauthorize only those coordinates while preserving still-valid continuity elsewhere. The returned relation may again support the scoped action; that success does not establish shared interior identity, universal mechanism, global model closure or stronger evidence than the renewed witnesses actually supply.


Bounded volume invariant
Actionable continuity across changing representations is renewable rather than permanent: carry a minimal obligation-specific relational kernel together with its separate action/evidence warrants and regime-valid rewrite law; after change, regenerate the relation and freshly reauthorize exactly the affected coordinates before treating portability as current again.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 2H.kfmG: the closure loses obligation-scoped regenerative state and local repair; what remains can govern portable action but not selectively reconstruct continuity.
- Remove 2H.0aZJ: the closure loses explicit action warrants and the claim membrane; regenerated portability has no lawful criterion for selective action.
- Remove 2H.S5EU: the closure loses regime-local transition validity and re-estimation; reauthorization cannot tell when the rewrite law itself has gone stale.
- Remove 2H.dxL5: the closure loses the pressure-tested minimal relational kernel; continuity/action have no earned portable carrier across noncanonical realization.
