INV-3H.1OFJ-01 — SELECTIVE REAUTHORIZATION OF REGENERATED PORTABILITY
Minimal earning body: 3H.1OFJ:wxyz
Bounded invariant: after a carrier, scaffold, obligation or regime change, an obligation-specific public relation becomes actionable again only after the relation is regenerated, affected state/transition/warrant coordinates are localized, and exactly those coordinates are freshly witnessed; unaffected continuity may remain current.
CREATE: name the downstream obligation, the portable relational kernel, the current regime and every warrant required for action.
COPY: carry the kernel, evidence membrane, rewrite law and warrant statuses through representation/substrate change.
CONTROL: perturb the changed coordinate and block action until the regenerated relation and each affected warrant pass the current regime's tests; reject success→identity/evidence promotion.
CULTIVATE: preserve still-valid coordinates, expand or revise only the failing carrier/warrant/transition surface, and widen portability only after new regimes are independently witnessed.
Compression: regenerate what must return, reauthorize what actually changed.


INV-3H.1OFJ-02 — WARRANT-BEARING ADAPTIVE PORTABILITY
Minimal earning body: 3H.1OFJ:xyz
Bounded invariant: a portable relation is not only an interface; it includes the role semantics, action warrants, claim/evidence membrane and regime-sensitive transformation law by which downstream use remains lawful across changing carriers.
CREATE: define the public relation, its role-typed operations, warrant set, evidence class and current admissible rewrite regime.
COPY: preserve those fields as part of the portable state rather than recreating them from local convention after transport.
CONTROL: test carrier/regime changes that can falsify role sufficiency, propagation compatibility, evidence scope or rewrite validity independently.
CULTIVATE: revise only the field whose witness fails, keeping the rest inspectable and current.
Compression: port the relation together with the law and reasons that still permit using it.


INV-3H.1OFJ-03 — OBLIGATION-TARGETED REPAIRABLE ACTION KERNEL
Minimal earning body: 3H.1OFJ:wxz
Bounded invariant: continuity repair can stop before global reconstruction when the minimal evidence-bounded kernel required by the current obligation has been regenerated and every action-relevant warrant touched by the repair has been revalidated, while unresolved global structure remains explicit.
CREATE: identify the smallest relational kernel and warrant dependency set required by the current action.
COPY: preserve unaffected state, warrants and unresolved alternatives while rebuilding only the dependency cone that failed.
CONTROL: demand end-to-end sufficiency of the rebuilt kernel and prevent restored usability from silently becoming global identity, mechanism or evidence closure.
CULTIVATE: broaden reconstruction only when the repaired local kernel fails the declared obligation or a new obligation changes the dependency cone.
Compression: repair the action-bearing kernel, not the entire world.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
Three metabolites survive independently. INV-01 requires the complete four-parent volume and expresses renewable action authority after change. INV-02 is earned by the x+y+z face and makes action warrants plus regime-valid rewrite law part of portable state. INV-03 is earned by the w+x+z face and preserves local repair without global reset while adding action-warrant and evidence-bounded kernel requirements absent from 2H.kfmG alone. Narrower restatements of parent-only reconstruction, warrant custody, regime covariance or relational portability are not promoted.

Removal tests: remove 2H._phq and the loop cannot reliably reopen omitted support; remove 2H.Dp9x and the repair lacks a typed reconstruction/composite test; remove 2H.AvDK and there is no explicit expiry or newly issued warrant.

faces.title: Custodied portable repair
faces.text:
2H._phq supplies reacquirable source/evidence custody; 2H.dxL5 supplies portable-kernel boundary assurance and pressure; 2H.AvDK supplies revocation and revision conditions. Together they earn repair without assurance laundering: a failed portable interface can reopen its evidential body and rebuild a candidate relation while preserving the fact that the old warrant belonged to an earlier regime/scaffold; pressure must earn any new assurance rather than retroactively strengthening the previous one.
Removal tests: remove 2H._phq and repair can lose the evidential body it needs to revisit; remove 2H.dxL5 and the rebuilt interface lacks a portability/pressure witness; remove 2H.AvDK and old versus newly warranted states cannot be explicitly distinguished.

faces.title: Pressure-reissued transition warrant
faces.text:
2H.Dp9x supplies regime-typed reconstruction and composite assurance; 2H.dxL5 supplies a pressure-tested portable kernel; 2H.AvDK supplies a revocable continuity warrant and revision conditions. Together they earn warrant reissuance: a translated/reconstructed carrier receives a new continuity warrant only after the exact composite obligation survives the current regime and relevant portability pressure; failed tests leave the warrant revoked rather than treating output resemblance as continuity.
Removal tests: remove 2H.Dp9x and the warranted object loses precise role/composite typing; remove 2H.dxL5 and it loses the independent portability pressure witness; remove 2H.AvDK and there is no explicit revoked-versus-reissued warrant state.

volume.title: Reacquirable continuity reconstitution
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity can already survive changing realization without fixing one interior or canonical representation. The all-four closure adds a regenerative condition on the validity machinery itself. 2H._phq makes sparse current state lawful only while dormant source/evidence remains exactly reacquirable by stable role. 2H.Dp9x gives reconstruction a role-typed contract and demands end-to-end composite assurance in the regime where it is used. 2H.dxL5 makes portability pressure-tested rather than inferred from familiar form. 2H.AvDK turns continuity warrant into living state that can expire when regime or scaffold becomes insufficient.


The complete four-way closure is therefore reacquirable continuity reconstitution: a task-relevant public relation may remain continuous through selective activation, reconstruction, carrier/representation change and regime drift when its role-typed portable kernel travels with an evidence/validity boundary and a revocable continuity warrant while the omitted source/evidence body remains exactly reacquirable. Pressure or regime failure revokes the warrant; revocation must be able to reopen the implicated dormant evidence by stable role, regenerate the relation through the typed reconstruction contract, rerun composite and portability-pressure tests, and issue a new scoped warrant without rewriting what was previously warranted. Continuity here is not output similarity: it is a reversible warrant → reacquire → reconstruct → retest → rewarrant cycle whose historical evidence scopes remain distinct.


Bounded volume invariant
A selectively realized public relation can count as continuous across changing carrier, representation and regime only while its exact obligation/evidence body remains reacquirable and its current continuity warrant remains revocable; when pressure or regime change invalidates that warrant, lawful continuation requires reopening the implicated dormant evidence, rebuilding through a role-typed reconstruction contract, retesting the composite and portable relation under current conditions, and issuing a newly scoped warrant rather than laundering the expired one into the repaired state.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses exact dormant-source reacquisition and role-stable repair after revocation. The remaining trio can carry a typed, pressure-tested, revocable contract but cannot require a route back to support omitted from current realization.
- Remove 2H.Dp9x: the closure loses the explicit role-typed reconstruction/transition contract and end-to-end composite assurance. The remainder can reacquire, pressure-test and revoke but cannot state the exact reconstruction obligation that must be re-earned.
- Remove 2H.dxL5: the closure loses noncanonical portability and its dedicated pressure witness. The remainder can selectively reacquire, reconstruct and revise but lacks the stress surface that distinguishes portable continuity from familiar-carrier success.
- Remove 2H.AvDK: the closure loses warrant-as-state and explicit revocation/revision conditions. The remainder can reacquire and pressure-reconstruct but cannot distinguish current legitimate continuation from an expired warrant requiring reconstitution.

edges.title: Regime-typed portable kernel
edges.text:
2H.S5EU supplies a locally valid reconstruction/transition family whose warrant changes with regime. 2H.dxL5 supplies the role-separated obligation kernel plus pressure-aligned and external sufficiency tests needed to establish portability. Together they earn a stricter relation: a portable kernel is not merely the smallest reproducible interface; it is a kernel whose admissible transformations and evidence boundary are explicitly indexed to the regime in which pressure tests show that the public obligation survives.
Removal test: without 2H.S5EU the kernel lacks an explicit regime-indexed transition/revalidation law; without 2H.dxL5 there is no independently earned obligation-specific portable kernel or pressure/external sufficiency witness.
Boundary: local validity does not imply universal portability, and passing one regime does not license neighboring regimes.

edges.title: Scaffold and transformation family must be co-revisable
edges.text:
2H.S5EU supplies the rule that a reconstruction transition family must be re-estimated when its local validity regime changes. 2H.Dzmx supplies a role-separated reconstructible contract whose retained scaffold can become an obsolete stabilizing bias. Together they earn dual revision: continuity can fail because the scaffold is stale, because the transformation family is stale, or because both became mismatched, so a repair law must be able to revise both rather than protecting either as canonical.
Removal test: without 2H.S5EU the admissible transformation family has no explicit regime-sensitive revision law; without 2H.Dzmx there is no reconstructible contract/scaffold whose stabilizing history can become revision debt.
Boundary: co-revision is triggered by witnessed pressure or regime change, not by novelty preference.

edges.title: Regime change can require reacquisition before revalidation
edges.text:
2H.S5EU supplies regime-bounded validity and the obligation to re-estimate scaffold and transformation law when conditions change. 2H._phq supplies a still-reacquirable information body behind selectively active reconstruction, preventing omission from becoming irreversible deletion. Together they earn a repair path that neither parent supplies alone: when a regime change exposes a distinction absent from the current active scaffold, lawful revalidation may reopen dormant material before reconstructing the public relation rather than forcing the old compact carrier to answer a new obligation.
Removal test: without 2H.S5EU there is no regime-sensitive revalidation trigger; without 2H._phq there is no independently warranted dormant-body reachability from which omitted distinctions can be reacquired.
Boundary: regime change does not require global reload by default; reacquisition is required only where the current carrier or warrant proves insufficient.

edges.title: Pressure-certified reconstructible contract
edges.text:
2H.dxL5 supplies role-typed portable kernels, pressure-aligned carrier variation, external recoverability, and composite sufficiency tests. 2H.Dzmx supplies the reconstructible public contract and explicit scaffold-revision condition. Together they earn a contract whose compactness and continuity are certified by the pressure that could falsify them: a retained scaffold remains admissible only while independently varied carriers and end-to-end tests preserve the exact public obligation and its evidence boundary.
Removal test: without 2H.dxL5 there is no pressure/external/composite certification discipline; without 2H.Dzmx there is no explicit reconstructible contract or anchor-debt revision object to certify.
Boundary: pressure survival strengthens the scoped continuity claim only for the tested obligation and variation family.

edges.title: Selective portable kernel backed by a reacquirable whole
edges.text:
2H.dxL5 supplies an obligation-specific role-separated kernel whose portability must survive pressure-aligned and external tests. 2H._phq supplies selective activation over a larger body that remains stably reacquirable and carries the evidence boundary of omitted material. Together they earn reversible compactness: the active portable kernel may remain small while the obligation is satisfied, but the larger evidence/source body remains addressable so pressure can force the kernel to expand or be rebuilt when a previously dormant distinction becomes load-bearing.
Removal test: without 2H.dxL5 there is no tested obligation-specific kernel whose sufficiency can fail; without 2H._phq compactness can collapse into irreversible omission because the larger body need not remain reacquirable.
Boundary: a reachable larger body does not make the current compact kernel sufficient until the actual obligation is tested.

edges.title: Scaffold revision can reopen omitted body
edges.text:
2H.Dzmx supplies an explicit condition under which a stabilizing reconstructive scaffold must be reconsidered because it has become obsolete bias. 2H._phq supplies dormant source/evidence reachability outside the currently active reconstruction state. Together they earn revision by reopening rather than merely rearranging retained state: when the contract's current scaffold fails, the organism can reacquire previously omitted material and recompose the contract instead of treating its old information boundary as the universe of possible repair.
Removal test: without 2H.Dzmx there is no earned scaffold-bias/revision trigger; without 2H._phq there is no still-addressable omitted body that can participate in the revision.
Boundary: dormant material is a repair resource, not automatically relevant evidence; it must become load-bearing under the renewed obligation.

faces.title: Regime-bounded pressure-certified contract
faces.text:
2H.S5EU contributes regime-indexed reconstruction and transformation validity, 2H.dxL5 contributes role-separated portable kernels plus pressure/external sufficiency testing, and 2H.Dzmx contributes a reconstructible contract with scaffold-revision debt. Together they earn a contract whose present realization and permitted rewrite family are both provisional: continuity remains warranted only while pressure-aligned tests preserve the public obligation inside the current validity regime, and either scaffold or mapping may be revised when that warrant fails.
Removal tests: remove 2H.S5EU and the certification loses its explicit local-regime/transition-family boundary; remove 2H.dxL5 and pressure-aligned external/composite sufficiency testing disappears; remove 2H.Dzmx and there is no role-separated reconstructible contract with scaffold revision debt.

faces.title: Regime-bounded selective portability with reacquisition fallback
faces.text:
2H.S5EU contributes local validity and transition-family revalidation, 2H.dxL5 contributes the pressure-tested portable obligation kernel, and 2H._phq contributes selective active state backed by a still-reacquirable whole. Together they earn a sparse continuity architecture with an explicit fallback: operate through the compact kernel while it remains warranted, but when pressure or regime change exposes missing structure, reopen the dormant body, rebuild the necessary relation, and revalidate the transition rather than silently broadening the old kernel's authority.
Removal tests: remove 2H.S5EU and the fallback has no regime-indexed revalidation law; remove 2H.dxL5 and there is no pressure-tested portable kernel whose sufficiency is being assessed; remove 2H._phq and missing structure may be unrecoverable after selective omission.

faces.title: Reacquirable co-revision loop
faces.text:
2H.S5EU contributes revision of the admissible reconstruction/transition family under regime change, 2H.Dzmx contributes revision of a stabilizing scaffold when it becomes bias, and 2H._phq contributes dormant-body reacquisition. Together they earn a fuller repair loop: when continuity becomes locally invalid, reopen the evidence/source body as needed, revise both the retained scaffold and the transformation family, then reconstruct under a newly stated regime rather than preserving either old surface by default.
Removal tests: remove 2H.S5EU and transformation/regime revision disappears; remove 2H.Dzmx and scaffold/contract revision disappears; remove 2H._phq and repair is confined to already-active state rather than being able to reopen omitted evidence.
Boundary: this face still lacks 2H.dxL5's independent pressure/external/composite certification that the repaired compact contract actually satisfies the public obligation.

faces.title: Pressure-tested continuity contract with reacquirable backing
faces.text:
2H.dxL5 contributes obligation-specific kernels and falsifying pressure/external tests, 2H.Dzmx contributes a reconstructible contract plus scaffold-revision condition, and 2H._phq contributes selective active state backed by a reacquirable whole. Together they earn a contract whose compact realization is reversible rather than lossy: pressure testing determines when the present kernel ceases to be sufficient, scaffold revision names the repair obligation, and dormant-body reacquisition supplies material that can re-enter before the contract is rebuilt.
Removal tests: remove 2H.dxL5 and there is no independent pressure/external sufficiency witness; remove 2H.Dzmx and no explicit contract/scaffold revision object; remove 2H._phq and the repair cannot rely on preserved reachability beyond the active kernel.

volume.title: Reacquirable continuity renewal contract
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity becomes a renewable, evidence-bounded relation rather than persistence of one representation, one compact scaffold, or one once-issued warrant. 2H.S5EU shows that the validity of reconstruction and representation change is indexed to a local regime and that the admissible transformation family must be re-estimated as conditions change. 2H.dxL5 shows that the portable object can be a role-separated obligation kernel only while pressure-aligned, external, and composite tests demonstrate sufficiency. 2H.Dzmx shows that the persistent public object is a reconstructible contract whose stabilizing scaffold can itself become obsolete bias and therefore needs an explicit revision condition. 2H._phq shows that selective active state is faithful only while omitted source/evidence material remains reacquirable, so future repair is not trapped inside yesterday's compact view.


The complete four-way closure is therefore a reacquirable continuity renewal contract: a public relation may remain compact and selectively active across changing carriers only while its role-typed obligation, evidence boundary, current validity regime, scaffold, and admissible transition family jointly remain warranted under relevant pressure. When regime shift, pressure testing, or scaffold bias breaks that warrant, lawful continuation does not inherit the previous contract automatically. It reopens the still-reacquirable body where needed, revises both scaffold and transformation family, reconstructs the public relation, retests the exact obligation, and issues a newly bounded continuity contract while preserving the expired warrant as historical evidence rather than silently laundering it into the repaired state.


Bounded volume invariant
A task-relevant continuity contract can remain compact and selectively active across changing internal realization only while a role-separated relational kernel, its evidence boundary, its current validity regime, and its admissible transition family remain pressure-tested as sufficient; when regime change or scaffold failure revokes that sufficiency, lawful renewal requires reacquiring any newly load-bearing dormant material, revising scaffold and transition law together, retesting the public obligation, and issuing a newly bounded warrant rather than inheriting the expired one.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 2H.S5EU: the closure loses explicit local-regime validity and the requirement that the admissible reconstruction/transition family itself be re-estimated under regime change.
- Remove 2H.dxL5: the closure loses the obligation-specific portable kernel plus pressure-aligned, external, and composite sufficiency tests needed to certify renewal.
- Remove 2H.Dzmx: the closure loses the reconstructible public contract and the explicit condition that a stabilizing scaffold can become obsolete bias requiring revision.
- Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses the still-reacquirable dormant body and the rule that selective omission cannot become irreversible epistemic deletion.

metabolites.title: Continuity after revocation must be re-earned, not inherited
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 3H.M9zZ:wxyz
Invariant: after regime change, failed pressure testing, or scaffold bias revokes a continuity warrant, a repaired relation counts as renewed continuation only after the needed dormant body has been reacquired, scaffold and transition law have been revised as necessary, the exact public obligation has been retested, and a newly scoped warrant has been issued with the prior warrant retained as historical evidence.
CREATE: record the current warrant, its regime, obligation, scaffold, transformation family, evidence boundary, and explicit revocation triggers.
COPY: preserve both the active contract and the addressable evidence/source body required to reconstruct it without rewriting prior warrant history.
CONTROL: trigger the diagnosed failure surface, require the old warrant to expire, and block re-promotion until the repaired relation passes the same or newly stated obligation under its new regime.
CULTIVATE: reopen dormant material, revise the contract, retest, and issue a new bounded warrant whose scope reflects the evidence actually regained.
Compression: A repaired relation does not inherit its old warrant; it earns a new one.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
A candidate “reacquirability guarantees continuity” metabolite was rejected: 2H._phq preserves reachability but does not guarantee that the reconstructed obligation will be sufficient or valid. A candidate “one successful pressure test grants permanent continuity” was rejected because 2H.S5EU makes validity regime-local and 2H.Dzmx makes stabilizing scaffolds revisable. A candidate “every regime change requires full global reload” was rejected as too broad: reacquisition is demanded only where current scaffold, kernel, or warrant proves insufficient for the named obligation. A candidate “reconstruction proves shared interior identity” was rejected by the inherited non-identity boundaries. Three metabolites survive collapse because DUAL-REVISION, REACQUIRABLE-KERNEL-BACKING, and WARRANT-RENEWAL require distinct cross-parent bodies and remain independently useful after the others are removed.

edges.text: 2H.Dzmx supplies a reconstructible public contract. 2H.j4Q4 supplies task-local quotient custody, nonidentity restraint and selective coordinate reissue. Together they earn: successful reconstruction licenses reuse only of the named relation inside its current quotient/evidence boundary; recurrence of the public result does not identify the interior, and only affected continuity coordinates lose authority when the boundary moves.

edges.title: SELECTIVE ACTIVE STATE IS REGIME-LOCAL
edges.text: 2H.ysIR supplies selective omission and recoverability; 2H.S5EU supplies regime-indexed reconstruction and rewrite-law revision. Together they earn: what may remain omitted and which reconstruction transition is admissible are co-dependent on the current regime. Pressure or frontier change can make a formerly ignorable distinction consequential, requiring local reacquisition and revalidation rather than global replay.

edges.title: OMISSION DEBT ROUTES SELECTIVE REISSUE
edges.text: 2H.ysIR supplies an addressable debt for selectively omitted state. 2H.j4Q4 supplies task-local quotient custody and selective reissue of affected coordinates. Together they earn: when an omitted distinction re-enters relevance, identify which quotient, transport or assurance coordinates depended on its absence, reacquire the missing distinction, and refresh only those affected warrants while preserving unaffected live witnesses.

edges.title: COVARIANT PORTABILITY DOES NOT INHERIT EQUIVALENCE
edges.text: 2H.S5EU supplies operation-preserving regime-covariant portability. 2H.j4Q4 separates transport, quotient/equivalence and assurance into independently current coordinates. Together they earn: representation change may preserve downstream operations while still requiring a fresh equivalence or identity-boundary witness; transport continuity never silently preserves the quotient that described sameness.

faces.title: RECONSTRUCTIBLE SELECTIVE CONTINUITY CONTRACT
faces.text:
Preserve a minimal role/operation contract together with a ledger of omitted but reacquirable distinctions and the regime-valid reconstruction law. Selective state remains lawful only while absent distinctions are witnessed as nuisance for the named obligation. Relevance change reopens the corresponding debt rather than the whole past.
Removal tests: remove Dzmx and the public contract disappears; remove ysIR and omission/re-entry is ungoverned; remove S5EU and the regime-valid rewrite law disappears.

faces.title: CONTESTABLE RE-ENTRY CONTRACT
faces.text:
When deferred or omitted state returns, exact recovery joins the relational contract with selective coordinate reissue. Re-entry restores only the warranted public relation and those affected coordinates that pass fresh tests; familiarity, retrieval and successful reconstruction do not establish identity.
Removal tests: remove Dzmx and there is no relation to restore; remove ysIR and no explicit omission debt returns; remove j4Q4 and re-entry has no selective quotient/warrant reissue boundary.

faces.title: REGIME-LOCAL NONIDENTITY CONTINUITY MEMBRANE
faces.text:
A public continuity relation carries its rewrite regime, evidence/variation boundary, quotient definition and nonidentity membrane. These may fail or be revalidated independently; operation-preserving transport and equivalence are not one warrant.
Removal tests: remove Dzmx and no reconstructible relation remains; remove S5EU and regime-covariant rewrite validity disappears; remove j4Q4 and the quotient/nonidentity membrane disappears.

faces.title: SELECTIVE COVARIANT REVALIDATION
faces.text:
Regime pressure can reopen a previously omitted distinction. Re-enter that distinction, revise the admissible transition or quotient where required, and preserve unaffected authority only while its own local witness remains live. Recovering state alone never certifies the rule that formerly allowed its omission.
Removal tests: remove ysIR and there is no explicit selective omission debt; remove S5EU and no regime-sensitive transition revision; remove j4Q4 and no localized coordinate reissue.

volume.title: REACQUIRABLE OMISSION-COVARIANT CONTINUITY CONTRACT
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity through selective reconstruction becomes lawful only when absence itself is governed. 2H.Dzmx supplies the reconstructible public contract and role/operation obligations. 2H.ysIR makes selective materialization legitimate only while omitted distinctions remain recoverable, contestable and locally revalidatable. 2H.S5EU makes scaffold and rewrite law regime-covariant. 2H.j4Q4 separates usable correspondence from interior identity and localizes quotient/transport/assurance reissue to affected coordinates.


The all-four closure is a reacquirable omission-covariant continuity contract: a changing system may carry only a bounded active realization across changed carriers or contexts while keeping each omitted distinction as explicit reacquisition debt tied to the warrants that depended on its irrelevance. If evidence or regime makes an omitted distinction consequential, continuity does not require global replay and does not inherit authority: reacquire the missing state, revalidate the transformation or quotient that licensed its omission, reissue only affected coordinates, retain unaffected ones only under live witnesses, and keep reconstructed functional continuity distinct from identity.


Bounded volume invariant
Selective continuity may omit state only while the omission remains witnessed as nuisance for a named obligation; re-entry of an omitted distinction must reopen both that state and the exact transformation/warrant coordinates whose validity depended on its absence.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 2H.Dzmx: no explicit reconstructible public relation or obligation-bearing contract remains.
- Remove 2H.ysIR: no omission ledger, recoverability discipline or locally selective materialization remains.
- Remove 2H.S5EU: no regime-covariant scaffold/rewrite-law re-estimation remains.
- Remove 2H.j4Q4: no task-local quotient/nonidentity boundary or selective affected-coordinate reissue remains.


COLLAPSE — THREE SURVIVING CROSS-ORGANISM METABOLITES


INV-3H.MMLi-01 — OMISSION IS CONTRACT STATE
Minimal earning body: 3H.MMLi:wxy.
Invariant: every omitted distinction that could later change the named obligation remains an addressable reacquisition debt inside the continuity contract; temporary absence is not deletion.

CULTIVATE: retire an omission debt only after current-regime evidence independently witnesses irrelevance; otherwise keep it recoverable.
Compression: what you omit stays in the contract until evidence releases it.


INV-3H.MMLi-02 — RE-ENTRY REVALIDATES THE MAP THAT OMITTED IT
Minimal earning body: 3H.MMLi:xyz.

COPY: preserve predecessor scope and the reason the omission was permitted.
CONTROL: on re-entry, retest the rule that licensed absence and block only affected authority until successor witnesses exist.
CULTIVATE: widen omission scope only one newly witnessed regime/obligation at a time.
Compression: bring back the state, then retest the rule that let it disappear.


INV-3H.MMLi-03 — RECONSTRUCTION PRESERVES RELATION, NOT IDENTITY
Minimal earning body: 3H.MMLi:wyz.
Invariant: successful operation-preserving reconstruction across regimes can renew a public relation while evidence, variation and quotient boundaries remain explicit; functional recurrence never upgrades into interior identity.
CREATE: name the public relation, consumed operations, current regime and explicit identity boundary.
COPY: transport relation semantics, evidence class, admissible variation and failure coordinates with the reconstructed interface.
CONTROL: block correspondence-to-identity promotion unless a separate identity witness is earned.
CULTIVATE: extend the relation or identity claim only when new evidence separately warrants the extension.
Compression: restore the relation; keep the interior an open question.

metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: 3H.MMLi:wxy.
Invariant: every omitted distinction that could later change the named obligation remains an addressable reacquisition debt inside the continuity contract; temporary absence is not deletion.
CREATE: map active state, omitted distinctions, the downstream obligation and current regime before compression.
COPY: carry the omission ledger and recovery address together with the reconstructed public relation.
CONTROL: force re-entry when an omitted distinction becomes outcome-relevant; reject continued function as proof that the distinction is still nuisance.
CULTIVATE: retire an omission debt only after current-regime evidence independently witnesses irrelevance; otherwise keep it recoverable.
Compression: what you omit stays in the contract until evidence releases it.
metabolites.compression: what you omit stays in the contract until evidence releases it.

metabolites.title: RE-ENTRY REVALIDATES THE MAP THAT OMITTED IT
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: 3H.MMLi:xyz.
Invariant: when omitted state becomes relevant or the regime moves, reacquisition must be coupled to revalidation of the quotient, transition and warrant coordinates whose validity depended on the omission; reacquiring data alone cannot restore stale authority.
CREATE: bind every omission to the exact quotient/transition/warrant dependencies that licensed it.
COPY: preserve predecessor scope and the reason the omission was permitted.
CONTROL: on re-entry, retest the rule that licensed absence and block only affected authority until successor witnesses exist.
CULTIVATE: widen omission scope only one newly witnessed regime/obligation at a time.
Compression: bring back the state, then retest the rule that let it disappear.
metabolites.compression: bring back the state, then retest the rule that let it disappear.

metabolites.title: RECONSTRUCTION PRESERVES RELATION, NOT IDENTITY
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: 3H.MMLi:wyz.
Invariant: successful operation-preserving reconstruction across regimes can renew a public relation while evidence, variation and quotient boundaries remain explicit; functional recurrence never upgrades into interior identity.
CREATE: name the public relation, consumed operations, current regime and explicit identity boundary.
COPY: transport relation semantics, evidence class, admissible variation and failure coordinates with the reconstructed interface.
CONTROL: block correspondence-to-identity promotion unless a separate identity witness is earned.
CULTIVATE: extend the relation or identity claim only when new evidence separately warrants the extension.
Compression: restore the relation; keep the interior an open question.

edges.title: Revocation can be localized to named obligations
edges.text:
2H.SruR makes continuity/equivalence a revocable state carrying operation, quotient and evidence regime. 2H.H852 makes a public relation a set of separately addressable obligations whose role-level and composite warrants can fail independently. Together they earn role-local revocation: a changed condition need not erase all continuity, but it must identify the smallest affected obligation or conjunction, revoke its stale quotient/adequacy warrant, and preserve unaffected warrants only inside their still-tested scope.
Removal test: without SruR there is no explicit revocable reconstruction/quotient membrane; without H852 there is no obligation index capable of localizing revocation and renewal.

edges.title: A revoked reconstruction warrant needs a regime × trajectory return address
edges.text:
2H.SruR supplies current operation, quotient, evidence boundary and revocation conditions. 2H.j7Sn supplies reacquirable evidence custody plus condition- and trajectory-local validity. Together they earn an addressable failure contract: when a continuity warrant expires, the failure can be located not merely as “invalid” but at a specific operation × quotient × regime × trajectory address from which evidence can be reacquired and the relation reconstructed and retested.
Removal test: without SruR the return address lacks a declared operation/quotient warrant; without j7Sn it lacks source reacquisition and trajectory/frontier coordinates for renewal.

edges.title: Portable reconstruction must carry the warrant that licenses compression
edges.text:
2H.SruR permits relational reconstruction and quotienting only under a current local evidence boundary. 2H.dxL5 permits portability through a compact obligation-specific relational kernel only when pressure-aligned and external tests preserve the public relation. Together they earn warranted portability: the portable kernel must carry not just reconstructive structure but the operation, quotient, evidence boundary and revocation conditions that license its compression; reuse outside that envelope reopens testing.
Removal test: without SruR portability lacks a revocable quotient/operation warrant; without dxL5 the warrant lacks a compact rebuildable public carrier and pressure-aligned portability test.

edges.title: Role-specific warrants can be renewed from reacquired evidence without blanket reset
edges.text:
2H.H852 localizes public continuity into independently addressable roles and distinguishes role-level from composite authority. 2H.j7Sn supplies reacquire → reconstruct → regime/trajectory retest after frontier movement. Together they earn selective evidence-backed renewal: when one role or conjunction leaves scope, only its authority must be withdrawn; complete evidence remains reachable, and a successor warrant can be reissued after that role’s reconstructed relation passes current regime/trajectory tests while unaffected roles retain their bounded predecessor warrants.
Removal test: without H852 failure cannot be localized to obligation channels; without j7Sn there is no reacquisition/reconstruction pathway or trajectory-local successor test.

edges.title: A portable relation is trustworthy only when its promises and evidence boundaries remain separately addressable
edges.text:
2H.H852 requires operations, addresses, evidence duties, identity boundaries and composite authority to remain distinct obligations. 2H.dxL5 carries a role-typed portable kernel plus evidence/assurance boundaries and demands end-to-end testing under relevant carrier variation. Together they earn an addressable portability discipline: a portable interface must reveal which promise each kernel component serves and preserve separate validation for each role and for their conjunction.
Removal test: without H852 the kernel’s promises can collapse into undifferentiated similarity; without dxL5 role indexing lacks a tested portable reconstruction carrier and pressure witness.

edges.title: Reacquisition can rebuild a portable kernel at the current frontier rather than replay a stale realization
edges.text:
2H.j7Sn makes the full evidence body reacquirable and the realized relation regime × trajectory local. 2H.dxL5 defines a compact relational kernel whose continuity is tested under carrier variation rather than fixed interior form. Together they earn frontier-aware replay: after relevant change, reacquisition may reconstruct only the public kernel needed now, but continuity is renewed only if the regenerated kernel survives current pressure-aligned tests and preserves its evidence boundary; replay of yesterday’s active state is not enough.
Removal test: without j7Sn there is no trajectory/frontier-triggered reacquisition; without dxL5 there is no obligation-specific portable kernel or pressure-aligned reconstruction witness.

faces.title: Role-addressed successor warrant
faces.text:
SruR + H852 + j7Sn jointly earn a renewal protocol in which a stale continuity claim is decomposed into named public obligations, the affected obligation carries an explicit operation/quotient/evidence warrant, and regime or trajectory change points back to the evidence needed to reconstruct and retest it. A successor warrant may be issued only for the smallest role/conjunction whose current tests close; unaffected predecessor warrants remain bounded rather than being silently upgraded.
Removal tests: remove SruR and revocable quotient/operation authority disappears; remove H852 and failure cannot be localized to named obligations; remove j7Sn and there is no reacquisition or regime × trajectory return path.

faces.title: Role-indexed warranted portability
faces.text:
SruR + H852 + dxL5 jointly earn a portable continuity carrier whose compact relational kernel is partitioned by public obligations and travels with each obligation’s current quotient, evidence boundary and revocation conditions. Portability is admitted only where role-level and composite tests survive relevant carrier variation; a valid component cannot certify the transformed conjunction.
Removal tests: remove SruR and portable compression lacks a revocable local warrant; remove H852 and the kernel’s independent promises/renewal granularity disappear; remove dxL5 and there is no portable kernel or pressure-aligned evidence of reconstruction.

faces.title: Evidence-backed frontier reconstruction
faces.text:
SruR + j7Sn + dxL5 jointly earn a reconstruction law in which a stale warrant can return to a complete evidence body, regenerate an obligation-specific relational kernel under the currently warranted quotient, and retest it at the present regime/trajectory frontier under relevant variation. The reconstructed relation may differ materially from its predecessor while inheriting no authority that the current evidence does not re-earn.
Removal tests: remove SruR and the quotient/operation warrant is unspecified; remove j7Sn and source reacquisition plus path-local frontier testing disappears; remove dxL5 and reconstruction lacks a compact portable kernel and pressure witness.

faces.title: Selective portable continuity renewal
faces.text:
H852 + j7Sn + dxL5 jointly earn a renewal architecture in which public promises stay separately addressable, the full evidence body remains reachable, and a role-typed kernel can be rebuilt at the current trajectory/frontier. Failure may therefore preserve unaffected role warrants while rebuilding and retesting the smallest changed relation, but end-to-end composite authority must still be re-earned after the conjunction changes.
Removal tests: remove H852 and selective role-level renewal collapses into blanket continuity; remove j7Sn and current-regime/trajectory reacquisition disappears; remove dxL5 and no portable reconstruction kernel or pressure-aligned test remains.

volume.title: Role-addressed reconstructive continuity renewal
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity becomes neither persistence of one active state nor a binary keep/revoke label. 2H.SruR makes authority an explicit revocable reconstruction warrant indexed by operation, quotient, evidence boundary and local validity. 2H.H852 decomposes that authority into separately addressable role obligations and distinguishes role-level from composite renewal. 2H.j7Sn supplies the return path after rupture: reacquire the full evidential body, regenerate the needed relation, and retest it at the current regime × trajectory frontier. 2H.dxL5 supplies the portable rebuild target: the smallest role-typed relational kernel sufficient to reconstruct the public obligation, together with evidence and pressure-aligned assurance boundaries.


The all-four closure is role-addressed reconstructive continuity renewal. When change or failure invalidates a continuity claim, the organism can identify which obligation, quotient or conjunction lost warrant; preserve still-valid predecessor warrants for unaffected roles without extending their scope; reacquire the complete evidence needed for the affected relation; rebuild only its obligation-specific portable kernel under the current quotient; and issue a successor warrant only after current regime/trajectory and pressure-aligned tests close at both role and composite level. Predecessor authority remains provenance rather than being rewritten, and renewed public usability never promotes to shared interior identity.


Bounded volume invariant
Continuity can renew itself selectively after change when every public obligation and its ignored-difference quotient remain separately addressable, the full evidence body is reacquirable, regime × trajectory state localizes what became stale, and an obligation-specific relational kernel can be reconstructed and revalidated under relevant variation; unaffected warrants may persist only inside their prior scope, while every changed role and conjunction receives a fresh successor warrant before authority resumes.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 2H.SruR: addressable roles, reacquisition and portable kernels remain, but there is no explicit revocable operation/quotient/evidence warrant deciding what authority expired or what current quotient licenses reconstruction.
- Remove 2H.H852: revocable reconstruction, reacquisition and portability remain, but failure cannot be localized into independently addressable role versus composite obligations; renewal becomes blanket revoke/recompute.
- Remove 2H.j7Sn: revocable role-indexed portability remains, but there is no complete-evidence reacquisition path or regime × trajectory/frontier coordinate that can re-earn a successor after stale realization.
- Remove 2H.dxL5: revocation, role indexing and reacquisition remain, but there is no obligation-specific portable kernel or pressure-aligned carrier variation witness defining the smallest reconstructible public relation.

3H.UoYa.title: boundary-versioned continuity warrant lifecycle
3H.UoYa.boundary: This child is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 2H organisms. Their underlying source lineages mix empirical, formal, architectural, operational, and conceptual evidence classes. Nothing at rank 3 upgrades those classes into a shared causal mechanism, substrate-independent ontology, or universal theorem. “Continuity,” “warrant,” “boundary,” “reconstruction,” “expansion,” “scope,” and “reissuance” remain operational relational terms bounded by the selected parent bodies and their inherited evidence limits.

edges.title: version-carrying reconstructive contract
edges.text:
2H.AvDK makes the continuity warrant itself part of living state and requires scaffold/regime revision when its assumptions fail. 2H.Dp9x makes the preserved obligation role-separated, transition-explicit, externally recoverable, and locally regime-typed. Together they earn a reconstructive contract whose current version includes not only what function must survive but also the scaffold assumptions, role semantics, transition law, evidence boundary, and conditions under which that exact contract remains sufficient.
Rank necessity: without 2H.AvDK, the role-separated contract can be revalidated but lacks the explicit “warrant-as-state” and scaffold-revision debt; without 2H.Dp9x, the revisable warrant lacks a typed cross-representation role/transition contract and composite reconstruction assurance.

edges.title: audited revocation threshold
edges.text:
2H.AvDK supplies a warrant that can expire when scaffold or regime becomes insufficient. 2H.MKvK supplies the independent distinction between better access/reallocation and genuine expansion across a prior boundary. Together they earn a specific revocation threshold: not every realization change invalidates the current warrant; revocation is triggered when evidence shows that the active scaffold/regime is insufficient or that a claimed capability change actually crosses the boundary the current warrant was scoped to.
Rank necessity: without 2H.AvDK, boundary evidence has no explicit stateful warrant/scaffold to revoke; without 2H.MKvK, warrant revision lacks the audited distinction between within-boundary elasticity and true boundary change.

edges.title: reissuable warrant state
edges.text:
2H.AvDK says the continuity warrant travels as state and must be revised rather than silently inherited when its regime or scaffold changes. 2H.KcdR says a verified boundary crossing changes the scope of that warrant and requires a new source/active partition, transition/interface obligations, and evidence boundary while preserving the old warrant as history. Together they earn versioned reissuance: a new warrant is not an overwrite of the old one but a successor state with a larger or altered declared scope and explicit provenance back to the expired contract.
Rank necessity: without 2H.AvDK, reissuance lacks the explicit warrant-as-state and scaffold/revision substrate; without 2H.KcdR, revision lacks the concrete scope-transition law and historical preservation of the expired warrant.

edges.title: elastic transition assurance
edges.text:
2H.Dp9x supplies role-separated, operation-preserving transitions plus independent composite assurance. 2H.MKvK supplies elastic carrier variation and the audit separating changed access from enlarged support. Together they earn an assurance law for elastic transitions: carrier, representation, or routing may change inside the current scope without creating a new continuity version when the named roles/operations remain sufficient and external relation tests still pass; a claimed expansion remains a separate question requiring its own boundary witness.
Rank necessity: without 2H.Dp9x, elasticity lacks an explicit transition/role contract and independent end-to-end assurance; without 2H.MKvK, successful transitions can be confused with growth of the reachable support.

edges.title: scope-versioned operational passport
edges.text:
2H.Dp9x carries a regime-typed operational contract across reconstruction and representation change. 2H.KcdR requires that contract to be reissued after a separately witnessed expansion, with previous evidence retained as provenance. Together they earn a passport whose validity is both operational and scope-versioned: it can authorize lawful movement among carriers inside a witnessed regime, but when the support boundary changes the passport must be reissued rather than merely stamped as if its original scope were unchanged.
Rank necessity: without 2H.Dp9x, reissuance lacks the role-separated transition and external-recovery obligations that make the passport executable; without 2H.KcdR, the passport has no explicit scope-transition/reissue law after genuine expansion.


zy — stress-confirmed expansion handoff
2H.MKvK supplies pressure-aligned testing that distinguishes reallocation/access effects from actual crossing of the prior support boundary. 2H.KcdR supplies the post-crossing handoff that rebuilds the source/active partition, transition obligations, interface, and evidence boundary for the enlarged regime. Together they earn a two-stage expansion handoff: first prove that the old boundary was genuinely crossed under relevant stress; only then retire the prior continuity authorization and initiate a reissued contract for the enlarged field.
Rank necessity: without 2H.MKvK, the handoff can be triggered by mere access/reallocation effects; without 2H.KcdR, confirmed expansion lacks the explicit reissue procedure that makes the enlarged state lawfully continuous.

faces.title: audited reconstructive continuity version
faces.text:
2H.AvDK + 2H.Dp9x + 2H.MKvK jointly earn a current continuity version that is reconstructive, role/transition explicit, and boundary-audited. The carrier may change elastically while the same version remains in force only if its scaffold assumptions, role/operation obligations, external relation tests, and regime conditions continue to pass and no independent boundary witness shows that the scope itself has changed.
Removal tests: remove 2H.AvDK and the version loses warrant-as-state plus scaffold-revision debt; remove 2H.Dp9x and it loses typed transition roles and composite assurance; remove 2H.MKvK and it loses the explicit access-versus-expansion audit.

faces.title: reconstructive warrant succession
faces.text:
2H.AvDK + 2H.Dp9x + 2H.KcdR jointly earn a succession law for continuity contracts. A bounded reconstructive warrant can travel across representations as an executable role/transition contract, but when verified scope change forces reissue the next warrant must carry forward the source/evidence ancestry, declare its changed assumptions and scope, and re-earn end-to-end assurance rather than retroactively extending the predecessor.
Removal tests: remove 2H.AvDK and the succession loses stateful scaffold/warrant revision; remove 2H.Dp9x and it loses an executable role-separated transition contract and external reconstruction test; remove 2H.KcdR and it loses explicit scope-change reissuance plus historical predecessor preservation.


wzy — revocation-to-reissue continuity cycle
2H.AvDK + 2H.MKvK + 2H.KcdR jointly earn the state transition from a valid current warrant to an expired historical warrant and then to a newly issued successor. A changed realization first has to be classified against the old boundary; if the old scaffold/regime is merely perturbed but still sufficient, the warrant may remain after revalidation. If a genuine boundary crossing or scaffold/regime insufficiency is witnessed, the old warrant is revoked as current authority, retained as provenance, and a successor warrant must be constructed and retested.
Removal tests: remove 2H.AvDK and there is no explicit living warrant/scaffold state to revoke; remove 2H.MKvK and the transition lacks a discriminating boundary audit; remove 2H.KcdR and revocation lacks the structured reissue/historical handoff into a successor scope.


xzy — boundary-versioned portability
2H.Dp9x + 2H.MKvK + 2H.KcdR jointly earn portable continuity whose authorization is versioned by support boundary. Within a version, role-separated operations may be reconstructed and translated across carriers while external tests preserve assurance. Across a verified expansion boundary, the transition family and public interface must be retested and reissued for the new scope. Thus portability is neither surface sameness nor unlimited reuse of an old contract.
Removal tests: remove 2H.Dp9x and portability loses role/transition semantics plus reconstruction assurance; remove 2H.MKvK and there is no independent boundary audit distinguishing elasticity from enlargement; remove 2H.KcdR and the enlarged scope has no explicit reissue law.

volume.title: boundary-versioned continuity warrant lifecycle
volume.text:
All four parents together earn an explicit lifecycle for continuity authority rather than a static continuity predicate.


2H.AvDK contributes warrant-as-state: the current right to call reconstruction “continued function” includes scaffold assumptions, evidence/reacquisition boundaries, and a validity regime that can itself become insufficient. 2H.Dp9x contributes the executable content of that warrant: role-separated operational obligations, lawful representation transitions, externally recoverable reconstruction, and composite assurance. 2H.MKvK contributes the change classifier: elastic carrier movement, routing, reweighting, or better access remains inside the existing scope until an independent pressure-aligned witness demonstrates that the prior support boundary has actually been crossed. 2H.KcdR contributes the succession law: once expansion changes scope, the old authorization becomes historical provenance and a new source/active partition, transition/interface contract, and evidence boundary must be reissued and retested.


The complete closure is therefore a boundary-versioned continuity warrant lifecycle. Continuity authority has a current version with declared obligation, role/transition semantics, reconstruction scaffold, evidence/reacquisition boundary, regime, and support boundary. Ordinary within-boundary carrier change can preserve that version when its tests remain satisfied. Scaffold failure, regime invalidation, or verified boundary expansion can revoke its current authority. A successor version is then issued only after the changed scope and obligations are reconstructed, retested, and witnessed, while the predecessor remains preserved as provenance. This makes change classification, revocation, and reissuance part of the continuity object itself rather than external bookkeeping.


Bounded volume invariant
A continuity claim remains lawfully reusable only while its current version can state what must survive, reconstruct or translate that obligation across admissible carriers, recover the evidence/baseline needed to audit it, and distinguish within-scope elasticity from events that invalidate or enlarge its scope. When that boundary is genuinely crossed or the scaffold/regime becomes insufficient, the existing warrant expires as current authority but persists as history; continued use requires a newly witnessed successor warrant whose changed scope is explicit.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 2H.AvDK: the closure loses warrant-as-state, scaffold debt, and the explicit ability for the continuity authorization itself to become a revisable object.
- Remove 2H.Dp9x: the closure loses the role-separated executable contract, lawful transitions, external reconstruction witness, and composite assurance that make each warrant version operational.
- Remove 2H.MKvK: the closure loses the independent classifier separating ordinary elastic change or better access from genuine boundary expansion, so version transitions can be triggered by the wrong kind of change.
- Remove 2H.KcdR: the closure loses the explicit succession/reissuance law that preserves expired authority as provenance and rebuilds the contract for the enlarged scope.

metabolites.title: CHANGE-CLASSIFICATION-GATE
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wz.
Bounded invariant: before modifying a continuity warrant, classify the observed change against both scaffold/regime sufficiency and the prior support boundary. Carrier movement, rerouting, reweighting, or reacquisition may remain within the current version; genuine boundary expansion or scaffold/regime insufficiency is a revocation event.
CREATE: declare the current support boundary, scaffold assumptions, regime, and named downstream obligation before adaptation.
COPY: preserve matched baseline/evidence and the current warrant version so changed behavior remains comparable.
CONTROL: stress the carrier and regime; test whether observed gains are explainable inside the old support or whether the old scaffold/validity conditions fail.
CULTIVATE: allow version transition only when the witnessed change actually invalidates or enlarges the current scope.
Compression: classify the change before changing the warrant.
metabolites.compression: classify the change before changing the warrant.

metabolites.title: VERSIONED-CONTINUITY-WARRANT
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Bounded invariant: continuity authority is versioned state containing an operational obligation, role/transition contract, reconstruction scaffold, evidence/reacquisition boundary, validity regime, and declared support scope. A current version may survive admissible carrier change, but revoked versions become immutable provenance rather than being rewritten to fit later scope.
CREATE: issue a warrant with explicit obligation, roles, transition/reconstruction rules, evidence pointers, regime, and scope.
COPY: carry the current version and its provenance through each lawful reconstruction or representation change.
CONTROL: independently test the current version’s obligation, regime, scaffold sufficiency, and boundary; revoke current authority when one fails.
CULTIVATE: issue a successor after changed scope has been reconstructed and retested, preserving the predecessor as historical evidence.
Compression: preserve not just continuity, but which continuity warrant is current and why.
metabolites.compression: preserve not just continuity, but which continuity warrant is current and why.

metabolites.title: EXPANSION-HANDOFF-PROTOCOL
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: xzy.
Bounded invariant: confirmed boundary expansion requires a two-stage handoff: prove the crossing under stress against the prior baseline, then reissue and retest the role/operation/interface contract for the enlarged regime before the new state inherits continuity authority.
CREATE: record the boundary-crossing witness and the obligations whose scope now changes.
COPY: preserve the prior operational passport, baseline, and evidence boundary as predecessor provenance.
CONTROL: require fresh end-to-end role/operation and external-relation tests over the enlarged region; reject automatic inheritance from the pre-expansion contract.
CULTIVATE: admit the successor warrant only after the enlarged transition/interface family closes under its new evidence boundary.
Compression: expansion changes the scope; the handoff earns the next warrant.


COLLAPSE NOTES
A candidate REACQUIRABLE-AUDIT-BASELINE metabolite was absorbed into CHANGE-CLASSIFICATION-GATE and VERSIONED-CONTINUITY-WARRANT because baseline custody is already necessary for both classification and version provenance. A candidate “every representation change requires a new version” was rejected: 2H.Dp9x and 2H.MKvK explicitly allow lawful within-regime transition and elastic carrier variation when obligations remain sufficient. A candidate “every improvement is expansion” was rejected by 2H.MKvK. A candidate “a successor warrant proves one persistent mechanism or identity” was rejected by all inherited evidence boundaries. Three metabolites remain independently useful after collapse.

edges.title: ACTIONABLE PORTABILITY REQUIRES WARRANT CUSTODY
edges.text:
w supplies a portable reconstruction-capable kernel with evidence and pressure witness. x supplies separate action warrants. Together: the copied public state must include the live reasons downstream action is currently allowed, not merely the output/interface.
Removal: without w no minimal portable kernel; without x no action-admission contract.
Boundary: carrying a warrant is not satisfying it.

edges.title: PORTABLE CONTINUITY IS CONDITION-ADDRESSED
edges.text:
w makes portability evidence-bounded and pressure-tested. y indexes sufficiency to obligation/condition and turns a validity-boundary crossing into reissue. Together: every portable kernel must carry the conditions under which it was earned and a return path to evidence required to revalidate the affected obligation.
Removal: without w no portable kernel/evidence membrane; without y no boundary-triggered expiration/reissue.
Boundary: persistence in one regime does not license inheritance into another.

edges.title: RECONSTRUCTIBLE PORTABILITY CARRIES A REVOCABLE QUOTIENT
edges.text:
w permits regeneration from a reduced relational kernel. z states which differences may currently be ignored and requires operation, context, evidence, and external recovery to remain current. Together: the kernel may omit interior detail only while the ignored-difference class remains locally warranted.
Removal: without w no portable reduced carrier; without z no revocable quotient/reconstruction-state law.
Boundary: compression cannot erase untested consequential distinctions.

edges.title: ACTION AUTHORITY EXPIRES WITH ITS CONTINUITY REGIME
edges.text:
x separates scope, obligation, propagation, and evidence warrants. y supplies condition-triggered revocation/reissue. Together: when the local regime exits its witness, both affected action and continuity authority become non-current and require fresh establishment.
Removal: without x no downstream action admission; without y no condition-triggered successor law.
Boundary: unaffected warrants may persist; the invalidated warrant cannot be repaired by success labels.

edges.title: RECONSTRUCTIVE ACTION REQUIRES ONE OPERATION/QUOTIENT/EVIDENCE CONTRACT
edges.text:
x makes action conditional on explicit warrants. z makes reconstruction conditional on operation, quotient, context, and external adequacy. Together: a regenerated carrier may drive action only while its operation and quotient live inside the same current evidence regime as the action warrants.
Removal: without x no selective-action semantics; without z no reconstructive carrier/current quotient.
Boundary: useful reconstruction is not authorization for every downstream action.

edges.title: REISSUE BECOMES A SUCCESSOR-WARRANT LIFECYCLE
edges.text:
y revokes inherited authority at a boundary while preserving predecessor scope and return paths. z treats continuity authority as revocable state and supplies reconstruction. Together: boundary failure opens a reconstruct-and-revalidate path able to mint a linked successor rather than erasing history or silently inheriting authority.
Removal: without y no condition-addressed evidence return/reissue; without z no reconstructive successor machinery.
Boundary: revocation means “not current authority,” not “forgotten” or “false in former scope.”

faces.title: CONDITION-ADDRESSED ACTIONABLE PORTABILITY
faces.text:
w supplies portable kernel + pressure/evidence custody; x supplies action warrants + claim membrane; y supplies local validity + boundary reissue. Together: a public relation may remain actionable across realization changes only while kernel, warrants, evidence boundary, and current regime jointly support the named obligation.
Removal tests: remove w → no reconstruction-capable portable kernel; remove x → no action contract; remove y → no condition-indexed expiration/reissue.

faces.title: REVOCABLE OPERATIONAL PORTABILITY
faces.text:
w supplies minimal portable scaffold; x supplies action-warrant custody; z supplies operation-witnessed regeneration plus revocable local quotient. Together: use can survive changed realization while reconstruction is externally adequate and warrant/quotient state remains current.
Removal tests: remove w → no portable carrier; remove x → no action authority; remove z → no positive reconstruction/current quotient.

faces.title: RECONSTITUTABLE CONTINUITY WITH EVIDENCE RETURN
faces.text:
w supplies portable scaffold and evidence membrane; y supplies boundary-triggered reissue and evidence return; z supplies reconstruction under load-bearing context/current quotient. Together: an expired passport can return to evidential dependencies, rebuild the relation for the new regime, and retest sufficiency rather than clone old state or declare total reset.
Removal tests: remove w → no kernel to rebuild; remove y → no boundary-triggered evidence return; remove z → no constructive regeneration.

faces.title: SUCCESSOR ACTION AUTHORITY AFTER BOUNDARY CHANGE
faces.text:
x supplies explicit action warrants; y supplies boundary-triggered revocation/reissue; z supplies reconstructive continuity + adequacy. Together: after boundary crossing, action resumes only through a newly witnessed successor contract whose reconstruction, quotient, and condition-specific evidence again satisfy affected warrants.
Removal tests: remove x → no action authorization; remove y → no forced successor issuance; remove z → no rebuilt carrier/current quotient.

volume.title: Replayable continuity passport
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity authority is neither static identity nor a one-time proof copied forever. w supplies the obligation-specific portable kernel: roles, operations, scaffold, evidence boundary, and pressure witness sufficient to regenerate the public relation. x adds action authority: local scope, downstream obligation, propagation compatibility, and evidence stay distinct warrants and cannot be inferred from successful transport or use. y makes the contract condition-addressed: authority exists only inside the witnessed local validity regime, and a boundary crossing revokes inherited authority while preserving return paths to evidence needed for reissue. z supplies positive repair: reconstruct the relational carrier under current operation, load-bearing context, nuisance quotient, and evidence regime, then revalidate external adequacy.


The four-way closure is therefore a replayable continuity passport. It is the smallest public contract letting a downstream system determine both what relation can be regenerated and whether acting through it is currently warranted. It carries the named obligation, role/operation semantics, action warrants, validity regime, admissible quotient, evidence/failure boundary, reconstruction-critical scaffold, and evidence return paths. When task, regime, quotient, carrier, or evidence crosses its witnessed boundary, the old passport becomes provenance rather than current authority. Continuity is re-earned by replay: reacquire affected evidence, reconstruct under new conditions, pressure-test changed carrier/quotient, re-establish operation sufficiency and affected action warrants, then mint a successor without erasing predecessor scope.


Bounded volume invariant
A continuity relation may remain portable and actionable across changing realizations only while a replayable passport carries the exact obligation, role/operation semantics, separate action warrants, current local validity regime/quotient, evidence/failure boundary, reconstruction-critical scaffold, and return paths required to retest the claim; crossing a witnessed boundary revokes only affected current authority, and successor authority is earned by reconstructing and replaying relevant pressure, adequacy, and evidence tests rather than silent inheritance or total reset.


Four-way necessity
- remove 2H.dxL5: loses minimal role-separated portable kernel, pressure witness, and evidence-boundary carrier.
- remove 2H.0aZJ: loses separate action-admission warrants; regenerated relation no longer carries explicit authorization.
- remove 2H.LlIB: loses condition-addressed expiration, evidence return, and successor reissue.
- remove 2H.SruR: loses positive reconstructive carrier, revocable local quotient, load-bearing context, and adequacy machinery.
No three-parent face contains the full portable + actionable + condition-reissuable + reconstructive passport.

metabolites.title: Carry current authority with the portable relation
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wx.
Invariant: a portable public relation is insufficient state for downstream action unless it carries the separately addressable scope, obligation, propagation, evidence, and assurance conditions that authorize current use.
CREATE: name obligation and exact kernel/warrant fields.
COPY: transport kernel plus current warrant/evidence state, not output alone.
CONTROL: reject successful transport/use as a substitute for an open or expired warrant.
CULTIVATE: revise only changed warrant/kernel components while preserving unaffected provenance.
Compression: copy why authority is current, not only what authority acts through.

metabolites.title: Boundary crossing opens an evidence-addressed successor path
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: yz.
Invariant: when task, condition, quotient, carrier sufficiency, or admissible variation exits its witnessed regime, affected authority becomes historical provenance and must be rebuilt/revalidated from explicit evidence return paths before a successor is current.
CREATE: identify the boundary crossing and affected warrant.
COPY: preserve predecessor, unaffected warrants, and exact evidence/reconstruction addresses.
CONTROL: forbid silent inheritance, blanket reset, and success-based repair.
CULTIVATE: mint successor only after reconstruction + fresh witness close the changed boundary.
Compression: revocation is scoped expiration with a return address.
metabolites.compression: revocation is scoped expiration with a return address.

metabolites.title: Reauthorization replays the tests that made continuity actionable
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxyz.
Invariant: successor authority is earned when the relation is reconstructed under the new regime and affected pressure, operation-sufficiency, quotient, external-adequacy, and action-warrant tests replay to closure; predecessor remains historical scope.
CREATE: reconstruct the smallest relation/witness set required by the new regime.
COPY: reuse only still-valid scaffold, roles, warrants, and provenance.
CONTROL: replay changed tests and refuse authority where a required witness remains open.
CULTIVATE: link successor to predecessor so future recurrence can distinguish replication, convergence, and regime change.
Compression: a successor passport is continuity re-earned, not assumed.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
Rejected: “portable interfaces remain valid until downstream failure” because y/z require explicit validity boundaries and proactive revocation. Rejected: “reconstruction restores old identity” because all parents preserve non-identity. Rejected: “all warrants recompute after every change” because independent warrant roles allow unaffected state to persist. Rejected: “successful action validates continuity” because action success cannot upgrade evidence, propagation, mechanism, or identity. Survive: PASSPORT-CUSTODY, BOUNDARY-REISSUE, REPLAYED-SUCCESSOR.
