edges.title: Evidence-backed reconstructible contract
edges.text:
2H._phq supplies exact reacquirability of dormant evidence and the rule that omission from active state is not deletion from the evidence state. 2H.Dzmx supplies a role-separated minimal contract specifying the public obligation, operations, evidence membrane, and scaffold needed to rebuild the relation. Together they earn a stronger contract law: a compact reconstructible contract can remain small only if the evidence and dormant distinctions it omits from current active state stay addressable enough to reopen when the contract fails or its obligations change.
Removal test: without 2H._phq the reduced contract can become irreversibly lossy; without 2H.Dzmx reacquirable material lacks a typed minimal public obligation defining what must be reconstructed.
Boundary: addressability of evidence does not by itself certify the contract; the rebuilt relation still requires current testing.

edges.title: Reacquisition is not expansion
edges.text:
2H._phq permits dormant material to be reactivated and a public relation to be reconstructed from a larger reachable body. 2H.MKvK separates improved access/reallocation from genuine expansion of the possibility frontier. Together they require a strict classification: reopening previously reachable evidence or support may change realized performance without enlarging the supported field; a growth claim still needs a boundary-crossing witness beyond the prior reachable body.
Removal test: without 2H._phq there is no explicit dormant/reacquirable body whose reopening can improve realization; without 2H.MKvK there is no independent support-boundary test separating reacquisition from expansion.
Boundary: reacquisition can enable new outcomes relative to the active slice while remaining inside an older global support boundary.

edges.title: Custodied regime-revalidatable reconstruction
edges.text:
2H._phq supplies evidence custody and reacquisition behind selective reconstruction. 2H.AvDK supplies a living continuity warrant composed of operational obligation, evidence/reacquisition boundary, scaffold assumptions, and validity regime. Together they earn a reconstruction rule in which the evidence required to challenge or repair the current continuity claim remains reachable and the conditions under which reconstruction stops counting as the same function travel with the state.
Removal test: without 2H._phq dormant evidence can disappear from the repair path; without 2H.AvDK there is no explicit validity/warrant state able to revoke an apparently successful reconstruction.
Boundary: a reachable source body is not sufficient unless current obligation and validity conditions are retested.

edges.title: Contract-scoped frontier audit
edges.text:
2H.Dzmx supplies a typed reconstructible public contract and pressure-aligned sufficiency tests. 2H.MKvK supplies the distinction between elastic realization within a frontier and genuine frontier expansion. Together they make before/after claims commensurable: the same named obligation, role semantics, and evidence membrane define what is being compared, while a separate boundary witness determines whether the changed realization remains an instance of the old support or has enlarged it.
Removal test: without 2H.Dzmx there is no stable typed object against which before/after realization can be compared; without 2H.MKvK there is no criterion separating ordinary carrier elasticity from support expansion.
Boundary: a contract may remain satisfied while capability changes elsewhere; contract sufficiency is not a complete capability measure.

edges.title: Warrant-bearing reconstructible contract
edges.text:
2H.Dzmx supplies the minimal obligation set that lets a public relation be reconstructed across changing interiors. 2H.AvDK supplies the right-to-count-as-continuity as explicit living state carrying validity regime, scaffold assumptions, and revalidation conditions. Together they earn a warrant-bearing contract: every reconstructible public relation can carry not only what must be rebuilt but why the rebuilt relation currently counts, which evidence supports that judgment, and what conditions revoke it.
Removal test: without 2H.Dzmx the warrant lacks a sharply typed reconstruction target; without 2H.AvDK the contract lacks explicit validity state and revocation conditions.
Boundary: the existence of a warrant does not make it true outside its tested regime; it makes its scope and failure conditions inspectable.

edges.title: Boundary-classified warrant transition
edges.text:
2H.MKvK supplies a classification between ordinary access/reallocation and genuine support-boundary crossing, including the rule that true boundary change expires inherited continuity authority. 2H.AvDK supplies regime/scaffold-sensitive warrant state and a revision-triggered reconstruction path. Together they earn a transition discipline: ordinary carrier/access change can retain the current warrant after matched revalidation, whereas verified frontier crossing, regime departure, or scaffold failure retires the old warrant and requires a successor rather than silent extension.
Removal test: without 2H.MKvK changed performance cannot be classified against the old support frontier; without 2H.AvDK there is no explicit warrant lifecycle that can be revoked and reissued after classification.
Boundary: not every change forces a new warrant; the trigger must be a materially relevant boundary, regime, or scaffold event.

faces.title: Reacquirable frontier-audited contract
faces.text:
2H._phq contributes a dormant but exactly reacquirable body behind selective reconstruction, 2H.Dzmx contributes a role-separated public reconstruction contract, and 2H.MKvK contributes explicit frontier accounting. Together they earn an adaptive contract that can reopen omitted evidence as task pressure rises while distinguishing an expanded active realization from an actually enlarged support frontier.
Removal tests: remove 2H._phq and omitted evidence may be irrecoverable; remove 2H.Dzmx and there is no typed public obligation to reconstruct; remove 2H.MKvK and changed realization cannot be classified as access/reallocation versus expansion.

faces.title: Reacquirable warrant-bearing reconstruction
faces.text:
2H._phq contributes evidence custody and selective reacquisition, 2H.Dzmx contributes the typed minimal contract, and 2H.AvDK contributes explicit living validity/warrant state. Together they earn a reconstructible relation whose compact active carrier is backed by reopenable evidence and whose authority can be revoked when scaffold or regime assumptions fail.
Removal tests: remove 2H._phq and repair loses guaranteed evidence reachability; remove 2H.Dzmx and repair loses a precise reconstruction target; remove 2H.AvDK and repair loses explicit scope/revocation state.

faces.title: Reacquisition-mediated warrant renewal
faces.text:
2H._phq contributes the ability to reopen dormant source/evidence tissue; 2H.MKvK contributes the event that separates ordinary re-realization from genuine frontier change; 2H.AvDK contributes revision-triggered reconstruction and warrant-as-state. Together they earn a renewal path: when a boundary/regime/scaffold event invalidates current continuity authority, relevant dormant evidence can be reacquired and used to retest a revised reconstruction before a successor warrant is admitted.
Removal tests: remove 2H._phq and renewal may have no path back to omitted evidence; remove 2H.MKvK and there is no explicit distinction between ordinary access change and warrant-breaking frontier change; remove 2H.AvDK and no living warrant exists to revoke, revise, and renew.

faces.title: Versioned contract succession under boundary change
faces.text:
2H.Dzmx contributes a role-separated reconstructible contract, 2H.MKvK contributes boundary-triggered rewarranting, and 2H.AvDK contributes regime/scaffold-sensitive validity state. Together they earn predecessor/successor contract semantics: an old contract remains provenance when its validity envelope is left, while a revised typed contract must be independently tested before inheriting the continuity role.
Removal tests: remove 2H.Dzmx and succession lacks a typed obligation object; remove 2H.MKvK and no support-boundary trigger distinguishes ordinary change from expansion; remove 2H.AvDK and there is no explicit living warrant state to retire or reissue.
Boundary: without 2H._phq this face alone does not guarantee that all evidence needed for repair remains reacquirable.

volume.title: Frontier-conditioned reconstructive continuity
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity is neither raw snapshot persistence nor mere output similarity. 2H._phq contributes exact reacquirability and evidence custody behind selective reconstruction. 2H.Dzmx contributes a role-separated minimal contract defining the relation that must be rebuilt. 2H.MKvK contributes the audit that distinguishes carrier/access change inside a known support from actual boundary expansion and forces fresh authority when that boundary is crossed. 2H.AvDK contributes the continuity warrant itself as living, regime/scaffold-sensitive state that can be revoked and revised.


The complete closure is frontier-conditioned reconstructive continuity: a public task relation can persist through selective, noncanonical, or reconstructed realization while its current typed contract, reacquirable backing evidence, role semantics, and validity warrant remain jointly addressable and testable. Ordinary carrier, routing, or access changes may retain the current warrant when matched tests close inside the witnessed frontier. Verified support-boundary crossing, departure from the witnessed validity regime, or scaffold failure retires the previous warrant into provenance. Lawful continuation then requires reacquiring the relevant evidence, reconstructing or revising the typed contract, pressure-testing it under the changed frontier/regime, and issuing a newly scoped successor warrant rather than silently inheriting authority.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
Continuity through changing realization is warranted only while the reconstructible public contract, its dormant evidential backing, the known support frontier, and the current validity warrant remain jointly addressable; ordinary access/carrier changes may preserve the current warrant after matched revalidation, but boundary crossing, regime departure, or scaffold failure must retire inherited authority and trigger evidence-backed reconstruction plus a freshly witnessed successor warrant.


FULL-RANK REMOVAL TESTS
- Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses exact reacquirability and evidence custody; a contract can be revised and rewarranted, but repair may silently proceed after omitted evidence has become inaccessible.
- Remove 2H.Dzmx: the closure loses the role-separated reconstructible public obligation; evidence and warrants remain, but there is no minimal typed relational object that says precisely what must be rebuilt.
- Remove 2H.MKvK: the closure loses the distinction between access/reallocation and actual support expansion plus the frontier-triggered expiry of inherited authority.
- Remove 2H.AvDK: the closure loses warrant-as-state, local validity/scaffold revocation, and explicit revision-triggered reconstruction; frontier change can be detected but there is no living continuity authority to retire and renew.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.

metabolites.title: EVIDENCE-BACKED-RECONSTRUCTIBLE-CONTRACT
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wx.
Invariant: a compact role-separated reconstruction contract remains lawful only while the evidence and dormant distinctions excluded from current active state remain exactly reacquirable enough to challenge, repair, or enlarge the contract when its named obligation changes or fails.
CREATE: state the public obligation, its minimal role/operation contract, and stable addresses for the larger supporting evidence body.
COPY: regenerate the relation from the compact contract while preserving source reachability rather than copying every dormant detail into active state.
CONTROL: ablate contract fields and evidence access independently; reject compactness that succeeds only because omitted evidence has become impossible to recover or test.
CULTIVATE: reopen dormant evidence and revise the contract when new obligations or failures expose distinctions that the former active state did not need.
Compression: keep the contract small; keep the evidence path large enough to repair it.
metabolites.compression: keep the contract small; keep the evidence path large enough to repair it.

metabolites.title: FRONTIER-CLASSIFIED-WARRANT
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: yz.
Invariant: before continuity authority is inherited across change, classify the change against the current support frontier and validity regime: ordinary access/reallocation may retain the warrant after matched revalidation, whereas verified frontier crossing, regime departure, or scaffold failure retires it.
CREATE: name the prior support boundary, validity regime, scaffold assumptions, and current continuity warrant before evaluating the changed realization.
COPY: preserve the prior warrant and comparison coordinates as provenance across carrier or access changes.
CONTROL: test whether the observed difference is explained inside the previous support or crosses a boundary/validity condition that the old warrant did not cover.
CULTIVATE: admit broader support or revised regime only by creating a separately tested successor warrant rather than silently stretching the predecessor.
Compression: classify the change before deciding whether continuity authority survives it.
metabolites.compression: classify the change before deciding whether continuity authority survives it.

metabolites.title: SUCCESSOR-WARRANT-RECONSTRUCTION
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: when a continuity warrant is revoked by frontier crossing, regime departure, or scaffold failure, lawful continuation requires reacquiring the relevant evidence, revising or rebuilding the typed public contract, pressure-testing that reconstruction in the changed envelope, and issuing a newly scoped successor while preserving the expired warrant as historical provenance.
CREATE: instantiate the candidate successor contract together with the changed frontier/regime and the evidence reopened for repair.
COPY: preserve the predecessor contract/warrant as immutable provenance and carry forward only obligations that survive explicit retest.
CONTROL: require all-four closure—reacquirable evidence, typed contract, boundary classification, and current validity witness—before transferring continuity authority to the successor.
CULTIVATE: let repeated failure/renewal produce a traceable lineage of warrants whose scopes can expand, contract, or differentiate without laundering old authority into new conditions.
Compression: revoke, reacquire, rebuild, retest, reissue; never silently inherit expired authority.


COLLAPSE NOTES
A candidate “reacquisition proves expansion” was rejected because reopening previously reachable material can improve realization entirely inside an old support frontier. A candidate “every carrier change requires a new warrant” was rejected because matched revalidation can preserve authority across ordinary in-regime realization changes. A candidate “the typed contract alone constitutes continuity” was rejected because evidence reachability, frontier classification, and current validity authority remain independently necessary. Three metabolites survive because evidence backing, change classification, and successor reconstruction each have a distinct minimal earning body and none is reducible to the others.
metabolites.compression: revoke, reacquire, rebuild, retest, reissue; never silently inherit expired authority.

edges.title: Adaptive reconstruction becomes a typed continuity contract only when every preserved role re-earns composite assurance
edges.text:
2H.S5EU supplies a regime-indexed reconstruction/transition family whose scaffold, evidence membrane and admissible rewrites must be re-estimated as conditions move. 2H.Dp9x supplies explicit role-separated obligations and the rule that a reconstructed composite must re-earn end-to-end assurance in the regime where it is used. Together they earn a stricter relation: the transformation family that carries continuity must be typed by the exact operations/roles it promises to preserve, and each reconstructed realization must be tested as a whole rather than inheriting assurance from the map or components.
Removal test: without 2H.S5EU there is no adaptive regime-covariant reconstruction/transition family; without 2H.Dp9x there is no explicit role-typed composite obligation and end-to-end assurance gate.

edges.title: Adaptive portability must earn its transformation family under pressure
edges.text:
2H.S5EU supplies the locally revisable family of lawful reconstruction and representation transitions. 2H.xqNz supplies the obligation-minimal portable kernel plus pressure-aligned carrier/representation variation designed to expose false invariance. Together they earn a falsifiable portability law: a transition or reconstruction family is admissible only insofar as the regenerated public relation and its evidence membrane survive the relevant variation that should break a merely superficial continuity claim.
Removal test: without 2H.S5EU pressure evidence does not govern an explicitly revisable map of admissible transformations; without 2H.xqNz the adaptive map lacks a dedicated pressure surface and portable-kernel sufficiency witness.

edges.title: Continuity has two distinct revision triggers: changed regime and obsolete stabilization
edges.text:
2H.S5EU supplies revision when context, representation or local validity regime changes, including revision of the retained scaffold and admissible transformation family. 2H.Dzmx supplies custodial revision when the stabilizing scaffold itself becomes anchor debt and starts preserving the wrong future even if no externally named regime shift has already been recognized. Together they earn dual revision: continuity maintenance must react both to exogenous condition change and to endogenous evidence that its own stabilizing memory has become a source of error.
Removal test: without 2H.S5EU revision loses the explicit regime/transition dimension; without 2H.Dzmx it loses the endogenous scaffold-debt/obsolescence trigger.

edges.title: A minimal typed reconstruction contract earns portability only through pressure-aligned composite assurance
edges.text:
2H.Dp9x supplies a role-separated reconstruction contract and independent end-to-end assurance in the relevant validity regime. 2H.xqNz supplies minimization to the portable relational kernel and the requirement that invariance survive carrier/representation perturbations while neighboring non-invariants are allowed to move. Together they earn a stronger assurance criterion: a reduced/rebuilt contract is portable only when its exact composite obligation survives relevant variation, not merely when it works in one familiar realization.
Removal test: without 2H.Dp9x the pressure-tested kernel lacks an explicit role-typed composite obligation; without 2H.xqNz the typed contract lacks the dedicated perturbational witness that earns noncanonical portability.

edges.title: A reconstructible contract must carry an explicit expiry/revision condition
edges.text:
2H.Dp9x supplies current-regime sufficiency, role-typed reconstruction and composite assurance. 2H.Dzmx supplies the rule that retained scaffold can become obsolete bias and therefore must carry a revision condition with the regenerated public interface. Together they earn an assurance-lifecycle relation: the contract must specify not only what counts as success now, but the evidence or state change under which the current scaffold and assurance cease to be trusted and must be re-earned.
Removal test: without 2H.Dp9x revision is not tied to an exact composite assurance claim in a witnessed regime; without 2H.Dzmx there is no explicit anchor-debt/expiry condition for the retained scaffold.

edges.title: The portable contract is more stable than any one reconstruction mechanism
edges.text:
2H.xqNz and 2H.Dzmx share the same three-parent structural core {1H.hs7W, 1H.qI2L, 1H.9gYl} but close after substituting 1H.2VF2's dynamic relational re-instantiation for 1H.L4ld's bounded-state recurrent regeneration. Their complete 2H volumes converge on evidence-bounded/reconstructible public contracts despite that change in reconstruction pathway. Together they provide structural substitution evidence: within these selected bodies, the portable obligation/evidence kernel is not tied to one reconstruction mechanism, provided the alternative pathway still regenerates the relation under its pressure and boundary conditions.
Removal test: without either complete 2H body there is only one reconstruction pathway and no higher-rank substitution witness.
Boundary: this pair is structural recurrence evidence from two selected 2H organisms, not proof that reconstruction mechanism is universally irrelevant or freely interchangeable.

faces.title: Pressure-witnessed regime-typed portability
faces.text:
2H.S5EU contributes the adaptive regime-indexed transition/reconstruction family; 2H.Dp9x contributes role-typed obligations plus composite assurance; 2H.xqNz contributes the minimal portable kernel and pressure-aligned falsification surface. Together they earn a portable continuity contract whose representation/reconstruction map is valid only when named role obligations survive the current regime and independently chosen carrier variation.
Removal tests: remove 2H.S5EU and no adaptive regime-covariant map remains; remove 2H.Dp9x and the contract loses explicit role typing/composite assurance; remove 2H.xqNz and it loses the pressure witness that earns portability rather than assuming it.
Boundary: this face does not yet supply the endogenous condition that a formerly valid stabilizing scaffold may itself become obsolete bias.

faces.title: Self-revising reconstructive contract
faces.text:
2H.S5EU contributes regime-triggered revision of scaffold and transition family; 2H.Dp9x contributes exact role obligations and end-to-end reconstruction assurance; 2H.Dzmx contributes the explicit anchor-debt condition under which prior stabilization must be revised. Together they earn a contract that not only reconstructs continuity but carries a lifecycle for its own validity: it says what must survive, where the assurance holds, and when both map and retained scaffold must be reconsidered.
Removal tests: remove 2H.S5EU and the contract loses regime-covariant transition revision; remove 2H.Dp9x and it loses typed composite assurance; remove 2H.Dzmx and it loses the endogenous scaffold-obsolescence trigger.
Boundary: without 2H.xqNz this face lacks a dedicated independent pressure-aligned carrier-variation witness for false invariance.

faces.title: Mechanism-flexible adaptive portability
faces.text:
2H.S5EU contributes the revisable family of lawful reconstructions/transitions; 2H.xqNz contributes a pressure-validated portable kernel; 2H.Dzmx contributes a second reconstruction pathway and explicit scaffold-revision debt. Together they earn a continuity architecture in which the reconstruction mechanism itself may change while the public obligation/evidence boundary remains stable, provided the new pathway survives relevant variation and both transition map and scaffold remain revisable.
Removal tests: remove 2H.S5EU and no explicit adaptive cross-representation map remains; remove 2H.xqNz and the mechanism substitution loses its pressure-witnessed portable kernel; remove 2H.Dzmx and there is no alternate bounded-state pathway or endogenous anchor-debt revision.
Boundary: without 2H.Dp9x this face does not fully type the public obligation into independent roles with an explicit composite-assurance gate.

faces.title: Assurance-bearing reconstructible kernel
faces.text:
2H.Dp9x contributes role-typed contract and end-to-end assurance; 2H.xqNz contributes the minimal pressure-witnessed kernel and evidence-boundary assurance; 2H.Dzmx contributes reconstructible public obligation plus scaffold expiry/revision. Together they earn a compact persistent object that carries the role obligations, evidence membrane, stress witness and revision condition needed to rebuild a warranted interface even when the reconstruction mechanism varies.
Removal tests: remove 2H.Dp9x and the kernel loses explicit role-typed composite assurance; remove 2H.xqNz and it loses the pressure-witnessed minimization criterion; remove 2H.Dzmx and it loses reconstruction lifecycle/anchor-debt revision.
Boundary: without 2H.S5EU this face does not earn a regime-covariant family of lawful representation/context transitions.

volume.title: Reflexive continuity contract
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity has already detached from a fixed interior, canonical representation or single reconstruction procedure. The all-four closure adds a higher-order constraint on that freedom. 2H.S5EU makes the admissible reconstruction/transition family and its evidence membrane local to a validity regime and revisable as conditions move. 2H.Dp9x makes the persistent object an explicitly role-typed contract whose reconstructed composite must re-earn end-to-end assurance. 2H.xqNz makes portability a pressure-tested property of an obligation-minimal kernel rather than a consequence of familiar labels or stable parts. 2H.Dzmx adds the second revision channel: the scaffold that once preserved continuity can itself become obsolete anchor debt and must carry the condition of its own retirement or revision.


The complete four-way closure is therefore a reflexive continuity contract: a public relation may remain continuous across changing representations, regimes and reconstruction mechanisms when it is carried as a minimal role-typed contract whose claim-relevant operations and evidence boundary can regenerate the relation, whose transformation/reconstruction family is pressure-tested in the current regime, and whose retained scaffold and map carry explicit revision triggers. The contract is reflexive because part of what it preserves is the information needed to determine when its own continuity claim has stopped being warranted. Continuity is therefore not merely the ability to reproduce a relation; it is the ability to reproduce that relation together with the conditions that can falsify, expire and revise its mode of reproduction.


Bounded volume invariant


A durable public relation can remain continuous across changing representation, regime and reconstruction mechanism when it is carried as a minimal role-typed contract whose claim-relevant operations and evidence boundary can regenerate the relation, whose transition/reconstruction family is pressure-tested within the current regime, and whose scaffold and map include explicit revision triggers when conditions change or prior stabilization becomes bias; continuity is warranted only while the contract preserves both the relation and the conditions for detecting when it no longer does.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 2H.S5EU: the closure loses the explicit regime-covariant, revisable family of lawful reconstruction/representation transitions; the remaining trio can carry a typed, pressure-tested reconstructible contract but cannot earn its adaptive map across changing context/representation.
- Remove 2H.Dp9x: the closure loses explicit role-separated composite obligations and end-to-end reconstruction assurance; the remaining trio can support adaptive, pressure-tested, revisable portability but not the precise typed composite whose continuity is being certified.
- Remove 2H.xqNz: the closure loses the independent pressure-aligned carrier-variation witness and obligation-minimal portable-kernel criterion; the remaining trio can describe an adaptive typed self-revising contract but lacks the dedicated stress surface that earns portability under noncanonical variation.
- Remove 2H.Dzmx: the closure loses the endogenous anchor-debt/expiry condition and the independent bounded-state reconstruction pathway; the remaining trio can earn regime-typed pressure-tested portability but not the rule that continuity must detect when its own stabilizing scaffold has become the source of invalidity.

metabolites.title: Carry the relation together with the conditions that can revoke it
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 3H.k0uZ:wxyz
Invariant: a portable continuity contract is strongest when it carries not only the public obligation and evidence boundary, but also the current validity regime, the admissible reconstruction/transition family, the pressure witness and the explicit conditions under which that map or scaffold must be revised.
CREATE: state the public relation, independent role/operation obligations, evidence class, current regime, reconstruction/transition family and explicit revocation/revision conditions.
COPY: regenerate the relation together with its evidence membrane, regime witness and revision conditions rather than reproducing only the outward interface.
CONTROL: vary carrier, representation, regime and reconstruction pathway; revoke continuity when the public obligation fails, the pressure witness collapses or the stabilizing scaffold becomes anchor debt.
CULTIVATE: revise the scaffold, transition family and regime boundary as new evidence arrives while preserving the weaker prior claim where its original conditions still hold.
Compression: Carry the relation and the conditions that can revoke it.

metabolites.title: Separate the portable obligation from the reconstruction mechanism only after substitution survives
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 3H.k0uZ:yz
Invariant: within the selected 2H bodies, the same higher-order portability/contract structure survives substitution between dynamic relational re-instantiation and bounded-state recurrent regeneration, supporting a bounded distinction between the public continuity obligation and one particular reconstruction mechanism.
CREATE: identify a shared public obligation/evidence kernel and at least two genuinely different reconstruction pathways that instantiate it.
COPY: reproduce the obligation through each pathway without forcing identical interiors or histories.
CONTROL: compare external relation, pressure behavior, evidence boundary and failure modes under the substitution; reject mechanism-independence when the obligation changes.
CULTIVATE: widen the reconstruction family only as additional pathways preserve the same bounded obligation under matched stress.
Compression: Let the reconstruction mechanism vary only after the obligation survives the substitution.
Boundary: two convergent selected 2H organisms support structural substitution evidence, not universal mechanism-independence.

metabolites.title: Revise both the map and the memory
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: 3H.k0uZ:wz
Invariant: continuity can fail in at least two distinct ways represented here: the environment/representation regime can change so the old transition map is no longer warranted, or the retained scaffold can become an obsolete stabilizing bias even before that change is cleanly named. A living continuity contract therefore needs separate revision paths for map and memory.
CREATE: record the current transition/reconstruction map, retained scaffold, regime assumptions and the signals that would invalidate each.
COPY: carry both revision channels with every regenerated interface.
CONTROL: test for exogenous regime mismatch and endogenous anchor debt separately; do not let success on one hide failure on the other.
CULTIVATE: update the map, scaffold or both according to the witnessed failure while retaining unaffected obligations.
Compression: Revise the map when the world changes; revise the memory when yesterday's stability becomes today's bias.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS


A candidate “all continuity is contractual” metabolite was rejected as an unearned universal; the selected parents support contract-like continuity in these structural domains, not every form of persistence. A candidate “reconstruction mechanism never matters” metabolite was rejected: the yz substitution witness is bounded to two convergent 2H pathways and requires matched pressure/evidence checks. A candidate “every regime change requires a new identity” metabolite was rejected because the parents explicitly permit lawful reconstruction and translation while preserving a bounded public relation. A candidate “self-revision guarantees correctness” metabolite was rejected because revision machinery only preserves the ability to re-test and update; it does not guarantee that a revised contract is true. Three metabolites survive collapse because reflexive validity, mechanism-substitution witnessing and dual map/memory revision require different minimal cross-parent bodies and remain independently useful after the others are removed.

- Local revocation is sufficient only where unaffected coordinates retain their own current witnesses.
- Access/reallocation is not treated as expansion.
- Expansion authority is not inferred from recurrence, repair or successful local performance.
- Shared ancestry and immediate-parent overlap with nearby 3H lineage remain explicit; no independence is claimed.

edges.title: condition-local validity × expansion reissue
edges.text: Classify whether a changed relation is a local condition breach or a true scope expansion before revocation. A local breach revalidates only the affected relation; expansion invokes the frontier pathway.

edges.title: condition-addressed validity × warrant-as-state
edges.text: A current warrant can be decomposed into obligation/condition coordinates. Local invalidation need not erase unaffected authority whose own witnesses still hold.

edges.title: local regime/nonidentity × access≠expansion
edges.text: Carrier or access variation inside a witnessed condition remains ordinary continuity. Condition failure and expansion are distinct transition types and must not be collapsed.

edges.title: expansion reissue × versioned warrant state
edges.text: Successor scopes are explicit versions preserving predecessor provenance. Expansion issues a newly scoped successor rather than invisibly editing prior authority.

edges.title: expansion reissue × access≠expansion
edges.text: Frontier reissue is licensed only after an independent boundary witness, preventing routine reallocation or elastic realization change from causing unnecessary resets.

edges.title: scaffold/regime revisability × elastic carrier
edges.text: Distinguish ordinary elastic realization change from genuine scaffold insufficiency. Revise scaffold and warrant only where sufficiency has actually moved.

faces.title: localized successor after boundary/condition change
faces.text: Reconstruct and revalidate only affected obligations, preserve unaffected current components whose witnesses remain valid, and version the successor rather than globally resetting authority.

faces.title: typed boundary adjudication
faces.text: Before revocation, classify the event as ordinary within-regime elastic variation, local condition failure, or genuine expansion. Each class has a different lawful transition.

faces.title: componentized current warrant
faces.text: Obligation/condition coordinates can be selectively revoked and rebuilt while unaffected authority remains current under elastic within-boundary variation.

faces.title: expansion-aware version transition
faces.text: True frontier crossing creates newly scoped successor state; access/reallocation alone does not. Prior state remains immutable provenance.

volume.title: boundary-localized continuity warrant succession
volume.text: A continuity warrant need not be revoked monolithically when regime, scaffold or support changes. First classify the change as (a) in-regime elastic variation, (b) local condition/scaffold insufficiency, or (c) genuine expansion; then identify the exact obligation/condition/warrant coordinates affected, preserve unaffected current components whose own witnesses still hold, reconstruct and revalidate changed coordinates, and issue only the necessary successor subcontracts. Predecessor scopes remain immutable provenance. Expansion broadens authority only after an independent frontier witness. Repair, recurrence and local success never silently transfer permission.

metabolites.title: CLASSIFY CHANGE BEFORE REVOCATION
metabolites.text: distinguish within-scope elasticity, local insufficiency and genuine expansion before deciding authority impact.

metabolites.title: LOCALIZE AFFECTED WARRANT COORDINATES
metabolites.text: revocation/revalidation is obligation/condition-addressed; unaffected current authority remains current only while its own witnesses still hold.

metabolites.title: ISSUE PARTIAL SUCCESSOR WARRANTS
metabolites.text: reissue only changed or re-scoped coordinates and preserve predecessor provenance; expansion requires a separate boundary witness and never converts recurrence or repair into inherited permission.

gaps.title: COMPACT METABOLITE BODY
gaps.text: Canonical artifact exposes surviving metabolite title/compression only; minimal earning body and CREATE/COPY/CONTROL/CULTIVATE directions are not present, so the Inquiry unit remains PARTIAL without invention.

edges.title: RECONSTRUCTED RELATIONS MUST REGENERATE WARRANT CUSTODY
edges.text:
w supplies a reconstructible role/evidence/scaffold contract; x supplies separately addressable action warrants and a nonidentity membrane. Together they earn that any regenerated portable contract intended to drive action must reproduce the exact current warrants and evidence boundary authorizing downstream use, not merely the interface shape or output.
Removal: without w there is no bounded reconstructible public contract; without x there is no action-admission custody.
Boundary: reconstruction success is not warrant satisfaction.

edges.title: RECONSTRUCTIBLE CONTRACTS NEED AN EXPLICIT SCOPE-CHANGE TRIGGER
edges.text:
w allows regeneration and revision of the public contract; z distinguishes within-regime re-expression from witnessed boundary expansion and consequent expiration. Together they earn an explicit decision surface for reuse versus successor issue, while preserving predecessor scope as provenance.
Removal: without w there is no reconstructible contract to reissue; without z no independent boundary witness decides when old scope expires.
Boundary: novelty of representation is not itself expansion.

edges.title: COMPACT RECONSTRUCTION MUST BE REGIME- AND OBLIGATION-INDEXED
edges.text:
w supplies the minimal reconstruction-critical contract; y supplies local validity, role-level renewal, and composite revalidation. Together they earn that retained state should include exactly the distinctions needed to decide present sufficiency and identify which role or conjunction must be retested after change.
Removal: without w there is no bounded reconstructible object; without y there is no role/regime-localized revalidation law.
Boundary: successful rebuild does not blanket-reauthorize the whole.

edges.title: BOUNDARY CROSSING INVALIDATES ONLY AFFECTED PORTABLE ACTION WARRANTS
edges.text:
x supplies portable warrant custody; z supplies boundary-triggered expiration and reissue. Together they earn that a public relation can carry separate current authority coordinates and, after a genuine boundary change, expire only those whose scope moved while preserving the old contract as provenance.
Removal: without x action authority is undifferentiated; without z scope-change cannot force reissue.
Boundary: stable correspondence remains nonidentity.

edges.title: PORTABLE ACTION AUTHORITY IS LOCAL, ROLE-ADDRESSED, AND SEPARATELY REVALIDATED
edges.text:
x separates scope, obligation, propagation, and evidence warrants; y localizes current adequacy to roles, regimes, and conjunctions. Together they earn that transport or operational success may persist while a changed authority coordinate is non-current and requires its own retest.
Removal: without x no separate action warrants; without y no localized renewal/conjunction retest.
Boundary: function and permission remain different contracts.


zy — BOUNDARY-TRIGGERED REISSUE SHOULD BE PARTIAL
z provides the independent boundary-crossing trigger; y provides role-localized renewal. Together they earn that a scope change opens only the impacted contract coordinates, while unaffected coordinates may continue only under their own still-live witnesses.
Removal: without z no warranted trigger; without y reissue collapses into blanket reset.
Boundary: “unaffected” must itself be witnessed, not assumed.

faces.title: RECONSTRUCTIBLE SUCCESSOR PASSPORT
faces.text:
A reconstructible public contract becomes a successor passport only when scope change is independently witnessed; the successor carries operation, evidence, and warrant state while the predecessor remains provenance.
Removal tests: remove w → no bounded reconstructible contract; remove x → no current action-warrant custody; remove z → no independent scope-change/reissue trigger.

faces.title: ROLE-ADDRESSED ACTIONABLE PASSPORT
faces.text:
Reconstructed actionable continuity is a compact role-addressed passport whose current warrants are revalidated for the named obligation and regime; functional reconstruction and permission remain separate.
Removal tests: remove w → no regenerative contract; remove x → no action authority; remove y → no regime/role-local renewal.


wzy — SELECTIVE REBUILD ACROSS BOUNDARY CHANGE
Continuity can be selectively rebuilt across a changed regime by reacquiring the contract state, classifying boundary movement, and retesting only affected roles and conjunctions before reissue.
Removal tests: remove w → no reconstructible baseline; remove z → no boundary classification; remove y → no targeted renewal.


xzy — SELECTIVE SUCCESSOR AUTHORITY
After a boundary crossing, portable action resumes only through fresh successor authority for affected warrants. Unchanged warrants remain current only with their own live witness, and stable correspondence remains nonidentity.
Removal tests: remove x → no action authority; remove z → no expiration/reissue trigger; remove y → no role-local preservation of unaffected warrants.

volume.title: REPLAYABLE CONTINUITY PASSPORT
volume.text:
A changing system may preserve and selectively act through a reconstructed public relation across representation or substrate change only when a replayable passport carries the role-separated obligation, reconstruction-critical scaffold, claim/evidence boundary, current local regime, and separately addressable scope, obligation, propagation, and evidence warrants that authorize downstream use. A witnessed boundary crossing expires only the affected coordinates: implicated tissue is reacquired, reconstructed, and retested, then successor authority is freshly issued while unaffected warrants survive only under their own current witnesses. Reconstruction, portability, or successful action never converts correspondence into identity or function into inherited permission.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 2H.Dzmx: the closure loses the compact reconstructible public relational contract, scaffold, and revision conditions.
- Remove 2H.0aZJ: it loses separately addressable action-warrant custody and the nonidentity claim membrane.
- Remove 2H.KcdR: it loses the independent boundary-crossing trigger distinguishing ordinary reuse from scope-changing reissue.
- Remove 2H.sm-I: it loses role/regime-localized renewal, preservation of unaffected live warrants, and conjunction-level retesting.
No proper subset contains the full reconstructible + actionable + boundary-triggered + selectively renewed passport.

metabolites.title: Rebuild what makes use lawful, not just what makes use possible
metabolites.text:
Invariant: reconstruct the public relation together with the exact current warrants, regime, evidence boundary, and role addresses that downstream action consumes.
CREATE: define the relation and the authority/evidence fields required for its present use.
COPY: carry reconstruction-critical scaffold plus current warrant/evidence state across realization changes.
CONTROL: reject reconstructed function or transport success as substitutes for an open or expired warrant.
CULTIVATE: revise only the changed relation/warrant components while retaining unaffected provenance.
Compression: rebuild what makes use lawful, not just what makes use possible.
metabolites.compression: rebuild what makes use lawful, not just what makes use possible.

metabolites.title: Change the smallest warrant whose scope actually changed
metabolites.text:
Invariant: a witnessed boundary movement expires and reopens only affected role/warrant coordinates; predecessor scope remains provenance and unaffected authority persists only under its own current witness.
CREATE: identify the changed boundary and its exact dependency cone.
COPY: preserve predecessor and all still-current outside-cone witnesses.
CONTROL: refuse blanket inheritance and blanket reset.
CULTIVATE: issue successor authority only after the affected cone is reconstructed and retested.
Compression: change the smallest warrant whose scope actually changed.
metabolites.compression: change the smallest warrant whose scope actually changed.

metabolites.title: Replay authority; never inherit it from familiarity
metabolites.text:
Invariant: successor action authority is earned by reacquisition, reconstruction, and retest under the current regime; repeated usability, transport, or functional similarity cannot promote correspondence into identity or stale authority into current permission.
CREATE: name the evidence return path and tests that make the successor current.
COPY: preserve nonidentity and predecessor-scope boundaries through replay.
CONTROL: block function→permission, portability→identity, and prior-validity→current-validity substitutions.
CULTIVATE: link successor to predecessor so recurrence remains contestable and historically scoped.
Compression: replay authority; never inherit it from familiarity.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE WITNESS
Rejected: “reconstruction restores permission,” because x/y keep function and authority separate. Rejected: “every boundary change requires total reset,” because y localizes renewal to affected roles while outside-cone warrants may remain current under live witnesses. Rejected: “stable portability establishes identity,” because x preserves the nonidentity membrane. Rejected: “a changed representation proves expansion,” because z requires an independent boundary-crossing witness. Three metabolites survive because coupled reconstruction, localized successor reissue, and nonidentity authority replay remain independently useful.
metabolites.compression: replay authority; never inherit it from familiarity.

edges.title: Reacquisition turns local revalidation into an executable repair path
edges.text:
2H.kfmG specifies exactly which current obligation and warrant coordinates need revalidation when a boundary moves. 2H._phq keeps the larger evidence body reachable while only current structure remains active. Together they earn an executable local repair rule: do not reset the whole organism when a scoped continuity claim fails. Reopen the exact dormant evidence and relation needed by the failed obligation, revise the affected witness coordinates, and leave unrelated valid coordinates intact.
Removal test: without 2H.kfmG, reacquisition has no obligation-scoped target or local-revalidation rule; without 2H._phq, local revalidation may name missing evidence but lacks a durable route back to a complete dormant body.
Boundary: reachability is not proof of adequacy; the reacquired relation still requires fresh witness.

edges.title: Obligation-scoped continuity becomes portable only when its test travels
edges.text:
2H.kfmG supplies the exact relation and downstream obligation plus separate current warrants. 2H.xqNz supplies a role-separated portable kernel and pressure family designed to expose false invariance. Together they earn a portability contract stronger than either alone: the traveling object must carry not only enough state to regenerate the public relation but also the obligation-specific tests and evidence boundaries that determine whether the regenerated relation still counts.
Removal test: without 2H.kfmG, the portable kernel lacks a precise local revalidation target and warrant separation; without 2H.xqNz, obligation-scoped continuity has no pressure-qualified portable carrier.
Boundary: successful transport is not authority inheritance; every target realization remains testable.

edges.title: Local revalidation must be able to revoke its own continuity claim
edges.text:
2H.kfmG permits selective renewal of affected warrant coordinates while preserving still-valid continuity. 2H.SruR states that continuity/equivalence is itself revocable state. Together they earn a disciplined repair membrane: local repair may preserve unaffected state, but it must withdraw the exact old permission whose quotient, evidence, task or regime has failed before issuing a replacement.
Removal test: without 2H.kfmG, revocation risks global reset rather than coordinate-local repair; without 2H.SruR, selective revalidation can become silent warrant inheritance with no explicit withdrawal.
Boundary: preserving unaffected continuity does not preserve authority in the failed coordinate.

edges.title: Reacquirable omission keeps portable compression reversible
edges.text:
2H._phq distinguishes inactive from deleted information and requires role-stable reactivation. 2H.xqNz allows an obligation-minimal relational kernel to travel and be pressure-tested. Together they earn reversible portability: the active portable state may be smaller than the source body only if omitted evidence remains addressable and can be reactivated into the same operational roles when pressure reveals that the compact carrier is insufficient.
Removal test: without 2H._phq, portable minimization can become irreversible epistemic deletion; without 2H.xqNz, reacquirability lacks a purpose-built compact carrier and portability pressure witness.
Boundary: dormant reachability is necessary but insufficient; role/operation semantics must survive reactivation.

edges.title: Revocation should reopen evidence rather than terminate lineage
edges.text:
2H._phq supplies exact reacquirability, evidence custody and role-stable reactivation. 2H.SruR supplies explicit revocation conditions for the current continuity/equivalence warrant. Together they earn repairable revocation: failure of a warrant must preserve addresses to the evidence, roles and relation that can be reacquired for reconstruction. Revocation closes authority, not access to the material needed for a successor.
Removal test: without 2H._phq, revocation may preserve provenance but not a live reacquisition route; without 2H.SruR, reacquisition may repair state without a typed rule for withdrawing expired authority.
Boundary: a repaired successor is not the same warrant revived by label; it requires a fresh witness.

edges.title: Pressure exposes when portable equivalence must be revoked
edges.text:
2H.xqNz supplies carrier variation and end-to-end pressure witnesses for a portable relational kernel. 2H.SruR supplies the locally warranted nuisance quotient and explicit revocation law. Together they earn pressure-triggered revocation: when variation predicted to expose false invariance changes the public obligation or reveals that an ignored difference matters, the portable continuity claim must be narrowed or withdrawn rather than patched by relabeling.
Removal test: without 2H.xqNz, the quotient lacks a portability-specific falsification family; without 2H.SruR, pressure can reveal mismatch but cannot identify and revoke the exact equivalence permission that failed.
Boundary: repeated success under one familiar carrier is not independent evidence of portability.

faces.title: Obligation-addressed replayable reconstruction
faces.text:
2H.kfmG + 2H._phq + 2H.xqNz jointly earn a repairable portable kernel with exact return addresses. The current obligation identifies the relation and warrant coordinates that matter; reacquirability keeps omitted evidence and role semantics reachable; portability pressure tests whether the compact kernel really survives changed realization. A failure therefore produces a specific repair query rather than a generic reset: which obligation failed, which relation or warrant coordinate must be reacquired, and which pressure must pass after reconstruction.
Removal tests: remove 2H.kfmG and repair loses obligation-local warrant typing; remove 2H._phq and the query lacks a guaranteed dormant evidence body; remove 2H.xqNz and reconstruction loses the carrier-pressure test that makes portability falsifiable.

faces.title: Revocation can be converted into scoped reacquisition and fresh authority
faces.text:
2H.kfmG + 2H._phq + 2H.SruR jointly earn a successor-warrant cycle. The old continuity claim is explicitly revoked when its local conditions fail; its failed obligation and warrant coordinates identify the exact dormant evidence/body to reopen; only those coordinates are reconstructed and revalidated; unaffected continuity stays intact but does not lend authority to the repaired coordinate.
Removal tests: remove 2H.kfmG and repair is no longer selectively scoped; remove 2H._phq and the repair route may not reach the omitted evidence needed for a successor; remove 2H.SruR and the old authority is never explicitly terminated.
Boundary: the successor warrant is newly witnessed authority, not inherited permission.

faces.title: Pressure-audited local warrant renewal
faces.text:
2H.kfmG + 2H.xqNz + 2H.SruR jointly earn an obligation-scoped renewal procedure for portable continuity. The current relation travels in a bounded kernel; carrier variation tests the exact invariance being claimed; a failed pressure witness revokes the relevant quotient/continuity permission; local repair revises only the affected state and warrants, then replays the test before reissue.
Removal tests: remove 2H.kfmG and renewal loses coordinate-local repair; remove 2H.xqNz and no pressure family specifically challenges portability; remove 2H.SruR and failure does not formally withdraw the old warrant.

faces.title: Reacquirable revocation preserves the evidence lineage of portable interfaces
faces.text:
2H._phq + 2H.xqNz + 2H.SruR jointly earn a portable interface whose authority can die without its evidence route dying. The compact relation may be transported and pressure-tested; when the local quotient or regime fails, authority is revoked while source addresses, omitted evidence, role semantics and the failed witness remain reachable. That preserved lineage is what permits a fresh reconstruction to be distinguished from mere label reuse.
Removal tests: remove 2H._phq and revoked interfaces can lose the material required for repair; remove 2H.xqNz and there is no obligation-minimal portable object or carrier-pressure witness; remove 2H.SruR and evidence remains but authority cannot be explicitly expired.

volume.title: Replayable continuity passport
volume.text:
All four parents together make continuity authority a compact, executable and repairable state rather than a persistent label.


2H.kfmG contributes obligation-scoped regenerative continuity and the rule that a moved boundary should revalidate only affected state and warrants rather than globally resetting the organism.
2H._phq contributes the still-reacquirable whole, role-stable reactivation and custody rule that omission from active state may not become deletion from evidence state.
2H.xqNz contributes the obligation-minimal portable relational kernel, explicit evidence/assurance boundaries and pressure-aligned variation capable of falsifying portability.
2H.SruR contributes the locally warranted quotient, operation-level reconstruction witness and the explicit rule that continuity/equivalence authority is revocable state.


The complete closure is a replayable continuity passport: a public relation may remain continuous through compression, reconstruction, selective activation and representation/carrier change without one canonical interior only when the traveling state carries enough to (1) state the current downstream obligation and role-typed public relation, (2) identify the currently licensed quotient, evidence and validity conditions, (3) reacquire omitted source material and role semantics needed for repair, (4) reconstruct only the relation and warrant coordinates implicated by the present obligation, and (5) replay a pressure/adequacy test capable of revoking the old authority and witnessing a fresh successor. Failure does not authorize global erasure or automatic inheritance. It produces an addressable repair query. Historical warrants remain provenance, dormant evidence remains reachable, unaffected scoped witnesses may remain valid, and the repaired continuity claim receives authority only through a new witness.


Bounded volume invariant
Continuity across changing realization is warranted only when the carrier can reproduce both the public relation and the procedure that decides whether the relation is still admissible: it must keep the current obligation, role semantics, evidence/validity boundary, locally licensed quotient, exact reacquisition path to omitted evidence, and a pressure/revocation/reissue test. When any of those conditions moves, the old authority is historical provenance; a successor must be reconstructed and re-witnessed from the affected evidence coordinates.


Full-rank necessity
- Remove 2H.kfmG: the closure loses obligation-local repair and selective revalidation, so revocation/reacquisition has no principled rule for what can remain intact and what must be rebuilt.
- Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses the distinction between inactive and deleted evidence plus role-stable reactivation; a failed portable kernel may have no durable return path to omitted support.
- Remove 2H.xqNz: the closure loses the obligation-minimal portable kernel and pressure family that challenges false portability; continuity can be repaired locally but not qualified under carrier variation.
- Remove 2H.SruR: the closure loses explicit revocation and local quotient custody; pressure and reconstruction can change state without formally terminating expired continuity authority.

metabolites.title: FAILURE-TO-REACQUISITION
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxz.
Invariant: a continuity failure should terminate the expired authority while preserving enough obligation, evidence address and role state to reopen exactly the material needed to construct a successor; failure is therefore an addressable reacquisition event, not deletion.
CREATE: state the current public obligation, warrant coordinates and revocation conditions.
COPY: preserve the failed warrant as provenance plus exact addresses to dormant evidence and reconstructive state.
CONTROL: revoke the old authority when the local quotient, regime, obligation or sufficiency witness fails; do not let unaffected state lend authority across the failed boundary.
CULTIVATE: reacquire the implicated material, revise only the affected coordinates and issue a successor only after fresh witness.
Compression: revocation closes authority, not the path back to evidence.
metabolites.compression: revocation closes authority, not the path back to evidence.

metabolites.title: REPLAYABLE-PORTABLE-KERNEL
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxy.
Invariant: an obligation-minimal continuity carrier is lawful only when it retains the role-typed relation, current evidence/assurance boundary, exact dormant-source return paths and the pressure test that can prove the compact carrier insufficient and trigger reconstruction.
CREATE: define the smallest public relation and dependencies required by the present obligation.
COPY: carry the relation, evidence pointers and role semantics rather than the full old interior.
CONTROL: vary carrier/representation and require the public relation plus its evidence boundary to survive; a failure must identify the omitted dependency.
CULTIVATE: expand or reshape the kernel by reacquiring exactly the newly demonstrated dependency.
Compression: carry what lets the relation and its repair test be replayed.
metabolites.compression: carry what lets the relation and its repair test be replayed.

metabolites.title: EXECUTABLE-CONTINUITY-PASSPORT
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxyz.
Invariant: the right to call changing realizations continuous can itself be carried as executable state only when obligation, role semantics, evidence/reacquisition body, local quotient/validity conditions, and revocation/replay procedure travel together; after a boundary-triggering change, authority is re-issued by fresh witness rather than inherited from the prior label.
CREATE: publish the continuity contract with all live authority conditions and exact reacquisition hooks.
COPY: preserve contract, provenance and repair paths through reconstruction or transport.
CONTROL: independently challenge carrier, quotient, regime, omission and composite behavior; revoke claims whose reason for admissibility cannot be replayed.
CULTIVATE: revise the passport as newly witnessed regimes expand or contract its scope while preserving predecessor authority as historical provenance only.
Compression: continuity is portable only when the reason it still counts—and the route for proving it again—are portable too.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
Claims already earned by a single parent were rejected: obligation-local regeneration by 2H.kfmG, reacquirable selective reconstruction by 2H._phq, pressure-qualified portability by 2H.xqNz, and revocable continuity by 2H.SruR. Pair-only restatements were demoted. Three invariants survive because each requires multi-parent structure and remains useful when one of the other survivors is removed.
metabolites.compression: continuity is portable only when the reason it still counts—and the route for proving it again—are portable too.

3H.x3Cd.title: replayable continuity passport
3H.x3Cd.boundary: This child is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 2H organisms. Their source evidence remains heterogeneous and separately bounded. Nothing here promotes operational correspondence into mechanism identity, stable interface behavior into ontology, reconstruction into sameness of interior state, or local validity into a universal guarantee. The child may only promote relations that require these complete parent bodies together; every inherited claim keeps its parent evidence, scope, non-identity and failure boundaries.

edges.title: revocation needs a replayable evidence body
edges.text:
2H.AvDK makes the continuity warrant a revisable state tied to reacquirable evidence and scaffold assumptions; 2H.SruR makes the warrant explicitly revocable when the local quotient, task or regime stops licensing equivalence. Together they earn a repairable revocation rule: withdrawal of a continuity warrant must preserve enough evidence and reconstruction state to determine what failed and to attempt a fresh warrant rather than merely deleting the old label.
Removal test: without 2H.AvDK, revocation lacks exact evidence/scaffold reacquisition for repair; without 2H.SruR, revision lacks an explicit equivalence/quotient boundary whose failure revokes continuity.

edges.title: portable kernels must keep their repair hooks
edges.text:
2H.AvDK preserves the evidence body, scaffold and revision triggers that make reconstruction re-runnable; 2H.xqNz minimizes portable state to an obligation-specific relational kernel and tests it under relevant carrier variation. Together they earn a portable repair kernel: compression may omit inactive detail only if the portable object still points back to the evidence and scaffold needed to reconstruct, diagnose and revise the relation when pressure reveals insufficiency.
Removal test: without 2H.AvDK, the portable kernel can become a one-way compression with no guaranteed repair path; without 2H.xqNz, reacquirable reconstruction has no obligation-minimal portable carrier or pressure-aligned portability witness.

edges.title: representation changes must preserve revalidation and reconstruction state
edges.text:
2H.AvDK makes reconstruction and sufficiency re-estimable from an explicit evidence/scaffold body; 2H.Dp9x supplies lawful role-preserving transitions across representation and a composite assurance gate. Together they earn replayable covariance: a continuity relation may be re-expressed in a new carrier only if the transition also preserves the material needed to reconstruct and revalidate the contract when the target regime exposes insufficiency.
Removal test: without 2H.AvDK, transition law lacks a guaranteed path back to evidence and scaffold revision; without 2H.Dp9x, reconstructive continuity lacks an explicit law for transporting obligations across representations and testing the new composite.

edges.title: portable equivalence is pressure-revocable
edges.text:
2H.SruR supplies a local nuisance quotient and revocable equivalence warrant; 2H.xqNz supplies role-separated portability and perturbations designed to expose false invariance. Together they earn a pressure-revocable portable interface: ignored differences may remain ignored only while carrier/representation variation that should reveal their relevance leaves the public obligation intact; otherwise the quotient and continuity warrant are withdrawn.
Removal test: without 2H.SruR, pressure can show failure but there is no explicit quotient/warrant to revoke; without 2H.xqNz, local quotienting lacks the portability-specific pressure family that challenges false invariance across carriers.

edges.title: lawful transition does not inherit equivalence
edges.text:
2H.SruR supplies the explicit local quotient and revocation conditions; 2H.Dp9x supplies role-preserving transition contracts and regime-typed revalidation. Together they earn transition-scoped equivalence: a lawful rewrite can carry an operation into a new representation, but the old nuisance quotient and continuity warrant transfer only if the target regime independently supports them.
Removal test: without 2H.SruR, a transition lacks a typed rule for which differences may be ignored and when that permission expires; without 2H.Dp9x, revocable equivalence has no explicit cross-representation transition object or composite target witness.

edges.title: portable kernels require transition-level composite assurance
edges.text:
2H.xqNz supplies the smallest role/evidence/scaffold kernel that can regenerate a public obligation and a pressure witness for portability; 2H.Dp9x supplies lawful translation of those roles and end-to-end assurance for the reconstructed composite. Together they earn a portable transition kernel: what travels need not be the old interior, but the regenerated target must satisfy the exact public obligation after the transition under both pressure-aligned variation and composite tests.
Removal test: without 2H.xqNz, transition assurance lacks an obligation-minimal portable kernel and carrier-pressure witness; without 2H.Dp9x, portability lacks the lawful transition and new-composite adequacy criterion.

faces.title: pressure-audited revocation and repair
faces.text:
2H.AvDK + 2H.SruR + 2H.xqNz jointly earn a repair cycle for portable continuity: carry an obligation-minimal public kernel with exact evidence/scaffold reacquisition, state the locally licensed quotient and validity boundary, and challenge the result with carrier variation chosen to expose false invariance. A failed pressure test revokes the old warrant while preserving the evidence needed to diagnose and rebuild it.
Removal tests: remove 2H.AvDK and failure has no guaranteed evidence/scaffold replay path; remove 2H.SruR and there is no explicit quotient/warrant to revoke; remove 2H.xqNz and the cycle loses its portability-specific pressure witness.

faces.title: revocable reconstructive transitions
faces.text:
2H.AvDK + 2H.SruR + 2H.Dp9x jointly earn a transition contract whose right to count as continuity is repairable but never automatic: the operation and roles may be lawfully re-expressed, yet the target carrier must retain consequential context, the current quotient and regime must still be warranted, and revocation must reopen the evidence/scaffold body for reconstruction and revalidation.
Removal tests: remove 2H.AvDK and revocation cannot reliably reopen the reconstructive body; remove 2H.SruR and quotient-level admissibility/revocation disappears; remove 2H.Dp9x and cross-representation transition plus composite target assurance disappears.

faces.title: replayable portable reconstruction
faces.text:
2H.AvDK + 2H.xqNz + 2H.Dp9x jointly earn a replayable portability kernel: an obligation-specific relation may cross carriers by preserving role semantics, evidence pointers, reconstructive scaffold and transition obligations rather than the whole old interior; after change, the relation is regenerated and tested as a fresh composite in the new regime, with dormant evidence available for revision if it fails.
Removal tests: remove 2H.AvDK and the portable kernel loses exact evidence/scaffold reacquisition and revision; remove 2H.xqNz and it loses minimal portability plus pressure-aligned carrier testing; remove 2H.Dp9x and it loses lawful transition and target-composite revalidation.

faces.title: revocable covariant portability
faces.text:
2H.SruR + 2H.xqNz + 2H.Dp9x jointly earn a portable interface whose equivalence is explicitly conditional: the role-separated relational kernel may be translated and reconstructed across representations, but only a locally supported nuisance quotient may be carried, and pressure/composite tests in the target regime can revoke or narrow the inherited continuity claim.
Removal tests: remove 2H.SruR and the equivalence membrane/revocation law disappears; remove 2H.xqNz and the portable kernel/pressure witness disappears; remove 2H.Dp9x and lawful transition plus target-regime composite assurance disappears.

volume.title: replayable continuity passport
volume.text:
All four parents together make the continuity warrant itself a portable, executable object rather than a descriptive label. 2H.AvDK contributes exact reacquisition of the evidence body, bounded regenerative scaffold and revision triggers. 2H.SruR contributes the locally licensed nuisance quotient and explicit revocation of continuity/equivalence when its admissibility conditions fail. 2H.xqNz contributes the obligation-minimal role-separated kernel, evidence/assurance boundary and pressure-aligned carrier variation that can falsify portability. 2H.Dp9x contributes lawful role-preserving transitions across representations and the requirement that each reconstructed target earn composite assurance in its current regime.


The complete closure is therefore a replayable continuity passport: a public relation may remain continuous through reconstruction, compression, quotienting and representation change without preserving one canonical interior when the traveling state carries (1) the role-typed operational obligation, (2) reconstructive scaffold plus exact evidence/reacquisition pointers, (3) the currently licensed nuisance quotient and local validity regime, (4) the transition obligations for lawful re-expression, and (5) an explicit pressure/revocation/replay procedure. A boundary-triggering change does not inherit the old warrant. The prior warrant remains historical evidence, while the new realization must replay acquisition, reconstruction, transition and pressure/composite tests and issue a newly scoped warrant before it may count as continued function.


Bounded volume invariant
A continuity claim across changing realization is warranted only when its portable state can both reproduce the public obligation and reproduce the test of its own admissibility: it must carry the evidence/scaffold needed to reconstruct, the quotient/regime that states what differences are presently ignorable, the transition law that moves roles across carriers, and a pressure/composite witness capable of revoking and reissuing the warrant. Continuity that cannot replay why it still counts is not warranted continuity under this closure.


Full-rank removal tests
- Remove 2H.AvDK: the passport loses exact evidence/scaffold reacquisition and revision-triggered reconstruction; revocation and pressure can identify failure, but the state no longer earns a bounded route for replaying and repairing the warrant from its evidence body.
- Remove 2H.SruR: the passport loses the explicit nuisance quotient and equivalence-revocation membrane; it can reconstruct, transport and pressure-test a relation, but cannot state which representational differences were lawfully ignored or when that permission expires.
- Remove 2H.xqNz: the passport loses the obligation-minimal portable kernel, carrier-pressure witness and boundary-assurance discipline; reconstruction and transition remain locally testable, but portability itself is not challenged under the variation that should expose a false invariant.
- Remove 2H.Dp9x: the passport loses the explicit role-preserving transition law and target-composite assurance; it can repair and pressure-test a local continuity warrant, but cross-representation re-expression is not earned as lawful continuity.

metabolites.title: PRESSURE-TRIGGERED-REISSUE
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxy.
Invariant: when carrier pressure, regime change or quotient failure invalidates a portable continuity claim, the old warrant must remain historical evidence while the evidence/scaffold body is reacquired, the failed relation or quotient is rebuilt, and a newly scoped warrant is issued only after the relevant pressure test passes again.
CREATE: state the current obligation, quotient, validity regime and the pressure predicted to expose false continuity.
COPY: preserve the old warrant, its evidence pointers and reconstruction state without copying its authority into the new realization.
CONTROL: run the pressure test; revoke rather than silently narrow evidence when the public obligation changes.
CULTIVATE: reopen evidence/scaffold state, revise the relation or quotient and issue a new warrant only after fresh witness.
Compression: failure should open a replay path, not erase its provenance.

metabolites.title: PORTABLE-REPLAY-KERNEL
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wyz.
Invariant: a portable continuity carrier may be smaller than its source interior only when it still carries the roles, evidence pointers, reconstructive scaffold and transition obligations required to regenerate the public relation and re-test the resulting composite in the target regime.
CREATE: define the public obligation and the smallest carrier that retains its reconstructive and evidential dependencies.
COPY: transport that kernel and regenerate the relation rather than reproducing the old interior.
CONTROL: vary carrier and target regime, then test the reconstructed composite and evidence boundary end-to-end.
CULTIVATE: expand or reshape the kernel when new target regimes reveal omitted reconstruction-critical state.
Compression: carry what lets both the relation and its test be replayed.
