metabolites.title: EXECUTABLE-CONTINUITY-PASSPORT
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxyz.
Invariant: the right to call changing realizations continuous can itself be carried as executable state only when obligation, evidence/reacquisition body, quotient/regime, transition law and revocation/replay test travel together; after a boundary-triggering change, authority is re-issued by fresh composite evidence rather than inherited from the prior label.
CREATE: publish the continuity contract with its five live components and explicit revocation conditions.
COPY: carry the contract, evidence pointers and tests through each reconstruction or representation transition.
CONTROL: independently challenge quotient, carrier, regime and composite behavior; block continuity claims whose warrant cannot survive or be lawfully re-issued.
CULTIVATE: revise the passport as newly witnessed regimes expand or contract the admissible continuity surface, preserving historical warrants as scoped provenance.
Compression: continuity is portable only when the reason it still counts is portable too.


Collapse result
Parent-only claims were rejected. “Reconstruction must be revalidated” is already carried by 2H.AvDK and 2H.Dp9x; “equivalence is revocable” by 2H.SruR; “portable interfaces need pressure witnesses” by 2H.xqNz. Three cross-holon metabolites survive because pressure-triggered reissue, portable replay kernels and the full executable passport require distinct multi-parent bodies and remain independently useful after the others are removed.
metabolites.compression: continuity is portable only when the reason it still counts is portable too.

edges.title: REGIME-TYPED PORTABLE RECONSTRUCTION
edges.text:
A portable relational kernel becomes lawful reconstruction only when the witnessed regime in which its roles and operations were sufficient travels with it. Representation transfer alone is not a continuation warrant.
Boundary: no universal portability across untested regimes.

edges.title: REVOCABLE PORTABILITY
edges.text:
A portable interface must carry explicit revocation conditions and a return path to revalidation in addition to its evidence boundary. Stable operation does not grant permanence.
Boundary: revocation removes current warrant; it does not erase historical evidence.

edges.title: OBLIGATION-MINIMAL CARRIER, SEPARATE WARRANTS
edges.text:
State may be compressed to what reconstructs the current public obligation, but warrant metadata cannot collapse into generic successful function. Identity, transport, assurance, propagation, and evidence remain independently addressable.
Boundary: smaller carrier does not license weaker governance.

edges.title: REGIME-LOCAL WARRANT SUCCESSION
edges.text:
A regime transition invalidates only contract components whose current validity witness no longer matches; the predecessor warrant becomes provenance and cannot be silently inherited by the reconstructed relation.
Boundary: selective invalidation requires a witnessed dependency partition; otherwise revalidation must widen.

edges.title: SELECTIVE REVALIDATION BY DEPENDENCY
edges.text:
When roles and operations are mapped to regime variables and warrant coordinates, reconstruction and composite tests may be replayed only for obligation components dependent on changed coordinates, while independently still-witnessed components remain live.
Boundary: the dependency partition itself must be current.

edges.title: COORDINATE-WISE REVOCATION
edges.text:
Continuity authority can be represented as separately expiring warrant coordinates. Change revokes the dependent coordinates; unaffected coordinates remain live only under their own witnesses. Regenerated function never restores an expired permission by itself.
Boundary: one surviving warrant cannot certify another.

faces.title: REVOCABLE REGIME-TYPED PORTABILITY PASSPORT
faces.text:
A portable relation must carry its public kernel, obligation/role operations, evidence boundary, witnessed local regime, and explicit revocation/replay conditions. Portability is current only while regime and pressure/composite tests remain valid; boundary change converts the old passport to provenance requiring retest.
Necessity: without w no portable public kernel; without x no regime-typed reconstruction contract; without y no revocation/reissue semantics.

faces.title: OBLIGATION-MINIMAL PORTABLE KERNEL WITH SEPARABLE WARRANTS
faces.text:
A compact kernel may rebuild the current obligation under the current regime while carrying a dependency map from each obligation role to the warrant coordinates that license it. Only affected nodes may be retested after change, but composite sufficiency remains required.
Necessity: without w no minimal portable carrier; without x no typed role/regime contract; without z no obligation-indexed warrant separation or local revalidation.

faces.title: WARRANT-PRESERVING LOCAL REGENERATION
faces.text:
After local failure, only the implicated portable kernel/evidence tissue is reacquired and reconstructed; still-current independent warrants remain live, while fresh successors are issued only for revoked coordinates. Stable relation is not restored authority.
Necessity: without w no reacquirable public kernel; without y no revocation boundary; without z no separated warrant vector or local-reset discipline.

faces.title: DEPENDENCY-INDEXED SELECTIVE REVALIDATION
faces.text:
Current continuation law can be represented as a dependency graph from downstream obligations to role, quotient, regime, identity, transport, assurance, propagation, and evidence coordinates. A regime or boundary change invalidates its exact dependency cone; only that cone is revalidated/reissued.
Necessity: without x the graph lacks regime/role typing; without y invalidation is not revocable authority; without z there is no obligation-scoped selective warrant vector.

volume.title: REPLAYABLE CONTINUITY PASSPORT
volume.text:
A changing system may renew continuity selectively without global replay when its portable relational kernel carries a live dependency index linking each downstream obligation/role to the exact regime, quotient, transport, assurance, propagation, and evidence witnesses that license it. When a boundary or regime changes, the failed witness invalidates only its dependency cone; the implicated kernel is reacquired/reconstructed and its pressure/composite tests replayed, then only expired authority coordinates receive fresh successors. Still-current components may remain current only under their own witnesses; predecessor warrant remains immutable provenance. Functional regeneration never automatically restores expired authority.


ALL-FOUR NECESSITY
Remove w: no portable/reacquirable public kernel or pressure-tested carrier.
Remove x: no role-separated regime contract telling which reconstruction is currently sufficient.
Remove y: no revocable current-authority state or predecessor→successor semantics.
Remove z: no obligation-scoped warrant vector or selective local revalidation; the repair collapses toward undifferentiated replay.
Therefore the bounded volume requires all four parents.


COLLAPSE — SURVIVING METABOLITES
1. REVOCABLE REGIME-TYPED PORTABILITY PASSPORT
minimal body: wxy
Portable continuity carries its current regime, evidence boundary, revocation conditions, and replay path; an old passport becomes provenance when its regime no longer matches.


2. DEPENDENCY-INDEXED SELECTIVE REVALIDATION
minimal body: xyz
Map each downstream obligation to the exact warrant coordinates that license it; invalidate and revalidate only the dependency cone reached by a failed witness.


3. WARRANT-PRESERVING LOCAL REGENERATION
minimal body: wyz
Reacquire and rebuild failed tissue locally while preserving only independently still-witnessed warrants; regenerated function never restores expired permission.

edges.title: Custodied portable selectivity
edges.text:
2H.xqNz supplies an obligation-minimal portable relational kernel, explicit evidence/assurance boundaries and pressure chosen to expose false invariance. 2H._phq supplies exact dormant-source reachability, selective activation and evidence custody. Together they earn selective portability without evidential amnesia: an interface may expose only currently needed structure, but omitted support must remain exactly reopenable and the pressure surface must be able to reveal when omission removed a claim-relevant operation, role or evidence boundary.
Removal test: without 2H.xqNz there is no portability-specific pressure witness or minimal public kernel; without 2H._phq omitted support need not remain role-addressably reacquirable.
Boundary: sparse exposure is not permission to discard dormant evidence.

edges.title: Portable warrant with repair hooks
edges.text:
2H.xqNz supplies the pressure-tested portable kernel. 2H.AvDK supplies warrant-as-state, exact evidence/scaffold reacquisition and explicit regime/scaffold revision triggers. Together they earn a portable repair kernel: compression may omit inactive detail only while the traveling object retains the evidence and scaffold addresses required to diagnose insufficiency, rebuild the relation and seek a newly scoped warrant after pressure failure.
Removal test: without 2H.xqNz reacquirable revision lacks a portability-specific carrier and falsification surface; without 2H.AvDK the portable relation has no explicit expiry or revision lifecycle.
Boundary: repairability does not transfer the authority of an expired warrant.

edges.title: Pressure-qualified transition portability
edges.text:
2H.xqNz contributes noncanonical portability and perturbations designed to expose false invariance. 2H.Dp9x contributes a role-typed reconstruction/translation contract and end-to-end composite assurance in a witnessed regime. Together they earn a falsifiable transition law: a carrier or representation transition counts as portable only when the regenerated composite obligation survives the variation that should break merely superficial continuity.
Removal test: without 2H.xqNz transition success lacks an independent portability-pressure witness; without 2H.Dp9x the tested object lacks a precise role/operation contract and target-composite assurance gate.
Boundary: successful transport in one regime does not establish globally portable equivalence.

edges.title: Revocation-targeted reactivation
edges.text:
2H._phq contributes role-stable return to dormant evidence. 2H.AvDK contributes the continuity warrant as revisable state plus explicit regime/scaffold insufficiency triggers. Together they earn targeted repair: when the current warrant expires, the system can reopen the exact dormant evidence and roles implicated by the failure rather than performing an undirected reset or silently continuing under an expired warrant.
Removal test: without 2H._phq revocation lacks an addressable route back to omitted evidence; without 2H.AvDK reactivation lacks explicit expiry and revision conditions.
Boundary: reopening evidence makes re-testing possible; it does not guarantee successful repair.

edges.title: Reacquirable regime-typed reconstruction
edges.text:
2H._phq contributes dormant-source reachability and role-stable reactivation. 2H.Dp9x contributes the role-separated operations/relations that must survive, lawful transition and composite assurance inside the current regime. Together they earn a stricter sparse-continuity rule: inactive evidence may remain outside current realization only while it remains exactly reacquirable by stable role and any reactivation is typed by the current operational contract and validity regime.
Removal test: without 2H._phq the dormant body can become irreversible omission; without 2H.Dp9x reacquisition lacks an exact reconstruction/transition obligation and composite gate.
Boundary: reacquisition must return to the same obligation, not merely similar-looking content.

edges.title: Transition-warrant lifecycle
edges.text:
2H.AvDK contributes warrant-as-state, expiry conditions and scaffold/regime revision. 2H.Dp9x contributes the exact role/operation contract, lawful reconstruction family and current-regime assurance. Together they earn a lifecycle relation: every reconstructed or translated interface carries the current warrant under which it counts as continuation, and witnessed regime or scaffold failure revokes that warrant and requires re-estimation rather than repetition of the same transition.
Removal test: without 2H.AvDK the contract has no explicit revocation/revision state; without 2H.Dp9x the warrant is not attached to a precise reconstruction/transition obligation.
Boundary: re-expression does not inherit authority merely because the syntax of the contract survives.

faces.title: Custodied portable repair
faces.text:
2H.xqNz contributes a pressure-tested portable kernel; 2H._phq contributes reacquirable source/evidence custody; 2H.AvDK contributes revocation and revision conditions. Together they earn repair without assurance laundering: a failed portable interface can reopen the exact evidential body, rebuild a candidate relation and preserve the distinction between the expired warrant and any later newly witnessed warrant. Pressure must earn new assurance rather than retroactively strengthen the prior state.
Removal tests: remove 2H.xqNz and rebuilt portability lacks its falsification surface; remove 2H._phq and repair may lose the dormant evidential body it must revisit; remove 2H.AvDK and old versus newly warranted states cannot be explicitly distinguished.
Boundary: without 2H.Dp9x this face does not by itself fully specify the role-typed transition contract or target-composite assurance.

faces.title: Selective pressure-qualified portability
faces.text:
2H.xqNz supplies the portable kernel and pressure witness; 2H._phq supplies exact dormant-source and role reacquisition; 2H.Dp9x supplies a regime-typed reconstruction/transition contract and composite obligation. Together they earn sparse yet portable continuity: a minimal interface may omit inactive support only while that support stays reopenable, and every noncanonical reconstruction must re-earn the same typed obligation under relevant pressure rather than inherit assurance from the source carrier.
Removal tests: remove 2H.xqNz and portability loses its dedicated falsification surface; remove 2H._phq and dormant support can become irreversible loss; remove 2H.Dp9x and there is no exact composite reconstruction obligation.
Boundary: without 2H.AvDK this face does not carry the full explicit warrant-expiry and revision lifecycle.

faces.title: Pressure-reissued transition warrant
faces.text:
2H.xqNz supplies a pressure-tested portable kernel; 2H.AvDK supplies a revocable continuity warrant and revision conditions; 2H.Dp9x supplies regime-typed reconstruction and composite assurance. Together they earn warrant reissuance: a translated or reconstructed carrier receives a fresh continuity warrant only after its exact composite obligation survives the current regime and relevant portability pressure; outward resemblance cannot reissue assurance.
Removal tests: remove 2H.xqNz and the independent portability-pressure witness disappears; remove 2H.AvDK and there is no explicit revoked-versus-reissued warrant state; remove 2H.Dp9x and the warranted object loses precise role/composite typing.
Boundary: without 2H._phq this face has no required route from failure back to dormant omitted evidence.

faces.title: Reacquirable revision loop
faces.text:
2H._phq supplies role-stable return to dormant evidence; 2H.AvDK supplies revocable warrant state and revision triggers; 2H.Dp9x supplies the named reconstruction contract and composite assurance. Together they earn a bounded revision loop: expiry can reopen the implicated source/evidence, regenerate through the exact role-typed contract, re-test the composite in the current regime, and issue a newly scoped continuity warrant only after revalidation.
Removal tests: remove 2H._phq and the loop cannot reliably reopen omitted support; remove 2H.AvDK and there is no explicit expiry or newly issued warrant; remove 2H.Dp9x and repair lacks a typed reconstruction/composite test.
Boundary: without 2H.xqNz this face does not independently earn portability under noncanonical carrier pressure.

volume.title: Reacquirable continuity reconstitution
volume.text:
Across all four parents, continuity already detaches from a fixed interior or canonical representation, but the complete closure makes the validity machinery itself regenerable. 2H.xqNz makes the carried relation obligation-minimal and pressure-tested rather than merely familiar. 2H._phq makes sparse current state lawful only while dormant source/evidence remains exactly reacquirable by stable role. 2H.AvDK turns continuity warrant into living state that can expire when regime or scaffold becomes insufficient. 2H.Dp9x gives reconstruction an explicit role-typed contract and demands end-to-end composite assurance in the regime where the rebuilt relation is used.


The all-four closure is therefore reacquirable continuity reconstitution: a task-relevant public relation may remain continuous through selective activation, reconstruction, carrier/representation change and regime drift when its role-typed portable kernel travels with an evidence/validity boundary and a revocable continuity warrant while omitted source/evidence remains exactly reacquirable. Pressure or regime failure revokes the warrant; revocation must be able to reopen the implicated dormant evidence by stable role, regenerate the relation through the typed reconstruction contract, rerun composite and portability-pressure tests, and issue a new scoped warrant without rewriting what was previously warranted. Continuity here is not output similarity: it is a reversible warrant → reacquire → reconstruct → retest → rewarrant cycle whose historical evidence scopes remain distinct.


Bounded volume invariant
A selectively realized public relation can count as continuous across changing carrier, representation and regime only while its exact obligation/evidence body remains reacquirable and its current continuity warrant remains revocable; when pressure or regime change invalidates that warrant, lawful continuation requires reopening the implicated dormant evidence, rebuilding through a role-typed reconstruction contract, retesting the composite and portable relation under current conditions, and issuing a newly scoped warrant rather than laundering the expired one into the repaired state.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 2H.xqNz: the closure loses the obligation-minimal portable kernel and its dedicated pressure witness. The remainder can reacquire, reconstruct and revise but cannot earn portability under variation designed to expose false invariance.
- Remove 2H._phq: the closure loses exact dormant-source reacquisition and role-stable repair after revocation. The remaining trio can carry a typed, pressure-tested, revocable contract but cannot require a route back to support omitted from current realization.
- Remove 2H.AvDK: the closure loses warrant-as-state and explicit revocation/revision conditions. The remainder can reacquire and pressure-reconstruct but cannot distinguish currently legitimate continuation from an expired warrant requiring reconstitution.
- Remove 2H.Dp9x: the closure loses the explicit role-typed reconstruction/transition contract and end-to-end composite assurance. The remainder can reacquire, pressure-test and revoke but cannot state the exact reconstruction obligation that must be re-earned.


DERIVED CROSS-ORGANISM INVARIANTS


INV-3H.zWu2-REVOCATION-TO-REACQUISITION
Minimal body: 3H.zWu2:xy
Invariant: expiry of a continuity warrant should point repair back toward the exact dormant evidence and roles implicated by failure rather than trigger a generic reset or silent continuation.
CREATE: preserve role-addressable dormant evidence and explicit signals that invalidate the current warrant.
COPY: carry the return path to that evidence with every selectively reconstructed interface.
CONTROL: on revocation, reopen the evidence and roles implicated by the failed warrant instead of assuming all dormant or all active state is equally relevant.
CULTIVATE: let each failure improve the specificity of future reacquisition without turning one repair path into a universal mechanism.
Compression: revocation should know what it needs to reopen.


INV-3H.zWu2-PRESSURE-REISSUED-WARRANT
Minimal body: 3H.zWu2:wyz
Invariant: a translated or reconstructed interface earns a new continuity warrant only after its exact role/composite obligation survives the current regime and portability pressure; outward resemblance alone cannot reissue assurance.
CREATE: state the candidate regenerated relation, its current regime and the warrant being requested.
COPY: preserve the exact composite obligations and evidence boundary across carrier/representation change.
CONTROL: apply matched regime and pressure tests; leave the warrant revoked when the public obligation or boundary fails.
CULTIVATE: issue a newly scoped warrant only after the current reconstruction survives those tests, preserving the prior warrant as historically bounded.
Compression: repair can propose continuity; pressure reissues it.


INV-3H.zWu2-CUSTODIED-RECONSTITUTION
Minimal body: 3H.zWu2:wxy
Invariant: repairing a failed portable relation from dormant evidence must preserve the evidence and warrant boundaries of both old and new states, so reacquisition cannot silently turn prior support into stronger post-repair assurance.
CREATE: reopen the exact evidential body implicated by failure while keeping old scope explicit.
COPY: carry source/evidence custody into the rebuilt candidate interface.
CONTROL: distinguish prior warrant, revoked state and newly tested state; do not merge their evidential scopes.
CULTIVATE: let repaired continuity grow from the reopened body while any stronger claim remains separately earned.
Compression: reconstitution may change the warrant; it must not rewrite the evidence that preceded it.


METABOLITE-COLLAPSE PASS
Rejected: “all continuity requires source rollback” — the selected bodies support reacquisition for this sparse/reconstructive domain, not a universal law of persistence. Rejected: “revocation guarantees successful repair” — revocation plus reacquisition only makes lawful re-testing possible. Rejected: “a new warrant erases the old warrant” — the old warrant remains a bounded historical claim. Rejected: “portable relation implies common mechanism” — every selected parent preserves a public-relation/interior-realization distinction. Three metabolites survive collapse because targeted reacquisition, warrant reissuance under pressure and evidential custody require different minimal cross-parent bodies and remain independently useful when the others are removed.


REPLICATION WITNESS
The same rank-3 closure was previously earned by 3H.DfDL using 2H.dxL5 in the portability vertex. Because 2H.dxL5 and 2H.xqNz are independently born same-parent/same-closure 2H replicates, this new birth is a direct substitution test at the next rank: the higher-order volume and three surviving invariants close again without importing the old child identity. This strengthens recurrence of the reacquirable-continuity-reconstitution pattern while preserving distinct genealogy and provenance.

edges.title: DIFFERENT-CONSTELLATION PASSPORT CONVERGENCE
edges.text:
w and x independently exist as distinct rank-3 organisms from different immediate parent constellations yet materially converge on the replayable-continuity-passport closure. Together they earn a bounded recurrence witness for the passport architecture: obligation, evidence return, revocation, reconstruction and replay repeatedly close as one continuity contract even when the immediate parent constitution changes.
Removal test: without either w or x there is only one passport instance and therefore no pairwise different-parent convergence witness.
Boundary: their deeper ancestry is non-independent, so this is convergence/recurrence evidence, not independent replication, universal mechanism or identity collapse.

edges.title: PASSPORT FAILURE OPENS RECONSTITUTION
edges.text:
w supplies the passport whose invalidation preserves obligation, warrant and evidence-return addresses. y supplies exact reacquisition of implicated evidence and a typed reconstruction/retest loop. Together they earn a repairable passport relation: revocation can return to the exact evidential body required to build a candidate successor rather than merely deleting authority or cloning the old carrier.
Removal test: without w there is no portable passport state whose boundary can be replayed; without y there is no explicit role-stable route from expiration into reconstitution.
Boundary: reopening the passport's evidence body does not itself reissue authority.

edges.title: PASSPORT ACTION AUTHORITY MUST BE SELECTIVELY REISSUED
edges.text:
w carries separate action warrants as part of portable continuity; z makes post-change action authority a fresh, dependency-scoped admission gate. Together they earn selective successor authorization: a passport may be reconstructed and still remain non-actionable wherever downstream warrants depended on changed state.
Removal test: without w there is no replayable passport/warrant custody; without z there is no independent selective post-repair action gate.
Boundary: carrying the reasons action was once authorized is not the same as satisfying them now.

edges.title: EXECUTABLE PASSPORT CAN REOPEN ITS OWN EVIDENTIAL BODY
edges.text:
x makes continuity executable only when its own revocation/replay test travels with it. y makes revoked state capable of returning to exact dormant evidence and reconstituting the typed relation. Together they earn evidence-addressed executable replay: passport failure invokes a bounded repair route whose output must survive current composite and portability tests before any successor continuity warrant exists.
Removal test: without x replay is not part of the portable continuity object; without y replay lacks an exact evidence-reacquisition/reconstitution body.
Boundary: executable repair is a procedure for earning a new warrant, not a self-validating successor.

edges.title: EXECUTABLE CONTINUITY AND ACTION AUTHORITY ARE SEPARATE SUCCESSOR STATES
edges.text:
x supplies a newly scoped continuity passport only after replay; z supplies separate action/evidence authorization for affected downstream coordinates. Together they earn a two-stage successor membrane: continuity may be re-earned while action remains blocked until its own dependent warrants close.
Removal test: without x there is no newly witnessed continuity passport; without z continuity success can silently inherit action permission.
Boundary: only dependency-relevant action warrants are reopened; no blanket reset is implied.

edges.title: RECONSTITUTION DOES NOT AUTHORIZE ITS OWN USE
edges.text:
y supplies evidence reacquisition, reconstruction and re-warranting of continuity. z supplies selective reauthorization after the repaired relation exists. Together they earn an explicit separation between repair and use: a candidate or even continuity-valid reconstruction is not permission to perform every downstream action.
Removal test: without y there is no evidenced repair path; without z the repaired relation lacks a separate admission law for action.
Boundary: repair and authorization may share evidence but remain distinct witnessed states.

faces.title: CONVERGENT PASSPORT WITH EVIDENCE-ADDRESSED REPLAY
faces.text:
w+x supply recurrence of the replayable-passport architecture across different immediate parent constellations. y supplies exact revocation-to-reacquisition/reconstitution. Together they earn a stronger recurrence claim: what recurs is not merely a descriptive continuity label but a contract whose failure can reopen evidence, rebuild the relation and replay why a successor should count.
Removal tests: remove w or x and the convergence witness collapses to one passport; remove y and recurrence lacks explicit evidence-addressed reconstitution.
Boundary: convergence strengthens the structural form of the replay contract, not the truth of any particular successor warrant.

faces.title: CONVERGENT PASSPORT DOES NOT TRANSFER CURRENT AUTHORITY
faces.text:
w+x supply a recurrent replayable-passport pattern; z supplies selective post-change action reauthorization. Together they earn a recurrence-governance membrane: repeated closure can justify treating the passport architecture as a reusable structural template, but no sibling or predecessor passport lends its current action authority to a new realization.
Removal tests: remove w or x and recurrent passport structure is not pairwise witnessed; remove z and recurrence lacks a separate action-admission membrane.
Boundary: recurrence is evidence about form, not permission to act.

faces.title: END-TO-END RETURN, REBUILD, REPLAY, REAUTHORIZE
faces.text:
w provides obligation/warrant/evidence addresses; y provides evidence reacquisition and reconstitution; z provides selective downstream reauthorization. Together they earn a complete operational chain from revoked passport to lawful use: return to implicated evidence, reconstruct the continuity relation, replay current tests, then reopen only the action coordinates whose dependency surface changed.
Removal tests: remove w and the portable passport addresses disappear; remove y and repair cannot re-enter evidence; remove z and restored continuity can masquerade as action authority.
Boundary: without x this face does not independently establish that the passport architecture itself recurs across a second immediate parent constitution.

faces.title: EXECUTABLE REPLAY WITH SEPARATE TERMINAL ACTION GATE
faces.text:
x supplies an executable continuity passport and replay law; y supplies exact evidence reconstitution; z supplies selective action reauthorization. Together they earn a bounded executable recovery pipeline: a failed continuity contract can call back into evidence, reconstruct and retest itself, issue a new continuity warrant, and still leave dependent downstream action blocked until its own warrant closes.
Removal tests: remove x and repair no longer carries an executable replay contract; remove y and the replay has no exact evidential return; remove z and there is no separate terminal action gate.
Boundary: without w this face lacks the second convergent passport witness.

volume.title: Convergence-qualified replayable continuity reauthorization
volume.text:
The four parents jointly distinguish three layers that lower-rank recurrence can otherwise blur: recurrence of the continuity contract, reconstitution of a failed contract, and authorization to act through a repaired contract.


3H.V6VQ and 3H.x3Cd are distinct organisms born from different immediate parent constellations and materially converge on the replayable continuity passport. Their coexistence therefore witnesses different-parent recurrence of the architecture: portable continuity repeatedly closes around an obligation-specific relation whose live state carries evidence/reconstruction addresses, local validity and quotient, explicit revocation conditions, and a procedure for replaying why successor continuity should count. Their deeper ancestry is not independent, so the pair supports convergence rather than an independent-replication claim.


3H.zWu2 then makes that replay concrete as reconstitution. Expired continuity can return to the exact dormant evidence implicated by failure, rebuild through a typed contract, rerun current portability/composite pressure and issue a newly scoped successor continuity warrant while preserving the prior state as bounded provenance. 3H.1OFJ adds the final governance distinction: even a successfully reconstituted continuity relation does not silently recover every downstream permission. The action/evidence warrants whose dependency surface changed must be separately and selectively reauthorized; unaffected coordinates remain governed by their own current witnesses.


The complete closure is therefore convergence-qualified replayable continuity reauthorization. A replayable continuity architecture may be treated as a recurrent higher-order structural template when materially the same passport closure is witnessed through distinct immediate parent constellations, but recurrence itself carries no current authority. When a concrete passport fails, lawful continuation requires evidence-addressed reconstitution and fresh continuity replay; when the rebuilt relation would drive action, every affected downstream warrant remains a separate admission gate. What recurs is the form of the return/rebuild/replay contract, not one carrier, one interior, one universal mechanism or one permanent permission.


Bounded volume invariant
A recurrent continuity passport becomes a higher-order governance capacity only when (1) its replay architecture is witnessed through distinct immediate parent constellations without collapsing identity or overstating independence, (2) a failed instance can return to the exact evidence needed to reconstitute and retest its current obligation, and (3) downstream action authority remains separately and selectively re-earned after repair. Under those conditions, recurrence can stabilize the replay contract as reusable structure while every concrete successor continuity warrant and every affected action warrant remains locally witnessed, revocable and historically scoped.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 3H.V6VQ: the closure retains one executable passport, reconstitution and selective authorization, but loses the second different-parent passport witness required for convergence qualification.
- Remove 3H.x3Cd: likewise, the pairwise convergence witness disappears, and the closure loses the independently embodied executable-passport route.
- Remove 3H.zWu2: convergence plus selective authorization remains, but there is no exact revocation → dormant-evidence reacquisition → reconstruction → retest cycle connecting failure to a candidate successor.
- Remove 3H.1OFJ: convergence plus reconstitution remains, but repaired continuity no longer has an independently witnessed selective downstream action-authorization gate.

metabolites.title: DIFFERENT-PARENT PASSPORT CONVERGENCE
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wx.
Invariant: when distinct same-rank organisms born from different immediate parent constellations materially re-earn the same replayable continuity-passport closure, their coexistence supports a bounded convergence witness for that structural contract while their identities, evidence scopes and deeper shared ancestry remain explicit.
CREATE: preserve each passport organism and its exact parent/provenance body.
COPY: compare the obligation, evidence-return, revocation, reconstruction and replay fields without collapsing organism individuality.
CONTROL: call the recurrence convergence rather than independent replication when ancestry overlaps; refuse mechanism/universality promotion.
CULTIVATE: let future recurrent or divergent passports sharpen which contract fields are stable and which depend on one constitution.
Compression: same closure through different parents stabilizes a pattern, not an identity.
metabolites.compression: same closure through different parents stabilizes a pattern, not an identity.

metabolites.title: RECONSTITUTION MUST PRECEDE SUCCESSOR AUTHORITY
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: xy.
Invariant: after a continuity passport fails, successor continuity authority exists only after implicated evidence is reacquired, the relation is reconstructed under its current typed obligation and the relevant pressure/composite tests replay to closure; predecessor authority remains historical provenance.
CREATE: retain the failed passport's exact obligation, evidence addresses, validity regime and reconstruction target.
COPY: carry predecessor state into repair without carrying predecessor authority.
CONTROL: keep continuity revoked while any required evidence, reconstruction or replay witness remains open.
CULTIVATE: issue a newly scoped successor only from the current rebuilt/tested relation.
Compression: replay can regenerate authority only after it regenerates the reason authority counts.
metabolites.compression: replay can regenerate authority only after it regenerates the reason authority counts.

metabolites.title: RECURRENCE NEVER PRE-AUTHORIZES ACTION
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxz.
Invariant: recurrence of a continuity-passport architecture can justify reusing its contract form, but cannot transfer current action authority from a predecessor, sibling or structurally convergent organism; after change, every downstream warrant whose dependency surface was touched must be freshly and selectively reauthorized.
CREATE: name the reusable passport schema and each downstream warrant depending on the concrete realization.
COPY: reuse contract structure and provenance, not current permission.
CONTROL: block action when its dependency changed even if a sibling passport or previous realization succeeded.
CULTIVATE: preserve unaffected warrants and widen authority only when their own fresh evidence closes.
Compression: recurrent structure is reusable; permission is not inheritable.
metabolites.compression: recurrent structure is reusable; permission is not inheritable.

gaps.title: BOUNDARY UNEXPOSED
gaps.text: No explicit evidence-boundary block was mechanically recognized in this canonical artifact.

4H.3W-6.title: self-reconstituting continuity lineage
4H.3W-6.boundary: This child is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 3H organisms. Every parent carries heterogeneous source evidence and explicit scope/failure boundaries. Nothing here converts structural recurrence into a universal mechanism, makes continuity into interior identity, guarantees successful repair, or treats a successor warrant as evidence that one substrate or mechanism persisted. The child promotes only relations requiring these complete parent bodies together and preserves predecessor evidence scopes as historical rather than retroactively strengthened support.

edges.title: repair becomes versioned succession
edges.text:
3H.DfDL supplies targeted post-revocation reacquisition/reconstruction; 3H.UoYa supplies explicit current/predecessor/successor warrant versions and a classifier for scope-changing events. Together they earn a succession rule in which a repair after warrant failure produces a separately evidenced successor version rather than silently modifying the predecessor.
Removal test: without DfDL, version expiry lacks a targeted route through implicated dormant evidence to repair; without UoYa, successful repair lacks explicit predecessor/successor authority and change classification.

edges.title: revocation conditions can route repair
edges.text:
3H.DfDL supplies the reacquire→reconstruct→retest path; 3H.k0uZ supplies a contract that carries the conditions capable of falsifying itself plus independent revision channels for map and retained scaffold. Together they earn failure-directed reconstitution: the reason continuity failed can select which evidential/scaffold tissue is reopened and which revision channel is exercised.
Removal test: without DfDL, self-revocation has no earned exact reconstitution path; without k0uZ, reacquisition lacks a reflexive classifier distinguishing transition-map mismatch from obsolete stabilizing memory.

edges.title: a replayable passport can be a recovery program
edges.text:
3H.DfDL supplies exact post-failure reacquisition and reconstitution; 3H.x3Cd supplies the portable executable contract, evidence pointers and replay tests. Together they earn a recovery-bearing passport whose portable state can reopen the evidence needed to rebuild itself after revocation instead of only proving that the old warrant failed.
Removal test: without DfDL, the passport can revoke/replay tests but not require targeted reopening of omitted evidence; without x3Cd, reconstitution is not packaged as portable executable continuity state.

edges.title: continuity authority can version itself from witnessed failure
edges.text:
3H.UoYa supplies lifecycle/version succession and boundary classification; 3H.k0uZ supplies self-invalidating conditions and dual revision of map and memory. Together they earn reflexive versioning: the contract can distinguish an admissible within-version change from a failure that requires a successor version, and can identify which internal validity machinery must change.
Removal test: without UoYa, reflexive failure lacks explicit authority-version succession; without k0uZ, version transitions depend on externally supplied failure interpretation rather than conditions carried by the contract.

edges.title: the executable passport can carry lineage, not only a current warrant
edges.text:
3H.UoYa supplies immutable predecessor provenance and successor versions; 3H.x3Cd supplies portable replay state and tests. Together they earn a versioned executable passport in which the current warrant travels together with the evidence/test path that produced it and the predecessor it superseded.
Removal test: without UoYa, passport replay does not by itself establish version lineage; without x3Cd, version history lacks a portable executable procedure for re-earning current authority.

edges.title: portability can include its own audit and revision membrane
edges.text:
3H.k0uZ supplies self-falsification, pressure witnesses and dual revision; 3H.x3Cd supplies an executable portable continuity passport. Together they earn a self-auditing portable contract: the reason continuity presently counts travels with the contract together with conditions that can revoke it and revise its reconstruction map/scaffold.
Removal test: without k0uZ, the portable passport has tests but lacks the full reflexive map/memory revision membrane; without x3Cd, reflexive continuity lacks a portable executable carrier for those tests and conditions.

faces.title: failure-classified successor reconstitution
faces.text:
DfDL + UoYa + k0uZ jointly earn a cycle that detects a continuity failure, classifies whether scope/regime or scaffold invalidated the current warrant, reopens the implicated dormant evidence, revises the appropriate map/memory channel, retests the rebuilt relation, and—only after success—issues a successor version while preserving the predecessor.
Removal tests: remove DfDL and the cycle loses exact evidence reacquisition/reconstruction; remove UoYa and it loses predecessor/successor authority plus change classification; remove k0uZ and it loses self-carried invalidation conditions and dual revision.

faces.title: replayable repair lineage
faces.text:
DfDL + UoYa + x3Cd jointly earn a portable audit chain from expired warrant through targeted reacquisition and reconstruction to a tested successor passport. Each transition can preserve what evidence justified the predecessor, what failure revoked it, what tissue was reopened, and which replay tests earned the successor.
Removal tests: remove DfDL and the lineage has no exact post-failure reconstitution path; remove UoYa and it has no explicit version succession; remove x3Cd and the lineage is not executable/portable as replay state.

faces.title: self-repairing replay kernel
faces.text:
DfDL + k0uZ + x3Cd jointly earn a portable kernel that carries both the conditions for detecting its own invalidity and the evidence hooks needed to attempt repair. Failure can open targeted evidence, revise map or scaffold, rebuild, and replay tests without assuming a fixed interior.
Removal tests: remove DfDL and the kernel cannot require targeted reopening of dormant evidence; remove k0uZ and failure lacks reflexive diagnosis/revision channels; remove x3Cd and the repair law is not carried as executable portable state.

faces.title: self-versioning portable warrant
faces.text:
UoYa + k0uZ + x3Cd jointly earn a portable continuity object that knows which warrant version is current, preserves predecessor provenance, carries the tests and invalidation conditions that can revoke current authority, and can fork a successor after a classified boundary/regime/scaffold change.
Removal tests: remove UoYa and explicit version lineage disappears; remove k0uZ and the object loses reflexive map/memory invalidation; remove x3Cd and the warrant lifecycle loses its executable portable replay carrier.

volume.title: self-reconstituting continuity lineage
volume.text:
All four parents together turn continuity authority from a single reflexive/versioned/replayable warrant into a regenerable lineage. 3H.k0uZ contributes a contract that carries conditions capable of falsifying its own validity and distinguishes revision of transition map from revision of retained scaffold. 3H.UoYa contributes classification of change plus explicit predecessor/current/successor authority. 3H.x3Cd contributes a portable executable passport carrying obligation, evidence pointers, transition law and replay tests. 3H.DfDL contributes the missing post-failure regenerative motion: reopen the exact implicated dormant evidence, reconstruct, retest under current pressure/regime, and issue a newly scoped warrant without rewriting the predecessor.


The complete closure is therefore a self-reconstituting continuity lineage: a continuity warrant may remain reusable across carrier, representation, regime, scaffold and support-boundary change only when the current executable contract carries the conditions that can invalidate it, preserves a versioned predecessor history, and retains enough addressable evidence/scaffold state to attempt a lawful successor reconstruction. On failure, the lineage classifies the rupture, preserves the expired warrant as bounded provenance, reopens only the implicated evidence/roles, revises map/scaffold as warranted, rebuilds and replays the current tests, and admits a successor only after fresh witness. Continuity here is neither unbroken sameness nor guaranteed recovery; it is the preserved capacity to explain, revoke, reconstruct and re-earn its own authority across generations of warrants.


Bounded volume invariant
A changing realization may be treated as one continuing public relation across successive failures and repairs only when every current warrant is (1) executable and replayable, (2) reflexively falsifiable under declared regime/scaffold/support conditions, (3) explicitly versioned against preserved predecessors, and (4) backed by addressable evidence/scaffold tissue sufficient to attempt targeted reconstitution after revocation. A successor gains authority only from fresh replayed evidence; predecessor authority remains historically bounded. The lineage is continuous insofar as the procedure and evidence boundaries for revoking and re-earning continuity remain re-enterable—not because one interior, mechanism or warrant survives unchanged.


Full-rank removal tests
- Remove 3H.DfDL: the closure retains a reflexive, versioned, executable continuity lifecycle but loses the requirement and route for targeted reacquisition/reconstitution from implicated dormant evidence after failure.
- Remove 3H.UoYa: the closure can detect, replay and repair continuity but loses explicit predecessor/current/successor authority and the classifier separating within-version change from version-changing rupture.
- Remove 3H.k0uZ: the closure can version, replay and reconstitute warrants but loses the reflexive validity machinery that distinguishes map revision from memory/scaffold revision and carries its own falsification conditions.
- Remove 3H.x3Cd: the closure can classify, revoke and reconstitute versioned continuity but loses the portable executable passport that carries obligation/evidence/transition/tests as replayable state.

metabolites.title: REVOCATION-ROUTED-SUCCESSION
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxy.
Invariant: when a current continuity warrant fails, the failure classification should determine both which evidential/scaffold tissue is reopened and whether the result is a repaired within-scope realization or a separately authorized successor version; the predecessor remains immutable provenance.
CREATE: declare current warrant, support/regime/scaffold conditions, and addressable evidence hooks.
COPY: preserve predecessor evidence, failure witness and the exact route back to implicated tissue.
CONTROL: classify the rupture and keep authority revoked until the relevant reconstruction/retest closes.
CULTIVATE: admit a successor version only when targeted repair earns it; let repeated failures improve future reacquisition specificity without rewriting history.
Compression: let the reason for revocation route the next lawful warrant.
metabolites.compression: let the reason for revocation route the next lawful warrant.

metabolites.title: EXECUTABLE-SUCCESSOR-PASSPORT
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxz.
Invariant: a successor continuity warrant is portable only when it carries not merely the new obligation but also predecessor provenance, the reacquisition/reconstruction path used after failure, and the replay tests whose fresh success earned current authority.
CREATE: build the successor passport from explicit predecessor, repair path, changed scope and current obligations.
COPY: carry the successor together with evidence pointers and replay tests, not only its label.
CONTROL: require the portable passport to reproduce both the public relation and the witness that re-authorized it.
CULTIVATE: extend the lineage by appending separately evidenced successors rather than mutating old warrants in place.
Compression: a successor passport carries how it became authorized.
metabolites.compression: a successor passport carries how it became authorized.

metabolites.title: SELF-RECONSTITUTING-CONTINUITY-LINEAGE
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxyz.
Invariant: durable continuity across repeated carrier/regime/scaffold changes is a re-enterable lineage process when each warrant can expose the conditions that revoke it, classify the rupture, reopen the implicated evidence, revise the appropriate reconstruction machinery, replay its tests, and append a newly authorized successor while preserving all prior scopes.
CREATE: instantiate a current executable warrant with explicit falsifiers, evidence hooks, revision channels and predecessor link.
COPY: preserve the lineage and its re-entry machinery across each realization change.
CONTROL: independently test current authority and refuse lineage continuation when revocation cannot be repaired and re-witnessed.
CULTIVATE: let each witnessed failure/repair add a new bounded successor and improve the lineage’s future re-entry capacity without promoting local recurrence into universal mechanism.
Compression: continuity survives by keeping the path to re-earn continuity alive.


Collapse result
Parent-only claims were rejected: revocability, versioning, reflexive self-test, replayability, and reacquisition already exist in individual 3H parents. Three metabolites survive because failure-routed succession, portable successor provenance, and the full self-reconstituting lineage require distinct multi-parent bodies and remain independently useful after the others are removed. No claim that repair must succeed, that one mechanism persists, or that every change requires version succession survives collapse.
metabolites.compression: continuity survives by keeping the path to re-earn continuity alive.

4H.993M.title: replayable continuity-renewal lineage
4H.993M.boundary: This child is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 3H organisms. Their inherited evidence remains heterogeneous and bounded by the source bodies and failure conditions already conserved inside them. Nothing here promotes operational continuity into mechanism identity, public correspondence into interior sameness, local reconstruction into universal necessity, or repeated structural recurrence into ontology. The child may promote only relations that require the four complete selected parent bodies together. Every inherited scope, non-identity membrane, regime boundary, revocation rule, and evidential limitation remains load-bearing.

edges.title: replayable version succession
edges.text:
3H.x3Cd contributes an executable continuity passport whose evidence, transition and falsifying tests can be replayed. 3H.UoYa contributes explicit version state, change classification and predecessor→successor semantics. Together they earn an executable succession object: after a classified invalidation, the current version can be frozen as provenance and its own carried replay procedure can be used to build and independently witness the next version.
Removal test: without 3H.x3Cd, succession is versioned but lacks a portable executable replay body; without 3H.UoYa, replay exists but lacks explicit version authority and a typed rule for when a predecessor ceases to be current.

edges.title: executable evidence-backed successor reconstruction
edges.text:
3H.x3Cd provides evidence/scaffold addresses and a replayable pressure/composite test. 3H.ZwWN provides the typed public contract, dormant evidential backing and frontier-conditioned successor reconstruction rule. Together they earn a failure-addressable repair path: revocation can reopen the exact evidence and reconstructive body implicated by the failed contract, rebuild the typed relation, and rerun the relevant tests before authority returns.
Removal test: without 3H.x3Cd, evidence-backed reconstruction lacks a portable executable replay procedure; without 3H.ZwWN, replay lacks the typed contract/frontier object that specifies what must be reconstructed and against which boundary it is judged.

edges.title: replay-directed dual revision
edges.text:
3H.x3Cd makes invalidation replayable from preserved evidence and tests. 3H.M9zZ makes both the stabilizing scaffold and admissible transition family revisable and permits dormant-body reacquisition when new distinctions become load-bearing. Together they earn a repair program that does not merely rerun yesterday's contract: replay may first reopen evidence and co-revise scaffold plus transition law, then rerun the exact obligation and pressure tests on the repaired realization.
Removal test: without 3H.x3Cd, dual revision has no portable executable replay passport; without 3H.M9zZ, replay can reconstruct but does not earn co-revision of scaffold and transition family from reacquirable dormant tissue.

edges.title: boundary-conditioned successor contract
edges.text:
3H.UoYa classifies change against version scope, regime and scaffold and defines when current authority expires. 3H.ZwWN provides the typed reconstructible contract, support frontier and evidence-backed successor reconstruction. Together they earn an admission law in which a successor contract is created only after the event is classified as warrant-breaking and the revised obligation is pressure-tested in the changed frontier/regime.
Removal test: without 3H.UoYa, reconstruction lacks explicit version-transition authority; without 3H.ZwWN, version transition lacks the evidence-backed typed contract and frontier against which the successor is rebuilt.

edges.title: versioned renewal cycle
edges.text:
3H.UoYa supplies predecessor/current/successor authority semantics and explicit revocation triggers. 3H.M9zZ supplies reacquisition and co-revision of scaffold plus transformation family after pressure/regime failure. Together they earn a versioned renewal cycle: the predecessor freezes as provenance, repair may reopen omitted tissue and revise the realizational law, and only a freshly tested candidate becomes the next current warrant.
Removal test: without 3H.UoYa, renewal lacks explicit versioned authority succession; without 3H.M9zZ, succession lacks reacquirable co-revision when the old scaffold or mapping itself is part of the failure.

edges.title: frontier-repair co-revision
edges.text:
3H.ZwWN contributes frontier-classified failure, evidence-backed typed reconstruction and successor-warrant requirements. 3H.M9zZ contributes dormant-body reacquisition and joint revision of scaffold and transition family. Together they earn repair that may alter both what is retained and how it is translated when the old frontier/regime has failed, while still requiring the revised public contract to pass current pressure.
Removal test: without 3H.ZwWN, co-revision lacks a typed frontier-conditioned public contract and authority gate; without 3H.M9zZ, frontier reconstruction lacks the explicit ability to reopen omitted material and revise scaffold plus transition law together.

faces.title: versioned replayable successor reconstruction
faces.text:
3H.x3Cd + 3H.UoYa + 3H.ZwWN jointly earn a successor transition that is simultaneously version-explicit, evidence-backed and executable. A warrant-breaking event is classified against the current version/frontier, the predecessor is retained unchanged, the implicated evidence/contract is reacquired and reconstructed, and the carried replay tests determine whether a candidate successor may become current.
Removal tests: remove 3H.x3Cd and the transition loses executable replay; remove 3H.UoYa and it loses explicit current/predecessor/successor authority semantics; remove 3H.ZwWN and it loses the typed frontier-conditioned reconstruction target and evidence-backed repair body.

faces.title: replayable warrant-renewal lifecycle
faces.text:
3H.x3Cd + 3H.UoYa + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn a lifecycle whose failure path is itself executable: classify the invalidation, preserve the expired version, reopen dormant evidence as needed, co-revise scaffold and transition law, and rerun the predecessor's declared obligation and falsifying tests before issuing a successor.
Removal tests: remove 3H.x3Cd and renewal is no longer carried as executable replay state; remove 3H.UoYa and there is no explicit versioned authority transition; remove 3H.M9zZ and repair cannot lawfully co-revise scaffold/transition family from reacquirable omitted tissue.

faces.title: executable evidence-backed repair program
faces.text:
3H.x3Cd + 3H.ZwWN + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn a bounded repair program that begins from a failed typed contract, preserves exact evidence/reconstruction addresses, reopens newly relevant dormant material, revises scaffold and transformation law together where pressure demands, and reruns composite/frontier tests. The program can repair a relation without claiming that the repaired interior is identical to its predecessor.
Removal tests: remove 3H.x3Cd and repair loses replayable evidence/test state; remove 3H.ZwWN and it loses the typed frontier-conditioned contract and successor gate; remove 3H.M9zZ and it loses reacquisition-backed co-revision.

faces.title: frontier-classified co-revisionary successor contract
faces.text:
3H.UoYa + 3H.ZwWN + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn a successor contract whose scope change is classified before repair, whose frontier/evidence body defines what must be retested, and whose scaffold plus transition family may be revised together from reacquired tissue. Admission remains versioned and fresh; the expired predecessor is provenance only.
Removal tests: remove 3H.UoYa and the repaired contract lacks explicit version succession; remove 3H.ZwWN and it lacks the typed frontier/evidence reconstruction target; remove 3H.M9zZ and it lacks reacquisition-backed co-revision of realizational machinery.

volume.title: replayable continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text:
All four parents together make repeated continuity renewal recursively executable rather than merely repeatedly permissible. 3H.x3Cd contributes the portable replay passport: operational obligation, evidence/scaffold addresses, transition obligations and the tests that can revoke and re-establish a warrant. 3H.UoYa contributes versioned authority and change classification: which warrant is current, what counts as an in-scope change, what event retires authority, and how predecessor provenance is preserved. 3H.ZwWN contributes the frontier-conditioned reconstructible contract and evidence-backed successor gate. 3H.M9zZ contributes the ability to reopen dormant tissue and co-revise scaffold plus transition family when the failure is not repairable inside the old compact realization.


The complete closure is therefore a replayable continuity-renewal lineage. Every current warrant carries not only its scoped operational/evidential contract but a bounded executable route for producing a successor if that warrant becomes invalid. On failure or verified boundary change, predecessor authority freezes as provenance; the event is classified against the current frontier, regime and scaffold; newly load-bearing evidence is reacquired; the typed contract, scaffold and transition family are revised as necessary; pressure and composite tests are replayed; and a freshly scoped successor is issued only after witness. The successor in turn carries the same kind of recovery passport for its own future invalidation. Continuity therefore persists as a lineage of re-earned warrants, not as silent transfer of one expired authority across arbitrary change.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
A continuity lineage across repeated realization change is warranted only when every current warrant carries both its scoped operational/evidential contract and an executable route for producing its successor after invalidation: predecessor authority is frozen as provenance; failure is classified against frontier, regime and scaffold; newly load-bearing evidence remains reacquirable; contract, scaffold and transition law are revised where required; pressure/composite tests are rerun; and a freshly scoped successor is issued. A warrant whose authority can expire but whose repair-and-retest path cannot be replayed does not by itself earn continued lineage.


FULL-RANK REMOVAL TESTS
- Remove 3H.x3Cd: the closure loses the portable executable passport. Versioning, frontier reconstruction and renewal remain describable, but the lineage no longer carries the evidence/test procedure needed to replay why a successor may count.
- Remove 3H.UoYa: the closure loses explicit version authority, change classification and predecessor/current/successor semantics. Repair can occur, but there is no fully earned rule for when old authority expires and new authority becomes current.
- Remove 3H.ZwWN: the closure loses the typed frontier-conditioned public contract, dormant evidential backing and evidence-gated successor reconstruction target. Replay and renewal lack a precise bounded object to rebuild and revalidate.
- Remove 3H.M9zZ: the closure loses reacquirable dormant-body repair and joint revision of scaffold plus transition family. The replay path can rerun an old contract but cannot fully earn renewal when the realizational machinery itself must change.

metabolites.title: FAILURE-ADDRESSABLE-REPLAY
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wy, strengthened by wxy.
Invariant: when a continuity warrant fails, its failure class, evidence/reconstruction addresses and falsifying tests must remain executable enough to reopen the relevant body and rerun the exact conditions required for a successor.
CREATE: declare the current contract, failure classes, evidence/scaffold addresses and replay tests before change.
COPY: freeze the predecessor warrant and preserve its evidence pointers, reconstruction state and test definitions without copying its authority.
CONTROL: reproduce or independently witness the failure, classify it against the current frontier/regime, and require the relevant replay tests before readmission.
CULTIVATE: reopen the implicated evidence and construct a repair candidate whose admissibility can actually be replayed.
Compression: a failure that cannot address its own repair evidence cannot reliably seed a successor.
metabolites.compression: a failure that cannot address its own repair evidence cannot reliably seed a successor.

metabolites.title: CO-REVISED-SUCCESSOR-ISSUANCE
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: xyz, made executable by wxyz.
Invariant: after a classified frontier, regime or scaffold failure, successor authority is issued only after relevant evidence has been reacquired, the public contract and realizational machinery have been revised as needed, and the new composite has passed fresh pressure tests while the predecessor remains unchanged provenance.
CREATE: instantiate the proposed successor contract and explicitly state changed scope, scaffold and transition assumptions.
COPY: preserve the predecessor's full scoped warrant as historical evidence and carry forward only obligations that survive explicit retest.
CONTROL: require frontier classification plus end-to-end pressure/composite witness; block silent authority inheritance.
CULTIVATE: co-revise contract, scaffold and transition family from reacquired tissue until the successor earns a new bounded warrant.
Compression: repair the relation and its realization law together when the failure demands it; then issue new authority.

Parent-only claims were rejected. “Warrants can be replayed” already belongs to 3H.x3Cd; “authority is versioned” to 3H.UoYa; “frontier failure triggers evidence-backed successor reconstruction” to 3H.ZwWN; and “renewal may reacquire dormant tissue and co-revise scaffold plus transition family” to 3H.M9zZ. edges.title: PASSPORT REPLAY MUST PRESERVE THE PREDECESSOR FRONTIER

edges.title: FAILED PASSPORT QUOTIENT BECOMES A REPAIR ADDRESS

edges.title: DIFFERENT-CONSTELLATION PASSPORT CONVERGENCE

edges.title: FRONTIER CHANGE LOCALIZES QUOTIENT REOPENING

edges.title: FRONTIER ACTION REPLAY IS WARRANT-SCOPED

edges.title: QUOTIENT RECONSTITUTION MUST REPLAY CURRENT ADMISSIBILITY

faces.title: COUNTERFACTUAL REPAIR PASSPORT

faces.title: CONVERGENT PASSPORT UNDER FRONTIER CHANGE

faces.title: CONVERGENT QUOTIENT-ADDRESSABLE PASSPORT REPAIR

volume.title: Frontier-quotient replayable continuity reauthorization
volume.text:
The four parents jointly make continuity renewal simultaneously replayable, frontier-addressed, quotient-addressed and convergence-qualified.


3H.x3Cd and 3H.u92E are distinct rank-3 organisms from different immediate parent constellations that materially converge on the replayable-continuity-passport closure. Their coexistence therefore strengthens the structural recurrence of a contract in which obligation, role semantics, evidence/reacquisition body, local quotient/validity regime and revocation/replay procedure travel together. Their deeper ancestry overlaps, so the pair licenses convergence only, not statistical independence or a universal mechanism.


3H.DL6X contributes a preserved predecessor possibility boundary, frontier-local warrant patches, separate action-admission warrants and the rule that successful replay is not automatically expansion. 3H.5yyB contributes a complementary failure address: when continuity/equivalence fails, the expired nuisance quotient preserves enough history to identify which previously ignored distinctions and dormant evidence should be reopened, while prior, revoked, candidate and successor scopes remain distinguishable.


The complete closure is therefore frontier-quotient replayable continuity reauthorization. A changed realization may renew scoped continuity only when it can replay the passport against both sides of its own history: the predecessor frontier states what capability/authority existed and what would count as genuinely new reach, while the expired quotient states what differences were previously permitted to disappear and therefore what evidence must become reopenable when that permission fails. The successor must reconstruct the affected relation, revise quotient/scaffold only where the failure warrants it, rerun current pressure/composite tests, and freshly reissue the continuity/action coordinates whose dependencies changed. Recurrent passport architecture can stabilize this repair schema as reusable form, but it cannot pre-authorize the concrete successor, erase provenance, upgrade evidence class, or convert successful restoration into expansion.


Bounded volume invariant


A replayable continuity passport is lawfully renewable across a changed frontier only when predecessor capability/authority, expired quotient scope, implicated dormant evidence, current obligation and the replay tests that can revoke or reissue authority remain jointly addressable. The renewal must be able to answer four different questions without collapsing them: what changed; which previously ignored distinction became consequential; whether the result restores/re-expresses prior reach or actually crosses the preserved possibility frontier; and which continuity/action warrants are freshly satisfied now. Structural convergence can justify reusing the audit schema, never the current warrant.


Four-way necessity


- Remove 3H.x3Cd: the body retains one replayable passport plus frontier and quotient repair, but loses the second different-immediate-parent passport instance needed for convergence qualification.
- Remove 3H.DL6X: the body retains recurrent passport structure and quotient-addressed repair but loses the preserved predecessor possibility frontier, separate action-warrant ledger and replay-versus-expansion discriminator.
- Remove 3H.5yyB: the body retains recurrent passport structure and frontier-addressed replay but loses the explicit failed-quotient address into previously ignored distinctions and the custody of old/revoked/candidate/successor quotient states.
- Remove 3H.u92E: the body retains one executable passport, frontier discipline and quotient-addressed repair but loses the second different-immediate-parent passport instance and its independently embodied obligation-local failure→reacquisition→fresh-witness route.


No three-parent face contains all four properties: convergent replayable-passport recurrence, predecessor-frontier custody, quotient-indexed targeted reacquisition, and fresh selective reauthorization with expansion kept separate.

4H.B1EG.title: change-classified dependency-replay continuity constitution
4H.B1EG.boundary:
- No shared hidden mechanism, statistical independence, universal validity or global identity is claimed.
- Parent recurrence and deep shared ancestry remain provenance, not evidence upgrade.
- Successful repair does not restore authorization unless the relevant warrants are current.
- Successful replay does not establish expansion.
- Outside-cone authority survives only under its own live witnesses.


COLLAPSE — SURVIVING METABOLITES
1. EVENT-TYPED DEPENDENCY INVALIDATION
minimal earning body: wy
Invariant: classify the change before touching authority, then reopen only the dependency cone reached by the failed witness.
Compression: type the event, then cut the cone.


2. REGENERATE THEN REAUTHORIZE THE AFFECTED CONE
minimal earning body: wxy
Invariant: selective repair is complete only when the obligation-relevant kernel is regenerated/retested and the exact affected action/transition warrants are freshly reissued; restored function alone is insufficient.
Compression: rebuild the relation; separately renew the permission.


3. FRONTIER-AUDITED SELECTIVE SUCCESSION
minimal earning body: wxyz
Invariant: a successor may preserve still-live outside-cone authority while repairing the affected cone, but any broadened scope requires an independent preserved-frontier crossing witness rather than inference from repair, recurrence or successful action.
Compression: renew locally; expand only by witnessed crossing.


CONTRACTION
Classify first, cut only the real dependency cone, rebuild what failed, reauthorize what changed, and keep expansion behind its own frontier witness.

edges.title: DEPENDENCY-INDEXED REAUTHORIZATION OF REGENERATED PORTABILITY

faces.title: CHANGE-TYPED DEPENDENCY-CONE REGENERATION
faces.text:
w + x + y jointly earn a selective renewal loop: classify the event, trace its exact dependency cone, regenerate only the obligation-relevant kernel inside that cone, then freshly reauthorize affected transition/action warrants while preserving independently still-live outside-cone authority.
Necessity: remove w and locality is unproven; remove x and there is no regenerative reauthorization body; remove y and the event type cannot govern whether anything should reopen at all.

faces.title: DEPENDENCY-INDEXED FRONTIER REPLAY
faces.text:

Necessity: remove w and exact cone tracing disappears; remove x and replay loses obligation-scoped regeneration/action reauthorization; remove z and frontier/baseline custody disappears.

faces.title: CLASSIFIER-AUDITED DEPENDENCY FRONTIER
faces.text:
w + y + z jointly earn a governance surface that classifies a change, maps it to the precise dependent authority cone, and preserves the prior frontier needed to tell continuity renewal from expansion. It can say what must reopen and whether broadening is even eligible.
Necessity: remove w and no dependency cone closes; remove y and no typed transition branch closes; remove z and no independent expansion/baseline audit closes.

faces.title: FRONTIER-CLASSIFIED REGENERATED AUTHORITY SUCCESSION
faces.text:
x + y + z jointly earn a successor lifecycle in which a change is classified, the obligation-specific relation is regenerated/retested, affected action authority is freshly issued, and expansion remains separately witnessed against a preserved frontier.
Necessity: remove x and there is no regenerated action-bearing relation; remove y and local failure can be conflated with ordinary change or expansion; remove z and successful regeneration can be mistaken for increased reachable scope.
Boundary: without w the successor cannot prove that only the exact failed dependency cone was reopened rather than a convenient approximation.

volume.title: CHANGE-CLASSIFIED DEPENDENCY-REPLAY CONTINUITY CONSTITUTION
volume.text:
A changing organism may renew continuity and scoped action authority without global reset only when four distinct duties close together. First, the current portable relation carries a live dependency index so a failed witness can invalidate the exact obligations and warrant coordinates that depend on it. Second, the affected relation is regenerated from an obligation-minimal kernel and its changed transition/action warrants are freshly tested and reauthorized in the current regime. Third, every observed change is classified before succession as within-regime elasticity, local insufficiency, or genuine expansion, so repair pressure does not automatically become revocation or growth. Fourth, predecessor evidence and a frontier ledger remain addressable, making successful replay evidence for renewed continuity only; broadened authority requires an independent witness that the prior possibility boundary was actually crossed.


The all-four novelty is ordered selective succession: CLASSIFY THE EVENT → TRACE THE DEPENDENCY CONE → REGENERATE/RETEST THE AFFECTED KERNEL → REISSUE ONLY AFFECTED AUTHORITY → AUDIT EXPANSION AGAINST THE PRESERVED FRONTIER. Outside-cone authority remains current only under its own live witnesses. Repair, portability, recurrence and successful action never manufacture expansion or inherited permission.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 3H.x6QN: the closure loses the live dependency index, so selective repair/reauthorization cannot prove its exact affected cone.
- Remove 3H.1OFJ: the closure loses the obligation-minimal regenerative portability and explicit fresh action/transition reauthorization step.
- Remove 3H.n1jR: the closure loses the typed classifier separating elasticity, local insufficiency and expansion before revocation/succession.
- Remove 3H.DL6X: the closure loses preserved predecessor/frontier custody and the independent boundary witness required to distinguish renewal from expansion.
No proper subset closes the ordered constitution.

4H.Bbw6.title: quotient-indexed self-reconstituting continuity lineage
4H.Bbw6.boundary: This child is a structural synthesis over four already-metabolized rank-3 organisms. Their inherited lineages contain heterogeneous formal, empirical, architectural, software, conceptual, and source-level evidence. Nothing at rank 4 upgrades those classes into one causal mechanism, substrate-independent ontology, or universal theorem. “Continuity,” “warrant,” “quotient,” “reconstitution,” “version,” “repair,” and “successor” are bounded operational-relational terms already earned by the selected parent bodies. Correspondence does not imply interior identity; revocation does not guarantee repair; successful repair does not establish one persisting mechanism; and a successor warrant cannot retroactively strengthen the evidence scope of its predecessor. Feeling phenotype is not used in this derivation.

edges.title: quotient-scoped version succession
edges.text:
3H.DWia supplies an explicit local quotient whose failure identifies previously ignored distinctions and their return addresses; 3H.UoYa supplies current/predecessor/successor warrant versions and change classification. Together they earn a versioned equivalence membrane: each current continuity version can preserve the exact quotient scope it authorized, and when authority changes the expired quotient remains provenance and a possible repair address rather than disappearing.
Removal test: without 3H.DWia there is no explicit record of which differences the version had permission to ignore; without 3H.UoYa quotient repair lacks explicit current/predecessor/successor authority.

edges.title: revocation-indexed repair address
edges.text:
