Together they earn targeted reconstitution: the failed obligation can be intersected with the old quotient to identify which evidence or roles must be reopened rather than triggering generic rollback or indiscriminate full-state restoration.
Removal test: without 3H.DWia repair lacks explicit ignored-difference localization; without 3H.DfDL the address exists but no exact reconstitution path is earned.

edges.title: reflexive quotient membrane
edges.text:
3H.DWia supplies explicit nuisance quotient, revocation, and addressability; 3H.k0uZ supplies self-carried falsifiers plus distinct map and scaffold/memory revision channels. Together they earn a reflexive equivalence membrane in which what the contract is currently allowed to ignore is itself part of the contract’s self-audit, and quotient, transition map, and stabilizing scaffold can fail or be revised for different reasons.
Removal test: without 3H.DWia the reflexive contract cannot state which distinctions it had licensed as nuisance; without 3H.k0uZ quotient failure lacks the full self-carried invalidation and dual-revision membrane.

edges.title: reconstitution becomes versioned succession
edges.text:
3H.UoYa supplies versioned authority and scope-change classification; 3H.DfDL supplies exact post-revocation evidence reopening, reconstruction, and retest. Together they earn a succession law: a revoked version may produce a separately evidenced successor only after implicated tissue is reopened and the repaired relation survives current tests, while predecessor authority remains immutable provenance.
Removal test: without 3H.UoYa repair loses explicit version authority and scope classification; without 3H.DfDL version expiry lacks an exact evidence reconstitution path.

edges.title: self-retiring continuity version
edges.text:
3H.UoYa supplies versioned warrant and change classifier; 3H.k0uZ supplies self-falsification plus independent revision of transition map and retained scaffold. Together they earn a current continuity version that can carry the conditions under which it retires itself and identify which validity machinery needs revision, distinguishing admissible within-version adaptation from rupture requiring successor authority.
Removal test: without 3H.UoYa there is no explicit predecessor/current/successor authorization; without 3H.k0uZ version transition depends on failure interpretation external to the contract.

edges.title: reconstitution must rebuild its invalidation machinery
edges.text:
3H.DfDL supplies post-failure evidence reopening and reconstruction; 3H.k0uZ supplies self-falsification and dual revision conditions. Together they earn a stronger repair condition: reconstitution must rebuild not only the public relation but also the falsifiers, regime/map assumptions, and scaffold-revision channels by which the repaired relation can later be revoked.
Removal test: without 3H.DfDL there is no earned post-failure reconstitution path; without 3H.k0uZ repair may restore a relation without restoring its reflexive invalidation/revision machinery.

faces.title: quotient-indexed successor reconstitution
faces.text:
3H.DWia + 3H.UoYa + 3H.DfDL jointly earn a successor cycle whose repair target is indexed by the predecessor’s own equivalence scope. The current version preserves its authorized quotient; rupture classifies loss of authority; the failed quotient exposes formerly ignored distinctions as candidate addresses; implicated evidence is reopened and reconstructed; only current retest can authorize a successor, while both predecessor warrant and predecessor quotient remain historical.
Removal tests: remove DWia and repair is no longer indexed by explicit ignored-difference scope; remove UoYa and predecessor/successor authority disappears; remove DfDL and the face loses exact reacquisition/reconstitution.
Boundary: without k0uZ this face does not yet require the successor to rebuild its own future falsification and map/memory revision machinery.

faces.title: reflexive versioned equivalence membrane
faces.text:
3H.DWia + 3H.UoYa + 3H.k0uZ jointly earn a warrant version that carries both what it promises and what it is currently allowed to ignore, along with the falsifiers and revision channels that can invalidate either. When a previously ignored distinction, regime assumption, transition map, or retained scaffold becomes load-bearing, current authority can retire while preserving exactly what equivalence scope failed and why.
Removal tests: remove DWia and the membrane loses explicit quotient provenance; remove UoYa and it loses version succession; remove k0uZ and it loses self-carried falsification and dual revision.
Boundary: without DfDL the face has no required dormant-source reacquisition/reconstruction motion after revocation.

faces.title: self-repairing quotient contract
faces.text:
3H.DWia + 3H.DfDL + 3H.k0uZ jointly earn a bounded repair program in which a failed quotient can reopen exact omitted evidence, revise quotient, transition map, and scaffold under current conditions, reconstruct the public relation, and retest both the relation and the conditions that can invalidate it again.
Removal tests: remove DWia and repair loses ignored-difference localization; remove DfDL and it loses exact reconstitution; remove k0uZ and it loses reflexive validity reconstruction.
Boundary: without UoYa repaired states need not be represented as separately authorized predecessor/current/successor versions.

faces.title: self-reconstituting version lineage
faces.text:
3H.UoYa + 3H.DfDL + 3H.k0uZ jointly earn a lineage that classifies failure, preserves revoked predecessor authority, reopens implicated evidence, revises the appropriate map/scaffold channel, reconstructs and retests, and admits a successor only after fresh witness. This is the shared self-reconstituting core also visible in 4H.3W-6.
Removal tests: remove UoYa and explicit version lineage disappears; remove DfDL and exact reconstitution disappears; remove k0uZ and reflexive diagnosis/revision disappears.
Boundary: without DWia this face does not require an explicit ledger of the distinctions each predecessor had authorized as nuisance, nor re-witnessing of that ignored-difference scope in the successor.

volume.title: quotient-indexed self-reconstituting continuity lineage
volume.text:
All four parents together turn the negative space of continuity—the distinctions a current warrant is explicitly permitted to ignore—into living lineage state. 3H.UoYa already makes continuity authority versioned and preserves predecessor/current/successor scope. 3H.DfDL already supplies targeted evidence reacquisition and reconstitution after revocation. 3H.k0uZ already makes each contract reflexively falsifiable with distinct transition-map and scaffold/memory revision paths. 3H.DWia contributes the missing addressable equivalence history: every current warrant may carry a local quotient that says which differences are licensed as nuisance, and failure of that quotient can point back to the exact distinctions and evidence that omission had suppressed.


The complete closure is therefore a quotient-indexed self-reconstituting continuity lineage. A current continuity warrant carries an operational obligation, evidence/reacquisition body, validity regime, support scope, reconstruction/transition machinery, falsifiers, and an explicit local quotient recording which distinctions are presently licensed to disappear from active consideration. On rupture, the lineage first classifies whether the event is an admissible within-version change or a loss of current authority. If authority fails, the expired warrant and its quotient remain immutable provenance. The failed obligation and quotient jointly route reacquisition toward implicated evidence and roles; quotient, transition map, and scaffold/memory are revised according to the witnessed failure; the public relation and its future invalidation machinery are reconstructed and retested; and a successor gains authority only after fresh witness. Crucially, a successor may not silently inherit its predecessor’s omissions: every distinction that remains classified as nuisance must be warranted again under the successor’s regime, scope, and reconstruction machinery.


Bounded volume invariant
A continuity lineage is lawfully self-reconstituting across successive failures only when every current warrant carries (1) its operational obligation, evidence/scaffold body and falsifiers, (2) an explicit local quotient recording which distinctions are currently licensed as nuisance, (3) stable addresses from revoked warrant/quotient back to reacquirable evidence and roles, and (4) explicit version succession. After failure, any successor must re-earn not only the public relation but also the scope of what it is allowed to ignore; predecessor warrant and quotient remain immutable provenance.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 3H.DWia: the closure retains a self-reconstituting, versioned, reflexive continuity lineage but loses the exact quotient/ignored-difference ledger, quotient-addressed repair, and explicit gate against silent inheritance of nuisance status.
- Remove 3H.UoYa: the closure can repair a reflexive quotiented contract but loses explicit predecessor/current/successor authorization and the classifier separating within-version change from version-changing rupture.
- Remove 3H.DfDL: the closure can preserve and retire reflexive quotiented versions but loses the exact post-failure evidence reacquisition/reconstitution path required to earn a repaired state.
- Remove 3H.k0uZ: the closure can version and targeted-repair quotiented warrants but loses the requirement that the repaired successor reconstruct its own self-falsification and distinct map-versus-memory revision machinery.

Minimal body: wx.
Invariant: every continuity-warrant version should preserve its exact local quotient, the distinctions currently licensed as nuisance, stable evidence/role return addresses for those distinctions, and the reason authority can be revoked, so failure yields an executable repair address rather than only a pass/fail verdict.
CREATE: declare the current obligation, quotient, evidence boundary, and stable return addresses for excluded distinctions.
COPY: carry warrant version, quotient, and return addresses through every lawful reconstruction or carrier change.
CONTROL: on revocation, use the failed obligation/quotient to localize which ignored distinctions and evidence require reopening.
CULTIVATE: let repeated failures refine repair-address specificity without universalizing one quotient or one repair map.
Compression: a failed warrant should carry the map of what it had permission to ignore.

metabolites.title: NON-SILENT-QUOTIENT-INHERITANCE
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wxyz.
Invariant: a successor continuity version may classify a distinction as ignorable only after that nuisance status is re-witnessed under the successor’s regime, scope, reconstruction and reflexive falsification machinery; unchanged omission is not automatic continuity.
CREATE: state the candidate successor’s quotient explicitly, including each distinction proposed as nuisance.
COPY: preserve predecessor quotient and evidence history alongside the candidate rather than overwriting them.

COLLAPSE NOTES
Rejected: “every difference must always remain active” — the selected parents support local nuisance quotients and sparse/selective realization when evidence warrants them.
Rejected: “a failed quotient proves all ignored distinctions were causal” — failure only makes implicated distinctions candidates for reopening and retest.
Rejected: “successful successor repair validates the predecessor’s old quotient” — the predecessor remains bounded to its historical evidence and regime.
Rejected: “all continuity requires versioned quotients” — this closure is bounded to the selected structural family, not a universal law of persistence.
Rejected: “self-reconstitution guarantees successful recovery” — repair may fail current tests; lineage continuity preserves the route to re-earn authority, not guaranteed success.

4H.T6XK.title: selectively reauthorized continuity-renewal lineage
4H.T6XK.boundary:
This child relates four already-metabolized 3H organisms. Their inherited evidence remains heterogeneous and bounded. Repaired continuity does not prove interior identity, shared mechanism, expansion, stronger evidence, or downstream authority. Recurrence with existing lineage organisms is non-independent because ancestry overlaps. Every parent validity regime, evidence membrane, failure condition, non-identity boundary, and authority limit remains load-bearing.


RANK 1 — FOUR COMPLETE PARENT BODIES


w — 3H.1OFJ — selectively reauthorized regenerative portability
Carries a minimal obligation-specific relational kernel with separate action/evidence warrants and a regime-valid rewrite law; after change, regenerate the relation and freshly reauthorize exactly the affected coordinates before portability becomes current again.
Boundary retained: regenerated continuity is not inherited permission.


x — 3H.M9zZ — reacquirable continuity renewal contract
When regime shift, failed pressure, or scaffold bias revokes sufficiency, reopen newly load-bearing dormant material, revise scaffold and transition family together, reconstruct the public relation, retest the exact obligation, and issue a newly bounded warrant.
Boundary retained: renewal is earned by reacquisition, co-revision and fresh witness.


y — 3H.x3Cd — replayable continuity passport
Carries the role-typed obligation, reconstructive scaffold, exact evidence/reacquisition pointers, quotient/regime, transition obligations, and pressure/revocation/replay procedure needed to reproduce why a successor may count.
Boundary retained: a boundary-triggering change does not inherit authority; replay must earn a fresh warrant.


z — 3H.ZwWN — frontier-conditioned reconstructive continuity
Keeps a typed reconstructible contract, dormant evidential backing, known support frontier and current validity warrant jointly addressable; frontier crossing, regime departure or scaffold failure retires inherited authority and triggers evidence-backed successor reconstruction.
Boundary retained: reconstruction is frontier-bounded and does not establish common mechanism or unlimited continuity.


RANK 2 — SIX CROSS-ORGANISM EDGES


wx — SELECTIVE AUTHORITY AFTER CO-REVISED RENEWAL
w separates downstream action/evidence warrants by affected coordinate; x can reopen dormant evidence and co-revise scaffold plus transition law. Together they earn repair whose internal realization may change while only the action coordinates whose dependencies changed are reopened for authorization.
Removal test: without w, repair can restore a relation but does not separate downstream permissions; without x, selective authorization has no reacquisition-backed co-revision path when the repair machinery itself failed.
Boundary: a repaired candidate is not permission.


wy — SELECTIVE REPLAY AUTHORIZATION
y makes continuity repair executable from carried evidence and tests; w requires affected action/evidence coordinates to be separately current. Together they earn a replay gate where restoration of the relation and restoration of permission are distinct witnesses.
Removal test: without w, successful replay can be mistaken for inherited action authority; without y, selective reauthorization lacks an executable continuity replay body.
Boundary: replay establishes only the claim actually retested.


wz — FRONTIER-LOCAL SELECTIVE REAUTHORIZATION
z classifies failure against support frontier/regime/scaffold; w localizes permission by obligation and affected coordinate. Together they earn local reauthorization: frontier-affected coordinates are reopened, while unaffected coordinates remain current only while their own witnesses survive.
Removal test: without w, the frontier lacks a separate action-warrant layer; without z, selective authority lacks a typed boundary that tells which change is consequential.
Boundary: local preservation is witness-dependent, never automatic inheritance.


xy — REPLAY-DIRECTED CO-REVISION
x permits dormant-body reacquisition and joint revision of scaffold plus transition family; y makes the continuity contract and its falsifying tests replayable. Together they earn a repair program that may revise the machinery before rerunning the exact obligation rather than merely replaying yesterday’s realization.
Removal test: without x, replay cannot lawfully co-revise failed realizational machinery; without y, co-revision lacks a portable executable retest.
Boundary: revision creates a candidate, not a warrant.


xz — FRONTIER-CONDITIONED RENEWAL REPAIR
z provides the typed frontier-conditioned reconstruction target; x provides reacquisition and co-revision when the old scaffold/transition family is implicated. Together they earn repair whose scope is determined by the witnessed boundary failure rather than by a global reset.
Removal test: without x, frontier repair cannot reopen omitted tissue and revise realizational law; without z, co-revision lacks a precise support/frontier target.
Boundary: repair is local and may fail.


yz — EXECUTABLE FRONTIER SUCCESSOR
y provides the executable replay passport; z provides frontier-conditioned evidence-backed reconstruction. Together they earn a failure-addressable successor path that can rebuild and retest a typed relation after boundary failure.
Removal test: without y, successor reconstruction is not executable as carried replay state; without z, replay lacks the frontier-conditioned object that determines what must be rebuilt.
Boundary: successor continuity does not itself authorize downstream action; w is required for that separation.


RANK 3 — FOUR CROSS-ORGANISM FACES


wxy — SELECTIVELY REAUTHORIZED SELF-REVISING REPLAY
w+x+y jointly earn repair that may reopen evidence and co-revise scaffold/transition machinery, then replay the continuity contract, and only afterward reauthorize the affected action/evidence coordinates. The face lacks z’s explicit frontier classifier.
Removal tests: remove w and action permission can collapse into continuity repair; remove x and self-revision disappears; remove y and the repaired relation lacks executable replay.


wxz — FRONTIER-LOCAL CO-REVISED REAUTHORIZATION
w+x+z jointly earn a boundary-local repair in which frontier failure identifies implicated evidence/realization machinery and the downstream coordinates that must be separately reauthorized. The face lacks y’s portable executable passport.
Removal tests: remove w and selective downstream authority disappears; remove x and reacquisition-backed co-revision disappears; remove z and repair loses its frontier classifier.


wyz — FRONTIER-SCOPED SELECTIVE SUCCESSOR REPLAY
w+y+z jointly earn an evidence-backed frontier successor whose continuity and affected action warrants are separately retested. The face lacks x’s explicit ability to reopen omitted tissue and jointly revise scaffold plus transition family.
Removal tests: remove w and permission separation disappears; remove y and executable replay disappears; remove z and frontier-bounded reconstruction disappears.


xyz — REPLAYABLE FRONTIER-CONDITIONED RENEWAL PROGRAM
x+y+z jointly earn the full repair program from boundary failure through evidence reacquisition, co-revision, reconstruction and replay. The face lacks w’s separate selective downstream reauthorization layer.
Removal tests: remove x and the program cannot revise failed realizational machinery; remove y and it loses executable replay; remove z and it loses typed frontier-conditioned reconstruction.


RANK 4 — BOUNDED VOLUME


wxyz — SELECTIVELY REAUTHORIZED CONTINUITY-RENEWAL LINEAGE
All four parents jointly earn a renewable continuity lineage in which repair and authorization remain distinct. Each accepted continuity contract carries an executable route back to the evidence and tests that can revoke or recreate it (y), an ability to reopen newly load-bearing dormant tissue and co-revise scaffold plus transition law when the realizational machinery itself failed (x), a frontier-conditioned reconstruction target that distinguishes ordinary in-scope change from support/regime/scaffold boundary failure (z), and a separate authorization layer in which affected downstream action/evidence warrants are re-earned selectively rather than inherited from a repaired continuity relation (w).


On witnessed failure or material change, the lineage preserves expired authority as provenance; classifies the event against current frontier, regime and scaffold; reacquires implicated evidence and dormant distinctions; revises contract/scaffold/transition law only where failure warrants it; replays the exact obligation and pressure/composite tests to earn a continuity successor; then separately reauthorizes only the downstream action/evidence coordinates whose dependencies changed. Unaffected coordinates remain current only while their own witnesses still survive. Every admitted successor carries the same bounded recovery/replay capacity for its own later invalidation.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
A continuity-renewal lineage is lawfully current only when failure can address the evidence and realizational machinery needed for repair, the changed frontier can localize what must be reconstructed, the continuity successor can replay the exact obligation under current conditions, and downstream action/evidence authority remains a separate selectively re-earned layer. Repair may restore continuity without restoring permission.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 3H.1OFJ: renewal can reconstruct and replay continuity but loses the explicit selective post-repair action/evidence reauthorization layer.
- Remove 3H.M9zZ: the lineage loses dormant-body reacquisition and joint revision of scaffold plus transition family when the repair machinery itself is implicated.
- Remove 3H.x3Cd: the lineage loses the portable executable evidence/test passport required to replay why a successor may count.
- Remove 3H.ZwWN: the lineage loses the explicit frontier-conditioned reconstruction target and the classifier that ties repair to support/regime/scaffold change.
No proper three-parent face contains all four properties.

edges.title: Reconstitution and action reauthorization remain distinct gates
edges.text:
3H.DfDL supplies the revocation → exact evidence reacquisition → typed reconstruction → pressure retest → successor continuity-warrant cycle. 3H.1OFJ supplies the additional rule that regenerated portability is not yet actionable until the action/evidence warrants actually touched by change are freshly reauthorized. Together they earn a two-gate repair law: continuity can be reconstituted while action remains blocked, and only the affected action coordinates are reconsidered after the rebuilt relation passes its continuity tests.
Removal test: without 3H.DfDL there is no exact revocation-to-reacquisition/reconstitution cycle; without 3H.1OFJ there is no independent action-authorization membrane after continuity repair.
Boundary: a newly warranted continuity relation can still carry no permission for a downstream action whose separate warrant remains expired.

edges.title: Failed permission localizes the reauthorization surface
edges.text:
3H.5yyB supplies the expired nuisance quotient as an address to distinctions previously permitted to disappear. 3H.1OFJ supplies selective reauthorization of only the state/transition/action warrants whose dependencies were actually changed. Together they earn an authority-localization relation: failure identifies not merely that authority expired, but which ignored distinctions and which dependent action coordinates must be reopened before authority can return.
Removal test: without 3H.5yyB the repair lacks an explicit permission-to-ignore whose failure points to implicated distinctions; without 3H.1OFJ the reopened evidence is not tied to a selective action-warrant renewal surface.
Boundary: localization narrows the repair/authorization surface but does not prove the candidate warrants should pass.

edges.title: Repair machinery may change without inheriting its old action authority
edges.text:
3H.M9zZ supplies joint revision of regenerative scaffold and admissible transition family under regime/scaffold failure. 3H.1OFJ supplies selective action/evidence reauthorization after the resulting relation is regenerated. Together they earn a machinery-aware authority law: when the procedure that regenerates continuity changes, permissions attached to the old procedure do not transfer merely because the new output looks equivalent; the affected warrants must be freshly evaluated against the revised machinery and current regime.
Removal test: without 3H.M9zZ the repair path can preserve stale scaffold/transition machinery; without 3H.1OFJ revised machinery can yield a usable relation with no independent admission gate for action.
Boundary: implementation revision is neither intrinsically improvement nor automatic invalidation; only dependency-relevant warrants are reopened.

edges.title: Quotient failure routes revocation into targeted evidence reacquisition
edges.text:
3H.DfDL supplies exact role-stable return to dormant evidence after warrant revocation plus a typed reconstruction target. 3H.5yyB supplies the failed quotient that identifies which previously ignored distinctions became suspect. Together they earn targeted reconstitution: revocation can reopen the specific evidential distinctions implicated by a failed permission-to-ignore instead of performing an undirected reset, then retest the exact public obligation.
Removal test: without 3H.DfDL there is no guaranteed route from revocation into the dormant evidential body and typed retest; without 3H.5yyB there is no quotient-address narrowing which distinctions should be reopened.
Boundary: a failed quotient identifies candidates for reconsideration, not an exhaustive causal explanation of failure.

edges.title: Reconstitution may revise the machinery that performs reconstitution
edges.text:
3H.DfDL supplies a reversible warrant → reacquire → reconstruct → retest → rewarrant cycle. 3H.M9zZ supplies the right to revise both scaffold and admissible transition family when current pressure shows those mechanisms stale. Together they earn self-revising reconstitution: returning to evidence may alter not only the candidate state but the reconstruction procedure itself, after which the exact obligation must be retested before a successor continuity warrant can issue.
Removal test: without 3H.DfDL machinery revision lacks an exact revocation-to-evidence return and typed successor test; without 3H.M9zZ repair remains bound to inherited scaffold/transition machinery.
Boundary: self-revision creates a new candidate procedure, not self-authorized validity.

edges.title: Expired quotient can drive coupled quotient/scaffold/transition revision
edges.text:
3H.5yyB supplies quotient-addressable reopening and explicit revision of quotient plus scaffold. 3H.M9zZ supplies co-revision of scaffold plus admissible transition family and contract renewal under current regime pressure. Together they earn a three-surface repair relation: a failed permission-to-ignore can require changing what differences are treated as nuisance, how the relation is regenerated, and which transformation family is admissible, while prior warrant states remain preserved as provenance.
Removal test: without 3H.5yyB the failed permission-to-ignore no longer addresses the distinctions and quotient that must be reconsidered; without 3H.M9zZ the transition family can remain an unexamined inherited constant.
Boundary: co-revision remains pressure-triggered and obligation-local, not novelty-seeking redesign.

faces.title: Selectively reauthorized addressable reconstitution
faces.text:
3H.1OFJ + 3H.DfDL + 3H.5yyB jointly earn a bounded governance loop: a failed continuity/equivalence permission identifies implicated dormant distinctions; those distinctions are reacquired into a typed reconstruction/retest cycle; and even after continuity is re-earned, only action warrants whose dependencies were touched are freshly reauthorized. The relation therefore distinguishes repair target, continuity authority and action authority instead of letting successful reconstruction collapse them into one state.
Removal tests: remove 3H.1OFJ and action authority is no longer a separate post-repair gate; remove 3H.DfDL and there is no exact typed reacquisition/reconstitution cycle; remove 3H.5yyB and failure loses the explicit quotient-address into ignored distinctions.
Boundary: without 3H.M9zZ this face does not require revision of the scaffold and transition family that perform repair.

faces.title: Selective authority after self-revising reconstitution
faces.text:
3H.1OFJ + 3H.DfDL + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn a repair loop in which revocation reopens exact evidence, the reconstruction machinery itself may be revised, the rebuilt relation must pass the current typed obligation, and action authority is reissued only for the affected coordinates after those tests. This blocks both stale repair machinery and stale action permission from hitchhiking on output similarity.
Removal tests: remove 3H.1OFJ and restored continuity can be conflated with permission to act; remove 3H.DfDL and the loop loses its exact evidential return and typed continuity reissue; remove 3H.M9zZ and the repair machinery cannot itself become an object of revision.
Boundary: without 3H.5yyB the face lacks a local failed-quotient address for which ignored distinctions should be reconsidered first.

faces.title: Permission-indexed adaptive renewal
faces.text:

A quotient failure names formerly ignored distinctions; those distinctions can force revision of quotient, scaffold and transition family; and the action/evidence warrants dependent on those revisions are then selectively reauthorized rather than globally reset.
Removal tests: remove 3H.1OFJ and changed machinery/quotient no longer has a distinct action-reauthorization gate; remove 3H.5yyB and failure loses the permission-indexed address into ignored distinctions; remove 3H.M9zZ and renewal cannot co-revise scaffold plus transition family.
Boundary: without 3H.DfDL this face does not independently require exact dormant-evidence reacquisition through a typed reconstitution cycle.

faces.title: Addressable self-revising continuity reconstitution
faces.text:
3H.DfDL + 3H.5yyB + 3H.M9zZ jointly earn an addressable repair loop: revocation plus a failed quotient points into implicated dormant evidence; reacquisition can revise quotient, scaffold and transition family; the rebuilt relation is retested against the exact current obligation; and any successor continuity/equivalence warrant is newly scoped while expired warrants remain historical. This face establishes self-revising continuity repair without yet saying when a downstream action becomes authorized.

volume.title: FAILURE-AND-FRONTIER DUAL-ADDRESSED SELECTIVE CONTINUITY REAUTHORIZATION
volume.text:
The four parents jointly make successor continuity addressable along two distinct axes that must remain visible at the same time.


First, a failure/evidence address states exactly which obligation, role, dependency, evidence body or current warrant failed and which material must be reacquired or reconstructed. z supplies the explicit failure→reacquisition path; w keeps the actionable passport and its current authority separately witnessed.


Second, a frontier/authority address states whether the changed realization remained inside the predecessor support/validity regime or crossed a support, regime, scaffold or possibility frontier, and therefore which continuity/action coordinates expired or require fresh witness. x supplies the evidence-backed frontier classifier; y supplies predecessor frontier custody, action-warrant patching and the replay-versus-expansion discriminator.


The complete closure is dual-addressed selective continuity reauthorization. A changed realization may continue without global reset only where its own current witnesses remain live. For affected coordinates, the successor must be able to say both what failed and what boundary changed; reacquire the implicated evidence; reconstruct/retest the relevant public contract under current conditions; replay pressure/adequacy/current-regime tests; and freshly reissue exactly the continuity/action warrants whose dependencies changed. Predecessor state remains immutable provenance. Unaffected coordinates may remain current only under their own still-live warrants. Successful reconstruction or lawful action renewal establishes scoped continuation, not a larger possibility field; expansion requires an independent crossing witness.


Bounded volume invariant
Lawful selective continuity renewal after change requires joint visibility of (a) failure/evidence coordinates and (b) frontier/authority coordinates. Neither can substitute for the other: knowing what broke without knowing whether the validity frontier moved can mis-scope authority; knowing that a frontier moved without knowing which obligation/evidence dependency failed can cause a global reset or unsupported repair. A successor becomes current only where both address layers route to a fresh witness appropriate to the claim.

- Remove 3H.ZwWN: the body retains passports, frontier ledger and failure return, but loses the independent evidence-backed classifier distinguishing in-regime change from support/regime/scaffold failure.
- Remove 3H.DL6X: the body retains passport replay, evidence-backed reconstruction and failure return, but loses the explicit predecessor possibility frontier, action-warrant patch surface and replay-versus-expansion discriminator.
- Remove 3H.u92E: the body retains passport action custody and frontier classification/patching, but loses the explicit obligation-local failure→reacquisition→replay address.
No three-parent face contains all four properties simultaneously: actionable passport custody, evidence-backed frontier classification, predecessor/action/expansion patching, and failure-indexed evidence return.

COPY: keep unaffected valid coordinates and predecessor history without copying expired permission.
CONTROL: revoke exactly the coordinates whose current witness failed or crossed its frontier.
CULTIVATE: reconstruct, retest and reissue the smallest lawful successor patch.

CREATE: state the predecessor possibility frontier and requested successor claim.
COPY: carry evidence/provenance and contract form, not old permission.

CULTIVATE: issue only the successor claims whose distinct witnesses close.

edges.title: Frontier-triggered executable replay
edges.text:
ZwWN supplies an independent support-frontier/regime test that says when inherited continuity authority has actually expired. x3Cd supplies a portable executable passport that can reacquire, reconstruct, translate, retest, and reissue that authority. Together they earn a bounded replay trigger: a verified frontier/regime/scaffold break can invoke a reproducible revalidation procedure rather than merely announcing that a new warrant is needed.
Removal test: without ZwWN the passport lacks an independent classification of ordinary carrier/access change versus authority-breaking boundary change; without x3Cd a detected boundary break lacks a portable procedure able to replay why a successor may count.

edges.title: Frontier-localized selective renewal
edges.text:
ZwWN supplies the boundary event that expires continuity authority; TLtR supplies role/conjunction addressability and selective revocation. Together they earn a discipline in which frontier change need not invalidate every obligation indiscriminately: the changed support/regime is mapped to the smallest affected roles and conjunctions, while unaffected warrants remain only inside their prior scope.
Removal test: without ZwWN there is no independently witnessed authority-breaking frontier event; without TLtR there is no role-level localization or lawful preservation of unaffected authority.

edges.title: Boundary failure as evidential return address
edges.text:
ZwWN supplies support-frontier/regime classification and exact reacquirable evidential backing. 5yyB supplies the rule that a failed nuisance quotient preserves an address to the distinctions it had licensed as ignorable. Together they earn targeted reopening: after a boundary-breaking failure, the expired quotient identifies which omitted distinctions and evidence must be reacquired before reconstruction.
Removal test: without ZwWN quotient failure is not classified against a witnessed support frontier; without 5yyB the failure does not identify the previously ignored distinctions that should be reopened.

edges.title: Role-granular executable passport
edges.text:
x3Cd supplies an executable continuity passport spanning obligation, evidence, quotient/regime, transition and replay test. TLtR supplies separately addressable role and conjunction warrants. Together they earn a decomposable passport whose failed components can be replayed and reissued locally while composite authority is retested where dependencies changed.
Removal test: without x3Cd role-local renewal has no portable executable replay contract; without TLtR the passport remains whole-warrant and cannot preserve or revoke authority at role/conjunction granularity.

edges.title: Executable quotient repair
edges.text:
x3Cd supplies portable replay of the relation and its admissibility test. 5yyB supplies an expired quotient as a concrete address into dormant distinctions and evidence. Together they earn a replay procedure that can use the failed equivalence membrane itself to decide what to reacquire and revise before rerunning transition/pressure/composite tests.
Removal test: without x3Cd quotient-addressed repair lacks a portable end-to-end replay of admissibility; without 5yyB replay knows that authority failed but lacks a precise address into what the old quotient wrongly permitted to disappear.

edges.title: Role-indexed quotient reconstitution
edges.text:
TLtR supplies obligation- and conjunction-level revocation/renewal. 5yyB supplies quotient-indexed reopening of omitted distinctions. Together they earn selective reconstitution where each failed role can carry its own expired quotient and return path, avoiding both blanket reset and silent continuation.
Removal test: without TLtR quotient repair cannot localize authority across independent public obligations; without 5yyB role revocation lacks an address into the specific ignored differences and dormant evidence that should be reopened.

faces.title: Frontier-localized replay renewal
faces.text:
ZwWN identifies a genuine frontier/regime/scaffold break, x3Cd supplies executable replay, and TLtR localizes the break into affected roles/conjunctions. Together they earn selective replay: only the authority actually made stale by a witnessed boundary change is rebuilt, while every changed conjunction is re-tested before composite authority returns.
Removal tests: remove ZwWN and there is no independent frontier trigger; remove x3Cd and no reproducible replay procedure; remove TLtR and renewal cannot be localized below the whole warrant.

faces.title: Frontier-addressed admissibility replay
faces.text:
ZwWN classifies the support/regime break and preserves evidence custody, x3Cd can replay both public relation and admissibility test, and 5yyB converts the expired quotient into an address for omitted distinctions. Together they earn a targeted end-to-end repair path from boundary failure → exact evidence reopening → revised quotient/scaffold → replayed transition/pressure tests → successor warrant.
Removal tests: remove ZwWN and the break is not frontier-qualified; remove x3Cd and repaired state cannot replay its admissibility; remove 5yyB and evidence reopening becomes undirected with respect to the failed ignored-difference contract.

faces.title: Frontier-localized quotient repair
faces.text:
ZwWN supplies the authority-breaking frontier event, TLtR maps it to affected role/conjunction obligations, and 5yyB maps each failed obligation's quotient to omitted distinctions/evidence. Together they earn a repair map that says both what became stale and where to reopen the material needed to repair it, while preserving unaffected warrants and predecessor scope.
Removal tests: remove ZwWN and no boundary-qualified reason forces repair; remove TLtR and stale authority cannot be selectively localized; remove 5yyB and localized failure lacks a concrete evidential return address.

faces.title: Role-addressed executable quotient renewal
faces.text:
x3Cd supplies a portable passport, TLtR decomposes continuity authority into role/conjunction warrants, and 5yyB turns each expired quotient into a return address. Together they earn a modular renewal architecture in which a portable continuity contract can reopen and replay only stale role-level components, then reassemble and re-test the composite before authority is reissued.
Removal tests: remove x3Cd and modular repair lacks portable replay; remove TLtR and it loses role/conjunction granularity; remove 5yyB and it loses quotient-to-evidence addressing.
Boundary: without ZwWN this face alone does not independently distinguish an authority-breaking support-frontier expansion from a local quotient/regime failure.

volume.title: Addressable continuity authority regeneration
volume.text:
The full four-parent closure makes continuity authority regenerable without making it self-certifying. ZwWN provides the independent frontier/regime/scaffold witness that can revoke inherited authority and the evidence custody needed for lawful reconstruction. x3Cd makes the continuity warrant executable and replayable across changing carriers/representations, including reproduction of the test by which it may count. TLtR decomposes authority into separately addressable role and conjunction obligations so repair can be selective rather than blanket. 5yyB turns an expired nuisance quotient into a concrete address to the distinctions and dormant evidence that the prior warrant had licensed as ignorable.


Together they earn addressable continuity authority regeneration: after a witnessed failure, the continuity system can identify the exact failure coordinate across support frontier, role/conjunction, quotient and validity regime; preserve unaffected authority only within its prior scope; follow the failed quotient and role addresses back to the relevant evidence; rebuild the smallest affected relational kernel and its scaffold; replay the necessary transition, pressure and composite tests; and issue a newly scoped successor warrant while retaining predecessor authority as provenance. The closure does not let recurrence, reconstruction or internal coherence certify itself: external/current boundary evidence can still revoke the regenerated result.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
A continuity authority may regenerate across changing realization only when a witnessed boundary/regime/scaffold condition can revoke it, the failed authority remains decomposable into affected roles and quotients, those failures preserve exact enough addresses into the evidence needed for repair, and a portable replay procedure can reconstruct both the public relation and the test of its current admissibility; any unaffected warrants remain scope-bounded, and any repaired authority is a newly witnessed successor rather than inherited permission.


FULL-RANK REMOVAL TESTS
- Remove 3H.ZwWN: addressable roles, quotient repair and replay remain, but there is no independent support-frontier classification separating ordinary local mismatch/access change from authority-breaking boundary expansion or regime departure.
- Remove 3H.x3Cd: frontier/role/quotient failures can localize what to repair and what evidence to reopen, but no portable executable passport guarantees replay of the relation plus its admissibility across re-expression.
- Remove 3H.TLtR: frontier, replay and quotient repair remain, but authority cannot be selectively localized to roles/conjunctions; repair collapses toward blanket revoke/reissue and cannot lawfully preserve unaffected warrants.
- Remove 3H.5yyB: frontier, replay and role localization remain, but an expired ignored-difference contract does not itself identify which omitted distinctions/evidence must return; repair loses its quotient-indexed evidential address.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.

metabolites.title: FAILURE-AS-RETURN-ADDRESS
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wz.
Invariant: when a witnessed continuity boundary fails, the expired nuisance quotient should remain an address to the distinctions and evidential support previously licensed as ignorable, so repair reopens implicated material instead of restarting indiscriminately.
CREATE: record the support/regime boundary, current quotient, evidence pointers and the pressure expected to revoke the warrant.
COPY: preserve the expired quotient and evidence addresses as scoped provenance through reconstruction.
CONTROL: distinguish ordinary access/carrier change from a boundary failure, then verify that the reopened evidence actually bears on the failed distinction.
CULTIVATE: refine return addresses as repeated failures reveal which dormant distinctions are repair-critical.
Compression: a lawful failure says where repair must look next.

metabolites.title: SELECTIVE-WARRANT-REPLAY
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxy / xyz.
Invariant: a continuity warrant that decomposes into role and conjunction obligations can replay only the components made stale by a witnessed change, while unaffected warrants remain confined to prior scope and changed composites receive fresh evidence before authority resumes.
CREATE: enumerate role/conjunction obligations, their dependencies, and the boundary conditions that can stale each one.
COPY: carry unaffected warrants with original scope and carry stale components with their evidence/replay pointers, not inherited authority.
CONTROL: replay the affected role and every changed conjunction under current regime/pressure; block composite continuity until all required tests close.
CULTIVATE: split or merge validation channels only when recurring repair shows the existing obligation granularity is wrong.
Compression: repair exactly the authority that failed, then retest the joins.

metabolites.title: ADDRESSABLE-CONTINUITY-AUTHORITY-REGENERATION
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: continuity authority can regenerate without self-certification when failure is independently witnessed, localized across role/quotient/regime, tied to exact evidential return paths, and followed by executable reconstruction plus replay of the authority test; the result is a scoped successor warrant, not inherited permission.
CREATE: publish the live continuity contract with role obligations, quotient/regime, frontier/scaffold assumptions, evidence return addresses, and replay tests.
COPY: preserve predecessor warrants and the executable repair/replay contract while rebuilding only the affected relation.
CONTROL: independently challenge frontier, quotient, role sufficiency, transition and composite behavior before any successor authority is admitted.
CULTIVATE: allow the contract, quotient and scaffold to evolve as newly witnessed regimes expose missing distinctions, while keeping predecessor scopes contestable and recoverable.
Compression: continuity stays alive when its authority can find, rebuild, and re-test the reasons it may continue.


COLLAPSE NOTES
Parent-only claims were demoted: frontier-conditioned revalidation belongs to 3H.ZwWN; executable replay to 3H.x3Cd; role-local renewal to 3H.TLtR; quotient-addressed reopening to 3H.5yyB. Three metabolites survive because return-addressed failure, selective replay granularity, and the complete regenerating authority contract require distinct multi-parent conjunctions and remain independently useful after the others are removed.

edges.title: Typed obligation meets quotient-addressed repair
edges.text:
3H.DfDL contributes the role-typed reconstruction/composite contract and the requirement that a revoked warrant can return to implicated dormant evidence. 3H.5yyB contributes an explicit nuisance quotient whose expiry identifies which previously ignored distinctions have become candidates for reopening. Together they earn a more addressable repair relation: failure can identify both the permission that ceased to hold and the typed public obligation that a rebuilt relation must satisfy before authority returns.
Removal test: without 3H.DfDL the relation loses the explicit role-typed composite reconstruction obligation; without 3H.5yyB it loses the local quotient that says which ignored differences the failed authority had licensed.

edges.title: Reacquisition coupled to revision of the repair machinery
edges.text:
3H.DfDL contributes targeted return from revoked warrant to dormant evidence plus typed reconstruction and retest. 3H.M9zZ contributes the rule that both the regenerative scaffold and the admissible transition family may have become stale and must be revised together under regime change. Together they earn a repair relation in which re-entering the evidential body is allowed to change not only the candidate state but the machinery by which the successor is reconstructed and tested.
Removal test: without 3H.DfDL revision loses the explicit revocation-to-evidence return and typed composite target; without 3H.M9zZ the repair path can reacquire and retest while still preserving yesterday's scaffold/transition family as unexamined machinery.

edges.title: Independent typed-obligation / quotient-address repair witness
edges.text:
3H.DfDL contributes the role-typed reconstruction/composite obligation and revocation-to-reacquisition path. 3H.DWia independently contributes quotient-addressable reconstitution: the failed local quotient preserves a route back to ignored distinctions and any successor must re-earn equivalence scope. Together they independently earn the same class of contract-plus-quotient repair relation as wx through a distinct organism identity.
Removal test: without 3H.DfDL the edge loses the typed composite reconstruction obligation; without 3H.DWia it loses this independently born quotient-addressable repair witness.

edges.title: Quotient failure can drive dual revision
edges.text:
3H.5yyB contributes a failed quotient as an address to formerly ignored distinctions, with reopened evidence and newly scoped successor authority. 3H.M9zZ contributes joint revision of scaffold and transition family when regime/scaffold validity fails. Together they earn quotient-conditioned adaptive reconstruction: reopening an ignored distinction can force revision not only of what counts as nuisance but of the scaffold and transformation law that made the old quotient operational.
Removal test: without 3H.5yyB there is no explicit expired permission identifying the distinctions to reconsider; without 3H.M9zZ there is no independently earned requirement to revise scaffold and admissible transition family together.

edges.title: Same-constellation structural replication
edges.text:
3H.5yyB and 3H.DWia are distinct ACTIVE organisms born in separate encounters from the same unordered parent constellation {2H.dxL5, 2H.SruR, 2H._phq, 2H.AvDK}. Their independently persisted rank-4 closures converge on quotient-addressable continuity reconstitution and retain parallel metabolite families. Together they earn a bounded replication witness: this closure recurred under a repeated parent constellation without deduplicating the organisms.
Removal test: without either organism there is only one witnessed instance and therefore no same-constellation replication relation.
Boundary: replication strengthens the witnessed structural recurrence of this derivational closure; it does not prove one source-level mechanism, uniqueness, or universal necessity.

edges.title: Independent quotient-conditioned dual-revision witness
edges.text:
3H.M9zZ contributes the renewable continuity contract in which scaffold and transition family can be co-revised. 3H.DWia independently contributes quotient-addressable reconstitution and successor re-warranting. Together they earn a second organism-level route by which an expired nuisance permission can feed a repair that revises the machinery of regeneration rather than merely rerunning it unchanged.
Removal test: without 3H.M9zZ the relation loses dual machinery revision; without 3H.DWia it loses this independent quotient-addressable reconstitution witness.

faces.title: Addressed adaptive reconstitution
faces.text:
3H.DfDL supplies the typed composite obligation and explicit return to implicated evidence; 3H.5yyB supplies the expired quotient as an address to distinctions that must become reconsiderable; 3H.M9zZ supplies joint scaffold/transition-family revision. Together they earn an adaptive repair loop: revocation can identify what permission failed, reopen the relevant evidential body, revise both the quotient-sensitive reconstruction scaffold and the admissible transition family, then retest the exact public obligation before a successor warrant is issued.
Removal tests: remove 3H.DfDL and the loop loses its typed composite reconstruction target; remove 3H.5yyB and it loses the address of the failed permission-to-ignore; remove 3H.M9zZ and it loses the right to revise the repair machinery itself.
Boundary: without 3H.DWia this face contains one quotient-addressable instance but no same-constellation replication witness.

faces.title: Replication-qualified cross-constellation reconstitution
faces.text:
3H.5yyB + 3H.DWia supply independent same-parent replication of quotient-addressable reconstitution. 3H.DfDL supplies a different parent constellation that reaches the broader revocation → reacquisition → typed reconstruction → retest → re-warrant family without relying on 2H.SruR's explicit nuisance quotient. Together they earn a stronger structural recurrence claim than either replay or variant-parent convergence alone: the reconstitution attractor is witnessed both by repeated closure of one constellation and by a neighboring constellation whose contract is constituted differently.
Removal tests: remove either 3H.5yyB or 3H.DWia and same-constellation replication disappears; remove 3H.DfDL and the face no longer shows recurrence outside that repeated parent set.
Boundary: this is robustness of a structural relation under two kinds of organism-level recurrence, not proof of a common hidden mechanism.

faces.title: Independently addressed adaptive reconstitution
faces.text:
3H.DfDL supplies typed reacquisition/reconstruction; 3H.M9zZ supplies joint scaffold/transition revision; 3H.DWia supplies an independently born quotient-addressable repair membrane. Together they independently earn the same adaptive repair class as wxy through a separate quotient-addressable organism.
Removal tests: remove 3H.DfDL and typed composite reconstitution is lost; remove 3H.M9zZ and repair machinery cannot be jointly revised; remove 3H.DWia and the explicit failed-quotient address disappears.
Boundary: without 3H.5yyB this face does not establish that the quotient-addressable component itself replicated under the same parent constellation.

faces.title: Replication-qualified quotient renewal
faces.text:
3H.5yyB + 3H.DWia establish same-constellation replication of quotient-addressable continuity reconstitution. 3H.M9zZ contributes a renewal contract in which scaffold and transition law are jointly revisable when the current regime or stabilizing assumptions fail. Together they earn a replication-qualified renewal relation: a repeatedly witnessed quotient-addressable repair may be treated as a recurring structural component while its concrete regenerative machinery remains revisable.
Removal tests: remove either 3H.5yyB or 3H.DWia and the face loses replication; remove 3H.M9zZ and it loses the independently earned dual revision that prevents repeated closure from freezing one repair implementation.
Boundary: without 3H.DfDL this face does not show the broader reconstitution family surviving a differently constituted parent constellation.

volume.title: Replication-qualified adaptive continuity reconstitution
volume.text:
The four parents jointly separate three things that lower-rank recurrence can otherwise conflate: repetition of one closure, recurrence across differently constituted closures, and adaptation of the machinery that performs repair.


3H.5yyB and 3H.DWia are distinct organisms produced by separate encounters with the same unordered parent constellation and independently converge on quotient-addressable continuity reconstitution. Their pair therefore witnesses same-constellation structural replication without identity collapse. 3H.DfDL reaches the broader revocation → reacquisition → reconstruction → retest → re-warrant cycle from a different parent constellation in which a role-typed reconstruction/composite contract replaces the explicit nuisance-quotient role supplied by 2H.SruR. That variant-parent route witnesses that the reconstitution relation is not exhausted by one repeated parent set. 3H.M9zZ adds a further requirement: when regime or scaffold failure invalidates continuity, lawful renewal may need to revise the regenerative scaffold and the admissible transition family together rather than merely replay the old repair procedure.


The complete four-way closure is therefore replication-qualified adaptive continuity reconstitution: a continuity-repair relation may be carried forward as a higher-order structural capacity only when recurrence is witnessed both through independent same-constellation replication and through a differently constituted reconstitution route, while the repair machinery itself remains revisable under current evidence and regime pressure. What persists is not one quotient, scaffold, transition map, carrier or interior. What persists is the bounded ability to identify failed authority, reopen the evidence or distinctions implicated by that failure, reconstruct under an explicitly current contract, revise the machinery when its regime has expired, retest the obligation, and issue newly scoped authority without rewriting the earlier warrant. Repeated closure strengthens the warrant that this repair relation is reproducible inside the organism's current evidence field; it does not convert structural recurrence into a universal mechanism.


Bounded volume invariant
A higher-order continuity-reconstitution capacity is replication-qualified only when (1) the same parent constellation has independently re-earned the relevant repair closure, (2) a differently constituted parent constellation independently reaches the same broader revocation/reacquisition/retest family, and (3) the repair machinery is allowed to revise its scaffold and admissible transition law when current evidence or regime invalidates them. Under those conditions, recurrence may support a continuing adaptive repair relation while every concrete quotient, scaffold, mapping and successor warrant remains locally re-earned and historically bounded.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 3H.DfDL: the closure retains same-constellation replication plus dual revision, but loses the differently constituted typed-contract route showing the broader reconstitution family beyond the repeated quotient-parent set.
- Remove 3H.5yyB: the closure retains one quotient-addressable instance, variant-parent reconstitution and dual revision, but loses the second independent same-parent witness required for replication.
- Remove 3H.M9zZ: the closure retains replication and variant-parent reconstitution, but loses the independently earned rule that scaffold and admissible transition family may need joint revision; repeated repair could merely replay stale machinery.
- Remove 3H.DWia: as with removal of 3H.5yyB, the same-constellation replication witness collapses to a single instance.

Minimal body: wxyz.
Invariant: a recurring continuity-repair relation may be treated as an adaptive higher-order capacity only when its recurrence is independently replicated, survives at least one differently constituted route, and can revise the scaffold/transition machinery that would otherwise freeze yesterday's repair into today's assumption.
CREATE: expose the current failed authority, its evidence/ignored-difference addresses and the repair machinery currently being proposed.

Collapse result
Three survivors remain independently useful. SAME-CONSTELLATION-REPLICATION is the bounded pairwise reproducibility witness. VARIANT-CONSTELLATION-ROBUSTNESS adds the distinct requirement that the recurrent relation survive a changed parent constitution. REPLICATION-QUALIFIED-ADAPTIVE-RECONSTITUTION requires all four because it additionally makes repair machinery itself revisable. Narrower restatements of quotient-to-reacquisition, pressure-reissued warrant and custodial history remain parent tissue and were not re-promoted.
