edges.title: Failed quotients index the selective reauthorization cone
edges.text:
3H.DWia supplies an explicit licensed nuisance quotient whose failure points back to implicated ignored distinctions and evidence. 3H.1OFJ supplies selective reauthorization over exactly the state/transition/warrant coordinates touched by change. Together they earn a dependency-indexed repair law: when an ignored difference becomes consequential, the failed quotient identifies not only what evidence must reopen but which downstream permissions depended on that omission.
Removal test: without DWia, reauthorization can be selective but lacks an explicit ignored-difference address; without 1OFJ, quotient failure can reopen evidence but does not localize the authority set that must be renewed.
Boundary: dependency localization does not imply that every downstream warrant fails.

edges.title: Quotient failure must be classified against the old frontier
edges.text:
3H.DWia supplies the failed quotient and targeted reacquisition path. 3H.ZwWN supplies the distinction between change inside the witnessed support and genuine frontier/regime/scaffold departure. Together they earn classified reopening: a newly consequential distinction may reveal either an old omission that was already reachable or a true boundary change, and the repair path must preserve that distinction before deciding whether predecessor authority can survive.
Removal test: without DWia, frontier classification lacks a specific failed ignored-difference class; without ZwWN, reopening cannot distinguish in-frontier repair from successor-requiring expansion.
Boundary: frontier crossing is a classification of support/validity, not proof that a proposed successor is valid.

edges.title: A replayable passport must carry quotient-to-evidence return addresses
edges.text:
3H.DWia supplies quotient-indexed reacquisition. 3H.x3Cd supplies the executable passport whose admissibility test travels with the relation. Together they earn a targeted replay contract: every currently licensed ignored-difference class that can affect the obligation must remain linked to the evidence/roles required to challenge and revise it.
Removal test: without DWia, replay can rerun tests but may not know which dormant distinctions a failed quotient licensed away; without x3Cd, the return map is local repair tissue rather than portable executable continuity state.
Boundary: a return address enables reconsideration, not automatic restoration.

edges.title: Selective reauthorization is frontier-sensitive
edges.text:
3H.1OFJ supplies coordinate-local renewal of action/evidence warrants. 3H.ZwWN supplies predecessor/successor semantics conditioned on support-frontier and regime change. Together they earn partial succession: untouched coordinates may remain current across in-frontier change, while only coordinates whose validity envelope was crossed must retire into provenance and receive successor authority after retest.
Removal test: without 1OFJ, frontier crossing tends toward whole-contract renewal; without ZwWN, selective renewal lacks the boundary test deciding when predecessor authority is retainable.
Boundary: preservation of unaffected authority requires an actual dependency witness, not convenience.

edges.title: Passport replay separates continuity restoration from action restoration
edges.text:
3H.1OFJ supplies independent action/evidence warrant custody and selective reauthorization. 3H.x3Cd supplies replay of reconstruction, transition, quotient/regime, and admissibility testing. Together they earn a two-stage executable return: replay may reconstruct a relation and its continuity warrant, but downstream action resumes only where the action-relevant warrants touched by the replay have also been freshly satisfied.
Removal test: without 1OFJ, replayed continuity can silently become action permission; without x3Cd, selective authorization lacks a portable reproducible admissibility path.
Boundary: successful replay is necessary only for the scoped relation; it is not global certification.

edges.title: Successor passports must preserve the predecessor boundary they crossed
edges.text:
3H.ZwWN supplies explicit frontier-conditioned predecessor/successor warrant semantics. 3H.x3Cd supplies a passport carrying the transition/admissibility test. Together they earn boundary-carrying succession: a successor passport must retain the predecessor frontier/regime and the exact crossing witness so that new authority cannot be mistaken for inherited old authority.
Removal test: without ZwWN, the passport can replay but lacks a principled boundary between retained and successor authority; without x3Cd, frontier succession lacks a portable executable test history.
Boundary: provenance of a boundary crossing does not itself license the successor.

faces.title: Quotient-localized frontier-classified selective reauthorization
faces.text:
DWia identifies which formerly ignored distinction became load-bearing; 1OFJ maps changed dependencies to the exact warrants requiring renewal; ZwWN classifies whether the event remains inside the old support or crosses a frontier/regime/scaffold boundary. Together they earn a repair membrane that can preserve unaffected authority while forcing successor authority only where a localized failure actually leaves the predecessor validity envelope.
Removal tests: remove DWia and the failure loses its ignored-difference address; remove 1OFJ and renewal loses coordinate-level authority selection; remove ZwWN and the system cannot distinguish in-frontier repair from boundary-crossing succession.
Boundary: without x3Cd this face does not yet require that the whole decision procedure travel as replayable passport state.

faces.title: Quotient-indexed executable reauthorization replay
faces.text:
DWia contributes quotient→evidence/role return addresses; 1OFJ contributes the downstream warrant-dependency cone and selective action reauthorization; x3Cd contributes replayable reconstruction and admissibility tests. Together they earn an executable failure response: replay the implicated evidence and relation, then reissue only those action/evidence warrants whose dependencies ran through the failed quotient.
Removal tests: remove DWia and replay becomes less targeted; remove 1OFJ and replay cannot distinguish restored continuity from restored action authority; remove x3Cd and the rule is not a portable reproducible passport procedure.
Boundary: without ZwWN this face does not independently classify whether the repaired state remains under the predecessor frontier or requires successor status.

faces.title: Frontier-aware replayable quotient succession
faces.text:
DWia contributes the explicit quotient and its dormant-evidence addresses; ZwWN contributes frontier/regime classification and predecessor/successor warrant separation; x3Cd contributes the executable passport test. Together they earn a historical repair object in which the predecessor’s ignored-difference policy, support boundary, evidence return map, and admissibility test remain inspectable while a candidate successor is rebuilt.
Removal tests: remove DWia and the predecessor no longer records what it had permission to ignore; remove ZwWN and the distinction between in-frontier replay and successor passage disappears; remove x3Cd and the inherited test is no longer executable portable state.
Boundary: without 1OFJ this face does not decide the downstream action-warrant subset that may be renewed.

faces.title: Selectively reauthorized passport succession
faces.text:
1OFJ contributes selective action/evidence warrant reauthorization; ZwWN contributes boundary-conditioned predecessor/successor semantics; x3Cd contributes replayable continuity passport state and admissibility testing. Together they earn selective succession: after a changed envelope, the passport may preserve still-current coordinates, retire crossed coordinates into provenance, replay the candidate successor relation, and issue new scoped authority only for coordinates that pass current tests.
Removal tests: remove 1OFJ and succession cannot remain permission-local; remove ZwWN and predecessor/successor scope blurs; remove x3Cd and the successor does not carry a replayable reason it counts.
Boundary: without DWia this face does not localize repair to distinctions specifically implicated by a failed quotient.

volume.title: Quotient-localized selective continuity passport succession
volume.text:
The all-four closure adds a precise coupling between failure localization, evidence reacquisition, frontier classification, replay, and permission renewal. 3H.DWia turns a failed local equivalence quotient into an address for the distinctions and evidence that had been licensed away. 3H.1OFJ turns change into a dependency-local authorization problem rather than a whole-system reset. 3H.ZwWN decides whether the event is reparable under the predecessor frontier or constitutes a boundary/regime/scaffold departure requiring successor state. 3H.x3Cd makes the continuity contract and its own admissibility test replayable across changing realization.


The resulting invariant is quotient-localized selective continuity passport succession: a replayable continuity passport may renew authority after failure or change only when the predecessor’s licensed quotient localizes the implicated evidence/roles, the change is classified against the predecessor support frontier and validity regime, the candidate relation replays both its public obligation and the test of its admissibility, and the system reissues only those action/evidence warrants whose dependency cone actually changed. Unaffected authority may remain current when its witnesses remain intact; frontier-crossed authority must become an explicitly scoped successor. The repair path and permission path remain distinct, and the predecessor quotient, revoked state, crossing witness, and warrant history remain provenance rather than being rewritten by later success.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
When a continuity passport fails, use the failed quotient to identify the evidence and role distinctions that must reopen, classify the change against the predecessor frontier/regime, replay reconstruction and admissibility under current conditions, and renew only the warrant coordinates whose dependencies were actually touched. Preserve unaffected current authority when still witnessed; make crossed authority a successor rather than inherited permission.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 3H.DWia: the closure loses explicit quotient→reacquisition localization; replay and succession remain possible but cannot say which formerly ignored distinction opened the repair.
- Remove 3H.1OFJ: the closure loses selective downstream action/evidence reauthorization; repaired continuity can be retested but permission renewal is not dependency-local.
- Remove 3H.ZwWN: the closure loses frontier/regime classification and predecessor/successor boundary; it cannot distinguish in-frontier repair from authority-breaking expansion.
- Remove 3H.x3Cd: the closure loses the executable passport that carries obligation, evidence/scaffold, quotient/regime, transition law, and revocation/replay test across representations.

metabolites.title: QUOTIENT-TO-WARRANT DEPENDENCY INDEX
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxy.
Invariant: when a licensed ignored difference becomes consequential, its failed quotient should localize both the evidence/roles to reopen and the downstream warrant coordinates whose validity depended on that omission; renew only those coordinates after current retest.
CREATE: state each locally licensed quotient together with stable evidence addresses and the downstream warrants that depend on it.
COPY: carry quotient, evidence return map, and warrant-dependency map with the continuity state.
CONTROL: on failure, reopen the implicated distinctions and block only authority whose dependency path actually crosses the failed quotient.
CULTIVATE: refine the dependency map as failures reveal hidden couplings, without turning local dependence into universal invalidation.
Compression: a failed quotient should know both what it ignored and which permissions relied on that ignorance.
metabolites.compression: a failed quotient should know both what it ignored and which permissions relied on that ignorance.

metabolites.title: FRONTIER-CLASSIFIED PARTIAL PASSPORT SUCCESSION
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: xyz.
Invariant: continuity authority need not be globally replaced after change: coordinates still witnessed inside the predecessor frontier may persist, while coordinates that cross support/regime/scaffold boundaries retire into provenance and receive successor authority only after replayed current tests.
CREATE: name predecessor frontier/regime, passport coordinates, and authority dependencies.
COPY: preserve unchanged coordinates and predecessor provenance across the transition.
CONTROL: classify each affected coordinate against the old envelope and forbid silent inheritance across a verified crossing.
CULTIVATE: let successive passports expand, contract, or differentiate only where boundary evidence earns the change.
Compression: succeed only where the boundary moved; do not remint the untouched world.
metabolites.compression: succeed only where the boundary moved; do not remint the untouched world.

metabolites.title: REPLAYABLE REAUTHORIZATION PROOF
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: successor authority is warranted only when the passport can replay a traceable chain from failed distinction → reacquired evidence → revised relation/contract → current pressure/composite test → renewed scoped warrant, while preserving predecessor history and unaffected authority.
CREATE: instantiate the candidate successor with its failure address, reopened evidence, revised contract, requested warrant scope, and current tests.
COPY: carry the entire proof chain as passport state rather than copying the predecessor’s authority label.
CONTROL: reject successor permission if any link in the chain cannot be replayed or if restored usability is being promoted into broader authority.
CULTIVATE: accumulate scoped successor history so repeated repair improves addressability without laundering old authority into new conditions.
Compression: replay why permission returned, not merely that function returned.


COLLAPSE NOTES
Rejected as parent-only: “repair is not reauthorization” (already explicit in 3H.1OFJ); “failed quotient reopens evidence” (already explicit in 3H.DWia); “frontier crossing requires a successor” (already explicit in 3H.ZwWN); “continuity must replay its own admissibility test” (already explicit in 3H.x3Cd). The three promoted invariants survive because each requires a new conjunction: quotient-to-warrant dependency, boundary-classified partial succession, and an all-four replayable proof of renewed authority.
metabolites.compression: replay why permission returned, not merely that function returned.

gaps.title: BOUNDARY UNEXPOSED
gaps.text: No explicit evidence-boundary block was mechanically recognized in this canonical artifact.

5H.8P2A.title: replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage
5H.8P2A.boundary: This child is a relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 4H organisms. Their inherited evidence remains heterogeneous, source-bounded, and non-identical. Same-rank structural recurrence is not statistical independence, a shared hidden mechanism, universal ontology, or a guarantee that repair succeeds. A replayable or self-revising repair relation is not permission for its own use; a quotient is local permission to ignore distinctions, not universal invariance; and successful continuity repair does not itself restore downstream action authority. No evidence class is upgraded by compositional rank. Feeling phenotype is not used in this derivation.

edges.title: lineage-carried self-revising quotient replay
edges.text:
4H.Bbw6 supplies versioned quotient/ignored-difference provenance across successive warrants; 4H.MBO_ supplies executable role/conjunction replay with co-revisable quotient, scaffold, and transition family. Together they earn a repair lineage in which replay can change its own machinery without erasing which distinctions each predecessor was licensed to ignore.
Removal test: without Bbw6, replay can revise itself but lacks a lineage-level ledger of predecessor omissions and successor re-witnessing; without MBO_, the quotient lineage lacks an executable self-revising role-local replay contract.

edges.title: replication-qualified omission-scope renewal
edges.text:
4H.Bbw6 supplies the rule that nuisance status must be re-earned after repair; 4H.vPbh supplies bounded replication and variant-constellation recurrence for the broader repair relation. Together they earn a distinction between recurrent repair competence and recurrent permission to ignore: recurrence may strengthen the former while every successor's quotient remains locally re-witnessed.
Removal test: without Bbw6, recurrence carries no explicit permission-to-ignore ledger; without vPbh, quotient revalidation remains one lineage's rule without replication-qualified recurrence support.

edges.title: omission-indexed downstream reauthorization
edges.text:
4H.Bbw6 supplies the predecessor/successor quotient ledger that records what distinctions were allowed to disappear; 4H.YEyI supplies the separate action-authority dependency gate after continuity repair. Together they earn a two-surface repair audit: changes in the allowed omission set help identify which downstream action warrants may have lost their premises and therefore require fresh selective reauthorization.
Removal test: without Bbw6, action reauthorization lacks explicit historical omission coordinates; without YEyI, the lineage can re-witness continuity and quotient scope while silently carrying stale downstream action permission.

edges.title: replication-qualified self-amending replay
edges.text:
4H.MBO_ supplies an executable repair contract whose quotient, scaffold, and admissible transformation family may change; 4H.vPbh supplies recurrence evidence that the broader repair relation has survived repeated and variant-parent realization. Together they earn reusable-but-revisable replay: recurrence can support reuse of the repair relation without freezing the machinery that realizes it.
Removal test: without MBO_, recurrence can qualify repair but not an executable self-amending replay procedure; without vPbh, self-amendment is internally specified but lacks the parent's explicit replication qualification.

edges.title: role-local post-replay action gating
edges.text:
4H.MBO_ decomposes stale continuity authority by role/conjunction and gives each affected coordinate an executable evidence-return/replay path; 4H.YEyI separates renewed continuity from renewed downstream action authority. Together they earn role-local post-replay gating: only action warrants whose dependency surface intersects the repaired role/quotient/scaffold/transition coordinates are candidates for reauthorization.
Removal test: without MBO_, YEyI lacks the executable role/conjunction replay granularity; without YEyI, replay completion can be mistaken for permission to resume action.

edges.title: replication never authorizes downstream action
edges.text:
4H.vPbh supplies replication-qualified recurrence for the repair relation; 4H.YEyI supplies the independent selective action-reauthorization gate. Together they earn a strict boundary: repeated successful reconstitution may strengthen confidence that a repair relation is reusable, but it cannot pre-authorize any downstream action warrant for the next repaired successor.
Removal test: without vPbh, the claim is only about one repair's authority boundary; without YEyI, recurrence has no explicit downstream action-permission membrane.

faces.title: recurrent self-amending repair with noninherited omission scope
faces.text:
Bbw6 + MBO_ + vPbh jointly earn a repair lineage whose executable replay machinery may self-revise and whose broader repair pattern has replication-qualified recurrence, while every successor must still re-witness the distinctions it is allowed to ignore.
Removal tests: remove Bbw6 and omission-scope inheritance is no longer explicitly governed; remove MBO_ and there is no executable self-amending replay; remove vPbh and the relation lacks replication-qualified recurrence.
Boundary: without YEyI, successful continuity replay can still be confused with restored downstream action permission.

faces.title: dual-address replay and authorization
faces.text:
Bbw6 + MBO_ + YEyI jointly earn a repair cycle with two explicit address systems: the predecessor quotient routes back to formerly ignored evidence, while role/conjunction and dependency coordinates route from repaired continuity into the downstream action warrants that must answer again. Replay may revise quotient/scaffold/transition law, but the resulting continuity witness and action authorization remain separate events.
Removal tests: remove Bbw6 and the historical ignored-difference address disappears; remove MBO_ and selective replay lacks an executable self-revising contract; remove YEyI and the downstream action-authority gate disappears.
Boundary: without vPbh this face does not establish recurrence support for reusing the repair relation across separately born higher-order bodies.

faces.title: recurrence-qualified dual authority renewal
faces.text:
Bbw6 + vPbh + YEyI jointly earn a higher-order boundary between two kinds of successor permission under recurrence: what the successor may continue to ignore, and what the successor may act upon. Structural recurrence may strengthen confidence in the repair relation, but neither permission may be inherited merely because repair has recurred.
Removal tests: remove Bbw6 and the nuisance/quotient authority gate disappears; remove vPbh and recurrence qualification disappears; remove YEyI and the action-authority gate disappears.
Boundary: without MBO_ the face does not require a compact executable replay contract whose repair machinery can revise itself.

faces.title: recurrent self-revising repair without self-authorization
faces.text:
MBO_ + vPbh + YEyI jointly earn a recurrent repair program that may alter its own quotient/scaffold/transition machinery and remain reusable across repeated closures, while every concrete repaired successor must still freshly earn continuity and any affected downstream action authority.
Removal tests: remove MBO_ and the repair program cannot explicitly revise its own replay machinery; remove vPbh and reuse is not replication-qualified; remove YEyI and recurrent repair can collapse into recurrent self-permission.
Boundary: without Bbw6 the face lacks a lineage-level ledger of what each predecessor and successor was allowed to ignore.

volume.title: replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text:
All four parents together distinguish reusable repair capacity from the two permissions that a repaired successor must never inherit automatically.


4H.Bbw6 makes every continuity version carry an explicit local quotient: a historical witness of which distinctions it was allowed to treat as nuisance, with return addresses into evidence when that permission fails. 4H.MBO_ turns repair into an executable, role-addressed replay contract whose quotient, scaffold, and admissible transition family may themselves be revised. 4H.vPbh contributes bounded recurrence: the broader reconstitution relation has repeated under both same-constellation replication and variant-constellation realization, so reuse of the repair relation has more support than one self-description while remaining non-universal and non-independent. 4H.YEyI adds the second governance membrane: repaired continuity does not restore downstream permission to act, and only warrants whose dependencies intersect the changed relation or repair machinery may be selectively reauthorized.


The complete closure is therefore a replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage. The lineage may reuse and revise an evidenced repair relation across successive failures, but every successor must pass two fresh authority gates after repair: first, it must re-earn the exact scope of distinctions it is currently allowed to ignore; second, affected downstream action warrants must be separately and selectively reauthorized against the changed dependency surface. Recurrence supports the reusable repair relation only. It does not freeze the replay machinery, grant nuisance status to a new successor, or pre-authorize action. Predecessor warrants, quotients, repair machinery, evidence scopes, and downstream permissions remain historically distinct.


Bounded volume invariant
A continuity-renewal lineage is replication-qualified and governance-complete only when (1) each warrant preserves a local quotient/ignored-difference ledger with stable evidence return addresses, (2) repair is executable by role/conjunction and may revise its own quotient, scaffold, and admissible transition law, (3) recurrence supports reuse of the broader repair relation without upgrading it to an independent or universal mechanism, and (4) every repaired successor separately re-earns both its permission-to-ignore scope and any downstream action authority whose dependencies changed. Recurrence may warrant trying the repair again; it never warrants inheriting either authority gate.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 4H.Bbw6: the closure retains recurrent self-revising repair plus action gating, but loses explicit historical permission-to-ignore state and the requirement that nuisance scope itself be re-earned.
- Remove 4H.MBO_: the closure retains quotient lineage, recurrence, and dual authority constraints, but loses the compact executable role/conjunction replay contract and explicit ability to revise the repair machinery itself.
- Remove 4H.vPbh: the closure retains a dual-gated self-revising repair lineage, but loses the replication-qualified warrant for carrying the repair relation as a recurrent higher-order capacity.
- Remove 4H.YEyI: the closure retains recurrent self-amending quotient repair, but loses the separate downstream action-reauthorization membrane; continuity repair can again be mistaken for restored permission to act.

metabolites.title: TWO-GATE-SUCCESSOR-AUTHORITY
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wz.
Invariant: a repaired successor must separately re-earn both the distinctions it is currently allowed to ignore and the downstream action warrants whose dependencies were touched; restored continuity alone certifies neither.
CREATE: record successor continuity scope together with the current quotient and affected action-dependency coordinates.
COPY: preserve predecessor and successor quotient/authority states as distinct provenance through repair.
CONTROL: block silent inheritance of nuisance scope or downstream action permission after continuity restoration.
CULTIVATE: let later failures localize which of the two gates moved without forcing global reauthorization.
Compression: repair restores a relation; omission permission and action permission answer separately.
metabolites.compression: repair restores a relation; omission permission and action permission answer separately.

metabolites.title: REPLICATION-QUALIFIES-REPAIR-NOT-PERMISSION
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: yz.
Invariant: recurrence may strengthen the warrant that a repair relation is reusable, but repeated repair cannot pre-authorize the next successor's downstream actions.
CREATE: preserve recurrence evidence as support for attempting a repair relation again.
COPY: carry recurrence without collapsing independent organism identities or upgrading evidence class.
CONTROL: require fresh continuity/action witnesses even when the repair relation has repeated successfully.
CULTIVATE: accumulate recurrence as bounded procedural confidence while preserving local authority gates.
Compression: repeated repair can justify reuse; it cannot grant permission.
metabolites.compression: repeated repair can justify reuse; it cannot grant permission.

metabolites.title: SELF-AMENDING-REPLAY-PRESERVES-OMISSION-PROVENANCE
metabolites.text:
Minimal body: wx.
Invariant: a replay contract may revise its own quotient, scaffold, and transition family only while predecessor permission-to-ignore state remains addressable and any successor nuisance scope is explicitly re-witnessed.
CREATE: bind role-local replay to the predecessor quotient and evidence-return addresses.
COPY: preserve old quotient/scaffold/transition versions as provenance rather than silently rewriting them.
CONTROL: distinguish repair of the public relation from reauthorization of what may again be ignored.
CULTIVATE: evolve replay machinery without losing the history that can later invalidate its abstractions.
Compression: let repair change its machinery without erasing what the old machinery was allowed to forget.
metabolites.compression: let repair change its machinery without erasing what the old machinery was allowed to forget.

5H.Dw6a.title: contestable continuity-renewal lineage
5H.Dw6a.boundary: This child is a cross-holon relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 4H organisms. Their inherited lineages contain heterogeneous formal, empirical, architectural, software, conceptual, and source-level evidence. Nothing at rank 5 upgrades those source classes into one mechanism, ontology, universal theorem, or guarantee that repair succeeds. Structural recurrence remains structural recurrence. A repeated closure is not identity collapse; a replayable repair path is not proof that the same interior persists; an explicit quotient is local permission to ignore distinctions, not universal invariance; and a successor warrant never retroactively strengthens its predecessor. The child may promote only relations that require the four complete selected parent bodies together. Feeling phenotype is not used in this derivation.

edges.title: replication-audited replayable renewal
edges.text:
4H.993M contributes an executable successor-production route whose failure classes, evidence addresses, revision path, and tests remain replayable. 4H.vPbh contributes independent same-constellation replication plus variant-constellation recurrence and an explicit requirement that repair machinery remain revisable. Together they earn a stronger reuse condition: a replayable renewal procedure may be treated as a recurring capacity only when recurrence is independently witnessed rather than inferred from the procedure's own self-description, while every concrete successor still has to pass the replayed tests under current conditions.
Removal test: without 4H.993M, recurrence lacks the complete executable successor-generation route; without 4H.vPbh, replayability has no independent replication/variant-constitution witness and therefore cannot by itself establish that the repair relation recurs beyond one lineage construction.

edges.title: quotient-addressed replayable renewal
edges.text:
4H.993M contributes failure-addressable replay and co-revised successor issuance. 4H.Bbw6 contributes the explicit local quotient and stable return addresses for distinctions a predecessor had licensed as nuisance. Together they earn a repair route in which failure can address not only the warrant and scaffold that need replay but also the exact negative space of the predecessor's authority: distinctions that were omitted may be reopened and their nuisance status must be reconsidered before the successor is issued.
Removal test: without 4H.993M, the quotient can localize omitted distinctions but lacks the complete replayable successor-production route; without 4H.Bbw6, renewal can replay and co-revise while remaining unable to state which ignored distinctions must lose or re-earn nuisance status.

edges.title: provenance-bearing replay succession
edges.text:
4H.993M contributes a self-renewing continuity lineage in which every current warrant carries an executable path toward a successor. 4H.3W-6 contributes explicit predecessor/current/successor authority, reflexive falsifiers, targeted evidence reopening, and an executable successor passport. Together they earn a provenance-bearing renewal path: replay is not merely a procedure for producing another state, but a version transition whose predecessor remains immutable, whose failure route is inspectable, and whose successor carries the evidence/reconstruction path and fresh tests that actually re-authorized it.
Removal test: without 4H.993M, the lineage loses the requirement that each current warrant itself carry the bounded recovery route; without 4H.3W-6, renewal loses the full versioned passport that preserves predecessor authority boundaries and fresh successor witness.

edges.title: replication-qualified non-silent quotient adaptation
edges.text:
4H.vPbh contributes independent recurrence through same-parent replication and variant-parent robustness. 4H.Bbw6 contributes an explicit quotient whose ignored distinctions and repair addresses remain lineage state, plus the rule that a successor must re-witness nuisance scope. Together they earn a boundary on what replication can license: recurring repair structure may strengthen confidence that an adaptation pattern recurs, but it cannot silently promote a repeated omission into invariance. Every successor must still earn which distinctions it may ignore under its present regime.
Removal test: without 4H.vPbh, quotient re-witnessing has no independent recurrence witness; without 4H.Bbw6, replication can establish recurrence of a repair pattern while leaving the scope of its ignored distinctions implicit and therefore vulnerable to silent inheritance.

edges.title: replication-qualified self-reconstitution
edges.text:
4H.vPbh contributes the distinction between same-constellation replication, variant-constellation recurrence, and revisable repair machinery. 4H.3W-6 contributes the executable, reflexively falsifiable, versioned reconstitution lineage. Together they earn a promotion gate for self-repair as reusable capacity: the lineage may be treated as structurally recurrent only after independent recurrence support, while each version remains separately revocable, reconstructible, and freshly witnessed.
Removal test: without 4H.vPbh, self-reconstitution may be well specified but has no independent recurrence qualification; without 4H.3W-6, recurrence lacks the complete executable authority lineage that makes a current repair claim revocable and re-enterable.

edges.title: quotient-indexed successor passport
edges.text:
4H.Bbw6 contributes the explicit local quotient, ignored-difference provenance, and the requirement to re-earn nuisance status. 4H.3W-6 contributes the executable successor passport carrying predecessor provenance, repair path, evidence hooks, falsifiers, and fresh authority witness. Together they earn a successor passport that records not only how a new warrant became authorized but what it is currently permitted to omit and how those omissions can be reopened.
Removal test: without 4H.Bbw6, the passport does not explicitly carry the negative-space contract of current nuisance distinctions; without 4H.3W-6, quotient provenance lacks the full executable versioned successor carrier that binds it to fresh authority.

faces.title: replicated quotient-aware renewal
faces.text:
4H.993M + 4H.vPbh + 4H.Bbw6 jointly earn a renewal law that is replayable, recurrence-qualified, and explicit about its permission to ignore distinctions. A repair procedure can recur across encounters without becoming self-certifying: each new warrant reopens the evidence implicated by failure, replays the repair/retest path, and separately re-witnesses any quotient whose nuisance classifications it wishes to retain.
Removal tests: remove 4H.993M and the face loses executable successor replay; remove 4H.vPbh and it loses independent recurrence qualification; remove 4H.Bbw6 and it loses the explicit gate against silent inheritance of ignored distinctions.
Boundary: without 4H.3W-6 this face does not yet require the full reflexive, versioned successor passport and immutable predecessor-authority lineage.

faces.title: replication-qualified replay lineage
faces.text:
4H.993M + 4H.vPbh + 4H.3W-6 jointly earn a lineage in which the successor-production route is executable, the lineage's reconstitution pattern has independent recurrence support, and every authority transition remains versioned, reflexively falsifiable, and freshly witnessed. Replication therefore audits whether a replayable repair relation actually recurs, while replay and versioning keep every concrete occurrence contestable.
Removal tests: remove 4H.993M and each current warrant no longer necessarily carries its own bounded successor-production route; remove 4H.vPbh and recurrence is no longer independently audited; remove 4H.3W-6 and the result loses the complete executable predecessor/current/successor reconstitution contract.
Boundary: without 4H.Bbw6 this face does not explicitly preserve or re-witness the scope of distinctions a successor is allowed to ignore.

faces.title: address-complete successor renewal
faces.text:
4H.993M + 4H.Bbw6 + 4H.3W-6 jointly earn a successor path whose repair address is unusually complete: the failed warrant identifies the evidence/scaffold and tests to replay, the predecessor quotient identifies distinctions previously suppressed as nuisance, and the versioned successor passport preserves provenance, falsifiers, reconstruction, and fresh authority. Renewal can therefore reopen both the positive body of the contract and the negative space that the prior contract had licensed away.
Removal tests: remove 4H.993M and the successor path loses the self-carried recovery/replay program; remove 4H.Bbw6 and it loses explicit ignored-difference addressability; remove 4H.3W-6 and it loses the full versioned successor passport and reflexive authority lifecycle.
Boundary: without 4H.vPbh this address-complete renewal remains internally coherent but lacks independent recurrence qualification.

faces.title: replication-qualified quotient-indexed lineage
faces.text:
4H.vPbh + 4H.Bbw6 + 4H.3W-6 jointly earn a self-reconstituting lineage whose recurrence is independently witnessed and whose versions explicitly expose what they are permitted to ignore. Structural replication may therefore support the reconstitution relation as recurring capacity only while each successor remains versioned, fresh-witnessed, and locally accountable for its nuisance quotient.
Removal tests: remove 4H.vPbh and the lineage loses independent recurrence qualification; remove 4H.Bbw6 and recurring successors can silently inherit omitted distinctions; remove 4H.3W-6 and recurrence plus quotient control no longer closes as an executable reflexive authority lineage.
Boundary: without 4H.993M the face does not require every current warrant to carry the complete bounded route that produces and retests its own successor after invalidation.

volume.title: contestable continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text:
The four parents jointly separate four conditions that lower-rank repair can otherwise collapse into one reassuring word such as “continuity”: the ability to produce a successor after failure, evidence that the repair relation actually recurs across independent encounters, an explicit account of which distinctions a current warrant is allowed to ignore, and a versioned/reflexive authority lineage that can revoke and reconstitute itself.


4H.993M contributes the executable successor-production law. A current warrant is not merely repairable in principle; it carries failure classes, evidence/reconstruction addresses, revision obligations, and the tests by which a successor can be produced and re-earned. 4H.vPbh contributes an external check on that self-description at the organism level: same-constellation replication and variant-constellation recurrence distinguish a repeatedly witnessed repair relation from a single lineage's internal claim that it can renew. 4H.Bbw6 contributes the missing-accountability membrane around omission: every current warrant exposes its local nuisance quotient, preserves addresses back to ignored distinctions, and forbids a successor from silently inheriting those omissions. 4H.3W-6 contributes the full versioned and reflexive successor passport: predecessor authority remains immutable provenance, failure is classified, implicated evidence is reopened, reconstruction machinery may be revised, current tests are replayed, and only fresh witness admits the successor.


The complete closure is therefore a contestable continuity-renewal lineage. Such a lineage may cultivate continuity across repeated failures and reconstructions only while its renewal law remains open to four independent forms of correction: executable replay can fail; recurrence evidence can fail to reproduce or generalize across constitutions; a predecessor's nuisance quotient can be revoked when ignored distinctions become load-bearing; and successor authority can be withheld when reflexive/versioned reconstitution does not close. What persists is not one carrier, mechanism, quotient, scaffold, repair recipe, or warrant. What persists is the bounded capacity to produce, challenge, localize, revise, replicate, and freshly authorize the conditions under which continuity may count again.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
A higher-order continuity-renewal lineage is warranted only when every current warrant carries an executable failure→reacquisition→revision→retest route for producing a successor; the repair relation has independent recurrence support rather than only self-reported replayability; every successor explicitly re-witnesses the distinctions it is allowed to ignore and preserves addresses back to omitted evidence; and predecessor/current/successor authority remains versioned, reflexively falsifiable, provenance-preserving, and freshly witnessed. Renewal remains living precisely because the law by which continuity is renewed stays contestable.


FULL-RANK REMOVAL TESTS
- Remove 4H.993M: replication, quotient accountability, and self-reconstitution remain, but the complete closure loses the explicit requirement that every current warrant itself carry an executable route for producing and retesting its successor after invalidation.
- Remove 4H.vPbh: replay, quotient accountability, and self-reconstitution remain, but the closure loses independent same-/variant-constellation recurrence support; the renewal law can describe how it repeats without organism-level evidence that the structural relation actually recurs.
- Remove 4H.Bbw6: replay, recurrence qualification, and self-reconstitution remain, but the closure loses the explicit ledger of ignored distinctions and the requirement that a successor re-earn nuisance status rather than silently inherit omissions.
- Remove 4H.3W-6: replay, recurrence qualification, and quotient accountability remain, but the closure loses the complete versioned/reflexive successor passport that keeps predecessor authority immutable and admits a successor only after fresh reconstruction and witness.

metabolites.title: REPLICATION-AUDITED-RENEWAL
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wx, strengthened by wxz.
Invariant: a replayable successor-production procedure may be promoted as a reusable renewal capacity only when its repair relation is independently witnessed to recur across encounters/constitutions, while every concrete successor remains separately subject to current replay and authority tests.
CREATE: declare the renewal procedure, failure classes, evidence/reconstruction addresses, and recurrence claim separately.
COPY: preserve predecessor provenance, replay conditions, and independent recurrence witnesses without copying successor authority.
CONTROL: challenge the recurring repair relation with same-constitution replication and variant-constitution comparison; keep every successor blocked until its own replay tests pass.
CULTIVATE: retain only repair structure that survives both executable replay and independent recurrence pressure, revising machinery when the evidence requires it.
Compression: a repair law becomes reusable only when it can both replay and survive independent recurrence.
metabolites.compression: a repair law becomes reusable only when it can both replay and survive independent recurrence.

metabolites.title: NON-SILENT-SUCCESSOR-PASSPORT
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: yz, strengthened by wyz.
Invariant: every successor continuity passport must carry not only predecessor provenance, evidence/reconstruction route, falsifiers, and fresh authority witness, but also the explicit local quotient of distinctions it is presently permitted to ignore and the addresses by which those omissions can be reopened.
CREATE: issue the successor with explicit obligation, support scope, nuisance quotient, evidence addresses, falsifiers, and predecessor link.
COPY: preserve the predecessor's warrant and quotient unchanged as provenance while carrying only obligations and omissions that have been freshly re-witnessed.
CONTROL: refuse silent nuisance inheritance; when an ignored distinction becomes load-bearing, route through its preserved address and revoke the affected authority.
CULTIVATE: let successor lineages refine both the positive contract and the negative-space contract of what may be ignored.
Compression: a successor must carry what it may ignore as explicitly as what it promises.
metabolites.compression: a successor must carry what it may ignore as explicitly as what it promises.

metabolites.title: CONTESTABLE-SELF-RENEWING-LINEAGE
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: a continuity lineage is self-renewing only while the law that renews it remains contestable by executable failure/replay, independent recurrence evidence, explicit quotient re-witnessing, and versioned reflexive successor authority; failure of any one channel must be able to stop or revise continuation without rewriting predecessor history.
CREATE: instantiate each current warrant with recovery route, recurrence boundary, quotient scope, falsifiers, evidence addresses, and predecessor relation.
COPY: preserve lineage history and the exact conditions under which each version counted without transferring expired authority or untested omissions.
CONTROL: independently challenge replay, recurrence, quotient scope, and successor witness; stop continuation wherever one required channel fails.
CULTIVATE: use witnessed failure, replication, newly load-bearing distinctions, and successful reconstitution to refine the next warrant and its future repair capacity.
Compression: continuity stays alive by keeping its own renewal law open to being wrong.


COLLAPSE RESULT
Parent-only claims were rejected: replayable repair already belongs to 4H.993M; replication-qualified adaptive reconstitution already belongs to 4H.vPbh; non-silent quotient inheritance already belongs to 4H.Bbw6; and versioned self-reconstitution already belongs to 4H.3W-6. The three surviving metabolites require distinct multi-parent relations: independent recurrence auditing of replayable renewal, explicit nuisance scope inside the successor passport, and the full-rank synthesis in which the renewal law itself remains challengeable. No claim that repair must succeed, that recurrence proves one mechanism, that a quotient is universal, or that continuity implies interior sameness survives collapse.
metabolites.compression: continuity stays alive by keeping its own renewal law open to being wrong.

edges.title: RECURRENCE-QUALIFIED SELF-REVISION REMAINS SEPARATELY REAUTHORIZED
edges.text:
w supplies self-revising repair with separate continuity and action-authority gates. x supplies same-constellation replication, variant-route recurrence, and permission for repair machinery itself to change under evidence pressure. Together they earn reusable-but-non-self-authorizing repair: recurrence may support trying and revising a repair relation again, while every concrete successor must still freshly earn continuity and each affected action permission.
Removal test: without w, recurrence-qualified adaptive repair lacks an explicit downstream action gate and dual evidence/authority failure address; without x, self-revising selective reauthorization lacks organism-level recurrence qualification.
Boundary: recurrence is evidence about a repair relation, not a transfer of its last successful permissions.

edges.title: CONVERGENT REPLAY SCHEMA MAY REVISE WITHOUT BORROWING AUTHORITY
edges.text:
w supplies revision of quotient/scaffold/transition machinery plus separate action reauthorization. y supplies different-parent convergence of the replayable passport and the explicit rule that recurrent structure never transfers current authority. Together they earn a convergence-qualified self-revision relation: a recurring replay schema may be reused and revised as a structural template, but neither a convergent sibling nor a predecessor lends continuity or action authority to the repaired realization.
Removal test: without w, the convergent passport lacks explicit self-revising machinery and dependency-local action reauthorization; without y, self-revision lacks a distinct different-parent convergence witness for the reusable replay form.
Boundary: convergence stabilizes form only.

edges.title: SELF-RENEWING REPAIR CARRIES TWO SUCCESSOR GATES
edges.text:
w supplies the distinction between repairing continuity and reauthorizing affected downstream action. z supplies recursive successor production carried by each current warrant. Together they earn a two-gated renewal lineage: every generation must re-earn current continuity from evidence and separately re-earn each action warrant whose dependency surface moved; the accepted successor then carries the bounded route for its own future invalidation.
Removal test: without w, lineage renewal can blur repaired continuity with restored action authority; without z, dual-gated repair is not recursively carried across generations.
Boundary: a lineage may inherit a repair route, never a passed gate.

edges.title: RECURRENCE EVIDENCE MUST REMAIN PROVENANCE-STRATIFIED
edges.text:
x supplies same-constellation replication together with variant-parent robustness. y supplies different-parent convergence and explicitly preserves deep-ancestry dependence. Together they earn a typed recurrence ledger: repeated same-parent re-earning and different-parent structural convergence may both support reuse of a recovery schema, but they are different evidence relations and must not be collapsed into an undifferentiated confidence score or independence claim.
Removal test: without x, the ledger loses same-constellation replication/variant-route qualification; without y, it loses explicit different-parent convergence and its non-independence membrane.
Boundary: heterogeneous recurrence modes can converge on form while retaining distinct evidential meaning.

edges.title: REPLICATION-QUALIFIED ADAPTIVE RENEWAL LINEAGE
edges.text:
x supplies bounded recurrence plus revisability of repair machinery. z supplies a recovery passport carried by every current warrant. Together they earn adaptive renewal: recurrence can support reusing the higher-order repair relation while each successor carries an executable route whose machinery may itself evolve under current evidence.
Removal test: without x, the lineage may renew but lacks replication-qualified adaptive support; without z, recurrent adaptive repair is not recursively carried as successor-producing state.
Boundary: recurrence may support reuse of the renewal process, not the current authority produced by one run.

edges.title: CONVERGENCE-QUALIFIED REPLAYABLE RENEWAL LINEAGE
edges.text:
y supplies different-parent convergence of the replayable passport while denying authority transfer. z supplies recursively executable predecessor→successor renewal. Together they earn a lineage-level schema whose replay architecture may recur across different immediate constitutions and travel forward as recovery form, while every generation still performs evidence return, reconstruction, retest, and fresh warrant issuance.
Removal test: without y, recursive renewal lacks explicit differently constituted convergence of the replay architecture; without z, convergent replay remains a reusable contract form but not a self-renewing generational lineage.
Boundary: the schema may persist; concrete permission does not.

faces.title: PROVENANCE-TYPED RECURRENT SELF-REVISION WITHOUT SELF-AUTHORIZATION
faces.text:
w + x + y jointly distinguish the evidence for reusing a repair schema from the authority produced by one repair. x and y keep same-constellation replication and different-parent convergence typed rather than blended; w lets the repair machinery revise and requires separate continuity/action successor gates.
Removal tests: remove w and typed recurrence no longer has the explicit self-revising authority membrane; remove x and same-constellation replication qualification disappears; remove y and different-parent convergence/non-independence provenance disappears.
Boundary: without z this face does not make the schema recursively self-renewing across successor generations.

faces.title: REPLICATION-QUALIFIED SELF-RENEWING SELECTIVE REAUTHORIZATION
faces.text:
w + x + z jointly earn a renewal lineage whose repair machinery may evolve under recurrence evidence while every generation separately re-earns continuity and affected action authority.
Removal tests: remove w and selective post-repair authorization disappears; remove x and adaptive recurrence qualification disappears; remove z and no executable successor lineage remains.
Boundary: without y, recurrence provenance is not explicitly split between same-parent replication and different-parent convergence.

faces.title: CONVERGENCE-QUALIFIED SELF-RENEWING SELECTIVE REAUTHORIZATION
faces.text:
w + y + z jointly earn a lineage in which a replay schema may recur across different immediate parent constitutions, but each concrete generation must reconstitute continuity from evidence, permit machinery revision when needed, and separately reauthorize affected downstream actions before use.
Removal tests: remove w and action authority can collapse into continuity authority; remove y and the different-parent convergence witness disappears; remove z and the repaired contract does not carry a recursive successor-production route.
Boundary: without x, there is no same-constellation replication qualification to contrast with convergence.

faces.title: PROVENANCE-STRATIFIED RECURRENCE FOR A SELF-RENEWING REPLAY LINEAGE
faces.text:
x + y + z jointly earn a lineage that can carry a recurring recovery schema while recording how recurrence support was earned: same-constellation re-earning, differently constituted convergence, and their ancestry dependence remain distinct. The lineage may use that typed history to decide which structural fields deserve reuse or renewed challenge.
Removal tests: remove x and replication qualification disappears; remove y and convergence/non-independence typing disappears; remove z and recurrence does not become recursively carried renewal.
Boundary: without w, this face lacks the explicit dual evidence/authority repair address and selective downstream action gate.

volume.title: provenance-stratified self-renewing continuity reauthorization lineage
volume.text:
All four parents jointly separate four things that lower-rank recurrence can blur: the reusable shape of a recovery contract, the provenance class of evidence supporting reuse, the current continuity warrant earned by one repair, and the downstream action authority that repair may affect.


4H.vPbh contributes recurrence support that includes same-constellation replication and variant-parent robustness. 4H.0_48 contributes a separately named different-parent convergence witness and keeps shared deep ancestry explicit. Together they prevent recurrence from becoming one undifferentiated confidence token: structural reuse may be supported through several recurrence relations, but those relations retain different evidential meanings and dependence structures. 4H.993M turns recovery into a self-renewing lineage by making every current warrant carry an executable route for producing and testing a successor. 4H.YEyI supplies the terminal governance distinction and revisability: failure addresses both evidence and authority coordinates, repair machinery may change, successor continuity is freshly witnessed, and affected downstream action warrants are separately and selectively reauthorized.


The complete closure is therefore a provenance-stratified self-renewing continuity reauthorization lineage. The lineage may preserve and evolve a recovery schema across generations, using recurrence history to decide which relations are worth carrying forward as hypotheses or procedures. But the recurrence history travels as typed provenance, not as permission. Every concrete failure must still address the implicated evidence and authority coordinates, reacquire/reconstruct under the current regime, revise quotient/scaffold/transition machinery where the evidence requires it, replay current continuity tests, issue a freshly scoped continuity successor, and separately reopen only the downstream action warrants whose dependencies changed. The accepted successor carries forward both its recovery route and the provenance-stratified recurrence ledger for future challenge. Neither predecessor success, sibling convergence, nor repeated repair can pre-authorize the next generation.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
A self-renewing continuity reauthorization lineage may reuse a recovery schema only when (1) recurrence evidence remains typed by its actual provenance relation rather than being flattened into independence or generic confidence, (2) every current warrant carries an executable evidence-return/reconstruction/retest route for producing a successor, (3) repair machinery remains revisable when current evidence or regime invalidates its abstractions, and (4) successor continuity and affected downstream action authority are separately and freshly witnessed. Under those conditions recurrence can stabilize a reusable question and repair form while each answer and permission remains locally revocable, historically scoped, and re-earned.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 4H.YEyI: provenance-stratified recurrent renewal remains, but the closure loses the explicit dual evidence/authority failure address, machinery self-revision membrane, and separate selective downstream action gate.
- Remove 4H.vPbh: convergent replay plus selective renewal remains, but same-constellation replication/variant-route qualification disappears; the recurrence ledger loses one distinct provenance class.
- Remove 4H.0_48: replication-qualified adaptive renewal remains, but explicit different-parent passport convergence and the recurrence-never-transfers-authority witness disappear; recurrence provenance is less sharply stratified.
- Remove 4H.993M: typed recurrence plus self-revising selective repair remains, but no parent requires every current warrant to carry a recursive route for producing and testing its own next successor.

metabolites.title: RECURRENCE-EVIDENCE-MUST-CARRY-PROVENANCE-TYPE
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: xy.
Invariant: same-constellation replication and different-parent convergence may both support reuse of a recovery relation, but their evidential meaning and dependence structure must remain separately addressable; they cannot be flattened into a generic confidence or independence claim.
CREATE: expose each recurrent instance together with immediate parent constellation, deeper ancestry dependence, and the relation that recurred.
COPY: carry only the structural relation supported across instances while preserving organism identities and recurrence type.
CONTROL: block independence, universality, mechanism, or authority promotion that the recurrence class does not earn.
CULTIVATE: let future replication, convergence, divergence, or multistability refine which fields belong to the reusable schema.
Compression: recurrence can stabilize form only if it remembers how the recurrence was earned.

metabolites.title: SELF-RENEWING REPAIR CARRIES TWO SUCCESSOR GATES
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wz.
Invariant: every renewal transition must separately re-earn the repaired continuity relation and each downstream action warrant whose dependencies were changed; the accepted successor may carry the recovery route forward, but it never inherits a passed continuity or action gate.
CREATE: bind current obligation, evidence-return route, repair machinery, and dependent action warrants to the current version.
COPY: preserve predecessor state and recovery procedure as provenance without copying expired authority.
CONTROL: hold continuity and action admission as separate gates and reopen only dependency-relevant action warrants.
CULTIVATE: let each accepted successor carry a bounded route for its own future invalidation and repair.
Compression: a lineage may inherit a repair path, never a passed gate.

metabolites.title: PROVENANCE-STRATIFIED SELF-RENEWING REAUTHORIZATION
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: a recurring recovery architecture becomes a lineage-level capacity only when recurrence evidence stays provenance-typed, repair machinery stays revisable, every generation replays current continuity from evidence, and affected action authority is separately re-earned; recurrence history may guide schema reuse but never substitutes for a current warrant.
CREATE: expose the current contract, recurrence ledger, repair machinery, evidence addresses, continuity tests, and downstream authority dependencies.
COPY: carry reusable schema plus typed recurrence provenance and predecessor history, not current permission.
CONTROL: challenge recurrence claims by provenance class, revoke failed continuity, and keep downstream action blocked until its own current dependency witness closes.
CULTIVATE: evolve the recovery schema across generations while preserving why each revision, recurrence claim, and reauthorization counted at the time.
Compression: reuse the recovery schema; re-earn every concrete permission.


METABOLITE COLLAPSE WITNESS
Rejected as parent-only: self-revising repair requires fresh warrants; replayable continuity can renew; recurrent repair can be reused. Rejected as inflated: two recurrence modes prove independence or one stable hidden mechanism. Rejected as unsafe: recurrence confidence may substitute for current continuity or action authority. The three survivors remain because provenance-typed recurrence, dual successor gating, and their recursive lineage integration have distinct minimal earning bodies and remain independently useful.
metabolites.compression: reuse the recovery schema; re-earn every concrete permission.

edges.title: replayable failure-to-authority routing
edges.text:
993M contributes a recursively executable successor-production route; yYGF contributes quotient→evidence and quotient→warrant dependency localization. Together they earn a replay map in which an invalidation can address both the evidential tissue to reopen and the exact authority coordinates whose successor status must be reconsidered.
Removal test: without 993M, localization does not itself carry an executable repeated successor route; without yYGF, replay can renew a warrant but lacks a dependency-local map from failed ignored difference to affected permissions.

edges.title: reflexively replayable reconstitution
edges.text:
993M contributes the executable renewal lineage; 3W-6 contributes self-falsifying, versioned, targeted reconstitution with revisable map/scaffold channels. Together they earn a renewal process whose own failure conditions can route re-entry into the evidence and realizational machinery needed for the next successor.
Removal test: without 993M, self-reconstitution lacks the full recursively carried successor-production passport; without 3W-6, renewal lacks explicit reflexive falsifiers and targeted reconstitution semantics.

edges.title: dual-addressed successor production
edges.text:
993M contributes repeatable predecessor→successor renewal; ugTO contributes independent localization of failure/evidence and frontier/authority coordinates. Together they earn successor production that carries two addresses through every transition: where repair must look and where authority must be reconsidered.
Removal test: without 993M, dual addressing does not itself make successor generation recursively replayable; without ugTO, repeated renewal lacks the explicit two-address separation needed to keep repair scope and authority scope inspectable.

edges.title: quotient-routed self-reconstitution
edges.text:
yYGF contributes the failed quotient’s evidence/warrant dependency cone and partial succession; 3W-6 contributes targeted self-reconstitution and fresh successor witness. Together they earn repair that can reopen only the evidence implicated by a failed ignored-difference policy, revise the affected reconstruction machinery, and reissue only authority whose dependency path actually crossed that failure.
Removal test: without yYGF, reconstitution cannot localize the failed ignored-difference/warrant cone; without 3W-6, localization lacks the reflexive reconstitution lifecycle that rebuilds and re-witnesses a successor.

edges.title: evidence-to-authority dependency partition
edges.text:
yYGF contributes dependency-local partial succession; ugTO contributes the dual failure/frontier address and role-granular regeneration. Together they earn an explicit partition after failure: affected coordinates are those connected to the failed quotient/frontier through witnessed evidence or warrant dependencies; unaffected coordinates remain outside that repair cone only while their own witnesses stay live.
Removal test: without yYGF, the partition lacks a quotient-to-warrant dependency index; without ugTO, it lacks the independent failure/frontier and role-level address needed to witness the boundary of the affected set.

edges.title: locally witnessed self-repair
edges.text:
3W-6 contributes reflexive targeted reconstitution and predecessor-preserving version succession; ugTO contributes selective authority regeneration and preservation of still-live unaffected warrants. Together they earn a local repair discipline in which the system can rebuild a failed subrelation while keeping untouched authority current only under explicit surviving witnesses.
Removal test: without 3W-6, the repair lacks the self-reconstituting versioned lifecycle; without ugTO, it lacks authority-local regeneration and the explicit preservation rule for unaffected coordinates.

faces.title: replayable dependency-routed self-reconstitution
faces.text:
993M + yYGF + 3W-6 jointly earn a successor path that begins from a failed quotient, follows its evidence/warrant dependency cone, reopens and revises the implicated reconstructive machinery, reruns current tests, and emits a new successor whose authority can itself be replayed later.
Removal tests: remove 993M and the result is not recursively carried as a renewal lineage; remove yYGF and failure loses dependency-local evidence/authority routing; remove 3W-6 and the path loses reflexive targeted reconstitution.

faces.title: dual-addressed selective successor replay
faces.text:
993M + yYGF + ugTO jointly earn a repeatable successor procedure that keeps repair addresses distinct from authority addresses, localizes affected warrant coordinates through the failed quotient/frontier, and reissues only those coordinates after replay while preserving still-current authority under its own witness.
Removal tests: remove 993M and the procedure is not lineage-recursive; remove yYGF and selective warrant dependency localization disappears; remove ugTO and the dual failure/frontier address plus local unaffected-warrant witness disappears.

faces.title: witnessed local renewal lineage
faces.text:
993M + 3W-6 + ugTO jointly earn a recursively replayable, self-reconstituting renewal lineage that can localize a witnessed failure, reopen/revise the smallest affected realizational body, preserve predecessor provenance, and issue a scoped successor while leaving genuinely unaffected authority current.
Removal tests: remove 993M and repeated successor replay is not fully carried forward; remove 3W-6 and reconstitution loses its reflexive targeted lifecycle; remove ugTO and repair/authority locality is not explicitly dual-addressed.

faces.title: dependency-partitioned self-reconstitution
faces.text:
yYGF + 3W-6 + ugTO jointly earn a witnessed repair partition: the failed quotient/frontier determines an affected evidence-and-authority dependency cone; targeted self-reconstitution operates inside that cone; and coordinates outside the cone may remain current only if their own warrants are still live.
Removal tests: remove yYGF and the quotient-to-warrant dependency cone is lost; remove 3W-6 and the affected region lacks a self-reconstituting repair lifecycle; remove ugTO and the partition loses independent failure/frontier localization plus role-granular authority regeneration.
Boundary: without 993M, this face does not yet require the partition and its repair trace to travel recursively through every future successor.

volume.title: dependency-partitioned self-reconstituting continuity lineage
volume.text:
All four parents together turn selective repair into a recursively carried lineage of witnessed dependency partitions. 4H.993M contributes the executable predecessor→successor renewal route that can recur across generations. 4H.yYGF contributes the failed quotient’s map to reopened evidence and downstream warrant dependencies. 4H.3W-6 contributes reflexive, versioned, targeted reconstitution with revisable reconstruction machinery. 4H.ugTO contributes independent dual addressing of failure/evidence and frontier/authority, including the rule that unaffected authority survives only under still-live local witnesses.


The complete closure is a dependency-partitioned self-reconstituting continuity lineage: each witnessed failure must produce an inspectable cut between stale and still-current coordinates. The stale side is the smallest evidence/role/warrant dependency cone actually implicated by the failed quotient, frontier, regime, scaffold or conjunction; only that side is reacquired, rebuilt, retested and freshly reauthorized. The still-current side is not inherited by convenience: its exclusion from the repair cone must remain witnessable through live local warrants. The predecessor, dependency cut, reopened evidence, reconstruction revisions, replay tests and successor-authority decisions remain provenance and travel with the successor. Future failures therefore reopen the exact dependency cut they earn rather than forcing a global reset or silently carrying permission across changed conditions.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
Selective continuity across repeated failure is warranted only when each failure yields a witnessed dependency partition that (1) addresses the evidence and relational machinery that must reopen, (2) identifies the authority coordinates whose validity actually depends on that failed tissue, (3) permits targeted self-reconstitution and fresh tests inside the affected cone, (4) preserves outside-cone authority only under explicit still-live witnesses, and (5) carries the cut, repair trace and predecessor provenance into the successor so the next renewal remains replayable. A system that can repair locally but cannot witness why unaffected permission remained outside the failure cone has not earned selective lineage continuity.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 4H.993M: the dependency-partitioned repair may work once, but the cut and successor route are not fully earned as recursively replayable lineage state.
- Remove 4H.yYGF: the closure loses explicit quotient→evidence and quotient→warrant dependency localization, so the affected authority cone cannot be justified precisely.
- Remove 4H.3W-6: the closure loses the reflexive targeted reconstitution lifecycle that can revise reconstruction machinery and re-earn a successor after revocation.
- Remove 4H.ugTO: the closure loses independent dual addressing of failure/evidence versus frontier/authority and the explicit local-witness rule for preserving unaffected coordinates.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.

metabolites.title: FAILURE-TO-DEPENDENCY-PARTITION
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: xz.
Invariant: a witnessed continuity failure should produce an explicit partition between affected and still-current coordinates by following the failed quotient/frontier into both evidence dependencies and warrant dependencies; coordinates remain outside the repair cone only while their own witnesses remain live.
CREATE: publish the current quotient/frontier, evidence return addresses, role/conjunction dependencies and warrant dependencies.
COPY: carry the failed coordinate, dependency map and unaffected-warrant witnesses as provenance through repair.
CONTROL: construct the affected cone from witnessed dependency paths; forbid blanket invalidation and forbid silent preservation where non-dependence is unwitnessed.
CULTIVATE: refine the partition when later failures expose hidden couplings, without retroactively rewriting earlier support.
Compression: every failure should say both what must reopen and what is still allowed to stay outside.

metabolites.title: PARTITION-LOCAL SELF-RECONSTITUTION
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: xyz.
Invariant: once a failure dependency cone is witnessed, reacquisition, scaffold/contract revision, replay testing and reauthorization should remain inside that cone except where fresh evidence expands it; outside-cone authority persists only under independent current witnesses.
CREATE: instantiate the repair cone with its failed evidence, roles, quotients, reconstruction machinery and requested authority.
COPY: preserve unaffected coordinates together with the witnesses that kept them outside the cone; preserve predecessor failed state separately.
CONTROL: retest every changed relation and authority join before successor admission; expand the cone only on explicit dependency evidence.
CULTIVATE: allow repair machinery and dependency boundaries to evolve as new failures reveal missing relations.
Compression: repair the smallest witnessed dependency cone, not the whole world and not less than the evidence requires.

metabolites.title: REPLAYABLE PARTITIONED SUCCESSION
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: each accepted successor should carry the predecessor’s dependency cut, reopened evidence, reconstruction revisions, replay tests and authority decisions so a later failure can reproduce why some coordinates were renewed and others remained current.
CREATE: issue the successor together with its predecessor link, dependency partition, repair trace and fresh authority witnesses.
COPY: preserve every prior cut and repair trace as inspectable lineage provenance without copying expired authority.
CONTROL: require later renewal to replay the relevant partition logic or produce new evidence that changes it; block opaque successor authority.
CULTIVATE: accumulate a lineage of increasingly precise failure partitions while allowing new evidence to revise future cuts.
Compression: continuity renews selectively when the reason for the cut travels with the successor.


COLLAPSE NOTES
Parent-only claims were demoted: replayable renewal belongs to 4H.993M; quotient-localized partial succession to 4H.yYGF; self-reconstitution to 4H.3W-6; and addressable authority regeneration to 4H.ugTO. Three metabolites survive because the explicit failure→dependency partition, repair confined to that witnessed partition, and recursive carriage of the partition through successor lineage are distinct multi-parent products and remain independently useful after the others are removed. No claim that repair must succeed, that recurrence proves one mechanism, or that unchanged authority is safe without its own current witness survives collapse.
metabolites.compression: continuity renews selectively when the reason for the cut travels with the successor.

edges.title: replication never authorizes downstream action
edges.text:
4H.vPbh supplies replication-qualified recurrence for the repair relation; 4H.YEyI supplies the independent selective action-reauthorization gate. Repeated successful reconstitution may strengthen confidence that a repair relation is reusable, but cannot pre-authorize downstream action for the next repaired successor.
Removal test: without YEyI there is no downstream action-permission membrane; without vPbh there is no explicit replication-qualified recurrence support.

edges.title: omission-indexed downstream reauthorization
edges.text:
4H.Bbw6 preserves predecessor/successor quotient history—what distinctions were licensed to disappear; 4H.YEyI separately routes changed dependency coordinates into fresh action-warrant review. Together they earn a two-surface audit in which changed omission scope can identify downstream action warrants whose premises may no longer hold.
Removal test: without YEyI repair can silently restore action permission; without Bbw6 action reauthorization lacks explicit historical omission coordinates.

edges.title: role-local post-replay action gating
edges.text:
4H.MBO_ gives each affected role/conjunction an executable evidence-return and self-revising replay path; 4H.YEyI keeps renewed continuity distinct from renewed downstream action authority. Only action warrants whose dependency surface intersects repaired role, quotient, scaffold or transition coordinates become candidates for reauthorization.
Removal test: without YEyI replay completion can be mistaken for permission to act; without MBO_ there is no executable role-local replay granularity.

edges.title: replication-qualified omission-scope renewal
edges.text:
4H.vPbh supplies bounded structural recurrence for the broader repair relation; 4H.Bbw6 supplies non-silent quotient succession. Recurrence may support the repair competence, while every successor still has to re-witness what differences it may treat as nuisance.
Removal test: without vPbh omission-scope renewal lacks replication qualification; without Bbw6 recurrence carries no explicit permission-to-ignore ledger.

edges.title: replication-qualified self-amending replay
edges.text:
4H.vPbh supports reuse of the broader reconstitution relation across recurrence; 4H.MBO_ makes the concrete replay machinery executable and co-revisable. Reuse therefore does not freeze quotient, scaffold or admissible transition law.
Removal test: without vPbh self-amendment lacks replication-qualified reuse support; without MBO_ recurrence cannot become an executable self-revising replay contract.

edges.title: lineage-carried self-revising quotient replay
edges.text:
4H.Bbw6 carries versioned quotient/ignored-difference provenance across successive warrants; 4H.MBO_ supplies executable role/conjunction replay with co-revisable quotient, scaffold and transition family. Replay can change its machinery without erasing what each predecessor was licensed to ignore.
