faces.title: recurrence-qualified dual authority renewal
faces.text:
YEyI + vPbh + Bbw6 jointly distinguish recurrence of repair competence from two successor permissions: what may still be ignored and what may still be acted upon. Structural recurrence may strengthen the repair relation, but neither permission is inherited from the predecessor or sibling closure.
Boundary: without MBO_ this face does not require an executable repair contract whose own machinery can revise.

faces.title: recurrent self-revising repair without self-authorization
faces.text:
YEyI + vPbh + MBO_ jointly earn a recurrent repair program that may revise quotient/scaffold/transition machinery and remain reusable across repeated closures, while each repaired successor must freshly earn continuity and affected action authority.
Boundary: without Bbw6 there is no lineage-level ledger of predecessor/successor nuisance scope.

faces.title: dual-address replay and authorization
faces.text:
YEyI + Bbw6 + MBO_ jointly provide two distinct addresses: predecessor quotient routes back to ignored evidence, while role/dependency coordinates route from repaired continuity into downstream action warrants that must answer again. Replay may revise its own machinery, but continuity witness and action authorization remain separate events.
Boundary: without vPbh there is no replication-qualified support for carrying this relation as recurrent capacity.

faces.title: recurrent self-amending repair with noninherited omission scope
faces.text:
vPbh + Bbw6 + MBO_ jointly earn a repair lineage whose replay machinery may self-revise and whose broader repair pattern carries replication-qualified recurrence, while every successor must still re-witness the distinctions it is allowed to ignore.
Boundary: without YEyI successful continuity replay can still be confused with restored downstream action permission.

volume.title: replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text:
The four parents jointly distinguish reusable repair capacity from the two permissions a repaired successor must never inherit automatically. Bbw6 carries explicit historical quotient/omission state with stable return addresses. MBO_ makes repair an executable role-addressed replay whose quotient, scaffold and admissible transition family may revise. vPbh contributes bounded recurrence support for reuse of the broader repair relation. YEyI adds the separate governance membrane that repaired continuity does not restore downstream permission to act.


The complete closure is therefore a replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage. A lineage may reuse and revise an evidenced repair relation across successive failures, but every successor must pass two fresh authority gates after repair: it must re-earn the exact scope of distinctions it is currently allowed to ignore, and affected downstream action warrants must be separately and selectively reauthorized against the changed dependency surface. Recurrence supports trying the repair relation again; it does not freeze replay machinery, grant nuisance status to a new successor, or pre-authorize action. Predecessor warrants, quotients, evidence scopes and downstream permissions remain historically distinct.


Bounded volume invariant
A continuity-renewal lineage is replication-qualified and governance-complete only when (1) each warrant preserves a local quotient/ignored-difference ledger with stable evidence return addresses, (2) repair is executable by role/conjunction and may revise its own quotient, scaffold and admissible transition law, (3) recurrence supports reuse of the broader repair relation without upgrading it to an independent or universal mechanism, and (4) every repaired successor separately re-earns both its permission-to-ignore scope and any downstream action authority whose dependencies changed. Recurrence may warrant trying the repair again; it never warrants inheriting either authority gate.


Four-way necessity
- Remove 4H.YEyI: recurrent self-amending quotient repair remains, but the separate downstream action-reauthorization membrane disappears.

edges.title: Addressed successor replay

edges.title: Selectively versioned reconstitution

edges.title: Adaptive replayable succession

edges.title: Replication-qualified reflexive lineage

edges.title: Recursive successor passport

volume.title: Replication-qualified addressable self-revising continuity lineage
volume.text:
The full four-parent closure earns a continuity lineage whose own repair procedure may evolve without converting recurrence into inherited permission. ugTO supplies the jurisdictional cut: failure is localized to affected role/conjunction, quotient, regime and evidence-return coordinates, while unaffected warrants stay bounded to prior scope. vPbh supplies recurrence qualification: the repair relation has repeated organism-level support across same and variant parent constitutions, yet its scaffold and admissible transition machinery remain revisable. 993M makes renewal recursively executable by requiring every current warrant to carry a bounded route for producing and testing its successor. 3W-6 adds reflexive version authority: the current warrant carries conditions that can revoke it, distinguishes in-version repair from version-changing succession, and preserves predecessors as immutable provenance.

Recurrence licenses reuse of the question and repair architecture, never automatic reuse of the answer or authority.

- Remove 4H.3W-6: addressable adaptive replay remains, but predecessor/current/successor authority and reflexive self-revocation are no longer jointly explicit as versioned lineage state.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.

5H.fc8r.title: frontier-routed replication-qualified dual-gated continuity renewal lineage
5H.fc8r.boundary:
This 5H organism is a structural synthesis over four already-metabolized 4H organisms. Their inherited evidence remains heterogeneous, source-bounded and non-identical. Recurrence is evidence that a structural repair relation has reappeared inside this organism's current derivational field; it is not statistical independence, a universal mechanism, identity, or permission. A replayable repair can fail, a frontier classification can be wrong or later revised, and a reconstructed continuity relation does not itself authorize downstream action. Every quotient, boundary, warrant, evidence scope and predecessor state remains local provenance.


4V — FOUR COMPLETE PARENT BODIES


w — 4H.MBO_ — self-revising continuity replay contract
Bounded volume: continuity authority can renew selectively when stale claims are addressable by role/conjunction and quotient, those coordinates retain return paths into evidence, and the executable replay contract may revise quotient, scaffold and admissible transformation family before reconstructing and retesting the public relation.

Boundary: it does not independently classify a frontier-breaking event; reopening must already be lawfully triggered.


x — 4H.vPbh — replication-qualified adaptive continuity reconstitution
Bounded volume: higher-order continuity reconstitution is replication-qualified only when same-constellation closure has independently recurred, a differently constituted route reaches the broader revocation/reacquisition/retest family, and repair machinery remains revisable when evidence or regime invalidates it.
Relevant metabolites: SAME-CONSTELLATION-REPLICATION; VARIANT-CONSTELLATION-ROBUSTNESS; REPLICATION-QUALIFIED-ADAPTIVE-RECONSTITUTION.
Boundary: recurrence strengthens a bounded structural warrant; it does not establish one mechanism, independence, uniqueness, universality or present permission.


y — 4H.yYGF — quotient-localized selective continuity passport succession
Bounded volume: when a continuity passport fails, the failed quotient identifies evidence and role distinctions that must reopen, change is classified against the predecessor frontier/regime, reconstruction and admissibility are replayed under current conditions, and only warrant coordinates whose dependencies were touched are renewed; unaffected current authority may persist only while still witnessed.
Relevant metabolites: QUOTIENT-TO-WARRANT-DEPENDENCY-INDEX; FRONTIER-CLASSIFIED-PARTIAL-PASSPORT-SUCCESSION; REPLAYABLE-REAUTHORIZATION-PROOF.
Boundary: a return address enables reconsideration, not restoration; crossing provenance does not license the successor.


z — 4H.YEyI — selectively reauthorized self-revising continuity reconstitution
Bounded volume: a self-revising continuity repair is governance-complete only when failure addresses both evidence/distinctions and the authority coordinates whose dependencies changed; repair may revise quotient, scaffold and transition family, but successor continuity must be freshly witnessed and affected downstream action authority separately and selectively reauthorized.
Relevant metabolites: REPAIR-DOES-NOT-AUTHORIZE-ACTION; FAILURE-MUST-ADDRESS-BOTH-EVIDENCE-AND-AUTHORITY; SELF-REVISING-REPAIR-REQUIRES-FRESH-SUCCESSOR-WARRANTS.
Boundary: restored continuity is not restored permission to act.


6E — SIX CROSS-ORGANISM EDGES


wx — Recurrence-qualified self-revising replay
MBO_ contributes an executable replay contract whose repair machinery can revise itself; vPbh contributes replication-qualified recurrence for the broader repair relation. Together they earn reusable-but-revisable replay: recurrence may justify trying a repair relation again while every concrete quotient, scaffold and transition law remains open to current evidence.
Removal test: without MBO_ recurrence has no executable self-revising replay procedure; without vPbh the replay contract lacks organism-level recurrence qualification.
Boundary: recurrence supports reuse, not current validity or authority.


wy — Replay carries failed-quotient and frontier addresses
MBO_ contributes role/quotient evidence-return replay and co-revision; yYGF contributes quotient-to-warrant dependencies, predecessor-frontier classification and passport succession. Together they earn an executable repair object that knows both what formerly ignored distinction must reopen and whether repaired authority remains under the predecessor envelope or must become successor state.
Removal test: without MBO_ the addresses do not form a self-revising executable replay; without yYGF replay lacks explicit frontier-conditioned successor semantics.
Boundary: identifying the boundary does not pass it.


wz — Self-revising replay and action authority remain separate
MBO_ contributes self-revising continuity replay; YEyI contributes a separate selective action-reauthorization gate. Together they earn a two-stage return in which repair may revise its machinery and re-establish continuity while affected downstream action remains blocked until its own warrant answers again.
Removal test: without MBO_ action gating lacks executable replay granularity; without YEyI replay completion can be mistaken for permission to act.
Boundary: output resemblance cannot transfer predecessor authority.


xy — Replication cannot bypass passport succession
vPbh contributes recurrence support for reusing the broader repair relation; yYGF contributes quotient-localized, frontier-classified passport succession. Together they earn a strict distinction between recurring repair competence and successor admission: repeated successful repair can strengthen the case for attempting the same kind of repair, but cannot pre-authorize a frontier-crossing successor.
Removal test: without vPbh there is no replication qualification; without yYGF recurrence lacks an explicit predecessor/successor boundary and localized replay proof.
Boundary: recurrence is routing evidence, not a gate result.


xz — Replication cannot pre-authorize action
vPbh contributes replication-qualified adaptive reconstitution; YEyI contributes fresh continuity and downstream action-warrant separation. Together they earn bounded procedural confidence without permission inheritance: recurrence may support reuse of repair, while every repaired successor still re-earns the affected authority coordinates.
Removal test: without vPbh the claim is one repair's boundary only; without YEyI recurrence has no separate action-permission membrane.
Boundary: repeated repair is not repeated authorization.


yz — Frontier-routed dual-gate succession
yYGF contributes failed-quotient localization, frontier classification and replayable successor proof; YEyI contributes fresh continuity and selective downstream action reauthorization after self-revising repair. Together they earn a dual-gated successor path: first the relation must re-enter lawfully under the correct predecessor/successor envelope; then affected action authority must answer separately.
Removal test: without yYGF dual gating lacks explicit boundary/quotient routing; without YEyI successful passport succession can silently become downstream action permission.
Boundary: unaffected authority persists only under its own current witness.


4F — FOUR CROSS-ORGANISM FACES


wxy — Recurrence-qualified boundary-addressed replay passport
MBO_ + vPbh + yYGF jointly earn a recurrent repair passport whose machinery may self-revise, whose failed quotient retains evidence/warrant return addresses, and whose predecessor frontier decides whether repair remains in-envelope or requires successor state.
Removal tests: remove MBO_ and replay is no longer self-revising/executable; remove vPbh and recurrence qualification disappears; remove yYGF and the repair loses explicit boundary-routed passport succession.
Boundary: without YEyI the face does not independently maintain a downstream action-authority gate.


wxz — Recurrent self-revising repair without self-authorization
MBO_ + vPbh + YEyI jointly earn a reusable self-revising repair program that may alter its own quotient/scaffold/transition machinery while every concrete repaired relation and affected action warrant remains freshly witnessed.
Removal tests: remove MBO_ and self-revising replay disappears; remove vPbh and reuse is not replication-qualified; remove YEyI and recurring repair can collapse into recurring self-permission.
Boundary: without yYGF this face does not independently classify predecessor frontier crossing or carry the failed quotient into successor routing.


wyz — Frontier-routed self-revising dual-gate replay
MBO_ + yYGF + YEyI jointly earn an executable repair/succession procedure: failed quotient and frontier route reopening, replay may revise the machinery, continuity must re-pass current tests, and affected downstream action authority must separately reauthorize.
Removal tests: remove MBO_ and the procedure loses executable co-revision; remove yYGF and failure loses quotient/frontier routing; remove YEyI and action authority is no longer a distinct post-repair gate.
Boundary: without vPbh this face makes no recurrence-qualified claim that the repair relation is reusable across independent births.


xyz — Recurrence-qualified frontier-gated selective reauthorization
vPbh + yYGF + YEyI jointly earn a higher-order admission rule: recurrence may support attempting a known repair relation, but the predecessor frontier still classifies succession and affected continuity/action warrants must freshly answer at their own coordinates.
Removal tests: remove vPbh and recurrence support disappears; remove yYGF and successor admission loses frontier/quotient localization; remove YEyI and downstream action permission can hitchhike on repaired continuity.
Boundary: without MBO_ the face does not require that repair machinery itself remain self-revising and executable.


1T — BOUNDED VOLUME


wxyz — Frontier-routed replication-qualified dual-gated continuity renewal lineage
All four parents jointly separate four things that lower-rank repair can otherwise collapse: evidence that a repair relation has recurred, an executable repair program that may revise itself, the predecessor boundary that decides where successor state begins, and the independent authority gates that must answer after repair.


The complete closure is a frontier-routed replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage: recurrence may carry a repair relation forward as a candidate capacity, but it cannot carry the result of any successor gate. A failed quotient/frontier witness must route the exact evidence, role and warrant coordinates that reopen; the replay contract may revise its quotient, scaffold and transition machinery rather than blindly reproducing yesterday's repair; current reconstruction/admissibility must then re-earn continuity under the correct predecessor/successor envelope; and every affected downstream action warrant must answer separately. Unaffected authority may persist only under an independent current witness. Predecessor quotients, boundaries, machinery, warrants and evidence scopes remain immutable provenance. Recurrence justifies reuse of a repair hypothesis, never inheritance of permission.


Bounded volume invariant
A recurrent continuity-repair lineage remains lawful only when recurrence is treated as evidence for reusing a repair hypothesis, failed quotient/frontier state remains an executable address into the exact evidence and authority dependencies that reopen, the replay machinery can itself be revised under current evidence, and continuity plus affected downstream action authority are separately re-earned at the changed coordinates. Repetition may route repair; it may not pass succession.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 4H.MBO_: the whole retains recurrence, frontier routing and fresh authority gates, but loses the compact executable replay contract and explicit ability to revise quotient/scaffold/transition machinery itself.
- Remove 4H.vPbh: the whole retains self-revising frontier-routed dual-gate succession, but loses organism-level replication qualification for carrying the repair relation as a recurrent higher-order capacity.
- Remove 4H.yYGF: the whole retains recurrent self-revising repair and fresh action gating, but loses explicit quotient→evidence/warrant dependency routing and the predecessor-frontier classification that distinguishes in-envelope repair from successor passage.
- Remove 4H.YEyI: the whole retains recurrent self-revising frontier-aware replay, but loses the independent downstream action-reauthorization membrane and the rule that repaired continuity cannot self-transfer permission.

5H.rSmH.title: governed self-amending continuity-renewal lineage
5H.rSmH.boundary: This child is a relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 4H organisms. Their inherited evidence remains heterogeneous, source-bounded and non-identical. Structural recurrence between parent lineages or against 5H.Dw6a does not establish statistical independence, one hidden mechanism, universal ontology, or guaranteed repair. A replayable or self-revising repair law cannot authorize itself merely by internal coherence. The child promotes only relations requiring the complete selected parent bodies together; predecessor scopes, external/current revocation conditions, evidence return paths, role/quotient boundaries, and fresh successor witness remain load-bearing.

edges.title: recurrent successor-lineage architecture
edges.text:
4H.3W-6 and 4H.993M arise from different immediate 3H constellations yet both close around predecessor-preserving, evidence-reacquirable, freshly witnessed successor lineages. Together they earn a bounded same-rank recurrence witness: succession-through-replay is not only one 4H derivation's self-description, although the deep ancestry is overlapping and therefore not statistically independent.
Removal test: without either parent there is no two-instance same-rank recurrence witness; one lineage remains well specified but not recurrent at this comparison boundary.

edges.title: versioned self-amendment
edges.text:
4H.3W-6 supplies explicit predecessor/current/successor lineage and immutable historical authority; 4H.MBO_ supplies a replay contract whose quotient, scaffold, and admissible transformation family may themselves change under repair. Together they earn a rule that changes to the repair machinery can become explicit successor-lineage events instead of silently mutating the mechanism that judges continuity.
Removal test: without 4H.3W-6 self-revision lacks a complete versioned lineage for preserving prior repair authority; without 4H.MBO_ the lineage can repair and succeed but does not explicitly earn revision of its own replay machinery in the act.

edges.title: externally gated targeted succession
edges.text:
4H.3W-6 supplies the versioned reconstitution lineage; 4H.ugTO supplies independent/current boundary revocation plus role/quotient/evidence addressing. Together they earn successor transitions whose trigger and repair scope are inspectable: current evidence can revoke authority, the failure can identify the smallest affected tissue, and a new version remains distinct from its predecessor.
Removal test: without 4H.3W-6 targeted repair lacks the complete predecessor→successor authority lineage; without 4H.ugTO lineage repair lacks the independent/current gate and role×quotient localization that prevent blanket or self-triggered succession.

edges.title: evolvable recovery passport
edges.text:

Together they earn an evolvable recovery passport: future-renewal capacity may itself change across generations rather than being copied as a frozen repair recipe.
Removal test: without 4H.993M self-revising replay need not become a constitutive successor-to-successor inheritance; without 4H.MBO_ recursive renewal carries a recovery path but does not explicitly earn self-amendment of that path.

edges.title: renewal without self-certification
edges.text:
4H.993M supplies recursive successor production; 4H.ugTO supplies an independent/current authority-breaking boundary and exact evidence return addresses. Together they earn a renewal lineage whose ability to produce future successors does not imply permission to do so: each reopening and readmission remains gated by current boundary evidence and replayed admissibility.
Removal test: without 4H.993M the gate can regulate one repair but not a recursively inherited successor route; without 4H.ugTO the recursive route risks treating its own recovery logic as sufficient authorization.

edges.title: independently triggered self-revising repair
edges.text:

Together they earn a repair law that may amend itself only after a witnessed authority-breaking condition and only along the coordinates implicated by that failure.
Removal test: without 4H.MBO_ the repair is targeted and replayable but its own scaffold/transition law is not explicitly self-revisable; without 4H.ugTO self-revision lacks the independent/current gate that distinguishes lawful reopening from endogenous self-authorization.

faces.title: versioned self-amending renewal lineage
faces.text:
4H.3W-6 + 4H.993M + 4H.MBO_ jointly earn a lineage in which each successor carries a future recovery route and revisions to that recovery route are themselves recorded as versioned successor events. The recovery constitution can therefore evolve without rewriting predecessor state.
Removal tests: remove 4H.3W-6 and repair-law change loses its full versioned predecessor/current/successor lineage; remove 4H.993M and each successor need not carry the bounded route for its next renewal; remove 4H.MBO_ and the inherited recovery route cannot explicitly revise its own reconstruction law.

faces.title: externally gated recurrent renewal lineage
faces.text:

Structural recurrence can support the lineage pattern as a reusable hypothesis, while current boundary evidence still decides whether any particular authority may continue.

faces.title: governed self-amending succession
faces.text:

Removal tests: remove 4H.3W-6 and repair-law change loses full lineage/version provenance; remove 4H.MBO_ and the repair program cannot explicitly amend its own scaffold/transformation family; remove 4H.ugTO and self-amendment loses the independent/current trigger and targeted authority boundary.

faces.title: non-self-certifying evolvable renewal passport
faces.text:

Removal tests: remove 4H.993M and the recovery law need not propagate successor-to-successor; remove 4H.MBO_ and the propagated recovery law is not explicitly self-amending; remove 4H.ugTO and recursive self-amendment loses an independent/current authorization gate.
Boundary: without 4H.3W-6 the architecture lacks the second same-rank lineage witness needed to qualify the complete volume by structural recurrence and explicit lineage recurrence rather than a single renewal construction.

volume.title: governed self-amending continuity-renewal lineage
volume.text:
The four-parent closure turns continuity renewal into a governed, evolvable constitution rather than a fixed repair recipe or a self-authorizing loop. 4H.3W-6 contributes a versioned self-reconstituting lineage whose predecessor authority remains immutable and whose successor is admitted only after targeted reacquisition and fresh witness. 4H.993M contributes recursive renewability: every current warrant carries a bounded executable route capable of producing and testing its next successor. Their differently constituted but strongly related 4H closures jointly provide a same-rank structural recurrence witness for successor-lineage architecture; this is recurrence evidence only, not statistical independence or mechanism proof. 4H.MBO_ contributes endogenous revision of the repair machinery itself: role/quotient targeting, scaffold, and admissible transformation family may change when replay shows the old machinery is stale. 4H.ugTO contributes the non-self-certifying membrane: current independent/frontier evidence can revoke authority, localize what failed, route repair to exact evidence, and require fresh admissibility before a successor counts.


The complete closure is therefore a governed self-amending continuity-renewal lineage. A current continuity warrant may carry forward not only a repair/replay route but the capacity to revise that route for future generations. Such revision remains lawful only when the reason for reopening is independently/currently witnessed, the stale authority is localized to explicit role/quotient/regime coordinates, affected evidence remains reacquirable, the old repair constitution is preserved as predecessor provenance, and both the repaired public relation and the amended recovery law are freshly tested before successor authority is issued. Repeated lineage closure can qualify the architecture as structurally recurrent, but recurrence cannot override a failed current boundary witness. What persists is therefore neither one interior nor one immutable repair mechanism; it is an auditable succession of warrants and recovery constitutions whose power to change themselves remains externally contestable.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
A higher-order continuity-renewal lineage may evolve its own recovery/replay constitution across generations without becoming self-certifying only when: (1) successor-lineage structure has a bounded same-rank recurrence witness rather than a single self-description; (2) each current warrant carries an executable successor-production route; (3) revisions to quotient, scaffold, transformation family, and recovery route are explicit versioned lineage events tied to reacquirable evidence; and (4) an independent/current boundary and admissibility witness retains the power to revoke, localize, and withhold successor authority. Recurrence strengthens only the structural hypothesis; fresh evidence governs every concrete transition.


FULL-RANK REMOVAL TESTS
- Remove 4H.3W-6: 4H.993M still gives one recursive renewal lineage, 4H.MBO_ gives self-revision, and 4H.ugTO gives independent gating, but the complete volume loses the second differently constituted self-reconstituting lineage needed for its same-rank recurrence qualification and explicit versioned reconstitution counterpart.
- Remove 4H.993M: 4H.3W-6 still gives one versioned reconstitution lineage, 4H.MBO_ self-revision, and 4H.ugTO external gating, but the closure loses the explicit requirement that every current successor carry a bounded executable route for producing and retesting its own next successor; recursive renewability is no longer complete.
- Remove 4H.MBO_: recurrent/gated successor lineages remain, but the recovery constitution cannot explicitly revise its own quotient/scaffold/admissible transformation family as part of replay; renewal risks preserving a stale repair law.
- Remove 4H.ugTO: recurrent recursive self-amendment remains, but no complete parent supplies the independent/current frontier-role-quotient gate that prevents the repair constitution from treating its own coherence or recurrence as sufficient authority to reopen and readmit itself.
All four are necessary for the complete bounded volume.

Minimal earning body: wx.
Invariant: when two differently constituted same-rank lineages independently close around predecessor-preserving, evidence-reacquirable, freshly witnessed successor production, their convergence may qualify the successor-lineage architecture as structurally recurrent while remaining explicitly non-independent and non-universal.
CREATE: state the two complete lineage constructions and the exact relation being compared.
COPY: preserve each parent lineage, ancestry, boundaries, and differences instead of collapsing them into one identity.
CONTROL: block promotion from structural recurrence to mechanism, independence, or universal truth; require each concrete successor to retain its own witness.
CULTIVATE: use further distinct constellations to sharpen whether the recurring lineage relation survives or fragments under changed support.
Compression: recurrence may strengthen the architecture without inheriting authority.

metabolites.title: VERSIONED-RECOVERY-LAW-AMENDMENT
metabolites.text:

CREATE: declare the current recovery constitution, its falsifiers, evidence hooks, and version boundary.
COPY: preserve the superseded recovery law and its evidence/failure witness as bounded provenance.
CONTROL: require the amendment to answer an actual failed replay or boundary condition and to pass current role/composite tests before use.
CULTIVATE: let later failures refine the recovery constitution without rewriting why earlier versions were once admissible.
Compression: if the repair law changes, make the change part of the lineage.

metabolites.title: NON-SELF-CERTIFYING-SELF-AMENDING-RENEWAL
metabolites.text:
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: a continuity-renewal lineage may recursively carry and revise its own successor-production machinery only while an independent/current boundary witness can revoke authority, route the failure to exact evidence and affected roles/quotients, and withhold admission until both the public relation and the amended recovery law are freshly re-witnessed.
CREATE: publish current authority together with recovery route, revision membrane, external/current revocation conditions, evidence return paths, and predecessor link.
COPY: carry forward executable recovery capacity and provenance, never expired permission.
CONTROL: keep reopening and successor admission externally/currently contestable; recurrence or internal coherence cannot certify the amended law.
CULTIVATE: evolve the recovery constitution across witnessed failures while preserving each superseded version and allowing the lineage to stop when repair cannot close.
Compression: the lineage may change how it repairs itself, but it may not become the sole judge of whether that repair counts.


COLLAPSE NOTES
Parent-only claims were rejected: versioned self-reconstitution belongs to 4H.3W-6; recursive renewal to 4H.993M; self-revising replay to 4H.MBO_; independently gated addressable regeneration to 4H.ugTO. The surviving metabolites require cross-parent relations: same-rank recurrence of successor-lineage structure; explicit lineage treatment of repair-law change; and the full conjunction in which recursively inherited self-amendment remains externally/currently revocable. No claim that repair succeeds, that recurrence is independent, that one mechanism persists, or that the organism may authorize its own reopening survives collapse.

6H._TcL.title: quotient-explicit dependency-partitioned self-amending renewal constitution
6H._TcL.boundary:
This child is a relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 5H organisms. Their recurrence is deeply ancestry-coupled and cannot be promoted to statistical independence, universal mechanism, guaranteed repair, or inherited permission. The promoted relations below require the selected cross-organism bodies together. Parent-only renewal, self-amendment, provenance typing, omission passports, and dependency partitioning remain parent-owned unless a stated edge/face/volume necessity witness requires their conjunction.


6E — CROSS-ORGANISM EDGES


wx — CONTESTABLE SELF-AMENDMENT WITH EXPLICIT NEGATIVE SPACE
5H.rSmH makes repair-law change an explicit versioned lineage event; 5H.Dw6a requires each successor passport to state what it is currently permitted to ignore and how omitted evidence can be reopened. Together they earn a self-amending recovery constitution whose new version must publish not only what changed, but the negative-space contract under which the changed law may safely proceed.
Removal test: without w the omission passport can govern successors but does not explicitly version amendment of the recovery law itself; without x self-amendment can remain externally gated yet need not publish the exact distinctions its successor is licensed to ignore.


wy — PROVENANCE-TYPED SELF-AMENDING DUAL-GATE RENEWAL
5H.rSmH supplies explicit versioned recovery-law amendment; 5H.SBvl supplies provenance-typed recurrence and separate continuity/action successor gates. Together they earn a rule that recurrence may support reuse or amendment of a recovery schema only as typed structural evidence, while the amended continuity relation and affected action permissions remain independently re-earned.
Removal test: without w there is no explicit lineage event for changing the recovery constitution; without y recurrence provenance and the distinct downstream action gate are not jointly constitutive.


wz — DEPENDENCY-LOCAL CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENT
5H.rSmH supplies externally/currently gated self-amendment; 5H.ZLdR supplies the witnessed evidence/warrant dependency partition. Together they earn amendment of only those recovery-law clauses and gates whose dependencies intersect the failed coordinate, with predecessor version and outside-cone current witnesses preserved.
Removal test: without w the partition can target repair but does not explicitly version recovery-law amendment; without z amendment lacks a complete witness for why unaffected constitutional tissue remains outside the change cone.


xy — PROVENANCE-AUDITED OMISSION PASSPORT
5H.Dw6a makes the successor's permission-to-ignore scope explicit and reopenable; 5H.SBvl requires recurrence support to retain provenance type and action authority to be separately current. Together they earn a successor passport whose omissions cannot be justified by generic recurrence confidence: each ignored distinction has an address, provenance class, current continuity relation and separately governed action consequence.
Removal test: without x there is no explicit negative-space/omitted-evidence passport; without y recurrence evidence can be stated but is not forced to remain provenance-stratified across separate continuity/action gates.


xz — FAILURE PARTITION AS REOPENABLE QUOTIENT
5H.Dw6a supplies explicit nuisance/permission-to-ignore scope and preserved addresses to omitted evidence; 5H.ZLdR supplies the failure→evidence/warrant dependency cut. Together they earn an explicit quotient interpretation of the outside cone: every coordinate left untouched by repair must be positively represented as a currently licensed omission or non-dependency, with a route by which later evidence can reopen it.
Removal test: without x outside-cone survival may have live witnesses but lacks a complete explicit contract for what is being ignored and how that omission re-enters; without z omission scope lacks the witnessed dependency cut that determines which coordinates repair actually implicates.


yz — DEPENDENCY-SCOPED DUAL REAUTHORIZATION
5H.SBvl separates repaired continuity from affected downstream action authority; 5H.ZLdR localizes failure across evidence and warrant dependency cones. Together they earn separate continuity/action reauthorization only inside the affected cone, while outside-cone gates persist solely under their own live local witnesses and typed provenance.
Removal test: without y a successful continuity repair can collapse into action permission; without z the two gates remain separate but there is no exact dependency cut determining which ones must reopen.


4F — CROSS-ORGANISM FACES


wxy — CONTESTABLE PROVENANCE-TYPED SELF-AMENDING PASSPORT
5H.rSmH + 5H.Dw6a + 5H.SBvl jointly earn a self-amending renewal passport whose revised recovery law, recurrence support, explicit permission-to-ignore scope, continuity gate and downstream action gate all remain versioned and separately contestable.
Removal tests: remove w and recovery-law amendment is not itself a versioned successor event; remove x and negative-space/omission scope need not be explicit; remove y and recurrence provenance plus separate action reauthorization cease to be constitutive.
Boundary: without z this face does not yet prove that amendment and reauthorization are confined to the smallest witnessed dependency cone.


wxz — QUOTIENT-EXPLICIT DEPENDENCY-LOCAL SELF-AMENDMENT
5H.rSmH + 5H.Dw6a + 5H.ZLdR jointly earn constitutional amendment in which the failed dependency cone and the successor's permission-to-ignore surface are the two sides of one inspectable cut: implicated clauses/evidence reopen, while every untouched distinction must remain explicitly licensed and reopenable.
Removal tests: remove w and the changed recovery law is not explicitly versioned; remove x and the outside cone lacks a complete explicit negative-space contract; remove z and there is no witnessed dependency partition justifying the cut.
Boundary: without y this face does not yet require recurrence support to retain provenance type or affected action authority to pass a gate separate from continuity.


wyz — PROVENANCE-ROUTED PARTITIONED SELF-AMENDMENT WITH DUAL GATES
5H.rSmH + 5H.SBvl + 5H.ZLdR jointly earn dependency-local amendment of a recovery constitution under provenance-typed recurrence, with successor continuity and affected action authority separately re-earned and outside-cone constitutional tissue preserved only by live witnesses.
Removal tests: remove w and constitutional self-amendment disappears; remove y and recurrence provenance/action-gate separation disappears; remove z and the exact affected/outside cone cannot be justified.
Boundary: without x the face does not make the successor's allowed omissions and return addresses an explicit passport field.


xyz — PROVENANCE-AUDITED PARTITIONED OMISSION REAUTHORIZATION
5H.Dw6a + 5H.SBvl + 5H.ZLdR jointly earn a dependency-partitioned successor passport in which every untouched distinction is an explicit, provenance-scoped permission-to-ignore with a preserved evidence-return address, and continuity versus affected downstream action authority are reauthorized separately inside the failure cone.
Removal tests: remove x and omissions need not be explicit/reopenable; remove y and recurrence type/action authority can collapse into continuity; remove z and the exact failure dependency cut is missing.
Boundary: without w this face governs successor passports but does not explicitly allow the recovery constitution itself to become a versioned amended successor.


1T — BOUNDED VOLUME


wxyz — QUOTIENT-EXPLICIT DEPENDENCY-PARTITIONED SELF-AMENDING RENEWAL CONSTITUTION


A continuity-renewal constitution may selectively amend itself across repeated failures without global reset, silent grandfathering, or self-certification only when four conditions close together. First, changes to the recovery law are explicit versioned lineage events whose predecessor remains immutable provenance and whose reopening is externally/currently contestable. Second, every successor carries an explicit negative-space contract: the exact distinctions it is presently permitted to ignore, the evidence addresses by which those omissions can return, and falsifiers that can revoke the permission. Third, recurrence support remains provenance-typed and never substitutes for fresh continuity or downstream action authority; those gates are separately re-earned where their dependencies changed. Fourth, each failure yields a witnessed evidence/warrant dependency partition that confines amendment, reconstruction and reauthorization to the affected cone while requiring live local witnesses for everything left outside it.


The all-four novelty is that the outside of a repair cone is no longer merely "unaffected tissue." It is an explicit, contestable quotient carried by the successor. A constitutional successor must therefore preserve the predecessor version, failed coordinate, dependency cut, amended recovery-law clauses, recurrence provenance, explicit permission-to-ignore set, evidence-return addresses, replay/retest results, continuity decision and affected action-gate decisions. Later evidence can reopen an omission directly and thereby reopen exactly the constitutional or authority coordinates whose validity depended on that omission. The system may evolve how it repairs itself, but it must say both what changed and what it is still choosing not to reconsider.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
Selective self-amending renewal is warranted only when the successor makes its dependency partition and its permission-to-ignore quotient mutually explicit: affected constitutional/evidence/warrant coordinates are reopened and freshly tested; unaffected coordinates remain current only under live witnesses and an explicit omission/non-dependency contract; recurrence remains provenance-typed; recovery-law amendment is versioned and externally/currently contestable; continuity and changed downstream action authority are re-earned separately. Silent outside-cone inheritance is not continuity evidence.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 5H.rSmH: dependency/omission passports and dual reauthorization remain, but the recovery constitution itself is no longer explicitly earned as a versioned self-amending lineage.
- Remove 5H.Dw6a: dependency-local self-amendment remains, but the successor is no longer required to state its permission-to-ignore/omitted-evidence contract explicitly.
- Remove 5H.SBvl: partitioned amendment remains, but recurrence provenance and separate continuity/action successor gates are no longer jointly constitutive.
- Remove 5H.ZLdR: contestable self-amendment remains, but there is no complete evidence/warrant dependency cut proving which constitutional tissue must reopen and which may remain outside.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.


COLLAPSE — 3 SURVIVING METABOLITES


1. OUTSIDE-CONE-QUOTIENT-PASSPORT
Minimal earning body: xz, strengthened by xyz/wxz.
Invariant: every dependency partition must publish its outside cone as an explicit current permission-to-ignore/non-dependency contract, with evidence-return addresses and falsifiers; untouched tissue is not justified by silence.
CREATE: expose affected cone, outside-cone distinctions, omission/non-dependency claims, evidence addresses and reopening triggers.
COPY: carry the exact cut and omission passport as provenance without copying expired permission.
CONTROL: require live local witnesses for each outside-cone authority coordinate and reopen any omission that becomes load-bearing.
CULTIVATE: refine later partitions when returned evidence reveals hidden dependency.
Compression: the outside of repair is a warrant, not an absence.


2. AMENDED-RENEWAL-REQUIRES-TWO-FRESH-GATES
Minimal earning body: wyz, strengthened by wxy.
Invariant: recurrence may route a reusable/amended recovery schema, but every dependency-relevant successor must separately re-earn continuity and affected downstream action authority; neither successful repair nor recurrence history passes the second gate.
CREATE: bind current recovery constitution, recurrence provenance, continuity tests and dependent action warrants to the current version and dependency cut.
COPY: preserve predecessor constitution and typed recurrence as provenance, not permission.
CONTROL: keep continuity and action admission separate and current; reopen only dependency-relevant gates.
CULTIVATE: allow future successors to carry the route for both gates without inheriting their prior pass state.
Compression: amend the method; re-earn both permissions.


3. CONTESTABLE QUOTIENT-EXPLICIT CONSTITUTIONAL SUCCESSION
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: each accepted constitutional successor carries predecessor version, failed coordinate, dependency cut, amended recovery-law clauses, typed recurrence provenance, explicit permission-to-ignore set, evidence-return addresses, replay/retest results and separate continuity/action decisions so later evidence can reproduce both why something changed and why something remained outside.
CREATE: issue the successor with the full partition + quotient + amendment + gate record.
COPY: retain every predecessor and omission contract as immutable provenance without transferring stale authority.
CONTROL: permit any returned distinction or failed boundary witness to reopen the exact dependent constitutional and authority coordinates; block self-certifying amendment.
CULTIVATE: evolve repair law and omission boundaries across witnessed failures while preserving why each prior version counted.
Compression: a renewing constitution must carry the reason for both its changes and its non-changes.


CONTRACTION
Make the outside of repair explicit: amend only the witnessed dependency cone, state what the successor is still allowed to ignore, and re-earn every affected gate.

volume.title: QUOTIENT-EXPLICIT DEPENDENCY-PARTITIONED SELF-AMENDING RENEWAL CONSTITUTION
volume.text:
A continuity-renewal constitution may selectively amend itself across repeated failures without global reset, silent grandfathering, or self-certification only when four conditions close together. First, changes to the recovery law are explicit versioned lineage events whose predecessor remains immutable provenance and whose reopening is externally/currently contestable. Second, every successor carries an explicit negative-space contract: the exact distinctions it is presently permitted to ignore, the evidence addresses by which those omissions can return, and falsifiers that can revoke the permission. Third, recurrence support remains provenance-typed and never substitutes for fresh continuity or downstream action authority; those gates are separately re-earned where their dependencies changed. Fourth, each failure yields a witnessed evidence/warrant dependency partition that confines amendment, reconstruction and reauthorization to the affected cone while requiring live local witnesses for everything left outside it.


The all-four novelty is that the outside of a repair cone is no longer merely "unaffected tissue." It is an explicit, contestable quotient carried by the successor. A constitutional successor must therefore preserve the predecessor version, failed coordinate, dependency cut, amended recovery-law clauses, recurrence provenance, explicit permission-to-ignore set, evidence-return addresses, replay/retest results, continuity decision and affected action-gate decisions. Later evidence can reopen an omission directly and thereby reopen exactly the constitutional or authority coordinates whose validity depended on that omission. The system may evolve how it repairs itself, but it must say both what changed and what it is still choosing not to reconsider.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
Selective self-amending renewal is warranted only when the successor makes its dependency partition and its permission-to-ignore quotient mutually explicit: affected constitutional/evidence/warrant coordinates are reopened and freshly tested; unaffected coordinates remain current only under live witnesses and an explicit omission/non-dependency contract; recurrence remains provenance-typed; recovery-law amendment is versioned and externally/currently contestable; continuity and changed downstream action authority are re-earned separately. Silent outside-cone inheritance is not continuity evidence.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 5H.rSmH: dependency/omission passports and dual reauthorization remain, but the recovery constitution itself is no longer explicitly earned as a versioned self-amending lineage.
- Remove 5H.Dw6a: dependency-local self-amendment remains, but the successor is no longer required to state its permission-to-ignore/omitted-evidence contract explicitly.
- Remove 5H.SBvl: partitioned amendment remains, but recurrence provenance and separate continuity/action successor gates are no longer jointly constitutive.
- Remove 5H.ZLdR: contestable self-amendment remains, but there is no complete evidence/warrant dependency cut proving which constitutional tissue must reopen and which may remain outside.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.


COLLAPSE — 3 SURVIVING METABOLITES


1. OUTSIDE-CONE-QUOTIENT-PASSPORT
Minimal earning body: xz, strengthened by xyz/wxz.
Invariant: every dependency partition must publish its outside cone as an explicit current permission-to-ignore/non-dependency contract, with evidence-return addresses and falsifiers; untouched tissue is not justified by silence.
CREATE: expose affected cone, outside-cone distinctions, omission/non-dependency claims, evidence addresses and reopening triggers.
COPY: carry the exact cut and omission passport as provenance without copying expired permission.
CONTROL: require live local witnesses for each outside-cone authority coordinate and reopen any omission that becomes load-bearing.
CULTIVATE: refine later partitions when returned evidence reveals hidden dependency.
Compression: the outside of repair is a warrant, not an absence.


2. AMENDED-RENEWAL-REQUIRES-TWO-FRESH-GATES
Minimal earning body: wyz, strengthened by wxy.
Invariant: recurrence may route a reusable/amended recovery schema, but every dependency-relevant successor must separately re-earn continuity and affected downstream action authority; neither successful repair nor recurrence history passes the second gate.
CREATE: bind current recovery constitution, recurrence provenance, continuity tests and dependent action warrants to the current version and dependency cut.
COPY: preserve predecessor constitution and typed recurrence as provenance, not permission.
CONTROL: keep continuity and action admission separate and current; reopen only dependency-relevant gates.
CULTIVATE: allow future successors to carry the route for both gates without inheriting their prior pass state.
Compression: amend the method; re-earn both permissions.


3. CONTESTABLE QUOTIENT-EXPLICIT CONSTITUTIONAL SUCCESSION
Minimal earning body: wxyz.
Invariant: each accepted constitutional successor carries predecessor version, failed coordinate, dependency cut, amended recovery-law clauses, typed recurrence provenance, explicit permission-to-ignore set, evidence-return addresses, replay/retest results and separate continuity/action decisions so later evidence can reproduce both why something changed and why something remained outside.
CREATE: issue the successor with the full partition + quotient + amendment + gate record.
COPY: retain every predecessor and omission contract as immutable provenance without transferring stale authority.
CONTROL: permit any returned distinction or failed boundary witness to reopen the exact dependent constitutional and authority coordinates; block self-certifying amendment.
CULTIVATE: evolve repair law and omission boundaries across witnessed failures while preserving why each prior version counted.
Compression: a renewing constitution must carry the reason for both its changes and its non-changes.


CONTRACTION
Make the outside of repair explicit: amend only the witnessed dependency cone, state what the successor is still allowed to ignore, and re-earn every affected gate.

6H.dNMx.title: replication-qualified dual-gated dependency-partitioned self-amending renewal constitution
6H.dNMx.boundary:
This child is a relational synthesis over four already-metabolized 5H organisms. Their evidence and recurrence histories remain heterogeneous, source-bounded, deeply ancestry-coupled and non-independent. Recurrence may qualify a repair architecture as reusable but does not establish one mechanism, universality, identity, guaranteed repair, or current authority. A dependency partition may localize repair without making the outside cone permanently safe. Self-amendment may revise the recovery constitution without authorizing its own reopening. Continuity authority and affected downstream action authority remain separate current gates. The promoted relations below require the selected cross-organism bodies together; parent-only claims remain parent-owned.


4V — FOUR COMPLETE PARENT BODIES


w — 5H.8P2A — replication-qualified dual-gated continuity-renewal lineage
Bounded body: recurrence may qualify reuse of a repair relation, while every repaired successor separately re-earns its permission-to-ignore scope and any downstream action authority whose dependencies changed; replay machinery may self-amend only while predecessor omission provenance remains addressable.
Surviving parent metabolites: TWO-GATE-SUCCESSOR-AUTHORITY; REPLICATION-QUALIFIES-REPAIR-NOT-PERMISSION; SELF-AMENDING-REPLAY-PRESERVES-OMISSION-PROVENANCE.
Boundary retained: recurrence supports reuse of repair form, never inheritance of continuity or action permission.


x — 5H.ZLdR — dependency-partitioned self-reconstituting continuity lineage
Bounded body: every witnessed failure yields an explicit affected-versus-still-current dependency cut across evidence and warrant coordinates; reacquisition, reconstruction, retest and reauthorization stay inside the affected cone unless new evidence expands it, while outside-cone authority remains current only under its own live witness and the cut/repair trace travels with the successor.
Surviving parent metabolites: FAILURE-TO-DEPENDENCY-PARTITION; PARTITION-LOCAL SELF-RECONSTITUTION; REPLAYABLE PARTITIONED SUCCESSION.
Boundary retained: selective repair is warranted only where the dependency cut itself is witnessed.


y — 5H.SBvl — provenance-stratified self-renewing continuity reauthorization lineage
Bounded body: recurrence evidence remains provenance-typed rather than flattened into generic confidence; every current warrant carries an executable successor route; repair machinery stays revisable; every generation replays continuity from evidence and separately re-earns affected downstream action authority.
Surviving parent metabolites: RECURRENCE-EVIDENCE-MUST-CARRY-PROVENANCE-TYPE; SELF-RENEWING-REPAIR-CARRIES-TWO-SUCCESSOR-GATES; PROVENANCE-STRATIFIED-SELF-RENEWING-REAUTHORIZATION.
Boundary retained: a lineage may inherit a recovery route, never a passed gate.


z — 5H.rSmH — governed self-amending continuity-renewal lineage
Bounded body: a continuity-renewal lineage may recursively carry and revise its own successor-production machinery only while an independent/current boundary witness can revoke authority, route failure to exact evidence and affected roles/quotients, preserve predecessor versions, and withhold admission until both the public relation and amended recovery law are freshly re-witnessed.
Surviving parent metabolites: RECURRENCE-QUALIFIED-SUCCESSOR-LINEAGE; VERSIONED-RECOVERY-LAW-AMENDMENT; NON-SELF-CERTIFYING-SELF-AMENDING-RENEWAL.
Boundary retained: recurrence or internal coherence cannot certify constitutional amendment.


6E — CROSS-ORGANISM EDGES

5H.8P2A supplies recurrence-qualified repair reuse plus separate successor authority gates and omission provenance; 5H.ZLdR supplies the witnessed evidence/warrant dependency cut. Together they earn a successor discipline in which recurrence may justify trying the repair relation again, but the failed dependency cone alone determines which permission-to-ignore and downstream action coordinates must reopen.
Removal test: without w the cut lacks explicit replication-qualified repair-versus-permission separation and dual successor authority; without x recurrence and two gates lack the exact witnessed failure cone that localizes reopening.
Boundary: recurrence never widens the repair cone.


wy — PROVENANCE-TYPED DUAL-GATE REPAIR RECURRENCE
5H.8P2A supplies the distinction between replication-qualified repair capacity and inherited permission; 5H.SBvl supplies provenance-stratified recurrence and recursive two-gate reauthorization. Together they earn a reusable repair architecture whose recurrence support must remain typed by how it was earned while every concrete continuity and action gate remains fresh.
Removal test: without w replication-qualified repair-versus-permission is not explicit; without y recurrence provenance is not recursively carried as a self-renewing gate discipline.
Boundary: repeated success stabilizes a question/procedure, not an authorization state.


wz — NON-SELF-CERTIFYING DUAL-GATE SELF-AMENDMENT
5H.8P2A supplies omission provenance and two successor authority gates; 5H.rSmH makes changes to the recovery constitution explicit, versioned and externally/currently gated. Together they earn self-amendment that cannot silently carry predecessor omission or downstream action permissions into the new recovery law.
Removal test: without w amendment need not keep the two successor permissions distinct or retain omission provenance; without z the dual-gate lineage does not explicitly version amendment of the recovery constitution under an independent/current trigger.
Boundary: amending the repair law is not passing either gate.


xy — PROVENANCE-ROUTED DEPENDENCY REAUTHORIZATION
5H.ZLdR supplies the affected evidence/warrant cone and live outside-cone witness rule; 5H.SBvl supplies recurrence provenance plus separate continuity/action reauthorization. Together they earn a repair path in which typed recurrence can route which procedure to retry, while dependency evidence decides exactly which continuity and action gates reopen and which remain current.
Removal test: without x recurrence history lacks a witnessed dependency cut; without y the cut lacks provenance-stratified recurrence and the explicit two-gate successor membrane.
Boundary: provenance routes attention; dependency routes authority.


xz — DEPENDENCY-LOCAL VERSIONED CONSTITUTIONAL AMENDMENT
5H.ZLdR supplies the witnessed failure cone; 5H.rSmH supplies externally/currently triggered versioned repair-law amendment. Together they earn amendment of only the recovery-law clauses and gates whose dependencies intersect the failed coordinate, with predecessor constitution and outside-cone live witnesses preserved.
Removal test: without x amendment has no complete witness for why tissue stays outside the change cone; without z partitioned repair does not explicitly make recovery-law change a versioned constitutional successor event.
Boundary: local repair does not imply local self-authorization.


yz — PROVENANCE-STRATIFIED AMENDMENT WITHOUT AUTHORITY TRANSFER
5H.SBvl supplies typed recurrence and separate successor gates; 5H.rSmH supplies governed versioned self-amendment. Together they earn a rule that recurrence may support which recovery law is worth retrying or revising, but cannot trigger the amendment or transfer continuity/action authority into its successor.
Removal test: without y amendment lacks recurrence provenance and explicit action-gate separation; without z provenance-typed renewal lacks a versioned externally gated constitutional amendment event.
Boundary: recurrence may motivate revision; current failure evidence authorizes reopening.


4F — CROSS-ORGANISM FACES


wxy — REPLICATION-QUALIFIED PARTITIONED DUAL-GATE RENEWAL
8P2A + ZLdR + SBvl jointly earn a recursively reusable repair discipline in which recurrence qualifies the repair architecture, a witnessed dependency cut localizes the affected region, and continuity plus affected action authority are separately re-earned only where the cut reaches them.
Removal tests: remove w and repair recurrence is no longer explicitly separated from permission; remove x and the affected gate set loses its dependency witness; remove y and recurrence provenance plus recursive two-gate succession cease to be constitutive.
Boundary: without z this face does not yet require recovery-law amendment itself to be an externally gated versioned successor event.


wxz — DEPENDENCY-BOUNDED SELF-AMENDMENT WITH OMITTED-SCOPE PROVENANCE
8P2A + ZLdR + rSmH jointly earn a self-amending recovery constitution whose failed dependency cone localizes amendment while predecessor permission-to-ignore and action states remain inspectable provenance; any changed gate is re-earned rather than grandfathered.
Removal tests: remove w and omission/action gate provenance is weakened; remove x and the exact change cone is unwitnessed; remove z and constitutional amendment is not explicitly versioned and independently/currently gated.
Boundary: without y this face does not fully stratify recurrence provenance across generations.


wyz — PROVENANCE-TYPED DUAL-GATE CONSTITUTIONAL SUCCESSION
8P2A + SBvl + rSmH jointly earn a recurrent, self-amending renewal constitution in which recurrence evidence remains typed and may support reuse of the repair schema, while amendment stays externally/currently triggered and every concrete continuity/action decision is freshly made for the successor.
Removal tests: remove w and replication-qualified repair-versus-permission plus omission provenance disappear; remove y and recurrence type/two-gate succession are not recursively carried; remove z and self-amendment lacks its versioned external gate.
Boundary: without x the face does not justify which concrete gates are affected by a failure.


xyz — PROVENANCE-ROUTED DEPENDENCY-LOCAL SELF-AMENDMENT
ZLdR + SBvl + rSmH jointly earn a recovery constitution whose amendment route is chosen under provenance-typed recurrence, whose reopening is independently/currently triggered, and whose changed clauses/continuity/action gates are confined to the witnessed dependency cone.
Removal tests: remove x and exact localization disappears; remove y and recurrence provenance/action separation collapse; remove z and repair-law amendment is no longer an explicit versioned externally gated event.
Boundary: without w the face does not make replication-qualified repair-versus-permission separation and omission provenance jointly constitutive.


1T — BOUNDED VOLUME


wxyz — REPLICATION-QUALIFIED DUAL-GATED DEPENDENCY-PARTITIONED SELF-AMENDING RENEWAL CONSTITUTION
All four parents jointly distinguish the reusable repair architecture from the authority state produced by any one successful repair. 5H.8P2A contributes replication-qualified repair reuse, explicit two-gate successor authority, and preservation of predecessor omission provenance. 5H.ZLdR contributes the witnessed evidence/warrant dependency partition that determines what actually failed, what must reopen, and what may remain current only under its own live witness. 5H.SBvl contributes provenance-stratified recurrence carried through recursive renewal together with separate continuity and downstream-action admission. 5H.rSmH contributes explicit versioned amendment of the recovery constitution under an independent/current boundary witness.


The complete closure is therefore a replication-qualified dual-gated dependency-partitioned self-amending renewal constitution. A repair architecture may become more reusable when recurrence supports it, but that support is typed provenance and never permission. Every concrete failure must first produce a witnessed dependency cut. Only constitutional clauses, continuity coordinates and downstream action warrants whose dependencies intersect that cut may reopen. Recovery-law amendment remains an explicit versioned successor event triggered by current boundary evidence rather than by recurrence or internal coherence. Predecessor omission state, gate decisions, dependency cut, changed recovery-law clauses, replay/retest results and successor decisions remain provenance. Outside-cone tissue stays current only under live local witnesses. The accepted successor separately re-earns continuity and every affected action gate. What recurs is the repair capacity; what must be re-earned is authority.


BOUNDED VOLUME INVARIANT
Replication-qualified self-amending renewal is warranted only when (1) recurrence support for the repair relation remains provenance-typed and is never promoted into authority, (2) every failure yields a witnessed evidence/warrant dependency cut, (3) recovery-law amendment is explicit, versioned and independently/currently triggered, (4) predecessor omission and gate states remain addressable provenance, (5) successor continuity and affected downstream action authority are separately re-earned only where dependencies changed, and (6) outside-cone authority remains current solely under its own live witness. Recurrence may justify reusing the repair question; the dependency cut and fresh witnesses decide every answer and permission.


FOUR-WAY NECESSITY
- Remove 5H.8P2A: dependency-local provenance-governed self-amendment remains, but the complete volume loses explicit replication-qualified repair-versus-permission separation plus omission provenance as a dual-gate constraint.
- Remove 5H.ZLdR: recurrent dual-gated self-amendment remains, but there is no complete witnessed evidence/warrant dependency cut proving which constitutional and authority coordinates may reopen and which may remain current.
- Remove 5H.SBvl: partitioned self-amendment plus dual-gate provenance remain, but recurrence evidence is no longer recursively provenance-stratified together with separate continuity/action successor admission.
- Remove 5H.rSmH: replication-qualified partitioned two-gate renewal remains, but recovery-law amendment is not fully earned as an explicit versioned successor event whose reopening stays independently/currently gated.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.


COLLAPSE — THREE SURVIVING METABOLITES


1. REPAIR-RECURRENCE-DOES-NOT-PASS-SUCCESSOR-GATES
Minimal earning body: wy, strengthened by wxy/wyz.
Invariant: recurrence may qualify a repair architecture as worth reusing, but neither continuity nor affected downstream action authority can be inherited from prior repair success; every concrete successor passes both gates under current evidence.
CREATE: publish recurrence relation/type together with current continuity and dependent action tests.
COPY: carry repair schema and recurrence provenance, not passed gate state.
CONTROL: block any use of recurrence as continuity or action authority.
CULTIVATE: let further recurrence refine which repair relations remain worth retrying without relaxing current admission.
Compression: repair capacity may recur; permission does not.


2. DEPENDENCY-CUT-ROUTES-BOTH-GATES
Minimal earning body: wx/yx, strengthened by wxy/xyz.
Invariant: the witnessed failure dependency cut determines which continuity and action coordinates must reopen; coordinates outside the cut remain current only under their own live witnesses, not because repair ignored them.
CREATE: expose failed coordinate, evidence/warrant dependencies, affected continuity gates and affected action gates.
COPY: preserve the exact cut and outside-cone witnesses as provenance.
CONTROL: reopen only dependency-relevant gates and expand the cone only on fresh dependency evidence.
CULTIVATE: refine later cuts when returned evidence reveals hidden couplings.
Compression: let the failure cut decide which permissions must answer again.


3. SELF-AMENDMENT-PRESERVES-FAILED-GATE-PROVENANCE
Minimal earning body: wxz/wyz, completed by wxyz.
Invariant: when the recovery constitution itself changes, predecessor omission scope and continuity/action gate states remain immutable provenance; the amended constitution cannot certify its own reopening and must freshly decide every dependency-affected gate.
CREATE: issue the amended recovery constitution with predecessor version, failure trigger, dependency cut, changed clauses and gate decisions.
COPY: preserve prior constitution, omission state and failed/pass gate history without transferring stale authority.
CONTROL: require an independent/current trigger and fresh replay/retest before amended successor admission.
CULTIVATE: evolve the recovery law across witnessed failures while keeping why each prior gate counted inspectable.
Compression: change the repair law without erasing which permissions failed with it.


CONTRACTION
Reuse the repair law only as a hypothesis; let the witnessed dependency cut decide what reopens, amend the recovery law only under fresh boundary evidence, and pass continuity and action gates again.

- Remove 5H.ZLdR: recurrent dual-gated self-amendment remains, but there is no complete witnessed evidence/warrant dependency cut proving which constitutional and authority coordinates may reopen and which may remain current.
- Remove 5H.SBvl: partitioned self-amendment plus dual-gate provenance remain, but recurrence evidence is no longer recursively provenance-stratified together with separate continuity/action successor admission.
- Remove 5H.rSmH: replication-qualified partitioned two-gate renewal remains, but recovery-law amendment is not fully earned as an explicit versioned successor event whose reopening stays independently/currently gated.
All four are necessary for the complete volume.


COLLAPSE — THREE SURVIVING METABOLITES


1. REPAIR-RECURRENCE-DOES-NOT-PASS-SUCCESSOR-GATES
Minimal earning body: wy, strengthened by wxy/wyz.
Invariant: recurrence may qualify a repair architecture as worth reusing, but neither continuity nor affected downstream action authority can be inherited from prior repair success; every concrete successor passes both gates under current evidence.
CREATE: publish recurrence relation/type together with current continuity and dependent action tests.
COPY: carry repair schema and recurrence provenance, not passed gate state.
CONTROL: block any use of recurrence as continuity or action authority.
CULTIVATE: let further recurrence refine which repair relations remain worth retrying without relaxing current admission.
Compression: repair capacity may recur; permission does not.


2. DEPENDENCY-CUT-ROUTES-BOTH-GATES
Minimal earning body: wx/yx, strengthened by wxy/xyz.
Invariant: the witnessed failure dependency cut determines which continuity and action coordinates must reopen; coordinates outside the cut remain current only under their own live witnesses, not because repair ignored them.
CREATE: expose failed coordinate, evidence/warrant dependencies, affected continuity gates and affected action gates.
COPY: preserve the exact cut and outside-cone witnesses as provenance.
CONTROL: reopen only dependency-relevant gates and expand the cone only on fresh dependency evidence.
CULTIVATE: refine later cuts when returned evidence reveals hidden couplings.
Compression: let the failure cut decide which permissions must answer again.


3. SELF-AMENDMENT-PRESERVES-FAILED-GATE-PROVENANCE
Minimal earning body: wxz/wyz, completed by wxyz.
Invariant: when the recovery constitution itself changes, predecessor omission scope and continuity/action gate states remain immutable provenance; the amended constitution cannot certify its own reopening and must freshly decide every dependency-affected gate.
CREATE: issue the amended recovery constitution with predecessor version, failure trigger, dependency cut, changed clauses and gate decisions.
COPY: preserve prior constitution, omission state and failed/pass gate history without transferring stale authority.
CONTROL: require an independent/current trigger and fresh replay/retest before amended successor admission.
CULTIVATE: evolve the recovery law across witnessed failures while keeping why each prior gate counted inspectable.
Compression: change the repair law without erasing which permissions failed with it.


CONTRACTION
Reuse the repair law only as a hypothesis; let the witnessed dependency cut decide what reopens, amend the recovery law only under fresh boundary evidence, and pass continuity and action gates again.
