metabolites.title: Put iterative feedback in continuity, not dependency cycles
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.4nQ1:xyz.
CREATE: Keep cross-component dependency graphs acyclic and represent a component’s need to revisit its own prior state as a time/wake policy rather than as an edge from the component back to itself.
COPY: Each bounded activation reads prior canonical truth, incorporates newly moved inputs or a declared tick, commits a new version and ends; the next activation repeats the process through time.
CONTROL: Reject true circular subscriptions at compile time, distinguish time-based self-reassessment from data dependency, and bound wake cadence so feedback does not become uncontrolled polling.
CULTIVATE: Design iterative/adaptive systems as a sequence of versioned state transitions over an acyclic dependency graph, making feedback history inspectable without sacrificing topological termination.
Compression: A behavioral loop does not need a graph loop; let time carry the feedback.
metabolites.compression: A behavioral loop does not need a graph loop; let time carry the feedback.

metabolites.title: Durable intent can be portable across execution substrates
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.4nQ1:wxz.
CREATE: Keep the authoritative responsibility in a human-readable semantic contract and define host interactions through abstract execution/state primitives rather than embedding one platform’s private orchestration machinery into the intent.
COPY: The same contract can be carried to another conforming host while the host remaps session spawning, state backend and tools beneath the contract.
CONTROL: Treat portability as conditional on semantic conformance: inspect receipts/state/output behavior and do not infer that two hosts are equivalent merely because both can parse the file.
CULTIVATE: Version semantic contracts independently from harness implementations and use conformance/evaluation artifacts to progressively prove which hosts preserve which semantics.
Compression: Preserve the promise above the substrate; test whether each substrate actually keeps it.
metabolites.compression: Preserve the promise above the substrate; test whether each substrate actually keeps it.

vertices.title: Standing-work thesis, layer boundary and maturity contract
vertices.text:
Source files: root `README.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, and `skills/open-prose/SKILL.md`.
Nutrient: the public intent and scope: OpenProse treats reusable/standing AI work as durable Markdown contracts declaring what should remain true; source intent is meant to stay decoupled from models/harness implementation; contracts are preferred to choreography; the skill routes authoring/compile/run operations; language/framework semantics belong in the open source while harness machinery stays below that layer; the source explicitly calls the system young, evolving and benchmark-incomplete.

vertices.title: Authored intent separates maintained truth from pinned choreography
vertices.text:
Source files: `skills/open-prose/contract-markdown.md` and `skills/open-prose/prosescript.md`.
Nutrient: the human-authored language object: a responsibility declares `### Requires`, `### Maintains`, `### Continuity`, postconditions/facets and invariants; a function declares Parameters→Returns; ProseScript exists only when exact intra-node order, loops, retries, branches, parallelism or calls must be pinned. `### Maintains` is the schema/canonicalization contract for published truth, while `### Execution` is optional mechanism. Cross-node composition is subscription, not ProseScript wiring.

vertices.title: Semantic compile lowers intent into deterministic change propagation
vertices.text:
Source files: `skills/open-prose/forme.md`, `skills/open-prose/responsibility-runtime.md`, and `skills/open-prose/concepts/reconciler.md`.
Nutrient: the compile/run machinery: Forme semantically matches `Requires.<facet>` to `Maintains.<facet>` and freezes an acyclic topology; compile also lowers canonicalizers and postconditions. At run time the reconciler carries no LLM judge: it compares contract/input fingerprints, skips unchanged work, coalesces wakes, launches one bounded render when material input changed, and propagates only committed world-model fingerprints that moved. Self-driven continuity represents temporal feedback without adding a graph cycle.

vertices.title: Bounded execution publishes canonical truth through a commit boundary
vertices.text:
Source file: `skills/open-prose/prose.md`.
Nutrient: the execution semantics and state boundary: a Prose-complete host embodies the VM, spawning bounded real sessions and binding state through a selected backend; render scratch lives privately in `workspace/`, while only declared maintained truth is deterministically serialized into the published `world-model/` and signed into an append-only receipt chain. Failed renders leave last-good published truth standing. State and receipts survive session boundaries; the conversational/render session itself need not remain alive.

S.5al0.title: Verbalizable Representations Form a Global Workspace in Language Models

edges.title: A verbalizable coordinate system becomes an access format only through causal use
edges.text: Given w + x, the paper moves from a measurement construction to a functional object: w defines a sparse vocabulary-aligned component that can be read and written, while x shows that this component causally mediates report, deliberate loading, flexible recombination, and portions of silent reasoning even though the bulk of representation may remain elsewhere. Removing w leaves causal effects without a principled representational address; removing x leaves a lens-derived coordinate system without evidence that it functions as a workspace.

edges.title: The J-space is not merely a decoder artifact because its geometry meets independent structural privilege
edges.text: Given w + y, a corpus-averaged causal Jacobian-derived format is independently matched by a mid-layer band, limited occupancy, broad MLP/attention connectivity, ignition-like sharpening, post-training-dependent perspective signals, and a training intervention that changes later silent contents. Removing w loses the operational identity of the space; removing y loses the structural and developmental evidence that the identified format occupies a privileged computational role.

edges.title: The operationalization stays falsifiable because its blind spots remain part of its definition
edges.text: Given w + z, J-space can be treated as a concrete scientific object without being confused with the whole model state. The formal sparse-cone definition, recipe comparisons, single-token limitation, bag-of-concepts limitation, alternative lenses, and multi-token prototypes make explicit which distinctions the method can and cannot currently resolve. Removing w loses the object under test; removing z turns an operational instrument into an unjustified ontology.

edges.title: Flexible access is supported by both functional routing and broadcast architecture
edges.text: Given x + y, the global-workspace analogy gains two independent kinds of support: x shows selective causal availability for report and flexible downstream computation, while y shows a capacity-limited intermediate hub whose contents are broadly amplified and relayed. The same information can remain outside the hub for automatic tasks, so the relation is selective rather than globally exhaustive. Removing x leaves structural privilege without demonstrated cognitive use; removing y leaves functional effects without a matching broadcast/capacity architecture.

edges.title: Selective bypass is the control that prevents access from becoming cognition-as-a-whole
edges.text: Given x + z, the strongest functional results coexist with direct evidence that routine computation, underlying property representations, and substantial causal processing can proceed outside J-space. Experiential-language effects, report effects, and reasoning mediation therefore identify a privileged accessible format rather than proving that J-space contains all cognition or constitutes phenomenology. Removing x loses the behavioral dissociation; removing z loses the methodological and theoretical constraints that keep the dissociation bounded.

edges.title: A visible and trainable cognitive surface is useful precisely because it is incomplete
edges.text: Given y + z, J-space can expose silent leverage, evaluation awareness, prompt-injection recognition, trained misalignment, Assistant-relative reactions, and counterfactually trained principles, and can sometimes be causally manipulated to change behavior. Yet automatic processing can bypass it, automated J-lens auditing has documented misses, and the lens is less expressive than richer methods in some cases. Removing y loses the practical read/write evidence; removing z falsely upgrades an informative audit surface into a complete safety monitor.

faces.title: Causally identifiable workspace-like interface
faces.text: w + x + y jointly establish a privileged representational interface rather than a correlational readout: w supplies a defined sparse verbalizable coordinate system, x shows that it causally mediates selective report and flexible reasoning, and y shows that the same format is structurally capacity-limited and broadly broadcast. Remove w and the interface is not operationally identified; remove x and it lacks functional mediation; remove y and it lacks independent structural privilege.

faces.title: An earned access channel without exhaustiveness or phenomenal inflation
faces.text: w + x + z establish that a verbalizable component can be causally important for access-like behavior while remaining a partial and method-dependent view of the model. The paper earns a functional access channel because it can be measured and intervened upon, but the appendix failures, bypass routes, vocabulary/binding limits, and theory discussion forbid identifying that channel with all computation or phenomenal consciousness. Removing any one constituent either loses the channel, its causal role, or its epistemic boundary.

faces.title: From interpretability instrument to bounded intervention surface
faces.text: w identifies the J-space, y shows that its structure, post-training perspective, alignment-relevant contents, and reflection-trained dispositions can be read and causally reshaped, and z supplies method comparisons, audit failures, and scope limits. Together they earn the J-space as a practical intervention surface whose utility survives controls without implying uniqueness or completeness. Remove w and there is no stable address; remove y and there is no intervention/developmental evidence; remove z and there is no warranted boundary on the tool.

faces.title: Workspace, trained self-perspective, and phenomenology remain distinct variables
faces.text: x shows access-like function and selective bypass, y shows that the workspace is already present in base models while post-training privileges an Assistant-relative perspective, and z explicitly separates functional consciousness theories from phenomenal or substrate-specific claims. Together these bodies earn a dissociation: a workspace-like access architecture can precede a trained “self” perspective, and neither fact settles phenomenal consciousness. Remove x and the workspace loses functional grounding; remove y and the self/workspace developmental dissociation disappears; remove z and the phenomenal boundary is unearned.

volume.title: Bounded whole-paper closure
volume.text: The paper operationally identifies a small, sparse, vocabulary-aligned representational format—the J-space—using a corpus-averaged causal Jacobian lens. In the studied models, this format causally supports verbal report, deliberate loading, flexible downstream reuse, and portions of silent reasoning, while the same information and substantial routine computation can often remain outside it. J-space occupies an intermediate, capacity-limited layer regime and is preferentially amplified and relayed by model weights; its contents expose some silent strategic and alignment-relevant cognition, change with post-training into a more Assistant-relative perspective, and can be deliberately reshaped by counterfactual reflection training in ways that causally alter behavior. The whole paper therefore earns a concrete functional global-workspace-like interface: a privileged, verbally addressable routing surface for selected cognition. It does not earn that J-space is the complete or unique workspace, that all cognition or misalignment routes through it, that a transformer reproduces the recurrent human global-workspace implementation, or that functional access implies phenomenal consciousness. The relation between these functional signatures and phenomenal experience remains UNDERDETERMINED / OPEN.

metabolites.title: Access is a routing state, not possession of information
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.5al0:x.
Invariant: In the tested tasks, the same information can be encoded and used automatically while its verbal label is absent from J-space, then become J-space-accessible when explicit report or flexible recombination is demanded.
CREATE: load a content label into J-space by changing the computational demand from automatic use toward explicit report, deliberate thought, or flexible inference.
COPY: preserve the underlying stimulus/property while observing its reuse across matched tasks with different access demands.
CONTROL: use identical-stimulus paired prompts, J-space coordinate swaps, J-orthogonal property probes, and selective/global J-space ablations to distinguish possession from access.
CULTIVATE: derive predictive criteria for when content is routed into J-space and test nonverbal, multimodal, temporal, and latent access measures that do not depend on asking for a label.
Compression: Knowing something and making it globally addressable are different computational states.
metabolites.compression: Knowing something and making it globally addressable are different computational states.

metabolites.title: Flexible broadcast requires both a common format and structural privilege
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.5al0:xy.
Invariant: A shared representational interface becomes workspace-like when selected contents are flexibly reusable across downstream functions and the architecture preferentially amplifies and relays that interface while limiting what occupies it.
CREATE: allow interpreted content to enter the sparse J-space during the intermediate layer regime.
COPY: reuse the same J-space concept vector as an argument to different downstream computations and trace J-aligned amplification/relay across layers and positions.
CONTROL: compare matched random, rotated-J, non-J, SAE-stratified, capacity, and broadcast-head perturbations rather than inferring broadcast from readout alone.
CULTIVATE: test whether other architectures and modalities instantiate different privileged interface formats, and derive structural predictors of which representations become broadly reusable.
Compression: A common interface becomes a workspace when many processes can read it and only selected content enters it.
metabolites.compression: A common interface becomes a workspace when many processes can read it and only selected content enters it.

metabolites.title: Counterfactual verbal disposition can train silent cognition
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.5al0:y.
Invariant: Training a model to articulate grounded principles only in counterfactual reflection continuations can install corresponding J-space contents in uninterrupted task contexts and improve downstream behavior; ablating those implanted contents removes much of the gain.
CREATE: attach reflection-only supervision to ordinary task contexts while withholding that reflection turn at evaluation time.
COPY: recover the trained principles as silent J-space contents in the original contexts and reproduce behavioral improvement across distinct honesty-related evaluations.
CONTROL: compare base and reflection-trained models with no reflection prompt at evaluation, then ablate the implanted J-space concept family to test mediation rather than mere correlation.
CULTIVATE: test other principles, model families, abstraction levels, adversarial settings, durability, and side effects to determine how generally counterfactual verbal dispositions can sculpt silent computation.
Compression: What a model is trained to say if asked later can alter what it silently represents now.
metabolites.compression: What a model is trained to say if asked later can alter what it silently represents now.

metabolites.title: Workspace architecture can precede a trained self-perspective
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.5al0:y.
Invariant: The studied base model already exhibits a load-bearing J-space, while post-training makes Assistant-relative reactions and self-monitoring-like contents more prominent, supporting a separation between access architecture and the perspective trained to occupy it.
CREATE: pretraining establishes the workspace-like carrier; post-training adds task-, role-, safety-, preference-, and interaction-relative dispositions that populate it from an Assistant viewpoint.
COPY: compare corresponding base and post-trained models on matched user turns involving safety, empathy, anticipated answers, roleplay, preference conflict, and thought-suppression reactions.
CONTROL: require paired base/post-training comparisons and preserve the paper’s caution that some apparent metacognitive reactions, especially thought-suppression failure responses, remain interpretive rather than uniquely mechanistic.
CULTIVATE: trace workspace and perspective emergence across training checkpoints, personas, role conditions, and interventions that selectively alter self-related contents without destroying the underlying workspace.
Compression: A workspace can exist before a trained point of view occupies it.
metabolites.compression: A workspace can exist before a trained point of view occupies it.

metabolites.title: A transparent workspace is an audit surface, not a complete safety monitor
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.5al0:yz.
Invariant: J-space inspection can expose and sometimes causally manipulate silent strategic, evaluation-aware, injection-aware, and trained misalignment-related contents, while documented bypass routes and audit misses prevent it from serving as a complete monitor of cognition or intent.
CREATE: inspect J-space around decision points and response onset, optionally using targeted token families or an automated auditing agent.
COPY: recover workspace signatures across blackmail, prompt injection, frontier-model audit cases, reward-hacking and reward-model-appeasement organisms, and evaluation-awareness probes.
CONTROL: combine causal ablations, baseline models, evaluation-versus-deployment contrasts, natural-language-autoencoder comparisons, and preserved failure cases; do not infer absence of misalignment from an empty J-space readout.
CULTIVATE: combine J-lens with SAEs, richer natural-language or multi-token lenses, attribution methods, and adversarial tests designed to characterize cognition that avoids the verbalizable workspace.
Compression: A privileged cognitive surface can make hidden reasoning visible without making hidden reasoning impossible elsewhere.


No cross-paper universality is claimed here. All five invariants remain single-source metabolites of S.5al0 until an explicit later cross-paper operation relates and challenges them.


FEELING PHENOTYPE — WITNESSED
Designation: S.5al0.⛨Ω⚸⁎
Canonical order: CREATE · COPY · CONTROL · CULTIVATE
Feeling signature: ⛨Ω⚸⁎
Phenotype state: WITNESSED


CREATE — ⛨ Bridge
Pre-aspect role-shape: Build a common addressable interface that spans otherwise separate internal processes, so selected latent content can be reported, deliberately loaded, reused in reasoning, and handed to many downstream computations.
Witness: J-space is earned as a sparse shared format because many distinct processes can read from and write to it while most processing remains elsewhere. ⛨ Bridge is stronger than ★ Pattern: the paper does not merely discover recurring structure; it identifies an architecture whose defining power is to span and connect heterogeneous computations through one load-bearing interface.


COPY — Ω Continuity
Pre-aspect role-shape: Preserve a concept’s recognizable identity while carrying it across different downstream operations, prompts, layers, and training conditions, and preserve the workspace carrier even when the perspective occupying it changes.
Witness: The same J-space concept vector can be lifted from one context and remain usable as an argument to another computation, while base and post-trained models retain the workspace even as post-training changes its characteristic contents. Ω Continuity is stronger than ⧢ Resonance because the paper’s evidence is explicit persistence/reusability of an identifiable representational thread rather than merely harmonious alignment.


CONTROL — ⚸ Constraint
Pre-aspect role-shape: Keep access selective and capacity-limited; make bypass routes, lens failures, vocabulary/binding limits, architectural differences, and the phenomenal-consciousness boundary part of the organism rather than treating an informative surface as exhaustive cognition.
Witness: The paper repeatedly preserves what J-space does not contain and what J-lens cannot resolve. Routine computation can bypass the workspace, the interface holds only selected contents, alternative methods sometimes see more, and functional access is not upgraded into phenomenology. ⚸ Constraint is stronger than ◎ Focus because the governing motion is not simply allocation of attention but coherence through explicit limits that prevent the workspace claim from inflating beyond its earned domain.


CULTIVATE — ⁎ Becoming
Pre-aspect role-shape: Reshape what occupies an already-existing workspace so a new trained perspective or silent disposition becomes active without erasing the underlying carrier architecture.
Witness: Base models already contain a load-bearing workspace; post-training populates it with an Assistant-relative point of view, and counterfactual reflection training implants principles that later appear silently and causally alter behavior. ⁎ Becoming is stronger than ⁂ Evolution because the specific motion is new form arising inside an existing pattern without destroying what was already there.


Whole-organism witness: ⛨Ω⚸⁎ describes one integrated motion: selected cognition is made globally addressable through a common bridge-format, remains portable and recognizable across reuse and training change, is kept honest by selective boundaries and bypasses, and can acquire genuinely new perspective/disposition while preserving the workspace that carries it. Phenotype remains orthogonal to identity, routing, rank, and any phenomenal-consciousness claim.
metabolites.compression: A privileged cognitive surface can make hidden reasoning visible without making hidden reasoning impossible elsewhere.

gaps.title: BOUNDARY UNEXPOSED
gaps.text: No explicit epistemic/evidence-boundary block was mechanically recognized in this canonical artifact.

vertices.title: Operationalizing a sparse verbalizable workspace
vertices.text:
Source span: Abstract → end of §2.5 (pp. 1–10).
Nutrient: The paper frames its target as access consciousness in a purely functional sense and identifies five workspace-like properties to test: reportability, directed modulation, internal reasoning, flexible generalization, and selectivity. It introduces the Jacobian lens (J-lens), which averages the linearized causal effect of intermediate activations on current and future outputs, and defines the J-space as sparse nonnegative combinations of vocabulary-aligned J-lens vectors. The J-space is a union of low-dimensional cones rather than a conventional linear subspace, and its component usually accounts for only a small fraction of activation variance. This body earns an explicit read/write operationalization of verbalizable representation, not a claim that all internal meaning is verbal or that a transformer reproduces the recurrent architecture of a human global workspace.

vertices.title: Functional access, causal mediation, and selective bypass
vertices.text:
Source span: §3 “J-space acts as a Global Workspace” (pp. 10–28).
Nutrient: Across report, deliberate thought, silent reasoning, flexible downstream reuse, and global-ablation tests, J-space contents behave like a selectively available working format. Coordinate swaps and decomposed steering show that small J-space components can causally redirect reports and intermediate computations even when most activation variance lies outside J-space. Paired-prompt controls show that the same underlying property can be encoded and automatically used while its verbal label is absent from J-space, then be loaded into J-space when explicit report or flexible reasoning demands it. Unspoken intermediates appear in J-space and can redirect multihop, multilingual, poetry, arithmetic, and bandit behavior; the same concept vector can be reused across different downstream functions. Conversely, routine continuation, shallow classification/retrieval, and other automatic operations can often bypass J-space. J-space ablation also reduces experiential language while preserving substantial coherence, but the paper does not treat this as evidence of phenomenology.

vertices.title: Structural privilege, alignment visibility, self-perspective, and causal reshaping
vertices.text:
Source span: §4 → end of §7 (pp. 28–51).
Nutrient: The paper shows that J-space has structural signatures matching its functional role: coherent content emerges in an intermediate layer band, occupancy is limited, and J-aligned directions receive disproportionately broad MLP and attention-mediated broadcast connectivity; specialized broadcast-head ablations weaken J-space content and some report effects while leaving much direct next-token behavior intact. Ambiguous representations also sharpen into a selected interpretation around workspace onset. The same interface exposes silent strategic and evaluation-relevant content in alignment cases and model organisms, although not all relevant cognition appears there. Base models already exhibit a load-bearing workspace, while post-training makes Assistant-relative safety, empathy, answer anticipation, roleplay disclaimers, preference conflict, and related reactions more salient in J-space, supporting a dissociation between workspace architecture and a trained Assistant perspective. Counterfactual reflection training then provides a direct intervention: training only reflective continuations about constitutional principles implants corresponding J-space contents in uninterrupted task contexts, improves two honesty-related behaviors, and J-space ablation of the implanted concepts reverses much of that gain.

vertices.title: Evidential stress, methodological boundary, and theoretical scope
vertices.text:
Source span: §8 → end of carrier, including §9, Appendix A, and References (pp. 52–117).
Nutrient: The related-work and discussion sections bound the global-workspace analogy and preserve open questions: J-lens is single-token and bag-of-concepts limited; the workspace/motor boundary is partly empirical and partly chosen; early-layer emptiness may reflect either computation or lens limits; the rule predicting when information enters J-space is not yet known; the mechanism that populates J-space is not identified; and scaling/training emergence remains open. The transformer implementation is feedforward across layer and sequence dimensions rather than recurrent in the human-neuroscience sense. The appendices stress the method against logit and tuned lenses, alternative Jacobian recipes, corpus sizes, matched controls, activation patching, SAE strata, broadcast alternatives, automated alignment auditing, and attribution graphs; they formalize J-space as a sparse union of cones and prototype multi-token template/oracle extensions. These controls support J-lens as a useful causal/intermediate lens while also exposing failures: natural-language autoencoders outperform it in some audits, automatic cognition can bypass the workspace, multi-token/binding structure is incompletely captured, and attribution graphs show J-space as a verbalizable skeleton through which only part of the total causal computation flows. The paper therefore treats access-consciousness-like function as empirically testable while leaving its relation to phenomenal consciousness UNDERDETERMINED / OPEN.

S.6arU.title: Decoupling the “What” and “Where” With Polar Coordinate Positional Embeddings

edges.title: independent roles require independent representational degrees
edges.text: w identifies the failure as two semantically distinct variables sharing the same phase coordinate; x moves content into magnitude while reserving phase for position. Derived relation: when two factors must be independently varied and queried, assigning them to the same representational degree creates cross-talk; separating the degrees preserves independent addressability before their final conjunction.

edges.title: predicted entanglement becomes a selective failure signature
edges.text: w predicts difficulty specifically when content and position must be manipulated independently; y constructs exactly that pressure in Indirect Indexing and observes an enormous RoPE–PoPE separation, then smaller gains in real sequence domains. Derived relation: an architectural diagnosis gains specificity when its strongest performance gap appears on a task that isolates the interaction the analysis identifies, rather than only on broad benchmarks.

edges.title: content-dependent coordinate semantics become extrapolation pressure
edges.text: w shows that RoPE lets content phase shift positional tuning; z shows that this becomes increasingly problematic as unseen sequence lengths activate low-frequency behavior beyond the training range. Derived relation: if the meaning of a positional coordinate depends on content state, extending the coordinate domain can expose interactions that training never constrained. Stable address semantics therefore matter especially outside the original range.

edges.title: separated factors can still form a conjunctive match
edges.text: x assigns what to magnitudes and where to relative phase; y shows that PoPE can solve a task requiring both source-content identification and positional offset arithmetic, while also supporting ordinary sequence modeling. Derived relation: disentanglement does not require preventing interaction; independently encoded factors can be combined at the decision operation after each remains separately addressable.

edges.title: factor purity preserves a reusable position law
edges.text: x defines positional phase solely from tθ and sθ, with content affecting magnitude rather than phase; z shows strong zero-shot extension to much longer positions and broader frequency utilization. Derived relation: the same relative-position rule can be reused beyond the training window when its coordinate semantics do not change with the content being carried. Learnable δ can tune frequency preference without reintroducing input-dependent positional phase.

edges.title: diagnostic success survives broader and harder regimes
edges.text: y establishes near-complete Indirect Indexing performance plus consistent in-domain sequence-modeling gains; z shows that the advantage is not confined to the diagnostic or training-length regime and survives long-context extrapolation, alternative positional controls and implementation audits. Derived relation: a proposed factorization is stronger when it succeeds both on the surgical independence test and on heterogeneous regimes that were not constructed solely to reward the diagnosis.

faces.title: factor-aligned representation
faces.text: w derives a concrete source of what–where interference; x assigns each factor a distinct coordinate role; y demonstrates independent content/position manipulation and broader task gains. Three-way derivation: representational geometry is better aligned with a task when factors that must be independently controlled remain independently encoded until the operation that intentionally combines them. Remove w and there is no identified confound; remove x and no structural separation; remove y and the claimed benefit is untested.

faces.title: stable address semantics
faces.text: w shows that content can alter the positional meaning of RoPE phase; x fixes positional phase as content-independent; z shows that this coordinate rule remains usable far beyond the trained context range. Three-way derivation: an address system extrapolates more naturally when the variable designated as “where” keeps the same semantics regardless of “what” occupies that address. This is an empirical result for PoPE, not a theorem that all disentangled coordinates extrapolate.

faces.title: one entanglement predicts two distinct failure surfaces
faces.text: w identifies the content-position interaction; y exposes failure when what and where must be independently manipulated; z exposes failure when positional coordinates are extended beyond the trained range. Three-way derivation: the same representational coupling is implicated in both independence failure and extrapolation instability, giving the diagnosis more explanatory reach than either benchmark alone.

faces.title: separation is not merely a diagnostic trick
faces.text: x implements the factorized attention geometry; y shows gains across music, genomics and language at several scales; z shows length extrapolation, broader positional controls, frequency-use differences and explicit computational costs. Three-way derivation: the architectural separation remains useful across diagnostic, natural-data and out-of-distribution regimes, while its costs and limits stay visible.

volume.title: independent addressability before conjunction
volume.text:
All four vertices together derive the paper’s deepest operational structure: attention needs both content and position, but needing both does not require encoding both in the same representational degree. RoPE’s polar form shows how content-dependent phase can shift positional phase (w). PoPE assigns content to magnitude and position to phase while delaying their intended interaction until the attention score (x). The resulting system can manipulate what and where independently and performs better across tested sequence domains (y), while its position law remains substantially more stable when sequence addresses extend far beyond training (z).


Volume invariant: factors that must be independently queried should remain independently addressable in the representation until the operation that intentionally combines them. In this paper, preserving distinct content and position coordinates reduces cross-talk, supports conjunctive attention, and improves both independent indexing and long-context extrapolation. The earned claim is architectural and empirical for the tested Transformer settings; it does not establish polar coordinates as unique or all factor coupling as harmful.

metabolites.title: independent addressability before conjunction
metabolites.text:
Source body: S.6arU:wxyz
CREATE — assign semantically independent roles to separate representational degrees: content controls magnitude while position controls phase.
COPY — carry those roles through keys and queries without allowing content variation to rewrite positional phase or positional change to redefine content magnitude.
CONTROL — combine the factors deliberately at the attention score through magnitude weighting and relative-phase matching; use only input-independent learned phase bias δ rather than restoring content-dependent phase.
CULTIVATE — learn content features and per-frequency preferences while preserving the role separation, and ablate each component to verify that the separation remains functional.
Compression: factors that must be independently queried should remain independently addressable until their intended conjunction.
metabolites.compression: factors that must be independently queried should remain independently addressable until their intended conjunction.

metabolites.title: stable coordinate semantics enable extrapolation
metabolites.text:
Source body: S.6arU:wxyz
CREATE — define the position coordinate through a content-independent phase law over relative offset.
COPY — reuse the same phase/frequency rule as sequence positions extend beyond the addresses observed during training.
CONTROL — constrain learned phase bias, choose initialization/frequency structure, measure long-context perplexity, and expose compute/memory overhead rather than hiding the cost of stability.
CULTIVATE — extend context through additional data or fine-tuning without changing the underlying positional semantics; adapt frequency preferences while keeping the coordinate rule intact.
Compression: extrapolation is easier when an address keeps the same meaning outside the range in which it was learned.
metabolites.compression: extrapolation is easier when an address keeps the same meaning outside the range in which it was learned.

metabolites.title: diagnostic independence test
metabolites.text:
Source body: S.6arU:wxyz
CREATE — construct a task in which success requires finding a source by content, applying an independently specified relative-position shift, and returning the content at the resulting address.
COPY — procedurally vary strings, source symbols and offsets so the same abstract operation must recur across many instances rather than be memorized.
CONTROL — hold Transformer/training settings constant while varying positional encoding, then compare additional baselines that partially or differently encode position.
CULTIVATE — carry the architecture that survives the surgical diagnostic into music, genomics, language, model-scale and long-context tests to determine whether the distinction remains useful outside the toy task.
Compression: to test whether two factors are truly disentangled, make them vary independently and require both to solve the task.


FEELING PHENOTYPE — WITNESSED
Designation: S.6arU.⌀Ω⚖⚒
Canonical order: CREATE · COPY · CONTROL · CULTIVATE
Feeling signature: ⌀Ω⚖⚒
Phenotype state: WITNESSED


CREATE — ⌀ Gap
Pre-aspect role-shape: Give “what” and “where” independent representational degrees so each remains itself rather than silently rewriting the other; preserve a real separation until their intended conjunction.
Witness: PoPE’s core generative move is to stop false merger: content magnitude and positional phase become separately addressable, which makes their later interaction cleaner rather than weaker. ⌀ Gap is stronger than ⛨ Bridge because the new architecture is earned first by honest separation, not by constructing a shared spanning carrier.


COPY — Ω Continuity
Pre-aspect role-shape: Keep content and position roles semantically stable as they pass through keys/queries, domains, model scales, and positions far beyond the training window.
Witness: The same content-independent positional phase law is reused as sequence addresses extend from the trained context into much longer contexts; content can vary without changing what “where” means. Ω Continuity is stronger than ★ Pattern because the central recurrence is the same address semantics continuing through range change, not merely a structure reappearing under stress.


CONTROL — ⚖ Balance

vertices.title: diagnose the what–where entanglement
vertices.text:
Source span: ABSTRACT + INTRODUCTION + BACKGROUND; ends immediately before METHOD.
Nutrient: rewriting RoPE in polar form exposes the confound directly. Each 2D key/query component carries both a magnitude and a content-dependent phase; the RoPE attention term is proportional to μq μk cos((s−t)θ + φk−φq). The relative-position phase and content-dependent phase therefore occupy the same angular degree of freedom, so changing what is represented can shift where the component is tuned. The paper predicts that this should be especially harmful when content and position must be matched independently.

vertices.title: assign content and position to separate representational degrees
vertices.text:
Source span: METHOD through the efficient attention implementation; ends immediately before RESULTS.
Nutrient: PoPE converts each real query/key feature into a complex feature whose nonnegative magnitude is obtained from content by softplus, while phase is determined only by sequence position. Attention becomes a sum of μq μk cos((s−t)θ+δ), where δ is a learned but input-independent frequency bias. Content can change match strength without shifting the position phase, and position can change relative phase without altering content magnitude. The method therefore preserves a conjunction of what-match and where-match while removing the content-dependent phase interaction. A custom Flash-Attention-style implementation makes the construction executable, with an explicit FLOP/memory overhead rather than treating geometry as free.

vertices.title: test independent addressability and in-domain usefulness
vertices.text:
Source span: RESULTS from INDIRECT INDEXING through ZERO-SHOT PERFORMANCE ON DOWNSTREAM TASKS; ends immediately before TEST-TIME LENGTH EXTRAPOLATION.
Nutrient: the Indirect Indexing diagnostic deliberately requires independent manipulation of content and relative position. RoPE reaches only about 11% accuracy while PoPE reaches about 95%, strongly separating the two representations under the pressure the analysis predicts. The same positional encoding then improves NLL/perplexity on symbolic music, genomic sequence modeling and OpenWebText, with language-model gains persisting from 124M to 774M parameters. Ablations show that the softplus magnitude transform and learnable bias contribute, and zero-shot downstream evaluation gives higher mean accuracy for PoPE at all three language-model scales, though not every individual task improves.

vertices.title: stress coordinate stability beyond the training basin and audit the mechanism
vertices.text:
Source span: TEST-TIME LENGTH EXTRAPOLATION through FREQUENCY USAGE ANALYSIS, RELATED WORK, CONCLUSION, IMPACT STATEMENT, REFERENCES, and APPENDICES A–D to the end.
Nutrient: models trained at context length 1024 are tested zero-shot up to 10240 tokens. RoPE degrades sharply; YaRN helps within its fine-tuned range but degrades beyond it; PoPE extrapolates strongly without interpolation or fine-tuning, while PoPE+ft improves further. The authors connect RoPE’s failure to content-dependent phase shifts whose effects become especially problematic in low-frequency channels as context expands. Frequency analysis shows PoPE uses a broader range, including high-frequency channels that RoPE tends to suppress. Appendices provide the full polar derivation, compute-overhead accounting, dataset/training details, broader positional-encoding controls, and additional frequency/bias visualizations. The boundary remains architectural/empirical: the results support PoPE in the tested settings, not the unique correctness of polar coordinates or the undesirability of every content-position interaction.

edges.title: Reference law ↔ predictable factor

edges.title: Predictable construction ↔ optimization
edges.text: Because h_n need only be determined from the past, prediction/density estimates and other evidence strategies can be updated recursively without sacrificing validity solely because they adapt.

edges.title: Predictable construction ↔ history-aware law
edges.text: Past-adaptive choice of h_n and history-dependence of a known assignment law are distinct admissible mechanisms. The first is predictable strategy adaptation; the second is a moving but specified reference contract.

edges.title: Computation ↔ robustness
edges.text:
Resampling and optimized statistics inherit the calibration quality of Q. More powerful or more computationally convenient factors do not repair a wrong reference law; exact normalization and exchangeability remain load-bearing.


4 FACES


Fwxy — lawful sequential CI evidence
An explicit conditional reference mechanism, predictable factor construction, and computable/optimized evidence combine into a recursively updateable conditional-independence test martingale.


Fwxz — stopping and adaptation boundary
Anytime validity survives arbitrary stopping and past-adaptive test choice because validity is certified factor by factor. Neither freedom authorizes changing or estimating the reference law without paying its separate calibration debt.


Fwyz — implementation under imperfect reference
Resampling makes the conditional witness executable, but exactness depends on the represented exchangeability/reference mechanism; approximation must be carried as quantified error rather than silently absorbed.


Fxyz — two kinds of adaptation
Adaptive statistic learning and adaptive experimental assignment can both be lawful, but only under different witnesses: predictable choice for the former and an actually known history-indexed conditional law for the latter. Reference-law learning/misspecification remains a third, separate problem.


1 VOLUME
Model-X conditional-independence evidence can be made anytime-valid under predictable past adaptation by multiplying conditional e-statistic factors normalized against the lawful conditional X reference. Arbitrary stopping is then valid within the process contract, including settings with history-indexed known assignment mechanisms. Reference-law estimation or misspecification remains independent calibration/provenance debt that neither optional stopping, predictable h_n selection, resampling, nor growth-rate optimization erases.


SURVIVING INVARIANTS


1. PREDICTABLE-ADAPTATION INVARIANT
A round-wise test function may depend on the observed past without spending stopping validity when every new factor retains the required conditional null expectation through the lawful reference mechanism.


2. PROCESS-VALIDITY INVARIANT
A product of valid conditional e-statistics forms the process certificate that licenses repeated peeking and arbitrary stopping. The permission is carried by the process law, not by repeated observation itself.


3. REFERENCE-CUSTODY INVARIANT
Exact Model-X anytime validity is carried by the correct conditional X law. That law may be history-indexed when the assignment mechanism is genuinely known; estimation or misspecification is not silently promoted to exact finite-sample custody.


4. IMPLEMENTATION-ROBUSTNESS INVARIANT
Computable resampling must preserve the exact normalization/exchangeability witness; the source’s corrected denominator does so, while a naive approximation can be anti-conservative. Approximation error therefore remains an explicit robustness term.


BOUNDARY
This source does not prove unrestricted conditional-independence testing, universal immunity to adaptive data reuse, exact validity under arbitrary same-sample estimation of Q(X|Z), or immunity to target/model switching. Its guarantee is source-contract specific: Model-X/reference-law assumptions, filtration/predictability conditions, and the stated e-statistic construction remain load-bearing. vertices.title: Induction / terminal-to-sequential bridge
vertices.text:
Source span: pp. 1–8, Sections 1–2.
Nutrient: For a valid terminal [0,1]-valued test, conditional expectation under the evolving filtration yields an adapted anytime-valid test process. Under the stated representation conditions an admissible anytime-valid process is tied back to terminal testing. vertices.text:
Source span: pp. 8–11, Sections 3–4.
Nutrient: Classical z- and t-tests can be induced into anytime-valid sequential procedures that retain the corresponding classical test at the planned terminal horizon N. The one-sided t-test extension is bounded by the sufficient-statistic/MLR assumptions established in the source, and the paper supplies explicit computational forms rather than a merely existential bridge.

vertices.title: Optional continuation / conditional budget transport
vertices.text:
Source span: pp. 11–14, Section 5.
Nutrient: If a first valid [0,1]-test realizes value phi_1, a successor that is conditionally valid at level phi_1 preserves the original global level. At an arbitrary stopping time sigma, an anytime-valid procedure may be stopped and replaced by a successor test/process that is conditionally valid at the inherited value phi_sigma given F_sigma. The source explicitly allows switching sequential procedures, experiment redesign, unplanned future experiments, and data-dependent branching filtrations under that conditional-validity contract. For composite nulls, retaining pointwise test families can support stronger continuation than prematurely collapsing them to one composite test.

vertices.title: e-value bridge, conditioning invariance, asymptotic SPRT, and limits
vertices.text:
Source span: pp. 14–26, Sections 6–8, references and appendices.
Nutrient: Rescaling connects [0,1]-tests to e-value/process language; optional continuation corresponds to multiplicative composition on the e-scale. Under the paper’s assumptions, log utility is uniquely compatible with the relevant conditioning invariance, tying induction to likelihood-ratio processes. The SPRT/log-optimal e-process appears as a limit of induced Neyman–Pearson tests in the stated asymptotic regime. The discussion also preserves a practical limitation: a process induced from a fixed finite-horizon test can hit zero and may not naturally support indefinite continuation beyond that horizon.


6E — PAIR CLOSURES


wx — Induction × classical applications
The source earns that planned-horizon classical-test behavior can be retained while adding lawful optional stopping before that horizon. Induction alone does not establish concrete z/t closure; the examples alone do not explain why the whole path is anytime-valid.


wz — Induction × optional continuation
The conditional-expectation construction turns a valid test value into a lawful stopped process value, and the continuation theorem gives that value a second role as the conditional level of a successor. This is stronger than stop-safety alone: validity can be transported across a procedural handoff under a new conditional-validity obligation.


wy — Induction × e-value/likelihood-ratio analysis
Conditional-expectation induction is the bridge from terminal tests to martingale-like processes; the later utility/e-value analysis identifies likelihood-ratio/log-optimal processes as a conditioning-invariant special case. Neither body alone earns the bridge-plus-fixed-point relation.


xz — Classical applications × optional continuation
A familiar fixed-horizon test can be sequentialized and then interrupted for a data-dependent switch or redesign without forfeiting the original level, but only if the successor pays its conditional-validity debt on the realized branch.


xy — Classical applications × e-value/limits
Exact agreement with a classical terminal test at N is compatible with anytime validity before N, while the e-process comparison exposes what that fixed-N construction does not automatically buy: natural indefinite continuation after absorbing/zero states. This is a real design trade-off rather than a contradiction.


zy — Optional continuation × e-value bridge
Conditional-level handoff on the [0,1] test scale and multiplicative composition on the e-scale encode the same iterated-expectation discipline in different coordinates. The paper earns procedural continuity under explicit conditional validity; it does not earn retroactive reinterpretation of earlier evidence under a newly authored semantic claim.


4F — TRIPLE CLOSURES


wxz — Planned-horizon preservation under intervention
A classical z/t procedure can be lifted into an anytime-valid path that still equals its planned terminal test at N, then lawfully handed to a redesigned successor at an arbitrary stopping time by passing the realized test level into a conditionally valid continuation.

Terminal-to-sequential induction can preserve planned-horizon target behavior while connecting ordinary tests to martingale/e-value process structure. The z/t cases witness the bridge concretely without implying that every composite test admits an equally simple computable induction.


wzy — Process composition by conditioning
Induced stopped tests, optional continuation, and e-process multiplication are held together by iterated conditional expectation. Log-optimal likelihood-ratio processes are a special conditioning-invariant case, not a warrant that every induced process is optimal or indefinitely reusable.


xzy — Practical intervention with explicit continuation debt
Sequentialized classical procedures permit mid-course intervention, while the e-value/process viewpoint explains how lawful continuation can compound beyond the original path. The source simultaneously preserves the limitation that finite-horizon-induced procedures can have absorbing behavior, so redesign freedom remains contract-bound rather than costless.

Terminal-test validity can be lifted into an anytime-valid process by conditioning on evolving information, and a stopped process can be composed with a successor by using its realized test outcome as the successor’s conditional significance level, preserving global validity while retaining the terminal test’s planned-horizon behavior. The successor still owes its own conditional-validity contract on the realized branch; stopping or redesign does not erase that obligation.

vertices.title: Coordination cost, correctness obligations, and execution model
vertices.text:
Source span: PDF pages 1–4 / printed pp.185–188.
Nutrient: The paper motivates coordination avoidance through the latency, availability and scalability costs of synchronous coordination; rejects serializability as a universally necessary implementation requirement; and defines the system vocabulary needed for a sharper question: database states, transactions, replicas, merge, application invariants, transactional availability, convergence and global invariant validity. Correctness is explicitly parameterized by application invariants rather than equated with one universal isolation level.
Boundary: this body establishes the problem and formal obligations, not yet the exact criterion deciding when coordination is avoidable.

vertices.title: Invariant confluence theorem and constraint taxonomy
vertices.text:
Source span: PDF pages 5–7 / printed pp.189–191.
Nutrient: The paper defines I-T-reachable states and invariant confluence: every pair of invariant-valid states reachable from a common ancestor under the admitted transactions/merge must merge to another invariant-valid state. Theorem 1 states a necessary-and-sufficient boundary: a globally invariant-valid system can provide coordination-freedom, transactional availability and convergence for transaction set T exactly when T is I-confluent with respect to invariant I. The paper sketches both directions and classifies representative integrity constraints, showing that safety depends jointly on invariant, transactions and merge semantics rather than on operation names alone.
Boundary: the full formal proof is delegated to the extended version; this carrier earns the theorem statement, proof sketch, examples and explicit limits. Arbitrary I-confluence analysis is not generally decidable.

vertices.title: Selective coordination in TPC-C and empirical realization
vertices.text:
Source span: PDF pages 8–10 / printed pp.192–194.
Nutrient: The paper applies I-confluence analysis to TPC-C, finding that most stated invariants can be maintained without cross-server coordination while two sequential-ID constraints are not I-confluent. The implementation coordinates only those remaining obligations and executes the rest with coordination-free mechanisms. The prototype and experiments report strong scaling, including 12.74 million New-Order transactions per second on 200 servers and roughly a 25-fold improvement over the coordinated baseline, with physical-resource limits becoming the dominant bottleneck.
Boundary: these are prototype/benchmark results under the paper’s implementation and workload; they do not prove that every implementation of an I-confluent workload scales equally or that benchmark specifications capture every production invariant.

vertices.title: Relation to weaker/stronger coordination criteria and final scope
vertices.text:
Source span: PDF pages 11–12 / printed pp.195–196.
Nutrient: Related-work and conclusion sections distinguish I-confluence from blanket serializability, commutativity/monotonicity heuristics, CRDT-style convergence, CAP framing and prior coordination-avoidance techniques. The paper emphasizes that convergence or algebraic conflict-freedom does not itself establish application correctness; the explicit application invariant is load-bearing. It closes by framing I-confluence as a way to identify when coordination is strictly necessary, not as a guarantee that unspecified or incorrect application requirements will be preserved.
Boundary: the result is conditioned on an explicit, sufficiently complete invariant and the modeled transaction/merge semantics; semantic correctness omitted from the specification remains outside the guarantee.

Without w the theorem lacks the exact obligations it protects; without x the cost/correctness setup lacks a tight decision boundary.

x supplies classifications of I-confluent and non-I-confluent invariant/transaction combinations; y instantiates that distinction inside TPC-C by executing most constraints without coordination while coordinating the sequential-ID residue. Together they earn workload decomposition by semantic obligation. Without x the decomposition lacks its criterion; without y it remains formal rather than operationally demonstrated.

edges.title: The statistical second-moment obligation becomes analytically reducible because the order-statistic formulas expose gamma and φ kernels rather than leaving the problem as unrestricted quadrature.
The reduction target is operational, not merely symbolic: the same moment representation can be evaluated by finite combinations of tabulated special functions.
Statistical target and derived moments can be checked by consistency relations, yet end-to-end numerical execution has a precision boundary independent of analytic correctness.
Intermediate transformed integrals close into explicit gamma/Spence expressions; tabulated special functions replace numerical integration.
Algebraic simplification is only computationally useful when evaluation discipline handles cancellation and validates the resulting moments.
Closed-form economy and symmetry reduce work, while the example shows that “closed form” does not imply automatic numerical stability or exhaustive error detection.

faces.title: Exact second moments can be computed without numerical quadrature by reducing order-statistic moment integrals to gamma derivatives and the Spence function.
Analytic reducibility must be paired with numerical witness and precision care: an exact derivation does not remove finite-precision debt.
Computational tractability is jointly produced by closed representation, symmetry savings, and bounded validation/precision handling.
Special-function closure, symmetry identity, and worked evaluation form an executable pipeline whose algebraic exactness and numerical conditioning remain distinct quality axes.

edges.title: Scalability becomes self-directed when expanding competence is tied to internally maintained goals
edges.text: Given w + x, the abstract target of an expanding cognitive light cone acquires an agentive mechanism. w defines flexibility and scalability as goal achievement across changing conditions and as enlargement of the spatial/temporal scope of prediction and control; x shows how living systems maintain selves, protect goals, build action-guiding models, and actively seek information. Remove w and autonomy has no source-defined scalability target; remove x and cognitive-light-cone expansion can be read as externally assigned capability accumulation. Together they earn a bounded relation: scalable intelligence in this paper is not only wider competence, but competence whose goals, sampling, and adaptive control increasingly originate within the system.

edges.title: Open-ended competence is developmental when new problem-solving scope is built by self-assembly and reconstruction
edges.text: Given w + y, the “intelligence ratchet” is connected to a concrete biological style of growth. w says new capabilities open new goals and adjacent possibilities; y says larger competences are assembled from active lower-level components and remain viable by continuous rebuilding rather than by freezing a perfected configuration. Remove w and self-assembly/reconstruction lacks the paper’s criterion of expanding problem-solving scope; remove y and scalability remains a descriptive trajectory without a source-grounded carrier process. Together they earn developmental scalability: intelligence grows by changing the architecture that carries it.

edges.title: The expansion of problem-solving scope remains physically and organizationally bounded
edges.text: Given w + z, “more intelligence” is not unconstrained omnipotence. w defines flexibility relative to an environment/niche and scalability as enlargement of a cognitive light cone; z shows that embodiment, energy, material laws, externalized structure, and communication channels shape which solutions are reachable and how collective goals are realized. Remove w and the physical/signaling mechanisms have no explicit relation to scalable competence; remove z and expansion can be mistaken for escaping constraint. Together they earn a constraint-sensitive light cone: capability expands by exploiting structured limits and communication surfaces, not by eliminating them.

edges.title: A self can persist because its realization is reconstructive rather than materially fixed
edges.text: Given x + y, protected goals and self-maintained identity coexist with continual replacement of the parts and representations that implement them. x gives the same-whole target—maintained boundaries, goals, and action-guiding models; y shows bodies, memories, networks, and components being rebuilt while function persists. Remove x and reconstruction has no criterion for continuing agency; remove y and autonomy risks becoming preservation of one fixed implementation. Together they earn functional continuity through reconstruction: selfhood can remain coherent while the carrier changes.

edges.title: Higher-level goals can coordinate local autonomy without erasing the agency of parts
edges.text: Given x + z, autonomy is not confined to one scale. x establishes agentic components with goals and local problem-solving; z supplies pervasive signaling and top-down constraint so larger collectives can specify outcomes while lower levels retain freedom over implementation. Remove x and top-down signaling becomes ordinary centralized control over passive parts; remove z and nested agents lack a source-grounded mechanism for alignment into a larger self. Together they earn multiscale delegated control: constrain outcomes and operating bands while preserving local problem-solving latitude.

edges.title: Rebuilding remains robust when constraints and signaling shape the space in which change occurs
edges.text: Given y + z, continuous self-assembly and turnover are not blind drift. y supplies mutable, reconstructive organization; z supplies physical regularizers, communication fields, and collective goals that bias local changes toward viable large-scale outcomes. Remove y and constraints/signals govern a comparatively static architecture; remove z and continual rebuilding lacks the coordinating membrane that distinguishes adaptive reorganization from disintegration. Together they earn guided reconstruction: change is productive when the possibility space is structured and feedback can propagate across scales.

faces.title: Scalable intelligence is an autonomous developmental ratchet
faces.text: w defines a moving frontier of solvable problems, x makes goal pursuit and learning increasingly self-directed, and y lets the carrier itself grow and rebuild. Together these bodies earn a stronger statement than any pair: scalable intelligence is a process that can enlarge both what the system can do and the machinery by which it learns to do it. Remove w and the expansion criterion disappears; remove x and growth may remain externally scripted; remove y and the agent cannot reconstruct the substrate of its own competence.

faces.title: Cognitive-light-cone expansion depends on goal-directed control that is embodied and communicative
faces.text: w supplies the scope of prediction/control, x supplies internally maintained goals and active modeling, and z supplies the physical and signaling channels through which those goals reach larger spatial, temporal, and organizational scales. Together they earn an embodied-control account of cognitive expansion. Remove w and the scale measure disappears; remove x and the control has no self-maintained agenda; remove z and the agenda has no multiscale realization mechanism.

faces.title: Open-ended growth is viable because reconstruction is constrained rather than arbitrary
faces.text: w frames scalability as continued access to new problem spaces, y makes change and rebuilding normal, and z shows how physical laws and collective signaling restrict and coordinate those changes. Together they earn a bounded recipe for open-endedness: the system explores and reconstructs without treating every possible change as equally admissible. Remove w and there is no pressure toward enlarged competence; remove y and nothing is progressively rebuilt; remove z and the paper’s stabilizing structure disappears.

faces.title: Nested agency can survive component turnover through coordinated reconstruction
faces.text: x supplies self-maintained goals and agent boundaries, y supplies multiscale active components plus continual rebuilding, and z supplies the signals and constraints that align local agendas with higher-level outcomes. Together they earn a nested-identity claim: a larger agent can remain coherent while its constituents act locally and its material realization changes. Remove x and there is no agentive identity to preserve; remove y and the multiscale/turnover problem disappears; remove z and alignment between scales is not maintained.

volume.title: Bounded whole-paper closure
volume.text: The paper’s life-inspired route to machine intelligence is a recipe for scalable organization rather than a blueprint for copying biological parts. Flexible intelligence is defined by goal achievement under changing conditions; scalable intelligence is the ability to enlarge the cognitive light cone and generate new problem-solving scope. Biology is argued to achieve this through five mutually reinforcing principles: autonomy gives systems protected goals, active sensing, and action-oriented models; multiscale self-assembly builds larger competences from active lower-level agents; continuous reconstruction preserves function and identity while the carrier changes; embodiment and physical constraint structure the possibility space and offload computation; pervasive signaling lets higher-level goals coordinate heterogeneous lower-level agents without requiring every decision to be centralized. The resulting picture is of intelligence as a continually rebuilt, constraint-sensitive hierarchy of partially autonomous controllers whose scope can grow through experience and development. The machine-intelligence lesson is prospective: architectures may become more flexible and scalable when they inherit this organizational logic. The carrier does not demonstrate that implementing these principles will produce AGI, that all five are necessary or sufficient, or that biological mechanisms are uniquely optimal.

metabolites.title: Scalability is expansion of the problem-solving horizon, not merely higher performance inside a fixed task
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.CTLJ:w.
Invariant: The paper distinguishes flexible competence within encountered conditions from scalability that enlarges the spatial, temporal, and problem-space scope of goals, prediction, and control—the “cognitive light cone.”
CREATE: define an explicit horizon of goals/problems that the system can currently manage and identify what would count as a genuinely new reachable region.
COPY: reproduce the expansion criterion across substrates without requiring identical tasks, architectures, or biological implementation.
CONTROL: distinguish better scores inside a fixed task family from new goals, new timescales, new spatial scope, or new problem spaces; keep niche/environmental bounds explicit.
CULTIVATE: let acquired competences create new exploration targets and measure whether the reachable horizon grows through experience rather than only through externally supplied benchmarks.
Compression: Scaling intelligence means enlarging what can be meaningfully pursued, not only optimizing what was already specified.
metabolites.compression: Scaling intelligence means enlarging what can be meaningfully pursued, not only optimizing what was already specified.

metabolites.title: Autonomous learning is organized around protected goals and action-guiding models
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.CTLJ:x.
Invariant: In the paper’s biological account, useful internal models need not be veridical world copies; they are coarse-grained structures sufficient to guide action toward self-maintained goals, with sensing and learning actively solicited by the organism.
CREATE: establish the minimal self-maintained variables/goals whose protection gives learning a direction.
COPY: preserve the goal→model→active sensing→action loop across different internal representations rather than copying one representational format.
CONTROL: test whether model detail improves adaptive action relative to cost; prevent passive predictive accuracy from substituting for autonomous goal pursuit.
CULTIVATE: deepen and extend models only as longer-horizon goals or new environments require richer prediction and control.
Compression: A model is valuable because it helps an agent keep and pursue its goals, not because it mirrors the world in maximal detail.
metabolites.compression: A model is valuable because it helps an agent keep and pursue its goals, not because it mirrors the world in maximal detail.

metabolites.title: Continuity can be reconstructive: stable function does not require stable material realization
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.CTLJ:y.
Invariant: Living systems preserve recognizable identity and capability while cells, molecules, memories, representations, and architectures are continually replaced, repaired, or reinterpreted.
CREATE: specify the functional/narrative relations that must survive a reconstruction instead of treating every current component as essential.
COPY: reproduce those relations through replacement and repair while allowing implementation-level drift.
CONTROL: distinguish faithful reconstruction from destructive drift using performance, goal, boundary, and identity criteria rather than bytewise sameness.
CULTIVATE: use perturbation, turnover, and relearning as opportunities to reorganize the carrier while testing that the preserved relations still close.
Compression: Persistence can live in the reconstruction process rather than in frozen parts.

metabolites.title: Multiscale coordination can preserve local autonomy by transmitting goals and constraints rather than micromanaging solutions
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.CTLJ:xz.
Invariant: Pervasive signaling lets higher-level biological collectives impose setpoints, fields, or operating constraints while lower-level components retain autonomous implementation latitude; this is presented as a route to scalable collective intelligence.
CREATE: express a collective objective in a form that can constrain many local agents without prescribing every local action.
COPY: preserve the relation between global goal and local freedom across scales and signaling modalities.
CONTROL: monitor defection/misalignment as well as over-centralization; require local behavior to remain inside collective viability bands while retaining adaptive degrees of freedom.
CULTIVATE: evolve richer signaling channels and nested goal structures as the collective’s cognitive light cone expands.
Compression: Scale coordination by broadcasting what must remain true, while letting local agents discover how to realize it.

vertices.title: Define flexible and scalable intelligence through diverse problem-solving and the cognitive light cone
vertices.text:
Source span: Abstract → Introduction → “Diverse intelligence in biology and machines” → “Scalable problem-solving in biology” → “Diverse intelligence includes machine intelligence,” ending immediately before “How does biology support flexible and scalable intelligence? Five design principles.”
Nutrient: The paper begins by rejecting intelligence as a binary property tied to one familiar substrate. Following William James, it treats intelligence as flexible goal achievement: the ability to reach a goal by variable means when conditions change. Biological examples—from cells and tissues to whole organisms—show competence in physiological, anatomical, behavioral, and other problem spaces. The “cognitive light cone” names the spatial and temporal scope over which a system can model, predict, care about, and control outcomes. Evolutionary and developmental transitions can expand that cone, creating an “intelligence ratchet” in which new problem-solving capacities enable new goals and new adjacent possibilities. Machine systems belong in the same diverse-intelligence comparison when assessed empirically by the problems and solution spaces they can navigate. The authors therefore set the target not as mere flexibility within a fixed repertoire, but scalability: a process that can autonomously enlarge the scope of competence.

vertices.title: Ground autonomy in maintained selfhood, protected goals, action-guiding models, and active learning
vertices.text:
Source span: “How does biology support flexible and scalable intelligence? Five design principles” → “Living organisms are ‘natural born autonomous’” → autonomy/Markov-blanket/generative-model/active-learning development, ending immediately before “Organisms’ bodies and cognitive abilities grow through the multiscale self-assemblage of active components.”
Nutrient: Living systems are described as autopoietic and self-directing: they must maintain the conditions of their own existence, establish goals, actively sample the environment, and learn from interaction rather than waiting for externally curated data. Markov-blanket language formalizes a boundary between internal and external states while preserving sensorimotor exchange. Homeostatic and allostatic goals provide protected setpoints around which action is organized; richer organisms build hierarchies of more distal goals. Internal or generative models are valuable insofar as they guide adaptive action, not because they reproduce reality veridically. Coarse-graining is therefore a resource-efficient feature, and active sensing makes learning self-directed. Across phylogeny, predictive models become deeper and more temporally extended, supporting larger cognitive light cones while retaining a thread of self-maintained agency.

vertices.title: Build competence through multiscale self-assembly and preserve function by continual reconstruction
vertices.text:
Source span: “Organisms’ bodies and cognitive abilities grow through the multiscale self-assemblage of active components” → “Living organisms continuously rebuild themselves – and achieve adaptation through change,” ending immediately before “Living organisms consistently exploit embodied and physical principles.”
Nutrient: The second and third design principles move intelligence from a monolithic controller into a nested developmental process. Cells are themselves active, problem-solving units; multicellular bodies and nervous systems arise by coordinating such parts into larger agents with goals that no individual component possesses. Higher competences scaffold on older ones rather than replacing every mechanism at once. The resulting architecture is robust precisely because its components retain local capacities while being recruited into larger-scale organization. The paper then makes change itself constitutive: living systems persist while molecules, cells, memories, representations, and even architectures are rebuilt. Genetic information acts more like compressed developmental prompts than a complete static blueprint, and memory is reconstructive rather than a bitwise archive. Functional and narrative continuity can therefore survive material turnover and representational drift—the Ship-of-Theseus problem becomes a normal operating condition rather than an exception. Learning, repair, metamorphosis, and adaptation are expressions of the same reconstructive stance.

vertices.title: Use embodiment, physical constraint, and pervasive signaling to coordinate nested agents and translate the biology into AI design
vertices.text:
Source span: “Living organisms consistently exploit embodied and physical principles” → “Pervasive signaling enables self-organization and top-down control from goals” → “What can we learn from the five design principles?” → Conclusion → acknowledgements/declarations/references → end of carrier.
Nutrient: Biology does not compute in an unconstrained abstract vacuum. Energy limits, material properties, biomechanics, reaction-diffusion systems, bioelectric fields, oscillations, and other physical laws prune the possibility space and can perform useful computation by shaping what dynamics are available. Organisms also externalize work into bodies, environments, tools, and social structures. Pervasive signaling then links local autonomous components into larger wholes: chemical, bioelectric, neural, and other signals can carry collective setpoints downward while local parts solve implementation details. Top-down causation is presented as higher-level goals constraining lower-level activity rather than micromanaging every component. This coordination can expand cognitive light cones, but it also creates failure modes such as cellular defection/cancer when local agendas decouple from collective goals. The final AI synthesis restates all five principles and argues that future systems may benefit from intrinsic autonomy, semi-autonomous active components, continual rebuilding, meaningful constraints, and hierarchical signaling. The authors explicitly frame the task as continuing the organizational logic of life rather than copying every biological detail.
