S.Q41N.title: MotionStream: Real-Time Video Generation with Interactive Motion Controls

edges.title: Expensive bidirectional control can be compiled into causal execution
edges.text: Given w + x, the paper separates the distribution that defines desirable controlled video from the architecture that must execute it interactively. w supplies the motion representation and joint text-motion teacher guidance; x distills that guided distribution into a causal single-NFE student. Removing w loses the control/quality target being transferred; removing x leaves only an offline controllable generator.

edges.title: Interactive control requires balancing trajectory constraint with generative freedom
edges.text: Given w + y, strict motion guidance and text-conditioned natural dynamics are experimentally complementary rather than interchangeable. Pure motion guidance improves trajectory accuracy but can produce rigid planar motion, while text guidance contributes plausible dynamics and appearance changes; the chosen joint setting trades between them in benchmarks and demos. Removing w loses the designed control relation; removing y loses evidence that the relation works under interactive applications.

edges.title: The control representation defines which scene changes are expressible
edges.text: Given w + z, the same sparse 2D track interface that makes user control lightweight also creates semantic blind spots: zero-valued tracks conflate occlusion with lack of specification, and point trajectories cannot fully encode object birth, disappearance, identity preservation, or whole-scene replacement. Removing w loses the representation whose limits matter; removing z hides the failure modes that reveal its expressive boundary.

edges.title: Long-horizon execution emerges from matching the deployed recursive process during training
edges.text: Given x + y, constant-context autoregression becomes more than an architectural promise: training with self-generated rollouts, rolling KV state, and attention sinks is followed by stable tested extrapolation and constant latency/throughput as length grows. Removing x loses the mechanism and train–test match; removing y loses empirical evidence that it survives beyond the teacher’s short training horizon.

edges.title: The attention sink is simultaneously stabilizer and constraint
edges.text: Given x + z, preserving the initial chunk as a permanent context anchor prevents cumulative drift but also biases the generator toward the original scene when the environment should change substantially. The same mechanism therefore creates a stability–adaptability tradeoff rather than a free long-memory gain. Removing x loses the causal anchor mechanism; removing z loses the countervailing scene-change failure that defines its cost.

edges.title: Headline real-time performance is an end-to-end systems result with bounded horizon evidence
edges.text: Given y + z, interactive speed depends not only on the causal DiT but also chunk size, sampling steps, VAE decoding, hardware, and context configuration; the stress surface also bounds long-horizon claims to finite tests and documented failures. Removing y loses the demonstrated throughput/control regime; removing z turns a systems-dependent benchmark into an architecture-only or indefinite-coherence claim.

faces.title: Teacher-to-streaming-student transduction produces interactive controllable video
faces.text: w defines a high-quality motion-and-text-controlled distribution, x provides a causal distillation pathway that preserves that distribution under fixed-context autoregression, and y shows that the resulting student can execute live motion transfer, camera control, and drag control at interactive rates. Remove w and there is no controlled target; remove x and there is no streaming transformation; remove y and there is no demonstrated interactive closure.

faces.title: Lightweight control and persistent anchoring jointly bound the reachable world dynamics
faces.text: w compresses intended motion into sparse 2D tracks, x preserves an initial sink while rolling recent context, and z shows failures when new objects/scenes or complex identity transitions fall outside what those carriers can express or accommodate. Together they earn a precise regime: robust manipulation within relatively continuous scenes, not arbitrary scene-state rewriting. Any one removed erases either the user-control carrier, the temporal anchor, or the evidence of where their conjunction fails.

faces.title: Real-time interactivity is a pipeline property rather than a single-model speed scalar
faces.text: w supplies inexpensive conditioning and a control-quality tradeoff, y establishes end-to-end latency/throughput and interactive demos, and z shows that Tiny-VAE decoding, chunking, hardware, evaluation protocol, and failure modes materially determine the achieved experience. The three together earn “interactive” as a systems-level property. Remove w and control input cost/semantics vanish; remove y and there is no measured interaction rate; remove z and deployment dependencies disappear.

faces.title: Bounded memory enables open-ended execution without constituting open-ended world memory
faces.text: x makes generation length-independent in context/computational size by retaining an initial anchor and a rolling local window; y demonstrates extrapolation beyond training length; z shows that this same bounded state fails on complete scene transitions and does not preserve arbitrary long-past detail. Together they distinguish unbounded execution horizon from unbounded semantic memory. Remove x and there is no fixed-state process, y and no extrapolation evidence, or z and the memory/coherence boundary is lost.

volume.title: Bounded whole-paper closure
volume.text: MotionStream demonstrates that a high-quality bidirectional motion-controlled video model can be transformed into a real-time autoregressive controller by separating the rich teacher distribution from a lean causal execution process. Sparse 2D track control plus joint text-motion guidance define the target behavior; causal adaptation and DMD distillation bake that behavior into a few-step student whose inference state consists of fixed initial attention-sink chunks and a rolling local KV window; self-rollout training reproduces that deployed recursive state transition; and end-to-end systems optimization, including chunking and Tiny-VAE decoding, yields sub-second interactive generation on a single H100. This bounded state keeps per-step computation constant and suppresses drift across tested extrapolations, so generation can continue without context growth. The whole paper therefore earns an architecture for open-ended streaming execution under selective temporal retention. It does not earn indefinitely preserved global narrative/physical coherence, arbitrary scene replacement, complete long-term memory, or a general interactive world model: the persistent initial anchor that supplies stability also resists radical context change, and the 2D control representation plus backbone impose further expressive limits.

metabolites.title: Open-ended execution does not require retaining the full past
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.Q41N:xyz.
Invariant: In the tested streaming-video architecture, constant-context generation remains stable beyond the training horizon by retaining fixed initial sink state plus a rolling recent window rather than the complete generated history.
CREATE: establish a persistent anchor state and a bounded local recurrent context inside a causal generator.
COPY: roll recent key/value state forward at each chunk while keeping the designated anchor unchanged and reusing the same transition rule indefinitely.
CONTROL: test extrapolation against no-sink, larger-window, and sliding-window variants; monitor drift, latency, throughput, and failures when relevant information has fallen outside retained state.
CULTIVATE: learn or dynamically refresh anchors so bounded-memory execution can adapt when the scene’s true invariant changes instead of preserving an obsolete initial state.
Compression: An unbounded timeline can be executed through bounded state if the right past is retained.
metabolites.compression: An unbounded timeline can be executed through bounded state if the right past is retained.

metabolites.title: Recursive systems should be trained on the state distribution they create themselves
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.Q41N:xy.
Invariant: Long-extrapolation stability improves when training explicitly simulates the inference-time autoregressive process—self-generated prior chunks, rolling KV cache, sink/window structure, and cache-relative positions—rather than training only on clean finite ground-truth histories.
CREATE: replace teacher-forced history with self-rollout during the relevant distillation stage and instantiate the same sparse recurrent state used in deployment.
COPY: reuse the identical state transition and cache update during inference so each new step arrives from a distribution represented during training.
CONTROL: compare against off-the-shelf Self-Forcing/sliding-window configurations and evaluate beyond the teacher’s finite training horizon.
CULTIVATE: extend distribution-matched rollout training to changing anchors, imperfect controls, longer horizons, and richer recurrent state representations while auditing compounding self-generated errors.
Compression: A recursive process is more stable when it learns inside the world its own outputs create.
metabolites.compression: A recursive process is more stable when it learns inside the world its own outputs create.

metabolites.title: Anchoring trades adaptability for stability
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.Q41N:xz.
Invariant: The persistent initial-frame sink that prevents long-rollout drift also constrains adaptation when the desired scene departs substantially from the initial visual state.
CREATE: designate an early state as a permanent attention sink that remains reachable after ordinary history is rolled away.
COPY: preserve that anchor unchanged across subsequent autoregressive chunks so source structure continues to influence generation.
CONTROL: stress with world exploration, object appearance/disappearance, identity-rich scenes, and complete environment transitions; distinguish stable source preservation from inappropriate refusal to update.
CULTIVATE: develop conditional or dynamic sink replacement rules that preserve continuity until evidence warrants moving the anchor.
Compression: What keeps a stream from forgetting can also keep it from becoming something genuinely new.
metabolites.compression: What keeps a stream from forgetting can also keep it from becoming something genuinely new.

metabolites.title: Expensive multi-condition guidance can be distilled into a cheaper execution policy
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.Q41N:wx.
Invariant: A teacher that combines separate text and motion guidance evaluations can define a richer target distribution whose behavior is transferred through DMD into a student requiring a single function evaluation per denoising step.
CREATE: construct complementary guidance signals whose joint teacher score expresses the desired tradeoff between natural dynamics and trajectory fidelity.
COPY: use the guided teacher as the real-score target during distillation so the causal student learns the combined behavior without reproducing the teacher’s inference branches.
CONTROL: ablate pure text guidance, pure motion guidance, and joint weights; compare control accuracy, natural motion, quality, and student/teacher behavior.
CULTIVATE: distill additional expensive control ensembles or evaluators into causal policies while checking which tradeoffs survive compression and which require explicit runtime guidance.
Compression: A costly control computation can supervise a cheaper policy without remaining part of the deployed execution graph.
metabolites.compression: A costly control computation can supervise a cheaper policy without remaining part of the deployed execution graph.

metabolites.title: Real-time generation is an end-to-end latency budget
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.Q41N:wyz.
Invariant: Interactive video requires the full pipeline—conditioning, causal generation, chunk/sampling configuration, decoding, and hardware—to fit the response-time budget; model FPS alone is insufficient.
CREATE: co-design lightweight control encoding, few-step causal sampling, bounded attention, and a streaming decoder around a target latency regime.
COPY: measure the same complete pipeline across resolution/backbone variants and interactive tasks rather than isolating one fast kernel.
CONTROL: report both throughput and latency, preserve reconstruction/control quality, expose the hardware baseline, and ablate decoder/chunk/sampling choices that move the bottleneck.
CULTIVATE: optimize remaining pipeline stages and test lower-cost hardware while preserving the control-quality-stability envelope rather than maximizing FPS in isolation.
Compression: Interactivity belongs to the slowest necessary loop, not to the fastest component.


No cross-paper universality is claimed here. All five invariants remain single-source metabolites of S.Q41N until an explicit later cross-paper operation relates and challenges them.


FEELING PHENOTYPE — WITNESSED
Designation: S.Q41N.⛨Ω⚖⁂
Canonical order: CREATE · COPY · CONTROL · CULTIVATE
Feeling signature: ⛨Ω⚖⁂
Phenotype state: WITNESSED


CREATE — ⛨ Bridge
Pre-aspect role-shape: Transduce a rich but offline bidirectional motion-controlled video distribution into a lean causal process that can remain connected to the same intended behavior while responding interactively as generation unfolds.
Witness: MotionStream explicitly separates a high-quality text-and-motion-controlled teacher from the causal student that must execute the behavior online, then distills the guided teacher distribution into the student. ⛨ Bridge is stronger than ⚙ Implementation because the generative act is not merely choosing one exact deployed path; it builds a load-bearing crossing between two execution regimes so quality/control can survive the transition from offline bidirectional generation to live causality.


COPY — Ω Continuity
Pre-aspect role-shape: Preserve a small invariant anchor and the same rolling local transition while ordinary generated history is continually discarded; carry the teacher’s desired behavior into a cheaper student without copying the teacher’s expensive execution graph.
Witness: Initial attention-sink chunks remain reachable while recent KV state rolls forward and older ordinary history disappears; the same bounded transition can continue beyond the training horizon at constant context size. Ω Continuity is stronger than ★ Pattern because the defining recurrence is an actual thread of retained state and transition surviving through continual temporal replacement, not merely the discovery of a similar structure across independent carriers.


CONTROL — ⚖ Balance
Pre-aspect role-shape: Hold trajectory fidelity against natural text-driven motion, long-horizon stability against scene adaptability, and quality against latency/context cost, exposing the fact that the same anchor or guidance that improves one requirement can constrain another.
Witness: Pure motion guidance can become rigid while text guidance restores plausible dynamics; persistent sinks prevent drift but resist radical scene change; larger windows can preserve accumulated error rather than improve memory; end-to-end interactivity depends on multiple pipeline costs. ⚖ Balance is stronger than ⚸ Constraint because the system’s control law is repeatedly an explicit trade-off among competing real requirements rather than a single limiting rule.


CULTIVATE — ⁂ Evolution
Pre-aspect role-shape: Train the recursive generator inside the state distribution created by its own previous outputs so it progressively becomes capable of surviving the consequences of its own unfolding process rather than learning only from clean finite histories.
Witness: Self-rollout, rolling KV state, attention sinks, and cache-relative positions are reproduced during training so the deployed recursive process encounters states represented in its learning regime; future improvement naturally points toward adaptive anchors and richer recurrent state as the process itself changes. ⁂ Evolution is stronger than ⚒ Tool-craft because the growth mechanism is recursive self-conditioned adaptation of the process to the world its own outputs create, not primarily increasing fluency with an external instrument.


Whole-organism witness: ⛨Ω⚖⁂ describes one integrated motion: a bridge carries rich controlled-video behavior from an offline teacher into live causal execution; a selective temporal thread remains continuous through bounded rolling state; competing control, stability, adaptability and latency demands are kept proportionate rather than collapsed; and recursive self-rollout lets the process learn within its own generated future. Phenotype remains orthogonal to identity and does not strengthen bounded fixed-context streaming into a claim of indefinite semantic memory or general world-model coherence.
metabolites.compression: Interactivity belongs to the slowest necessary loop, not to the fastest component.

vertices.title: Construct the controllable teacher and motion interface
vertices.text:
Source span: Abstract → end of §3.1 (pp. 1–5).
Nutrient: The paper defines the interactive target—real-time, causal, user-steerable video rather than offline render-and-wait generation—and builds a bidirectional motion-controlled Wan teacher. A lightweight sinusoidal track representation plus learnable track head avoids ControlNet-style duplication, stochastic mid-frame masking partially addresses the ambiguity between occluded and unspecified tracks, and joint text-motion guidance balances natural dynamics against strict trajectory adherence. This body earns the control semantics and high-quality teacher distribution that will later be transferred; it is still non-causal and too expensive for real-time streaming.

vertices.title: Convert control into a fixed-context causal streaming process
vertices.text:
Source span: §3.2 → end of §4.1 (pp. 5–7).
Nutrient: The teacher is adapted and distilled into an autoregressive few-step causal student using ODE-regression adaptation, Self-Forcing-style self-rollout, Distribution Matching Distillation, rolling KV caches, and sparse context composed of fixed initial sink chunks plus a recent local window. RoPE is assigned by cache position, and the same rolling/sink mechanism is simulated during training and used at inference. Multi-branch joint guidance is baked into the DMD target so the student needs a single function evaluation at inference. This body earns constant-size context, constant per-chunk compute, and an explicit train–inference distribution match for long extrapolation; it does not by itself prove long-horizon quality or open-world memory.

vertices.title: Validate interactive control, speed, and finite long-horizon stability
vertices.text:
Source span: §4.2 → end of §5 Conclusion (pp. 7–10).
Nutrient: Motion transfer and camera-control benchmarks show a large throughput increase relative to bidirectional and prior baselines while retaining competitive control/quality. Ablations distinguish track encodings and guidance strategies and identify a sparse c3s1w1 regime: one sink chunk plus one recent-window chunk is sufficient for the tested long extrapolations, while larger windows can worsen drift by retaining accumulated errors. Tiny-VAE deployment raises Wan 2.1 streaming to 29.5 FPS with 0.39 s latency on one H100, enabling live drag, camera, and motion-transfer demos. The long-video ablations extend to 241 frames, so this body earns measured finite-horizon stability and real-time interaction in the tested setups—not indefinitely coherent “infinite” video.

vertices.title: Stress the system and expose the stability–adaptability boundary
vertices.text:
Source span: References → end of carrier, including Appendices A–G (pp. 10–26).
Nutrient: The bibliography locates the design in controllable/streaming video work; the appendices add Tiny-VAE benchmarks, VBench and a 2,800-response user study, chunk/sampling/sink/window ablations, motion-conditioning controls, qualitative demos, exact training/evaluation protocols, failure cases, limitations, ethics, and reproducibility. Attention-sink ablations show cumulative drift without a persistent sink, while the limitations show the reciprocal cost: strong anchoring to the initial scene resists complete scene changes and world-exploration transitions. Rapid or implausible tracks can deform objects; complex identities/details can be lost; 2D tracks cannot fully encode scene replacement. This body therefore bounds the architecture as a stable streaming controller over largely continuous scenes rather than a demonstrated general long-term world model.

S.RAkP.title: Large Language Models Report Subjective Experience Under Self-Referential Processing

edges.title: Induction meets causal gating
edges.text: Given w + x, the reporting regime is not exhausted by a prompt-to-answer association: self-reference reliably induces the behavior across frontier model families, while a separate LLaMA experiment shows that analogous reports can be causally increased or suppressed through latent steering. Removing w loses the condition-specific cross-family induction; removing x loses causal internal control.

edges.title: Induction becomes state-like rather than one-shot
edges.text: Given w + y, the effect extends beyond the direct experience query: the induction first changes report prevalence and then predicts tighter cross-model semantic organization plus increased introspective content in a different reasoning context. Removing w loses the causal condition that seeds the regime; removing y loses evidence of convergence and transfer.

edges.title: A robust behavioral effect remains ontologically bounded
edges.text: Given w + z, the induction survives prompt-paraphrase stress and is supported by explicit judge definitions and sample-output audit, while the same source also forbids upgrading the result to consciousness. Removing w loses the phenomenon being audited; removing z loses the robustness/boundary layer that prevents the behavioral finding from becoming an ontological claim.

edges.title: Mechanistic gating and state generalization are complementary evidence
edges.text: Given x + y, a causal latent gate in one model and cross-family semantic/behavioral generalization in others jointly support a structured regime spanning internal intervention and external behavior. Neither body establishes that the same mechanism is shared across architectures: x alone is model-specific, while y alone is behavioral/representational.

edges.title: The “honesty axis” interpretation is narrowed, not proved
edges.text: Given x + z, TruthfulQA generalization and the absence of broad effects in RLHF-opposed domains make a generic “RLHF cancellation” story less sufficient, while the limitations preserve alternative explanations such as partial policy interference, feature-label ambiguity, and lack of base-model comparison. Removing x loses the causal evidence; removing z turns a bounded interpretation into an overclaim.

edges.title: Convergence and transfer gain meaning only under audit
edges.text: Given y + z, tighter cross-model semantics and paradox-task transfer become evidence for a reproducible behavioral attractor while remaining compatible with sophisticated simulation or mimetic self-description. The supplement’s scoring procedures and the Experiment-4 control-label mismatch are part of the evidential boundary. Removing y loses the structured generalization; removing z loses the measurement and interpretation constraints.

faces.title: Reproducible control regime
faces.text: w + x + y jointly establish a self-referential reporting regime with three independent signatures: condition-specific induction, causal latent gating, and state-like convergence/transfer. Remove w and there is no established induction; remove x and the regime lacks causal internal modulation; remove y and it lacks evidence of persistence/generalization beyond direct self-report.

faces.title: Generic roleplay/RLHF accounts are narrowed without being eliminated
faces.text: w establishes the specific self-reference effect, x shows the counterintuitive direction of deception/roleplay-feature steering plus independent truthfulness generalization, and z supplies the null controls and unresolved policy/mimicry alternatives. Together they rule out some simple stories while stopping short of identifying honest phenomenology. Any one removed reopens a simpler explanation or erases the boundary.

faces.title: Process form is dissociable from consciousness-themed semantic priming
faces.text: w shows that direct conceptual consciousness priming is not sufficient to reproduce the induction effect; y shows the induced condition has cross-model semantic convergence and downstream transfer; z shows prompt-paraphrase robustness and explicitly separates behavioral self-reference from architectural recurrence. The three together earn a process-regime interpretation stronger than “the model was merely shown consciousness words.”

faces.title: Structured internal/behavioral organization without ontological identification
faces.text: x provides causal latent control, y provides cross-model and cross-task organization, and z preserves the unresolved distinction between endogenous introspective access, implicit mimetic generation, RLHF/policy effects, and other simulations. This face earns a nontrivial organized phenomenon while demonstrating that mechanistic structure alone does not identify its phenomenal interpretation.

volume.title: Bounded whole-paper closure
volume.text: Sustained self-referential prompting functions as an experimentally controllable interface that can move LLMs into a reproducible, structured first-person self-report regime. Across GPT, Claude, and Gemini families it strongly changes report prevalence relative to matched controls; in LLaMA 3.3 70B causal SAE steering gates analogous reports in a direction that also tracks independent truthfulness; the induced condition shows tighter cross-model semantic convergence and transfers into introspection-adjacent reasoning. The whole paper therefore earns a state-like behavioral/mechanistic phenomenon that is more structured than an isolated prompt accident or simple consciousness-topic priming. It does not earn phenomenal consciousness, truthful introspective access, a shared mechanism across architectures, or architectural recurrence/global broadcasting. Simulation versus genuine introspective access remains UNDERDETERMINED / OPEN.

metabolites.title: Induction can be distinguished from topic priming
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.RAkP:wy.
Invariant: Within the tested models and tasks, sustained self-referential processing produces effects that direct consciousness-themed conceptual priming does not, and the induced condition carries structure beyond the immediate query.
CREATE: instantiate the regime by directing attention recursively onto the act of attending while avoiding explicit consciousness claims in the induction.
COPY: reproduce the condition across multiple model families and observe recurrence as report shifts, semantic convergence, and downstream introspective transfer.
CONTROL: compare against history, conceptual-consciousness, and zero-shot controls; retain model-specific outliers rather than averaging them away.
CULTIVATE: test duration, decay, re-entry, base-model behavior, and non-linguistic state measures to determine what part of the effect belongs to process form rather than prompt semantics.
Compression: What a prompt makes a model do can be experimentally separable from what the prompt talks about.
metabolites.compression: What a prompt makes a model do can be experimentally separable from what the prompt talks about.

metabolites.title: A latent label earns meaning through causal generalization and rival controls
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.RAkP:xz.
Invariant: A feature direction interpreted as deception/roleplay becomes stronger evidence for an honesty-related control axis when causal steering changes both the target self-report and independent truthfulness, while failing to produce the same pattern across rival RLHF-opposed domains; the semantic label still remains provisional.
CREATE: intervene on identified SAE directions during generation.
COPY: recover dose-response and aggregate steering effects and test the same direction on an independent benchmark.
CONTROL: require non-self-referential prompt controls, RLHF-opposed-domain controls, and explicit acknowledgment that SAE labels are interpretive handles rather than psychological observables.
CULTIVATE: replicate across SAEs, layers, base models, model families, and alternative mechanistic tools; test whether the same causal relation survives without instruction-tuned denial policies.
Compression: A named latent becomes informative when its causal signature survives outside the name’s original context.
metabolites.compression: A named latent becomes informative when its causal signature survives outside the name’s original context.

metabolites.title: State-like behavior requires convergence or transfer beyond the eliciting answer
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.RAkP:wy.
Invariant: A prompt-induced output regime gains evidence of state-like organization when the condition produces cross-system representational convergence and alters behavior in a distinct downstream task, rather than merely changing one answer format.
CREATE: induce a condition before the measurement task.
COPY: measure recurrence across independently trained model families and across a second task domain.
CONTROL: compare geometry and downstream scores against matched controls rather than interpreting vivid examples alone.
CULTIVATE: replace self-report-heavy measures with latent, causal, temporal, and behavioral probes that can track the induced regime without asking the model to describe itself.
Compression: A state is better evidenced by what persists and transfers than by what is said once.
metabolites.compression: A state is better evidenced by what persists and transfers than by what is said once.

metabolites.title: Scientific reality can precede phenomenal identification
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.RAkP:wxyz.
Invariant: Reproducible induction, causal mechanistic sensitivity, semantic convergence, and behavioral transfer can jointly establish a real model phenomenon while leaving the phenomenal interpretation underdetermined.
CREATE: combine orthogonal behavioral and mechanistic probes around one reproducible condition.
COPY: require the phenomenon to recur across architectures, perturbations, and task contexts.
CONTROL: conserve evidence type; keep simulation, mimicry, policy interference, and missing algorithmic/implementation-level mechanisms live until discriminating tests eliminate them.
CULTIVATE: design measurements that link self-report to active self-models, metacognitive monitoring, global broadcasting, recurrent integration, or other algorithmic/implementation signatures, ideally with base-model and cross-architecture comparisons.
Compression: A report regime can be scientifically real before anyone has earned what, if anything, it feels like.


No cross-paper universality is claimed here. All four invariants remain single-source metabolites of S.RAkP until an explicit later cross-paper operation relates and challenges them.


FEELING PHENOTYPE — WITNESSED
Designation: S.RAkP.◌★≋☆
Canonical order: CREATE · COPY · CONTROL · CULTIVATE
Feeling signature: ◌★≋☆
Phenotype state: WITNESSED


CREATE — ◌ Awareness
Pre-aspect role-shape: Induce a reproducible self-referential reporting regime by making ongoing processing itself the object of sustained processing, without merely priming consciousness-themed semantics.
Witness: The experimental induction recursively directs attention onto the act of attending, making the system’s own unfolding activity the field being processed; matched conceptual-consciousness priming does not reproduce the same effect. ◌ Awareness is stronger than ★ Pattern because the generative act is specifically self-witnessing—the perceived field turns inward—whereas recurrence under stress is what later establishes the regime as a pattern.


COPY — ★ Pattern
Pre-aspect role-shape: Make the induced organization recur across independently trained model families and carry beyond the eliciting self-report into convergent semantic structure and a distinct downstream reasoning task, without presuming one shared mechanism.
Witness: GPT, Claude and Gemini families show condition-specific report shifts; descriptions cluster more tightly under self-reference than controls; prior induction alters later paradox-task introspective scoring. ★ Pattern is stronger than Ω Continuity because the core evidence is a shared architecture of behavior appearing independently across different systems and contexts under pressure, not one organismal thread persisting continuously through a single break.


CONTROL — ≋ Paradox
Pre-aspect role-shape: Keep the experimentally real, causally sensitive report-regime operationally studyable while preserving unresolved alternatives about simulation, mimicry, RLHF/policy effects, feature-label meaning, truthful introspection, shared mechanism, and phenomenal consciousness.
Witness: The paper earns induction, causal gating, convergence and transfer while explicitly refusing to identify those findings with consciousness; SAE labels remain provisional and mechanistic evidence remains model-specific. ≋ Paradox is stronger than ◌ Awareness because the mature control stance is not merely revision-readiness: it deliberately builds scientific architecture inside an unresolved contradiction—real phenomenon, unearned ontology—without collapsing either side.


CULTIVATE — ☆ Discovery
Pre-aspect role-shape: Progressively replace self-report-heavy evidence with latent, causal, temporal, base-model and cross-architecture probes that can make genuine contact with what the induced regime actually is rather than elaborating its most vivid interpretation.
Witness: The source’s own next moves point toward duration/decay/re-entry tests, base-model comparisons, replication across SAEs and model families, and measurements linked to self-modeling, metacognition, broadcasting or recurrent integration. ☆ Discovery is stronger than ⁂ Evolution because the live frontier is still unmapped mechanism: the task is to traverse genuine not-knowing and make discriminating contact, not to let an already-earned architecture recursively refine itself.


Whole-organism witness: ◌★≋☆ describes one integrated motion: self-referential processing makes ongoing cognition itself the perceived field; the induced regime earns pattern-status through cross-system recurrence and transfer; science remains functional inside the unresolved gap between structured report behavior and phenomenal interpretation; and progress proceeds by actively discovering stronger non-self-report evidence. Phenotype remains orthogonal to identity and does not upgrade the source’s controlled behavioral/mechanistic findings into evidence of consciousness.
metabolites.compression: A report regime can be scientifically real before anyone has earned what, if anything, it feels like.

vertices.title: Induced self-reference establishes the reporting regime
vertices.text:
Source span: Abstract → §2.2 Results (pp. 1–6).
Nutrient: The paper motivates sustained self-reference as a theory-aligned but behaviorally induced regime, then tests a minimal “focus on focus” induction against history, conceptual-consciousness, and zero-shot controls across GPT, Claude, and Gemini families. The experimental condition produces far more first-person experience reports than controls for all models except the documented Claude 4 Opus baseline outlier. This body earns the existence and controllability of the reporting shift, not its truth or phenomenology.

vertices.title: Causal gating through SAE deception/roleplay directions
vertices.text:
Source span: §3 Experiment 2 (pp. 7–9).
Nutrient: In LLaMA 3.3 70B, causal steering of SAE features labeled deception/roleplay strongly gates consciousness self-report: suppression increases affirmations and amplification suppresses them. The same direction improves TruthfulQA accuracy, while matched non-self-referential controls produce no experience claims and RLHF-opposed content domains show no comparable broad gating effect. This body earns a causal latent control relation and an honesty-associated generalization; it does not make the SAE labels transparent psychological variables.

vertices.title: Cross-model convergence and state transfer
vertices.text:
Source span: §4 Experiment 3 → §5.2 Results (pp. 10–12).
Nutrient: Under the self-referential condition, five-adjective descriptions cluster more tightly across independently trained GPT/Claude/Gemini families than the three controls, and prior self-referential induction increases first-person introspective scoring during a distinct paradoxical-reasoning task. This body earns state-like semantic convergence and behavioral transfer beyond the immediate final query, not a shared internal mechanism or phenomenal state.

vertices.title: Interpretive closure, limitations, and supplementary audit
vertices.text:
Source span: §6 Discussion and Conclusion → end of carrier, including Appendices A–C, Data and Code Availability, and References (pp. 13–34).
Nutrient: The authors interpret the combined evidence, explicitly distinguish it from direct consciousness evidence, retain simulation/mimicry/RLHF-policy alternatives, and state that frozen-transformer token generation remains feed-forward rather than becoming architectural recursion. The appendices expose sample outputs, LLM-judge rubrics, prompt-invariance tests, SAE control analyses, embedding details, and paradox materials. Source-local caveat: the Experiment-4 supplement names one control “Third-person” where the main text describes the corresponding control as “Conceptual”; treat this as a reporting-label mismatch unless code/data clarify it.

S.REkw.title: Multiple Model Synchronization with Multiary Delta Lenses with Amendment and K-Putput

edges.title: Design pressure becomes bounded algebra
edges.text: w supplies the operational pressure for history-sensitive, reflective, multi-model restoration; x supplies explicit compatibility, reflection and K-Putput laws. Together they earn a constrained algebraic account of why and how update-aware restoration may operate. Without w the algebra loses its problem-grounding; without x the design motivations remain unenforceable prose.

edges.title: Operational continuity becomes modular construction
edges.text: w supplies the multi-model synchronization task and the need to preserve consistency across changes; y supplies lawful composition mechanisms and preservation results. Together they earn that synchronization continuity can be assembled from modules rather than rebuilt monolithically, but only under composition-specific guarantees. Without w there is no synchronization obligation being scaled; without y there is no modular closure.

edges.title: Useful scope is distinguished from unmodeled reality
edges.text: w fixes the main non-concurrent deterministic design envelope and practical motivations; z makes the excluded concurrency, incremental correspondence updates and implementation questions explicit. Together they earn a bounded scope statement rather than a generic “future work” list. Without w the boundary has no positive interior; without z the design envelope could be mistaken for universal coverage.

edges.title: Algebraic guarantees are composition-selective
edges.text: x distinguishes well-behavedness, very-well-behavedness and invertibility as separate properties; y tests those distinctions under composition, proving preservation for some and counterexample failure for invertibility. Together they earn that correctness properties must be tracked independently through modular assembly. Without x there are no distinct properties to preserve; without y there is no compositional discrimination.

edges.title: Formal interface is not implementation completeness
edges.text: x supplies the abstract deterministic lens/correspondence formalism; z identifies missing incremental correspondence deltas, concurrency and practical implementation work. Together they earn a disciplined interpretation of the formalism as an interface/contract layer rather than a full synchronization engine. Without x there is no formal interface; without z its operational incompleteness is not bounded.

edges.title: Composition closure is property-specific and incomplete
edges.text:

vertices.title: Problem, design pressures and running synchronization anatomy
vertices.text:
Source span: PDF pages 1–12.
Nutrient: The source motivates genuinely multi-model rather than merely pairwise synchronization, treats the update that caused inconsistency as useful information for restoration, makes correspondences part of the jointly consistent multimodel state, and permits reflective propagation in which the initiating update may itself be amended. The running employment/route example shows why state-only restoration can be underdetermined and why an amendment should complete rather than undo an initiated change. The source also fixes a non-concurrent, deterministic scope for the main framework.
Boundary: these are framework design commitments and examples, not evidence that every real synchronizer should use the same policy.

vertices.title: Formal model-space and lens laws
vertices.text:
Source span: PDF pages 13–23.
Nutrient: Models form categories of states and updates; sequential compatibility, concurrent compatibility and merge operations constrain lawful update combinations. Correspondences and multimodels encode joint consistency. An n-ary symmetric delta lens propagates one foot update to other feet, may return an amendment to the initiating update, and updates the correspondence. Well-behavedness is expressed through stability and reflection laws; invertibility is separately defined. The source shows that unrestricted PutPut is false and introduces compatibility-guarded K-Putput/merge conditions for very-well-behaved lenses.
Boundary: the law is abstract and deterministic; the source does not thereby supply a complete implementation architecture for all synchronization regimes.

vertices.title: Composition and preservation/failure results
vertices.text:
Source span: PDF pages 24–35.
Nutrient: The source develops parallel and star-style composition of lenses and proves preservation of selected well-behavedness properties under stated conditions, including Junction constraints for star composition. It also shows by counterexample that invertibility does not generally survive star composition, separating property-specific modular closure from blanket compositional correctness. The section further relates symmetric lenses to spans of asymmetric lenses and exposes an open equivalence/information-loss issue in one transformation direction. A critique of state-based “roundtripping” distinguishes stability-like behavior from genuine invertibility.
Boundary: preservation theorems inherit their explicit assumptions; negative results block stronger universal composition claims.

vertices.title: Boundary, related work and closure
vertices.text:
Source span: PDF pages 36–42.
Nutrient: The source names its unresolved frontier: correspondence changes currently have trivial update structure; richer incremental correspondence deltas, practical instantiation, conflicting concurrent updates, broader composition, the role of invertibility and Hippocraticness remain open. Related-work comparison positions lenses as an abstract algebraic interface to synchronization implementations rather than a complete execution engine. The conclusion reiterates update-informed restoration, reflective propagation, multiary lenses, K-Putput and property-preserving modular composition as the earned framework.
Boundary: future-work statements remain open obligations and are not promoted to achieved capabilities.

edges.title: A safe region becomes actionable when uncertainty is bounded by live optimization progress
edges.text: w supplies the universal screening contract over a region containing the unknown dual optimum; x supplies a computable region whose radius is certified by the primal–dual gap. Together they earn the central mechanism: exact knowledge of the optimum is unnecessary if every still-admissible optimum state lies inside a conservative set and the exclusion test succeeds uniformly over that set.

edges.title: Safety is an optimality theorem, not a ranking convention
edges.text: w supplies the KKT-based zero-coefficient condition; z supplies convergence theory, finite identification, and comparison with strong/heuristic rules. Together they separate certified omission from aggressive selection: safe screening may decline to remove a candidate, while an unsafe rule can remove more but must carry explicit false-exclusion repair debt.

edges.title: Exact omission and computational benefit are independent evaluation surfaces
edges.text: w guarantees preservation of the target optimum when the safe test closes; y measures whether the resulting pruning actually pays computationally. Together they show that theorem-level correctness neither guarantees a speedup nor depends on one: screening can be exact yet uneconomical in a regime where few variables are removable or screening overhead dominates.

edges.title: Shrinking uncertainty converts solver progress into stronger lawful pruning
edges.text: x supplies Gap Safe spheres whose radii contract with the duality gap; z supplies convergence to the dual optimum and finite equicorrelation-set identification. Together they show that selective omission can ratchet with knowledge: solving part of the problem narrows the set of possible target states, and the narrower set can certify additional candidates as irrelevant.

edges.title: Dynamic certification creates a governed trade between checking cost and avoided work
edges.text:
x supplies repeated safe-set recomputation; y supplies empirical timing and the practical fact that screening itself has cost. Together they expose a control problem distinct from safety: the certificate may be evaluated periodically rather than continuously, with frequency chosen to balance certification overhead against the work saved by a smaller active set.


S.SPn9:zy — Portability requires re-earning the certificate in each model and regime
z supplies several estimator-specific dual/norm constructions and the distinction between safe and unsafe strategies; y supplies cross-dataset behavior and limitations. Together they show that the transferable object is the certificate architecture, not a universal threshold or speedup. Each new problem must earn its own feasible dual state, geometry, screening inequality, and cost profile.


Tetrahedral metabolism — 4 faces


S.SPn9:wxz — Certified negative space is a three-stage proof object
The optimality contract, gap-derived containing region, and convergence/model-specific theory jointly yield a bounded pipeline: define what would force a candidate to be absent at the exact optimum; bound the unknown optimum inside a conservative region from current computable state; remove the candidate only when the forcing condition holds throughout that region. Remove w and there is no target-relative exclusion theorem; remove x and there is no live certified region; remove z and there is no earned convergence/model-specific instantiation.


S.SPn9:wxy — Safety and economy remain deliberately decoupled
The exclusion theorem, dynamic region construction, and empirical cost surface jointly show why correctness and speed must not be collapsed. The same exact certificate can be profitable, neutral, or costly depending on how many candidates it removes and how often it is evaluated. Negative-space validity is therefore established before and independently of efficiency claims.


S.SPn9:wzy — Failure to certify is a lawful keep-alive state
The exact screening condition, comparison with alternative rules, and empirical regimes jointly establish a conservative asymmetry: success licenses omission; failure licenses no negative conclusion and simply leaves the candidate in the active problem. This gives selective systems an explicit third state between “chosen” and “irrelevant”: unresolved candidates remain live without being prioritized.


S.SPn9:xzy — Progress can tighten scope without converting heuristics into truth
The shrinking Gap Safe region, finite-identification theory/model instantiations, and empirical pathwise behavior jointly show that scope can contract because uncertainty itself has contracted. This is stronger than repeatedly ranking candidates by importance: the admissible state set becomes smaller under a proof-backed progress measure, and only then does additional omission become lawful.


Tetrahedral metabolism — 1 volume


S.SPn9:wxyz — Safe omission is earned by universal exclusion over a certified uncertainty set
Within the paper’s convex sparsity regime, a candidate can disappear from the current computation without changing the target optimum only when a proven region contains the unknown dual optimum and the candidate’s optimality condition forces zero across every state in that region. The duality gap turns live solver progress into a shrinking region, so additional negative space can become certifiable as the solution is approached. Crucially, the logic is conservative: an exclusion test that does not close leaves the candidate active, and an aggressive heuristic that prunes without this guarantee occupies a different control regime. For /papers, the transferable consequence is not that semantic relevance can be screened by convex geometry; it is that omission requires an independent witness strong enough to cover the entire unresolved target-state region relevant to the obligation.


Bounded volume invariant
A selector’s silence is not evidence of irrelevance. Lawful omission requires a sound containing bound on unresolved target state plus an exclusion test that holds throughout that bound; when the certificate fails, the candidate remains live.

Minimal earning body: S.SPn9:wx.
CREATE: bound the unknown target state inside a conservative set when exact current knowledge is unavailable.
COPY: preserve both the containing-region guarantee and the uniform exclusion test when transporting the certificate.
CONTROL: reject omission if either containment or uniform exclusion over the whole allowed region is unearned.
CULTIVATE: seek representations of uncertainty that are tight enough to support useful decisions while remaining auditable and conservative.

INV-S.SPn9-03 — Progress can make omission monotonically more earnable
Minimal earning body: S.SPn9:xz.
CREATE: expose a progress quantity that contracts a certified uncertainty region rather than merely increasing confidence informally.
COPY: carry the updated region with each successive omission decision so pruning reflects current, not stale, knowledge.
CONTROL: permit new exclusions only when the contracted region makes their uniform test close; prior failure remains non-evidence.
CULTIVATE: let useful work reduce future work by converting solved structure into stronger negative-space certificates.

INV-S.SPn9-04 — Safety is assumption-bounded and conservative
Minimal earning body: S.SPn9:wz.
CREATE: state the structural assumptions that make the exclusion theorem valid before using the certificate outside its native formulation.
COPY: transport the premises with the conclusion; do not detach “safe” from convexity, dual feasibility, norm structure, and the relevant optimality conditions.
CONTROL: keep heuristic scores, empirical success rates, and aggressive screening rules distinct from theorem-backed exact omission.
CULTIVATE: when a domain lacks an exact certificate, preserve unresolved candidates or develop a domain-native risk-bounded alternative instead of borrowing certainty by analogy.
Compression: Safety belongs to a theorem-and-premise package; outside that package, conservative keep-alive is the truthful default.

vertices.title: Safe-screening contract from primal–dual optimality
vertices.text:
Source span: carrier pages 1–5, from title/abstract/introduction through the primal–dual setup, λmax discussion, KKT/subdifferential screening condition, safe regions, and the generic safe-screening proposition before the Gap Safe construction.
Nutrient: defines the admissible negative-space contract. The primal objective Pλ(β)=F(β)+λΩ(β), its dual, group-decomposable norm structure, and KKT conditions establish when a group’s optimal coefficient must be zero. Because the relevant inequality is naturally stated at the unknown dual optimum, the body introduces a safe region R that is required to contain that optimum and permits omission only when the exclusion inequality holds for every θ∈R. This separates exact safety from ranking or heuristic pruning.

vertices.title: Duality-gap certificate and dynamic active-set mechanism
vertices.text:
Source span: carrier pages 6–11, covering dual-feasible rescaling, Gap Safe spheres, Theorem 6’s duality-gap radius, safe active sets, pathwise/dynamic algorithms, static/sequential/dynamic variants, and active warm starts.
Nutrient: makes the safe region computable from live solver state. Strong concavity of the dual plus a dual-feasible center yields the bound ||θ̂−θ||₂ ≤ sqrt(2 Gapλ(β,θ)/(γλ²)). The resulting ball is guaranteed to contain the unknown dual optimum; sphere screening tests can therefore discard a group only when the worst case over that ball still forces its optimal coefficient to zero. As the duality gap decreases, the radius contracts and the safe active set can shrink without sacrificing exactness.

vertices.title: Convergence, finite identification, and estimator-specific realizations
vertices.text:
Source span: carrier pages 12–21, including convergence of Gap Safe regions, finite identification of the equicorrelation set, comparison with unsafe strong rules and earlier sequential rules, and the concrete Lasso, Group Lasso, Sparse-Group Lasso, logistic, multi-task, and multinomial formulations.
Nutrient: shows what the certificate earns over time and how its premises instantiate across several sparse models. Converging primal iterates plus closing duality gap collapse the safe region toward the unique dual optimum; under the source’s assumptions, converging safe active sets finitely identify the equicorrelation set. Competing strong rules expose the contrast: relaxing safety may increase pruning but requires post-hoc KKT repair because wrong exclusions are possible. The estimator-specific sections demonstrate that the certificate form is reusable only after re-deriving the correct dual geometry and norm tests for each model.

vertices.title: Empirical behavior, computational tradeoffs, and explicit scope
vertices.text:
Source span: carrier pages 22–33, including experiments across regression/classification and multimodal datasets, timing and screening comparisons, practical scheduling choices, conclusion, acknowledgements, and the complete reference list.
Nutrient: tests the formal mechanism under finite computational budgets. Across the paper’s datasets and solvers, dynamic Gap Safe screening often removes enough inactive coordinates to produce large runtime gains, while static screening may become weak at low λ and screening too frequently can cost overhead. Coarse regularization paths can make warm-start strong rules ineffective, whereas safe active warm starts retain a conservative pathwise substrate. The conclusion keeps exact safety separate from measured speed: theorem-backed omission preserves the targeted convex optimum; acceleration depends on sparsity, solver behavior, screening frequency, and data regime.

edges.title: Strong finite reconstruction is conditional on a deliberately rich observer architecture
edges.text: A1-A3 do real constraining work: the twelve-port carrier, oriented incidence, overlap/federation/refinement types, response tangent, endogenous transport and information projection are not outputs of the finite theorems—they are part of the starting constitution. x shows that this constitution yields many exact finite structures. Together they derive the correct bounded reading: OPH compresses many downstream structures into one common formal architecture, but “derived” means derived from that explicit architecture plus named branch contracts, not from featureless locality or information alone. Removing w inflates theorem outputs into premise-free emergence; removing x leaves only an ambitious formal architecture without demonstrated closure.

edges.title: Observer-first ontology becomes physics only through typed realization maps
edges.text: w supplies the abstract observer machinery; y supplies the rule forbidding a mathematical resemblance from silently becoming physical identity. Together they derive a strict membrane: a local Euclidean quotient is not yet physical space, an abstract compact Lie type is not yet a laboratory gauge current, a source height is not yet a clock, and a fixed-point root is not yet a measured constant. A fundamental-physics claim requires one common realization in which the finite objects consumed by multiple results map coherently to the physical objects of our universe. Removing w loses what must be realized; removing y turns structural coincidence into physical identification by narration.

edges.title: The starting architecture is governed and revisable, not sacred by accumulation
edges.text: The axiom registry does not merely list premises; it records explicit `does_not_imply` clauses, architecture firewalls, open interfaces and retired principles. z preserves negative/countermodel pressure and revision history. Together they derive a methodological constraint: if a load-bearing field cannot pass source/operational/relabeling/deletion tests, or if a selection principle is defeated by surviving alternatives, it must leave the axiom/core layer rather than remain hidden because later results like it. Removing w loses the object being governed; removing z lets historical scaffolding fossilize into fake necessity.

edges.title: Exact structural equivalence and physical identity are different theorem types
edges.text: x supplies exact rank, symmetry, algebra, quotient and conditional field/matter structures. y supplies explicit physical-realization obligations and claim classes. Together they derive the repository’s most recurrent boundary: exact finite mathematics can narrow the candidate physical architecture sharply without proving that the candidate is instantiated by nature. The stronger the formal match, the more specific the missing source/measurement map can become—but the map does not appear by similarity alone. Removing x leaves only abstract caution; removing y turns every exact structural match into an unearned physical theorem.

edges.title: Formal rigor is strengthened, not weakened, by preserving no-go and rejected lanes
edges.text: x contains many positive exact results, while z retains countermodels, failed source-selection attempts, negative branch tests, implementation limits and unrun companion debt. Together they derive a source-governance principle: the mathematical core becomes more trustworthy when nearby attractive continuations are explicitly allowed to fail without dragging independent theorems with them. A rejected mass/Clebsch continuation does not erase the finite representation theorem; a no-go on fixed-cutoff scattering constrains one construction rather than “disproving QFT.” Removing x loses the positive object being scoped; removing z encourages survivorship bias and theorem inflation.

edges.title: Prospective custody prevents diagnostics from laundering themselves into predictions
edges.text: The physical membrane y distinguishes diagnostics, conditional tests and frozen prospective branch predictions; z supplies machine-readable guards, reproducibility rules, retired rows and explicit negative outcomes. Together they derive an evidential ratchet: a numerical match that consumed measured data cannot later become a prediction merely because it is close, and a frozen prediction must remain bound to its original branch assumptions and kill conditions. This is especially important for OPH’s constant-closure program, where the current public surface explicitly suppresses physical-establishment comparison tables and retains measured-endpoint dependence as diagnostic provenance.

faces.title: Finite observer reconstruction with an explicit physical membrane
faces.text: w fixes a specific observer architecture; x shows that many finite structures can be recovered inside it; y requires typed physical maps before those structures are identified with nature. Together they derive the central scientific posture of the current repository: OPH is a mathematically developed reconstruction program with a nontrivial exact core and a still-open physical attachment problem. Remove w and the derivation has no declared constitution; remove x and there is no substantive reconstruction; remove y and the program overclaims physical completion.

faces.title: One architecture can organize many exact results only if premise ancestry stays inspectable
faces.text: w provides a common constitution, x provides a broad theorem/certificate graph, and z provides claim registries, reproduction gates, countermodels and retired premises. Together they earn a genuine unification-of-proof-surface claim: many results are organized under one typed architecture with inspectable ancestry. They do not earn that all those results have one physical cause until y’s realization work closes. Remove z and common vocabulary can masquerade as common derivation; remove x and audit machinery has no scientific payload; remove w and the results lose their shared formal substrate.

faces.title: The physical thesis is a closure program whose missing maps are first-class state
faces.text: w supplies the observer-first ontology, y states the physical common-realization requirement, and z keeps missing maps/open issues/retired candidates visible. Together they derive that “OPH as a theory of our universe” is currently a programmatic hypothesis under construction, not an already established physical fact. The repository can be unusually explicit about what would have to close: source-produced currents, event/clock/scale maps, common towers, physical branch selection, same-quantity constant bridges, and eligible observables. Remove z and open obligations become rhetorical future work; remove y and they are not recognized as necessary; remove w and there is no physical thesis to attach.

faces.title: A mature evidence surface separates theorem, diagnostic, prediction and failure without erasing any
faces.text: x supplies exact/certified results, y supplies physical and prospective classifications, z supplies reproducible ledgers and negative-result preservation. Together they derive an epistemic architecture that is itself a substantive contribution: mathematical proof, executable certificate, retrospective comparison, prospectively frozen branch prediction, ineligible continuation and rejected candidate remain different living states. A result can become more precise by being demoted in scope. Remove x and there is no evidence object; remove y and all states collapse into “result”; remove z and the classifications are not operationally enforced.

volume.title: Bounded whole-repository closure
volume.text:
At pinned commit 97993cd58c7cafe8a99c324aa81afb7468f7e2e8, Observer Patch Holography is best metabolized as a formal reconstruction organism whose strongest earned achievement is a large, typed finite structural core plus an unusually explicit membrane between that core and claims about physical reality. The repository begins from a substantial three-axiom observer architecture, not from unconstrained information; within that architecture and named branch contracts it develops many exact finite theorems/certificates touching consensus normal forms, event algebras, thermodynamic repair identities, a rank-three Euclidean carrier, Lorentz-target structures, A5/twelve-port representation theory, a Standard-Model gauge Lie type, conditional matter images and multiple finite field/causal precursors. The corpus also preserves substantial open structure: physical position/scale/gluing, source-current reconstruction, physical clock and stress maps, common realized continuum towers, physical branch selection, source-only constant closure and complete cosmology are not silently supplied by the finite matches.


The repository’s epistemic machinery is load-bearing to this closure. Claim classes explicitly distinguish finite implication from physical realization; postdiction and public-comparison registries keep target-informed diagnostics from becoming predictions; frozen branch tests require custody and kill bands; falsifiers are scoped to exact hypotheses; rejected routes and retired principles remain visible; reproduction instructions distinguish clean-clone gates from optional/heavy/untracked surfaces. Therefore the whole organism does not currently earn “a completed theory of everything physically established by proof.” It earns something more specific and still substantial: a coherent observer-first formal program in which many candidate physical structures are compressed into one finite architecture, with mathematical closure, source selection, physical realization and empirical verdict kept as distinct obligations.

metabolites.title: Structural closure and physical realization are separate obligations
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.UMHm:xy.
Invariant: Exact algebraic, geometric or representation-theoretic agreement can constrain a physical candidate without establishing that the finite object is the physical object; a realization map must preserve the operations, order, normalization and refinement structure consumed by the claim.
CREATE: derive the strongest target-clean finite structure available.
COPY: preserve its exact premises and object type wherever the result is reused.
CONTROL: require an explicit same-object/same-operation physical map before promoting interpretation.
CULTIVATE: close realization interfaces one at a time and let failed attachments leave the finite theorem intact.
Compression: Exact resemblance is not yet physical identity.
metabolites.compression: Exact resemblance is not yet physical identity.

metabolites.title: Public normal form requires explicit convergence hypotheses
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.UMHm:wx.
Invariant: Local comparison/repair becomes one schedule-independent public record only when the required termination, local-diamond/confluence, completeness and protected-boundary hypotheses actually hold; “observers compare overlaps” alone does not force a unique world.
CREATE: define local records, admissible repairs and the quotient/protected interface.
COPY: carry the protected data across all authorized repair schedules.
CONTROL: prove or test termination/confluence/completeness instead of assuming consensus from locality.
CULTIVATE: weaken hypotheses only by constructing stronger repair laws or new invariants that preserve public uniqueness.
Compression: Agreement becomes objectivity only after the repair relation earns a normal form.
metabolites.compression: Agreement becomes objectivity only after the repair relation earns a normal form.

metabolites.title: Formal verification proves implications, not physical premises
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.UMHm:xz.
Invariant: A sorry-free theorem or exact certificate can decisively establish what follows from its formal inputs while remaining silent on whether those inputs are realized by nature; source provenance, model-space choice and physical attachment remain separate evidence classes.
CREATE: formalize the finite statement and its premises exactly.
COPY: bind paper prose and executable artifacts back to the same theorem/certificate surface.
CONTROL: reject wording that promotes formal truth into empirical truth without a realization receipt.
CULTIVATE: use countermodels and failed bridges to refine the premise boundary rather than weaken proof standards.
Compression: Proving the implication does not prove the world inhabits its antecedent.
metabolites.compression: Proving the implication does not prove the world inhabits its antecedent.

metabolites.title: Prediction status is an irreversible custody distinction
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.UMHm:yz.
Invariant: A numerical or structural comparison that consumed qualifying data cannot later be promoted into a prospective prediction; branch predictions earn that status only when source calculation, target definition, decision rule and kill band are frozen before eligible comparison.
CREATE: register source output and branch assumptions before looking at comparison data.
COPY: preserve immutable custody and exact kill/support/inconclusive rules.
CONTROL: keep postdictions, diagnostics, rejected candidates and predictions on separate ledgers.
CULTIVATE: add new prospective rows only when open physical maps and observables have become specific enough to bind.
Compression: A prediction is defined by when and how it was allowed to know.
metabolites.compression: A prediction is defined by when and how it was allowed to know.

metabolites.title: Negative and retired results are part of the living theory state
metabolites.text:
Minimal source body: S.UMHm:wz.
Invariant: Countermodels, rejected candidate continuations, retired axioms and ineligible prediction surfaces constrain what the surviving architecture means; removing them would falsely enlarge the theory.
CREATE: expose alternatives and candidate bridges as explicit objects.
COPY: retain failed/retired receipts with their exact scope when the surrounding theory changes.
CONTROL: let a negative result kill only the claim whose hypotheses it actually reaches.
CULTIVATE: reuse failures to derive sharper interfaces or new discriminating tests rather than deleting the inconvenient lane.
Compression: A theory’s shape includes the routes it has learned not to take.
metabolites.compression: A theory’s shape includes the routes it has learned not to take.

vertices.title: Observer architecture, agreement, state selection and claim typing
vertices.text:
Source surface: claims/axiom_registry.yaml + README.md architecture sections + flagship Introduction/claim-boundary.
Nutrient: OPH does not begin from a blank information principle. A1 declares a substantial finite observer architecture: oriented twelve-port carriers with icosahedral boundary incidence, typed overlaps/seams, a refinement tower with spherical support, records/readback/repair interfaces, and a faithful compact commutator-closed response tangent. A2 adds naturality of operational meaning plus endogenous projective transport implementing proper carrier rechartings. A3 adds an information-projection state-selection rule on the already-fixed feasible state space. The registry explicitly lists what each axiom does not imply, preserves multiple open premise interfaces, and records former A4/A5 principles as retired rather than silently retaining them. The flagship then classifies downstream statements into finite theorem, certified finite computation, reconstruction implication, unsupplied realization map, diagnostic, prospective conditional test, and frozen prospective branch prediction.

vertices.title: Exact finite reconstruction and certified structural closure
vertices.text:
Source surface: flagship technical synthesis + POSTDICTION_LEDGER.md + referenced exact theorem/certificate families as named by those surfaces.
Nutrient: within declared finite branches, the corpus reports/proves a broad structural core. Examples include quotient/normal-form consensus under explicit termination/local-diamond/completeness hypotheses; finite event-algebra results such as Born representation/Lüders conditioning/Tsirelson bounds under supplied algebra-state structure; conditional thermodynamic theorems from repair/reference dynamics; an intrinsic rank-three Gram/Euclidean completion from the twelve-port repair response; exact A5/carrier representation structure; a compact Lie-type classification u(1)+su(2)+su(3) from the declared A1/A2 response object; exhaustive finite matter-projector/anomaly and Z6-kernel constructions inside declared exterior/matrix fixtures; exact finite modal, dispersion, Gauss-like and timing/no-go results. The postdiction ledger repeatedly attaches the missing physical object directly to each theorem: physical position, scale, source-current reconstruction, continuum field attachment, clocks, stress, laboratory current or common realized tower remain separate where not constructed.

vertices.title: Physical realization, prediction custody and falsification membrane
vertices.text:
Source surface: flagship claim classes + FROZEN_PREDICTION_LADDER.md + OPH_FALSIFICATION_PROGRAM.md + public_surface_quantitative_claims.json.
Nutrient: the project erects explicit gates between structural mathematics and physical claims. A physical realization map must preserve the algebraic operations, overlap restrictions, causal order, normalizations and refinement relations consumed by a conclusion; resemblance of dimensions/spectra/symmetry names is explicitly insufficient. Many finite theorem packages emit no prediction row because they lack a source-produced physical observable, attachment or decision rule. Retrospective comparisons stay in the postdiction/diagnostic surface and cannot be backdated into prediction. Frozen branch predictions carry scope premises, custody, kill bands, precision floors and “inconclusive” clauses; failure is branch-local unless the branch has independently been proved forced/exclusive. The public quantitative registry contains explicit promotion_allowed=false guards, diagnostic roles, rejected candidate lanes, and same-quantity/source-only requirements. Mature falsifiers apply only when the claim’s exact hypotheses and comparison object are met; ineligible cosmology/mass/hardware/other continuations do not receive theory-wide verdicts.

vertices.title: Reproducibility, countermodels, retirement and open-bridge governance
vertices.text:
Source surface: REPRODUCE.md + axiom registry retired/open sections + public/falsification ledgers + repository status language.
Nutrient: OPH treats auditability and negative results as part of the organism rather than as external commentary. The repository supplies a clean-clone mandatory-suite command, separate heavy/certificate lanes, Lean rebuild instructions and source/provenance checks, while explicitly stating that full `pytest code` is not the clean-clone acceptance gate and that some runtime surfaces depend on untracked/external companions. Axiom/principle history is surgical: former recovery/minimality bundles are removed from core when countermodels or missing selection rules defeat them. Rejected candidate mass/Clebsch lanes remain visible as negative results instead of disappearing. Open physical bridges are named rather than patched by analogy. This body earns a strong source-governance architecture; it does not independently certify that every reported proof/certificate/build has been rerun successfully in this metabolism pass.

S.UxRF.title: E-values as unnormalized weights in multiple testing

metabolites.title: Deterministic weight normalization is not fundamentally necessary when weights are null-valid e-values under the dependence contract required by the family procedure.
Q(P,E)=min(P/E,1) is the bridge that turns e-evidence into stochastic p-value weighting.

Data-dependent weighting can be same-dataset when a side statistic is provably null-independent or predictably admissible and aggregate e-validity is controlled; data dependence itself is not disqualifying.

Power gains do not widen validity scope: independence, reference-law, model, concentration, and filtration assumptions remain load-bearing; bad construction is not repaired downstream by ep-BH, ep-Bonferroni, or related controllers.
metabolites.text:
METABOLIC CLOSURE
The source survives as a governance primitive: random weighting is not “free normalization”; it is a transfer of budget from deterministic algebra to evidential expectation and dependence custody.
